(ghost-fn relaxed_below ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int))

(lemma dup_at (params (s (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (== (idx s i) (idx s j)))

(lemma pigeonhole (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (> (len s) n)
    (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s t)) (< (idx s t) n)))))
  (ensures (has_dup s))
  (decreases n)

    (if (== n 0)

      (if (has_dup s)
        (block)
        (block
          (ghost-let m int (- (len s) 1))

          (ghost-let s2 (seq int) (seq-build m (fn (t1) (if (== (idx s t1) (- n 1)) x (idx s t1)))))

          (call pigeonhole s2 (- n 1))
          (obtain ((a int) (b int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b m)) (== (idx s2 a) (idx s2 b))))
          (if (== (idx s a) (idx s b))
            (call dup_at s a b)
            (if (== (idx s a) x)
              (call dup_at s a m)
              (call dup_at s b m))))))))

(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))

  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1)))
           (== (path_weight g (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (call single_path g b)
        (assert (== (len (drop b 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) a)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b1 (seq int) (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (call path_take g b (- (len b) 1))
        (assert (== (idx b1 0) (idx b 0)))
        (call join_path g a b1)

        (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (assert (connected g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (call path_snoc g s)
        (assert (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g s1) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) (+ (path_weight g b1) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))))))
(lemma split_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))

  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))

    (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
         (and (< (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 1000000000000000)
              (<= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))))))
(ghost-fn complete ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start)) (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))
        (covers g d p)))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq int)) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (< (idx d x) 1000000000000000))
        (and (<= (neg b) (idx d x)) (<= (idx d x) b))))))
(ghost-fn below ((nd (seq int)) (d (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len nd))) (< x (len d)))
        (<= (idx nd x) (idx d x))))))
(ghost-fn edge_ok ((d (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (x int) (t int) (w int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len nd)))) (< (idx d x) 1000000000000000))
            (and (< (idx nd t) 1000000000000000) (<= (idx nd t) (+ (idx d x) w))))))
(ghost-fn relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (ub int) (ib int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x ub) (and (== x ub) (< e ib))))
        (edge_ok d nd x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn updw ((s0 (seq (seq int))) (s1 (seq (seq int))) (v int) (x (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn dup_at ((s (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len s))) (== (idx s a) (idx s b)))))
(ghost-fn cycle_of ((p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))))
  (body (drop (take p (+ b 1)) a)))
(ghost-fn cut_of ((p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))))
  (body (concat (take p (+ a 1)) (drop (drop p b) 1))))

(lemma wf_of (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (wf (view wg)))
  (body (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))))
(lemma weight_from_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (i0 int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i0) (<= i0 i)) (< i (len row))
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= j i))
                                  (!= (get (idx row j) 0) (get (idx row i) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) i0) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i i0))
  (body
    (if (< i0 i)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i0) 0) (get (idx row i) 0)))
        (call weight_from_at row (+ i0 1) i)
        (assert (== (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) i0) (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) (+ i0 1)))))
      (assert (== (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) i0) (get (idx row i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
  (body (call weight_from_at (idx g u) 0 e)))
(lemma edge_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (weights_and_size_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))
           (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
           (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (and (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) -100000) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma connected_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g u t))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u t w0))
    (obtain ((e0 int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) e0) 0) t) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e0) 1) w0))))))
(lemma path_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (start int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (idx p 0) start)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p i)) (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (> i 0)
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
        (call connected_target g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))
      (block))))

(lemma path_take_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))) (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ i 1) k)))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p k) i) (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) i) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))))
(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p k)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (take p k)) k))
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_take_at g p k i))))
(lemma path_drop_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ (+ i k) 1) (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (drop p k) i) (idx (drop p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g (idx p (+ i k)) (idx p (+ (+ i k) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) i) (idx p (+ i k))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ (+ i k) 1))))))
(lemma path_drop (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (drop p k)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (drop p k)) (- (len p) k)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_drop_at g p k i))))
(lemma path_snoc_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit v)) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx p i)))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
               (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_snoc_at g p v i))
    (assert (is_path g r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx r (len p)) v))
    (assert (== (take r (- (len r) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g r) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_join_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g s) (is_path g t) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx t 0))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ i 1) (+ (len s) (- (len t) 1)))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) i) (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len s))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx s i) (idx s (+ i 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) i) (idx s i)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) (+ i 1)) (idx s (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let j0 int (- (+ i 1) (len s)))
        (assert (connected g (idx t j0) (idx t (+ j0 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) i) (idx t j0)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s (drop t 1)) (+ i 1)) (idx t (+ j0 1))))))))
(lemma path_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g s) (is_path g t) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx t 0)))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat s (drop t 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat s (drop t 1))) (+ (len s) (- (len t) 1))))
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_join_at g s t i))))
(lemma weight_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len s) 0) (> (len t) 0) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx t 0)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (concat s (drop t 1))) (+ (path_weight g s) (path_weight g t))))
  (decreases (len t))
  (body
    (if (== (len t) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat s (drop t 1)) s))
        (assert (== (path_weight g t) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let t1 (seq int) (take t (- (len t) 1)))
        (assert (== (len t1) (- (len t) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 0) (idx t 0)))
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat s (drop t 1)))
        (ghost-let r1 (seq int) (concat s (drop t1 1)))
        (call weight_join g s t1)
        (assert (== (len r) (+ (len s) (- (len t) 1))))
        (assert (== (take r (- (len r) 1)) r1))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx t (- (len t) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 2)) (idx t (- (len t) 2))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g r)
                    (+ (path_weight g r1) (get_edge_weight g (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx t (- (len t) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g t)
                    (+ (path_weight g t1) (get_edge_weight g (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx t (- (len t) 1))))))))))
(lemma remove_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (cycle_of p a b))
    (> (len (cycle_of p a b)) 1)
    (== (idx (cycle_of p a b) 0) (idx (cycle_of p a b) (- (len (cycle_of p a b)) 1)))
    (is_path g (cut_of p a b))
    (== (idx (cut_of p a b) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (cut_of p a b) (- (len (cut_of p a b)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (< (len (cut_of p a b)) (len p))
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut_of p a b)) (path_weight g (cycle_of p a b)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let sa (seq int) (take p (+ a 1)))
    (ghost-let sb (seq int) (take p (+ b 1)))
    (assert (== (len sa) (+ a 1)))
    (assert (== (len sb) (+ b 1)))
    (ghost-let cy (seq int) (drop sb a))
    (ghost-let tl (seq int) (drop p b))
    (assert (== (len cy) (+ (- b a) 1)))
    (assert (== (len tl) (- (len p) b)))
    (ghost-let ct (seq int) (concat sa (drop tl 1)))
    (assert (== (cycle_of p a b) cy))
    (assert (== (cut_of p a b) ct))
    (call path_take g p (+ a 1))
    (call path_take g p (+ b 1))
    (call path_drop g sb a)
    (call path_drop g p b)
    (assert (== (idx cy 0) (idx p a)))
    (assert (== (idx cy (- (len cy) 1)) (idx p b)))
    (assert (== (idx sa (- (len sa) 1)) (idx p a)))
    (assert (== (idx sb (- (len sb) 1)) (idx p b)))
    (assert (== (idx tl 0) (idx p b)))
    (assert (== (idx sa 0) (idx p 0)))
    (call path_join g sa tl)
    (call weight_join g sa tl)
    (call weight_join g sa cy)
    (assert (== (concat sa (drop cy 1)) sb))
    (call weight_join g sb tl)
    (assert (== (concat sb (drop tl 1)) p))
    (assert (== (len ct) (+ (+ a 1) (- (- (len p) b) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx ct 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx ct (- (len ct) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (> (len s) n)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s x)) (< (idx s x) n)))))
  (ensures (exists ((a int)) (exists ((b int)) (dup_at s a b))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let lst int (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 lst) (< lst n)))
        (if (exists ((a0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a0) (< a0 (- (len s) 1))) (== (idx s a0) lst)))
          (block
            (obtain ((a1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 a1) (< a1 (- (len s) 1))) (== (idx s a1) lst)))
            (assert (dup_at s a1 (- (len s) 1))))
          (block
            (ghost-let t (seq int)
              (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (m) (if (== (idx s m) (- n 1)) lst (idx s m)))))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1)))
            (assert (forall ((x1 int))
              (=> (and (<= 0 x1) (< x1 (len t))) (and (<= 0 (idx t x1)) (< (idx t x1) (- n 1))))))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1))
            (obtain ((a2 int)) (exists ((b3 int)) (dup_at t a2 b3)))
            (obtain ((b2 int)) (dup_at t a2 b2))
            (assert (!= (idx s a2) lst))
            (assert (!= (idx s b2) lst))
            (assert (dup_at s a2 b2))))))))

(lemma extend_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (wit_entry g start p u du k) (connected g u v) (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (ensures (wit_entry g start (concat p (seq-lit v)) v (+ du w) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (call path_snoc g p v)
    (assert (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v))))
(lemma single_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int))
  (ensures (wit_entry g start (seq-lit start) start 0 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit start)) 1))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))))
(lemma init_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len wit) (len d)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d)))
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len d))) (== (idx d j) (if (== j start) 0 1000000000000000))))
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len wit))) (== (idx wit j) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures (witness_ok g start d wit 0))
  (body (call single_entry g start)))
(lemma witness_weaken (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int))
  (requires (witness_ok g start d wit k))

(lemma bounded_weaken (params (d (seq int)) (b1 int) (b2 int))

(lemma step_below (params (nd0 (seq int)) (nd1 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (v int) (x int))

(lemma step_mono (params (nd0 (seq int)) (nd1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (upd nd0 nd1 v x) (< x (idx nd0 v)))
  (ensures (below nd1 nd0))
  (body))
(lemma step_bounded (params (nd0 (seq int)) (nd1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded nd0 b) (upd nd0 nd1 v x) (<= (neg b) x) (<= x b))
  (ensures (bounded nd1 b))
  (body))
(lemma step_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (nd0 (seq int)) (nw0 (seq (seq int)))
                        (nd1 (seq int)) (nw1 (seq (seq int))) (v int) (x int) (k1 int) (r (seq int)))
  (requires (witness_ok g start nd0 nw0 k1) (upd nd0 nd1 v x) (updw nw0 nw1 v r) (wit_entry g start r v x k1))
  (ensures (witness_ok g start nd1 nw1 k1))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (nd0 (seq int)) (nd1 (seq int)) (ub int) (ib int))
  (requires (relaxed g d nd0 ub ib) (below nd1 nd0) (== (len nd1) (len nd0)))
  (ensures (relaxed g d nd1 ub ib))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_next_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed g d nd u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (edge_ok d nd u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (ensures (relaxed g d nd u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_next_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (relaxed g d nd u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (relaxed g d nd (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))

(lemma cover_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (relaxed g d nd (len g) 0)
            (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (covers g d (take p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (covers g nd p))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
    (ghost-let u0 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (ghost-let t0 int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) u0))
    (assert (connected g u0 t0))
    (call connected_target g u0 t0)
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u0 t0 w0))
    (obtain ((e0 int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u0) (< u0 (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g u0)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u0) e0) 0) t0) (== (get (idx (idx g u0) e0) 1) w0))))
    (call edge_weight g u0 e0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u0 t0) w0))
    (assert (< (idx d u0) 1000000000000000))
    (assert (<= (idx d u0) (path_weight g q)))
    (assert (edge_ok d nd u0 t0 w0))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g q) w0)))))
(lemma base_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) 1))
  (ensures (covers g d p))
  (body
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))))
(lemma complete_base (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0))
  (ensures (complete g start d 0))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call base_at g start d p))))

    (forall ((y int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))) (is some (idx a y)))
          (le_opt (idx b y) (field (idx a y) value)))))))
(ghost-fn relax_ok ((dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (u int) (t int) (c int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dold))) (is some (idx dold u)))
            (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dnew))) (le_opt (idx dnew t) (+ (field (idx dold u) value) c))))))
(ghost-fn relaxed_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (u int) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< e m))))
        (relax_ok dold dnew x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1))))))
(ghost-fn is_walk ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) t)))))
(ghost-fn wit_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (t int) (c int) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (is_walk g start q t) (and (== (path_weight g q) c) (<= (len q) (+ k 1))))))
(ghost-fn all_wit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (< y (len wit))) (is some (idx dist y)))
        (wit_ok g start (idx wit y) y (field (idx dist y) value) k)))))
(ghost-fn all_min ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((q (seq int)) (t int))
    (=> (and (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 1)))
        (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist t) (path_weight g q)))))))
(ghost-fn all_bound ((dist (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (is some (idx dist y)))
        (and (<= (- 0 (* k 100000)) (field (idx dist y) value)) (<= (field (idx dist y) value) (* k 100000)))))))
(ghost-fn changed_at ((dist (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len dist) (len d1)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d1))))
             (and (is some (idx d1 y)) (not (le_opt (idx dist y) (field (idx d1 y) value)))))))
(ghost-fn targets_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn row_distinct ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= i j)))
        (!= (get (idx row i) 0) (get (idx row j) 0))))))
(ghost-fn rows_distinct ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (row_distinct (idx g u))))))
(ghost-fn upd_d ((s0 (seq (option int))) (s1 (seq (option int))) (y int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))))
    (and (and (is some (idx s1 y)) (== (field (idx s1 y) value) c))
         (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s0))) (!= z y)) (== (idx s1 z) (idx s0 z))))))))
(ghost-fn upd_w ((s0 (seq (seq int))) (s1 (seq (seq int))) (y int) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))))
    (and (== (idx s1 y) q)
         (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s0))) (!= z y)) (== (idx s1 z) (idx s0 z))))))))
(ghost-fn injective ((s (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (!= (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
(ghost-fn all_below ((s (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n))))))
(ghost-fn squeeze ((s (seq int)) (n int)) (seq int)
  (requires (> (len s) 0))
  (body (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (i) (if (== (idx s i) (- n 1)) (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx s i))))))
(ghost-fn cut_seq ((q (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len q) (- j i)) (fn (x) (if (<= x i) (idx q x) (idx q (+ x (- j i))))))))
(ghost-fn cycle_seq ((q (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))))
  (body (seq-build (+ (- j i) 1) (fn (x) (idx q (+ i x))))))

(lemma wf_row (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))

  (body))
(lemma wf_view (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))

(lemma target_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) (len g))))

(lemma edge_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))
           (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)))
  (body))
(lemma edge_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (weights_and_size_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (>= (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) -100000) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) 100000)))
  (body (call edge_at g u e)))
(lemma conn_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (t int))
  (requires (connected g u t))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
           (exists ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t))))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (has_edge g u t c))
    (obtain ((e0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g u)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) e0) 0) t) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e0) 1) c))))))
(lemma weight_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (t int) (e int) (i int))
  (requires (row_distinct row) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i e)) (< e (len row)) (== (get (idx row e) 0) t))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row t i) (get (idx row e) 1)))
  (decreases (- e i))
  (body
    (if (< i e)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) (get (idx row e) 0)))
        (assert (== (weight_from row t i) (weight_from row t (+ i 1))))
        (call weight_at row t e (+ i 1)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row t i) (get (idx row i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_w (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int) (t int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u t) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (row_distinct (idx g u)))
    (call weight_at (idx g u) t e 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u t) (weight_from (idx g u) t 0)))))

(lemma ext_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (u int) (t int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) u) (connected g u t) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) i) (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit t) i)
    (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit t) (+ i 1))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len q))
      (assert (connected g (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (+ i 1) (len q)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) (+ i 1)) t))
        (assert (== (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) i) u))))))
(lemma walk_ext (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (u int) (t int))
  (requires (is_walk g start q u) (connected g u t))
  (ensures
    (is_walk g start (concat q (seq-lit t)) t)
    (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit t))) (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g u t)))
    (== (len (concat q (seq-lit t))) (+ (len q) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat q (seq-lit t)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call ext_edge g q u t i))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) t))
    (assert (is_path g r))
    (assert (== (take r (- (len r) 1)) q))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 2)) u))
    (assert (== (path_weight g r)
                (+ (path_weight g (take r (- (len r) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx r (- (len r) 2)) (idx r (- (len r) 1))))))))
(lemma take_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len q))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- m 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take q m) i) (idx (take q m) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take q m i)
    (call law_idx_take q m (+ i 1))
    (assert (connected g (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))))
(lemma walk_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (t int) (m int))
  (requires (is_walk g start q t) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len q))))
  (ensures (is_walk g start (take q m) (idx q (- m 1))) (== (len (take q m)) m))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call take_edge g q m i))
    (assert (== (idx (take q m) 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (take q m) (- m 1)) (idx q (- m 1))))
    (assert (is_path g (take q m)))))
(lemma w_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 2 m) (<= m (len q))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (take q m))
               (+ (path_weight g (take q (- m 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- m 2)) (idx q (- m 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_take_take q m (- m 1))
    (call law_len_take q m)
    (call law_idx_take q m (- m 2))
    (call law_idx_take q m (- m 1))
    (assert (== (take (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1)) (take q (- m 1))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (take q m))
                (+ (path_weight g (take (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 2)) (idx (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1))))))))

(lemma refines_refl (params (a (seq (option int))))

(lemma refines_trans_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (y int))

  (ensures (le_opt (idx c y) (field (idx a y) value)))
  (body

(lemma refines_trans (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))))

(lemma relaxed_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))))

(lemma relax_mono (params (dold (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (x int) (t int) (c int))

(lemma relaxed_mono_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dold (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (u int) (m int) (x int) (e int))
  (requires (relaxed_upto g dold a u m) (refines a b)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
            (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< e m))))
  (ensures (relax_ok dold b x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (relax_ok dold a x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1)))
    (call relax_mono dold a b x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1))))
(lemma relaxed_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dold (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (relaxed_upto g dold a u m) (refines a b))
  (ensures (relaxed_upto g dold b u m))
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int)) (call relaxed_mono_at g dold a b u m x e))))
(lemma relaxed_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len (idx g u))))
            (relaxed_upto g dold dnew u m)
            (relax_ok dold dnew u (get (idx (idx g u) m) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) m) 1)))
  (ensures (relaxed_upto g dold dnew u (+ m 1)))

(lemma min_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (all_min g start dist k) (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist t) (path_weight g q)))
  (body))
(lemma min_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dold k) (refines dold dnew)
            (relaxed_upto g dold dnew (len g) 0)
            (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dnew))) (le_opt (idx dnew t) (path_weight g q)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len q) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (call min_at g start dold k q t)
        (assert (le_opt (idx dnew t) (field (idx dold t) value))))
      (block
        (ghost-let s (seq int) (take q (+ k 1)))
        (ghost-let u int (idx q k))
        (call walk_take g start q t (+ k 1))
        (call min_at g start dold k s u)
        (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) t))
        (assert (connected g (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
        (assert (connected g u t))
        (call conn_edge g u t)
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t)))
        (call edge_w g u e t)
        (assert (relax_ok dold dnew u t (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
        (call w_step g q (+ k 2))
        (call law_take_all q)
        (assert (== (take q (+ k 2)) q))
        (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (path_weight g s) (get_edge_weight g u t))))))))
(lemma min_round (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dold k) (refines dold dnew)
            (relaxed_upto g dold dnew (len g) 0))
  (ensures (all_min g start dnew (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((q (seq int)) (t int)) (call min_step g start dold dnew k q t))))
(lemma min_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (<= k m) (all_min g start dist k) (refines dist dist)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0))
  (ensures (all_min g start dist m))
  (decreases (- m k))
  (body
    (if (< k m)
      (block
        (call min_round g start dist dist k)
        (call min_up g start dist (+ k 1) m))
      (block))))
(lemma walk_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dist k) (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0)
            (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist y) (path_weight g q)))
  (body
    (call refines_refl dist)
    (assert (is_walk g start q y))
    (call min_up g start dist k (+ k (len q)))
    (call min_at g start dist (+ k (len q)) q y)))
(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int) (y int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_wit g start dist wit k) (all_min g start dist k)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0) (== (len wit) (len dist))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))))
  (ensures (match (idx dist y)
    (case (none) (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=> (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))) false)))
    (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start y c))))
  (body
    (forall ((q1 (seq int))) (call walk_le g start dist k q1 y))
    (if (is some (idx dist y))
      (block
        (assert (wit_ok g start (idx wit y) y (field (idx dist y) value) k))
        (assert (is_walk g start (idx wit y) y))
        (assert (is_path g (idx wit y)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start y (field (idx dist y) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma final_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_wit g start dist wit k) (all_min g start dist k)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0) (== (len wit) (len dist)))
  (ensures (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist)))
        (match (idx dist y)
          (case (none) (forall ((q (seq int)))
            (=> (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))) false)))
          (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start y c))))))
  (body (forall ((y0 int)) (call final_at g start dist wit k y0))))

(lemma single_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int))
  (ensures (is_walk g start (seq-lit start) start)

(lemma init_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (q (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (is some (idx dist start)) (== (field (idx dist start) value) 0)
            (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) 1))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist t) (path_weight g q)))
  (body

    (assert (== t start))))
(lemma init_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len wit) (len g))
    (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (== (idx wit y) (seq-lit start))))

    (=> (and (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 1)))
        (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist t) (path_weight g q)))))))
(ghost-fn all_bound ((dist (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (is some (idx dist y)))
        (and (<= (- 0 (* k 100000)) (field (idx dist y) value)) (<= (field (idx dist y) value) (* k 100000)))))))
(ghost-fn changed_at ((dist (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len dist) (len d1)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d1))))
             (and (is some (idx d1 y)) (not (le_opt (idx dist y) (field (idx d1 y) value)))))))
(ghost-fn targets_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn row_distinct ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= i j)))
        (!= (get (idx row i) 0) (get (idx row j) 0))))))
(ghost-fn rows_distinct ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (row_distinct (idx g u))))))
(ghost-fn upd_d ((s0 (seq (option int))) (s1 (seq (option int))) (y int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))))
    (and (and (is some (idx s1 y)) (== (field (idx s1 y) value) c))
         (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s0))) (!= z y)) (== (idx s1 z) (idx s0 z))))))))
(ghost-fn upd_w ((s0 (seq (seq int))) (s1 (seq (seq int))) (y int) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))))
    (and (== (idx s1 y) q)
         (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s0))) (!= z y)) (== (idx s1 z) (idx s0 z))))))))
(ghost-fn injective ((s (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (!= (idx s i) (idx s j))))))

  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n))))))
(ghost-fn squeeze ((s (seq int)) (n int)) (seq int)
  (requires (> (len s) 0))
  (body (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (i) (if (== (idx s i) (- n 1)) (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx s i))))))

  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))))

  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))))

(lemma conn_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (t int))
  (requires (connected g u t))

           (exists ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t))))

  (requires (row_distinct row) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i e)) (< e (len row)) (== (get (idx row e) 0) t))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row t i) (get (idx row e) 1)))
  (decreases (- e i))

            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t))

(lemma ext_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (u int) (t int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) u) (connected g u t) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) i) (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit t) i)
    (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit t) (+ i 1))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len q))
      (assert (connected g (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (+ i 1) (len q)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) (+ i 1)) t))
        (assert (== (idx (concat q (seq-lit t)) i) u))))))
(lemma walk_ext (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (u int) (t int))
  (requires (is_walk g start q u) (connected g u t))

    (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit t))) (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g u t)))
    (== (len (concat q (seq-lit t))) (+ (len q) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat q (seq-lit t)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call ext_edge g q u t i))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) t))
    (assert (is_path g r))
    (assert (== (take r (- (len r) 1)) q))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 2)) u))
    (assert (== (path_weight g r)
                (+ (path_weight g (take r (- (len r) 1)))

(lemma take_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len q))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- m 1))))

  (body

    (call law_idx_take q m (+ i 1))
    (assert (connected g (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))))
(lemma walk_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (q (seq int)) (t int) (m int))
  (requires (is_walk g start q t) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len q))))
  (ensures (is_walk g start (take q m) (idx q (- m 1))) (== (len (take q m)) m))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call take_edge g q m i))
    (assert (== (idx (take q m) 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (take q m) (- m 1)) (idx q (- m 1))))

(lemma w_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 2 m) (<= m (len q))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (take q m))
               (+ (path_weight g (take q (- m 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- m 2)) (idx q (- m 1))))))
  (body

    (call law_len_take q m)
    (call law_idx_take q m (- m 2))
    (call law_idx_take q m (- m 1))
    (assert (== (take (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1)) (take q (- m 1))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (take q m))
                (+ (path_weight g (take (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 2)) (idx (take q m) (- (len (take q m)) 1))))))))

(lemma min_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (all_min g start dist k) (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist t) (path_weight g q)))
  (body))
(lemma min_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dold (seq (option int))) (dnew (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dold k) (refines dold dnew)
            (relaxed_upto g dold dnew (len g) 0)
            (is_walk g start q t) (<= (len q) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len dnew))) (le_opt (idx dnew t) (path_weight g q)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len q) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (call min_at g start dold k q t)
        (assert (le_opt (idx dnew t) (field (idx dold t) value))))
      (block
        (ghost-let s (seq int) (take q (+ k 1)))
        (ghost-let u int (idx q k))
        (call walk_take g start q t (+ k 1))
        (call min_at g start dold k s u)
        (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) t))
        (assert (connected g (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
        (assert (connected g u t))
        (call conn_edge g u t)
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) t)))
        (call edge_w g u e t)
        (assert (relax_ok dold dnew u t (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
        (call w_step g q (+ k 2))
        (call law_take_all q)
        (assert (== (take q (+ k 2)) q))
        (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (path_weight g s) (get_edge_weight g u t))))))))

  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dold k) (refines dold dnew)
            (relaxed_upto g dold dnew (len g) 0))
  (ensures (all_min g start dnew (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((q (seq int)) (t int)) (call min_step g start dold dnew k q t))))
(lemma min_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (<= k m) (all_min g start dist k) (refines dist dist)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0))
  (ensures (all_min g start dist m))
  (decreases (- m k))
  (body
    (if (< k m)
      (block
        (call min_round g start dist dist k)
        (call min_up g start dist (+ k 1) m))
      (block))))
(lemma walk_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (k int) (q (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_min g start dist k) (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0)
            (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (le_opt (idx dist y) (path_weight g q)))
  (body
    (call refines_refl dist)
    (assert (is_walk g start q y))
    (call min_up g start dist k (+ k (len q)))
    (call min_at g start dist (+ k (len q)) q y)))
(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int) (y int))
  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_wit g start dist wit k) (all_min g start dist k)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0) (== (len wit) (len dist))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))))
  (ensures (match (idx dist y)
    (case (none) (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (=> (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))) false)))
    (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start y c))))
  (body
    (forall ((q1 (seq int))) (call walk_le g start dist k q1 y))
    (if (is some (idx dist y))
      (block
        (assert (wit_ok g start (idx wit y) y (field (idx dist y) value) k))
        (assert (is_walk g start (idx wit y) y))
        (assert (is_path g (idx wit y)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start y (field (idx dist y) value))))
      (block))))

  (requires (rows_distinct g) (>= k 0) (all_wit g start dist wit k) (all_min g start dist k)
            (relaxed_upto g dist dist (len g) 0) (== (len wit) (len dist)))
  (ensures (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist)))

            (=> (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))) false)))
          (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start y c))))))
  (body (forall ((y0 int)) (call final_at g start dist wit k y0))))

(lemma new_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int) (u int) (e int) (t int))
  (requires

    (assert (== (len s) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take s (- (len s) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (call path_snoc g s)
    (assert (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))))
(lemma join_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1)))
           (== (path_weight g (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (call single_path g b)
        (assert (== (len (drop b 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) a)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b1 (seq int) (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (call path_take g b (- (len b) 1))
        (assert (== (idx b1 0) (idx b 0)))
        (call join_path g a b1)
        (ghost-let s (seq int) (concat a (drop b 1)))
        (ghost-let s1 (seq int) (concat a (drop b1 1)))
        (assert (== (len s) (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1))))
        (assert (== (take s (- (len s) 1)) s1))
        (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (assert (connected g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (call path_snoc g s)
        (assert (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g s1) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) (+ (path_weight g b1) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))))))
(lemma split_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))) (is_path g (drop p k))
           (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))) (path_weight g (drop p k)))))
  (body
    (call path_take g p (+ k 1))
    (call path_drop g p k)
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ k 1)))
    (ghost-let b (seq int) (drop p k))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
    (call join_path g a b)
    (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) p))))
(lemma cut_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1)))
    (is_path g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1)))
           (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))))
    (< (len (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1))) (len p))
    (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1))
             (- (len (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (> (len (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) 1)
    (== (idx (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 0)
        (idx (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) (- (len (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) 1))))
  (body
    (call split_path g p j)
    (ghost-let t (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let b (seq int) (drop p j))
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop t i))
    (assert (== (len t) (+ j 1)))
    (assert (is_path g t))
    (call split_path g t i)
    (assert (== (take t (+ i 1)) a))
    (assert (is_path g a))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
    (call join_path g a b)
    (assert (== (len (drop b 1)) (- (- (len p) j) 1)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat a (drop b 1)))
    (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))

(lemma connected_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (connected g u v))
  (ensures (exists ((e int)) (edge_idx g u v e)))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (edge_idx g u v i))))
(lemma find_weight (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k i)) (< i (len row)) (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= k j) (< j i)) (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v k) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i k))
  (body (if (< k i) (call find_weight row v i (+ k 1)) (block))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body (call find_weight (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) i 0)))
(lemma edge_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (weights_and_size_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))
           (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
           (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma path_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (idx p 0) start)
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (> t 0)
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t)))
        (call connected_edge g (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))
        (obtain ((e int)) (edge_idx g (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t) e))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- t 1))) e) 0) (idx p t))))
      (block))))

(lemma extend_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g))
            (relaxed_below g dist nd (len g))
            (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2)
            (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 2))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (len dist)))
            (!= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 2))) 1000000000000)
            (<= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 2))) (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len nd)))
                (and (!= (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 1000000000000)
                     (<= (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (ghost-let v int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (call connected_edge g u v)
    (obtain ((e int)) (edge_idx g u v e))
    (call edge_weight g u e)
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v))
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nd))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1))) (get_edge_weight g u v))))
    (assert (!= (idx nd v) 1000000000000))
    (assert (<= (idx nd v) (+ (idx dist u) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))))))
(lemma min_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (b int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g))
            (minimal_k g start dist b) (relaxed_below g dist nd (len g)) (<= (idx nd start) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ b 1)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len nd)))
                (and (!= (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 1000000000000)
                     (<= (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if (>= (len p) 2)
      (block
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 2))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (len dist))))
        (assert (!= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 2))) 1000000000000))
        (assert (<= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 2))) (path_weight g q)))
        (call extend_bound g dist nd p))
      (call single_path g p))))
(lemma min_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g))
            (minimal_k g start dist b) (relaxed_below g dist nd (len g)) (<= (idx nd start) 0))
  (ensures (minimal_k g start nd (+ b 1)))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call min_step g start dist nd b p))))
(lemma min_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) 0))
  (ensures (minimal_k g start dist 1))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call single_path g p))))
(lemma wits_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len wit)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) 0)
            (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist))) (!= w start)) (== (idx dist w) 1000000000000)))
            (== (idx wit start) (seq-lit start)))
  (ensures (wits_ok g start dist wit 1))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (call single_path g (seq-lit start))))
(lemma wits_widen (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (b1 int) (b2 int))
  (requires (wits_ok g start dist wit b1) (<= b1 b2))

(lemma wits_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (nd0 (seq int)) (nwit0 (seq (seq int)))
                         (nd (seq int)) (nwit (seq (seq int))) (v int) (x int) (s (seq int)) (b int))

            (is_path g s) (== (idx s 0) start) (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) v)

(lemma row_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed_row g dist nd u i)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< u (len dist)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len nd)))

  (requires (relaxed_below g dist nd u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (relaxed_row g dist nd u (len (idx g u))))

(lemma fix_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (relaxed_below g dist dist (len g)) (<= (idx dist start) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len dist)))
                (and (!= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 1000000000000)
                     (<= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (>= (len p) 2)
      (block
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (call fix_path g start dist q)
        (call extend_bound g dist dist p))
      (call single_path g p))))
(lemma final_v (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (b int) (v int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (relaxed_below g dist dist (len g)) (<= (idx dist start) 0)
            (wits_ok g start dist wit b)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (=> (== (idx dist v) 1000000000000)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
    (=> (!= (idx dist v) 1000000000000) (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call fix_path g start dist p))
    (if (!= (idx dist v) 1000000000000)
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (idx wit v))
        (assert (is_path g r))
        (assert (== (idx r 0) start))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) v))
        (assert (== (path_weight g r) (idx dist v)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (b int)
                      (out (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (relaxed_below g dist dist (len g)) (<= (idx dist start) 0)
            (wits_ok g start dist wit b)
            (== (len out) (len g)) (out_matches dist out)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx out v)
      (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                     (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
      (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (call final_v g start dist wit b v)
    (assert (== (idx out v) (if (!= (idx dist v) 1000000000000) (some (idx dist v)) (none))))))
(lemma out_all (params (graph weighted_graph) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (b int)
                       (out (seq (option int))))
  (requires (targets_ok (view graph)) (targets_distinct (view graph))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len (view graph))))
            (== (len dist) (len (view graph))) (== (len wit) (len (view graph)))
            (relaxed_below (view graph) dist dist (len (view graph))) (<= (idx dist start) 0)
            (wits_ok (view graph) start dist wit b)
            (== (len out) (len (view graph))) (out_matches dist out))
  (ensures
    (== (len out) (size graph))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph)))
          (match (idx out v)
            (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                           (=> (and (is_path (view graph) p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
            (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v d))))))
  (body
    (assert (== (size graph) (len (view graph))))
    (forall ((v int)) (call out_at (view graph) start dist wit b out v))))
(lemma neg_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (nd (seq int))
                         (nwit (seq (seq int))) (b int) (cv int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== b (len g))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (== (len nwit) (len g))
            (minimal_k g start dist b)
            (wits_ok g start nd nwit (+ b 1))
            (and (<= 0 cv) (< cv (len g)))
            (!= (idx nd cv) 1000000000000)
            (< (idx nd cv) (idx dist cv)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (idx nwit cv))
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) cv))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (idx nd cv)))
    (assert (<= (len p) (+ b 1)))
    (assert (> (len p) b))
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_vertex g start p t))
    (call pigeonhole p (len g))
    (assert (has_dup p))
    (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call cut_path g p i j)
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1)))
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) start))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) cv))
    (assert (<= (len q) b))
    (assert (<= (idx dist cv) (path_weight g q)))
    (assert (< (path_weight g c) 0))
    (assert (is_path g c))
    (assert (> (len c) 1))
    (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))))
    (assert (has_negative_cycle g))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (targets_ok g))
    (assert (targets_distinct g))
    (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (assert (and (<= 0 start) (< start n)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j0) 1000000000000)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (assert (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (!= y start)) (== (idx dist y) 1000000000000))))
    (assert (bounded dist 0))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int)) (seq-build n (fn (j1) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (== (idx wit start) (seq-lit start)))
    (call wits_init g start dist wit)
    (call min_init g start dist)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (while (< k n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (< k n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (<= (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (bounded dist (* k 100000)))
      (invariant (wits_ok g start dist wit (+ k 1)))
      (invariant (minimal_k g start dist (+ k 1)))
      (decreases (- n k))
      (let-mut nd (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j2) (idx dist j2))))
      (ghost-let-mut nwit (seq (seq int)) wit)
      (let-mut changed bool false)
      (ghost-let-mut cv int 0)
      (assert (== nd dist))
      (assert (le_all nd dist))
      (call bound_widen dist (* k 100000) (* (+ k 1) 100000))
      (call wits_widen g start dist wit (+ k 1) (+ k 2))
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (== (len nd) n) (== (len nwit) n)))
        (invariant (bounded nd (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
        (invariant (le_all nd dist))
        (invariant (wits_ok g start nd nwit (+ k 2)))

(lemma bf_pass_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (inf int)
    (was_changed bool)
    (now_changed bool))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old before u i inf)
    (bf_changed old before was_changed)
    (if (and (!= (idx old u) inf)
             (< (+ (idx old u) w) (idx before v)))
      (and
        (== x (+ (idx old u) w))
        (and
          (bf_update before after v x)
          (== now_changed true)))
      (and
        (== after before)
        (== now_changed was_changed))))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old after u (+ i 1) inf)
    (bf_changed old after now_changed))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len old)))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
            (<= (idx after q) (idx old q)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after))))
            (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                 (!= (idx old a) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx after (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
          (or
            (== (idx after q) (idx old q))
            (exists ((a int) (j int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                       (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                      (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after)))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                         (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                (and
                  (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) q)
                  (== (idx after q)
                      (+ (idx old a)
                         (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))))))))

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
                (== (idx s i) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
                (and
                  (< j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed i)
                      (idx compressed j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s i) (idx s j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a
          (take b (- (len b) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v p (- (len g) 1))))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          g start d inf a
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answer_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
