    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old before u i inf)
    (bf_changed old before was_changed)
    (if (and (!= (idx old u) inf)
             (< (+ (idx old u) w) (idx before v)))
      (and
        (== x (+ (idx old u) w))
        (and
          (bf_update before after v x)
          (== now_changed true)))
      (and
        (== after before)
        (== now_changed was_changed))))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old after u (+ i 1) inf)
    (bf_changed old after now_changed))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len old)))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
            (<= (idx after q) (idx old q)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after))))
            (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                 (!= (idx old a) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx after (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
          (or
            (== (idx after q) (idx old q))
            (exists ((a int) (j int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                       (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                      (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after)))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                         (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                (and
                  (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) q)
                  (== (idx after q)
                      (+ (idx old a)
                         (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))))))))

      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and

(lemma bf_path_range_at

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
                (== (idx s i) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
                (and
                  (< j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed i)
                      (idx compressed j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s i) (idx s j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires

    (is_path g b)

        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a

      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v p (- (len g) 1))))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          g start d inf a
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answer_at
  (params

(lemma bf_option_push_none
  (params
    (d (seq int))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))

        (<= (idx next v) (* 100000 (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_witness_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) inf))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v p k)
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx old v))))
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start a p k)
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v
            (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_lower_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v p k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) (+ k 2)))
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0)
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g
                      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                    (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx next (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf))
  (ensures
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ k 1) inf))
  (body
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_range_at g old next k inf v))
    (assert (bf_range next (+ k 1) inf))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_witness_at g start old next k inf v))
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (call bf_finish_lower_at g start old next k inf v p))))

(lemma bf_path_range_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (p (seq int))
    (h int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p h)) (< (idx p h) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< h (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)) w)))
      (if (== h 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)))
          (obtain ((w int))
            (has_edge g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)
              w))
          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx p (- h 1)))
                     (< (idx p (- h 1)) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 j)
                     (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- h 1)))))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 0)
                    (idx p h))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 1)
                    w)))))))))

(lemma bf_path_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures (bf_in_range_seq p (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_path_range_at g start p h))))

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
                (== (idx s i) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
                (and
                  (< j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed i)
                      (idx compressed j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s i) (idx s j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_subpath_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int)
    (h int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- hi lo))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) h)
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) (+ h 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_subpath
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
    (== (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
        (+ (- hi lo) 1))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) 0)
        (idx p lo))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))) 1))
        (idx p hi)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_subpath_edge_at g p lo hi h))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a
          (take b (- (len b) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v p (- (len g) 1))))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          g start d inf a
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answer_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (== (idx d v) inf)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=>
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
          false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx d v) inf)
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((witness (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v witness (- (len g) 1))
            (== (path_weight g witness) (idx d v))))
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_point_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (== next old))
  (ensures (bf_answer g start next inf))
  (body
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_fixed_answer_at g start next inf v))))

(lemma bf_option_push_some

(lemma bf_options_post
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (out (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_answer g start d inf)
    (bf_option_prefix d out (len d) inf))
  (ensures
    (and (== (len out) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx out v)

                (=> (and (is_path g p)
                      (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                           (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some x)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v x)))))))
  (body))

(spec bf_relax_pass
  (params
    (g weighted_graph)
    (old (vec i64))
    (start i64)
    (k i64))
  (returns
    (g_out weighted_graph)
    (next (vec i64))
    (changed bool))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size g)))
    (and (>= k 0) (< k (size g)))
    (bf_round_ok (view g) start old k (bf_inf)))
  (ensures
    (== g_out g)
    (bf_pass_ok (view g) old next (size g) 0 (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok (view g) start next (+ k 1) (bf_inf))
    (bf_changed old next changed))
  (effects alloc))

(def bf_relax_pass
  (body
    (call bf_graph_ok_view g)
    (let n i64 (len (field g adj)))
    (let-mut next (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (copy_index) (idx old copy_index))))
    (let-mut changed bool false)
    (call bf_pass_begin (view g) old next (bf_inf))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== (len old) n))
      (invariant (== (len next) n))
      (invariant (bf_pass_ok (view g) old next u 0 (bf_inf)))
      (invariant (bf_changed old next changed))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let degree i64 (len (idx (field g adj) u)))
      (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
      (while (< edge_index degree)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_index) (<= edge_index degree)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (== (len old) n))

        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start a p k)
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v
            (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_lower_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v p k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) (+ k 2)))
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0)
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g
                      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                    (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx next (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf))
  (ensures
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ k 1) inf))
  (body
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_range_at g old next k inf v))
    (assert (bf_range next (+ k 1) inf))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_witness_at g start old next k inf v))
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (call bf_finish_lower_at g start old next k inf v p))))

(lemma bf_path_range_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (p (seq int))
    (h int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p h)) (< (idx p h) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< h (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)) w)))
      (if (== h 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)))
          (obtain ((w int))
            (has_edge g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)
              w))
          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx p (- h 1)))
                     (< (idx p (- h 1)) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 j)
                     (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- h 1)))))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 0)
                    (idx p h))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 1)
                    w)))))))))

(lemma bf_path_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))))
  (ensures (bf_in_range_seq p (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_path_range_at g start p h))))

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
                (== (idx s i) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i int) (j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
                (and
                  (< j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed i)
                      (idx compressed j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s i) (idx s j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_subpath_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int)
    (h int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- hi lo))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) h)
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) (+ h 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_subpath
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
    (== (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
        (+ (- hi lo) 1))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) 0)
        (idx p lo))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))) 1))
        (idx p hi)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_subpath_edge_at g p lo hi h))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a
          (take b (- (len b) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v p (- (len g) 1))))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          g start d inf a
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answer_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (== (idx d v) inf)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=>
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
          false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx d v) inf)
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((witness (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v witness (- (len g) 1))
            (== (path_weight g witness) (idx d v))))
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_point_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (== next old))
  (ensures (bf_answer g start next inf))
  (body
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_fixed_answer_at g start next inf v))))

(lemma bf_option_push_none
  (params
    (d (seq int))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_option_prefix d before k inf)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len d)))
    (== (idx d k) inf)
    (== after (concat before (seq-lit (none)))))
  (ensures (bf_option_prefix d after (+ k 1) inf))
  (body))

(lemma bf_option_push_some
  (params
    (d (seq int))
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (k int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_option_prefix d before k inf)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len d)))
    (!= (idx d k) inf)
    (== after (concat before (seq-lit (some (idx d k))))))
  (ensures (bf_option_prefix d after (+ k 1) inf))
  (body))

(lemma bf_options_post
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (out (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_answer g start d inf)
    (bf_option_prefix d out (len d) inf))
  (ensures
    (and (== (len out) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx out v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and (is_path g p)
                      (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                           (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some x)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v x)))))))
  (body))

(spec bf_relax_pass
  (params
    (g weighted_graph)
    (old (vec i64))
    (start i64)
    (k i64))
  (returns
    (g_out weighted_graph)
    (next (vec i64))
    (changed bool))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size g)))
    (and (>= k 0) (< k (size g)))
    (bf_round_ok (view g) start old k (bf_inf)))
  (ensures
    (== g_out g)
    (bf_pass_ok (view g) old next (size g) 0 (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok (view g) start next (+ k 1) (bf_inf))
    (bf_changed old next changed))
  (effects alloc))

(def bf_relax_pass
  (body
    (call bf_graph_ok_view g)
    (let n i64 (len (field g adj)))
    (let-mut next (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (copy_index) (idx old copy_index))))
    (let-mut changed bool false)
    (call bf_pass_begin (view g) old next (bf_inf))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== (len old) n))
      (invariant (== (len next) n))
      (invariant (bf_pass_ok (view g) old next u 0 (bf_inf)))
      (invariant (bf_changed old next changed))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let degree i64 (len (idx (field g adj) u)))
      (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
      (while (< edge_index degree)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_index) (<= edge_index degree)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (== (len old) n))
        (invariant (== (len next) n))
        (invariant
          (bf_pass_ok (view g) old next u edge_index (bf_inf)))
        (invariant (bf_changed old next changed))
        (decreases (- degree edge_index))
        (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
          (idx (idx (field g adj) u) edge_index))
        (let destination i64 (get edge 0))
        (let edge_weight i64 (get edge 1))
        (if (!= (idx old u) 1000000000000000)
          (block
            (let candidate i64 (+ (idx old u) edge_weight))
            (if (< candidate (idx next destination))
              (block
                (ghost-let before_update (seq int) next)
                (let old_changed bool changed)
                (set-idx next destination candidate)
                (set changed true)
                (assert
                  (bf_update before_update next destination candidate))
                (call bf_pass_step
                  (view g) old before_update next u edge_index
                  destination edge_weight candidate (bf_inf)
                  old_changed changed))
              (block
                (ghost-let unchanged (seq int) next)
                (call bf_pass_step
                  (view g) old unchanged next u edge_index
                  destination edge_weight (idx next destination) (bf_inf)
                  changed changed))))
          (block
            (ghost-let unchanged_inf (seq int) next)
            (call bf_pass_step
              (view g) old unchanged_inf next u edge_index
              destination edge_weight (idx next destination) (bf_inf)
              changed changed)))
        (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
      (call bf_pass_row (view g) old next u (bf_inf))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call bf_finish_round
      (view g) start old next k (bf_inf))
    (return g next changed)))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (call bf_graph_ok_view graph)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut active_graph weighted_graph graph)
    (let-mut distances (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (initial_index) 1000000000000000)))
    (set-idx distances start 0)

    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (== next old)
    (== (len old) (len g)))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old next 0 0 inf)
    (bf_changed old next false))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pass_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (inf int)
    (was_changed bool)
    (now_changed bool))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old before u i inf)
    (bf_changed old before was_changed)
    (if (and (!= (idx old u) inf)
             (< (+ (idx old u) w) (idx before v)))
      (and
        (== x (+ (idx old u) w))
        (and
          (bf_update before after v x)
          (== now_changed true)))
      (and
        (== after before)
        (== now_changed was_changed))))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old after u (+ i 1) inf)
    (bf_changed old after now_changed))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len old)))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
            (<= (idx after q) (idx old q)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after))))
            (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                 (!= (idx old a) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx after (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
          (or
            (== (idx after q) (idx old q))
            (exists ((a int) (j int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                       (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                      (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after)))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                         (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                (and
                  (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) q)
                  (== (idx after q)
                      (+ (idx old a)
                         (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_range_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g 0 old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (or (== (idx next v) inf)
      (and
        (>= (idx next v) (* -100000 (+ k 1)))
        (<= (idx next v) (* 100000 (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_witness_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) inf))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v old_path k)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) (idx old v))))
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v old_path (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (obtain ((edge_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start a edge_path k)
            (== (path_weight g edge_path) (idx old a))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (call bf_append_one g edge_path v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v
            (concat edge_path (seq-lit v))
            (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_lower_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v p k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) (+ k 2)))
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0)
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g
                      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                    (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1)))))))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (take p (- (len p) 1))
            k))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx next (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf))
  (ensures
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ k 1) inf))
  (body
    (assert (== (len next) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_range_at g old next k inf v))
    (assert (bf_range next (+ k 1) inf))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_finish_witness_at g start old next k inf v))
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (call bf_finish_lower_at g start old next k inf v p))))

(lemma bf_path_range_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (p (seq int))
    (h int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p h)) (< (idx p h) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< h (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (obtain ((next_weight int))
          (has_edge g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)) next_weight)))
      (if (== h 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)))
          (obtain ((previous_weight int))
            (has_edge g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)
              previous_weight))
          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx p (- h 1)))
                     (< (idx p (- h 1)) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 j)
                     (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- h 1)))))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 0)
                    (idx p h))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 1)
                    previous_weight)))))))))

  (params

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found_index int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found_index) (< found_index n))
                (== (idx s found_index) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((repeat_i int) (repeat_j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 repeat_i) (< repeat_i repeat_j))
                (and
                  (< repeat_j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed repeat_i)
                      (idx compressed repeat_j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s repeat_i) (idx s repeat_j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_subpath_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (lo int)

  (requires

  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) h)
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) (+ h 1))))

(lemma bf_subpath
  (params

  (requires

    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))

  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
    (== (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
        (+ (- hi lo) 1))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) 0)
        (idx p lo))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))) 1))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a
          (take b (- (len b) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v p (- (len g) 1))))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          g start d inf a
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_answer_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start d (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g d d (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (if
      (== (idx d v) inf)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=>
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
          false))
      (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx d v) inf)
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((witness (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v witness (- (len g) 1))
            (== (path_weight g witness) (idx d v))))
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf v p))))))

    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_prefix_edge_at g p h))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))
        w))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (< (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i)
               (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 0)
              (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 1)
              w))))
    (call bf_edge_value g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) i)))

(lemma bf_pass_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (inf int)
    (was_changed bool)
    (now_changed bool))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old before u i inf)
    (bf_changed old before was_changed)
    (if (and (!= (idx old u) inf)
             (< (+ (idx old u) w) (idx before v)))
      (and
        (== x (+ (idx old u) w))
        (and
          (bf_update before after v x)
          (== now_changed true)))
      (and
        (== after before)
        (== now_changed was_changed))))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old after u (+ i 1) inf)
    (bf_changed old after now_changed))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len old)))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
            (<= (idx after q) (idx old q)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after))))
            (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                 (!= (idx old a) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx after (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
          (or
            (== (idx after q) (idx old q))
            (exists ((a int) (j int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                       (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                      (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after)))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                         (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                (and
                  (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) q)
                  (== (idx after q)
                      (+ (idx old a)
                         (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_range_at
  (params

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (or (== (idx next v) inf)
      (and
        (>= (idx next v) (* -100000 (+ k 1)))
        (<= (idx next v) (* 100000 (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (assert

            (>= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) -100000)

(lemma bf_finish_witness_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) inf))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start v p (+ k 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start v old_path k)
            (== (path_weight g old_path) (idx old v))))
        (assert (bf_bounded_to g start v old_path (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (obtain ((edge_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_bounded_to g start a edge_path k)
            (== (path_weight g edge_path) (idx old a))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (call bf_append_one g edge_path v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v
            (concat edge_path (seq-lit v))
            (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_lower_at
  (params

(lemma bf_finish_round
  (params

(lemma bf_path_range_at
  (params

    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p h)) (< (idx p h) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< h (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (obtain ((next_weight int))
          (has_edge g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)) next_weight)))
      (if (== h 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)))
          (obtain ((previous_weight int))
            (has_edge g
              (idx p (- h 1))
              (idx p h)
              previous_weight))
          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx p (- h 1)))
                     (< (idx p (- h 1)) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 j)
                     (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- h 1)))))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 0)
                    (idx p h))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 1)
