(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found_index int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found_index) (< found_index n))
                (== (idx s found_index) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((repeat_i int) (repeat_j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 repeat_i) (< repeat_i repeat_j))
                (and
                  (< repeat_j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed repeat_i)
                      (idx compressed repeat_j)))))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s repeat_i) (idx s repeat_j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_subpath_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int)
    (h int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- hi lo))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) h)
      (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) (+ h 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_subpath
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (lo int)
    (hi int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi))
    (< hi (len p)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
    (== (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)))
        (+ (- hi lo) 1))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1)) 0)
        (idx p lo))
    (== (idx (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p lo) (+ (- hi lo) 1))) 1))
        (idx p hi)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_subpath_edge_at g p lo hi h))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths
          g a
          (take b (- (len b) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ j 1))
      (drop p j))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ i 1))
      (drop p j))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (bf_bounded_to g start a p (- (len g) 1))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v q (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (bf_bounded_to g start v shortened (- (len g) 1)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))

          (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w)))))))

(ghost-fn dj_result
  ((dist (seq int)) (res (seq (option int))) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len res) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
              (some (idx dist v))
              (none))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_row_unique ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
          (!= i j))
        (!=
          (get (idx row i) 0)
          (get (idx row j) 0))))))

(lemma dj_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (>= (idx s i) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (dj_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_nonnegative (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_upper
  (params (s (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= b 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (<= (idx s i) b)))))
  (ensures (<= (dj_sum s) (* (len s) b)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int) (w int) (at int) (i int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row at) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row at) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i at)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- at i))
  (body
    (if (< i at)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_find row v w at (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g x)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call dj_weight_find (idx g u) v w i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_prefix_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p k) (- k 1)) (idx p (- k 1))))
  (body))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (take p k)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g x)))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_initial_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
        (==
          (idx dist x)
          (if (== x start) 0 inf))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist v) inf)
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v)))))
  (body
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))))

(lemma dj_initial_witnesses
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
        (==
          (idx dist x)
          (if (== x start) 0 inf))))
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures (dj_witnessed g start dist inf))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_initial_one g start dist inf v))))

(lemma dj_initial_bound
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (start int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (and (> inf 10000000000) (<= (len dist) 100000))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
        (==
          (idx dist x)
          (if (== x start) 0 inf)))))
  (ensures (dj_bounded dist inf))
  (body))

(lemma dj_edge_facts
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg)))
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
      (< (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) (size wg)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1))
      (<= (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1) 100000))
    (has_edge
      (view wg)
      u
      (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_witness_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int) (z int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (forall ((a int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g a)))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (exists ((p (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z)))
          (== (path_weight g p) (idx d1 z))))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (if (== z v)
        (block
          (obtain ((p (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
              (== (path_weight g p) (idx d0 u))))
          (call dj_append_path g p u v w)
          (assert
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
                  (==
                    (idx
                      (concat p (seq-lit v))
                      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
                    z)))
              (==
                (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (idx d1 z)))))
        (block
          (obtain ((p (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z)))
              (== (path_weight g p) (idx d0 z))))
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) (idx d0 z)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_witness_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (forall ((a int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (dj_witnessed g start d1 inf))
  (body
    (forall ((z int))
      (call dj_witness_one
        g start d0 d1 inf u v w x z))))

(lemma dj_bound_step
  (params
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int) (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_bounded d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (<= (len d0) 100000)
    (> inf 10000000000)
    (==
      (occurrences d1 inf)
      (if (== (idx d0 v) inf)
        (- (occurrences d0 inf) 1)
        (occurrences d0 inf))))
  (ensures (dj_bounded d1 inf))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (inf int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (dj_scan g dist inf u i)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (=>
      (< (idx dist u) inf)
      (and
        (< (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) inf)
        (<=
          (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (+
            (idx dist u)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (dj_scan g dist inf u (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_row
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (inf int) (u int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (dj_scan g dist inf u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (dj_scan g dist inf (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_complete_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (dj_scan g dist inf (len g) 0)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx dist u) inf))
  (ensures
    (< (idx dist v) inf)
    (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int)) (inf int))
  (requires (dj_scan g dist inf (len g) 0))
  (ensures (dj_stable g dist inf))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (call dj_scan_complete_one g dist inf u v w))))

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g x)))))
  (ensures
    (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound
          g start dist inf p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_path_weight_step g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist (idx p k))
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))
            0))))))

(lemma dj_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g x)))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (and
        (< (idx dist v) inf)
        (<= (idx dist v) (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound
          g start dist inf p (- (len p) 1))
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist v) inf)
            (<= (idx dist v) (path_weight g p)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_final_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start dist inf)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
        (dj_row_unique (idx g x)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path
            g start dist inf v q))
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path
            g start dist inf v p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))))))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (dj_witnessed (view wg) start dist inf)
    (dj_stable (view wg) dist inf)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (== (len dist) (size wg)))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path (view wg) p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
                      v)))
                false)))
          (case (some d)
            (is_shortest_dist
              (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_final_at
        (view wg) start dist res inf v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj_init_i) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (assert
      (forall ((dj_init_j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 dj_init_j) (< dj_init_j n))
          (==
            (idx dist dj_init_j)
            (if (== dj_init_j start)
              0
              10000000001)))))
    (call dj_initial_witnesses
      (view graph) start dist 10000000001)
    (call dj_initial_bound
      dist start 10000000001)
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative dist)
    (call dj_sum_upper dist 10000000001)
    (let-mut budget i64
      (+ (* n 10000000001) 1))
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (while active
      (invariant (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 100000)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
      (invariant
        (dj_witnessed
          (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
      (invariant (>= budget 0))
      (invariant
        (=>
          active
          (> budget (dj_sum dist))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (not active)
          (dj_stable
            (view graph) dist 10000000001)))
      (decreases budget)
      (let old_budget i64 budget)
      (ghost-let pass_sum int (dj_sum dist))
      (set budget (- budget 1))
      (set active false)
      (let-mut ou i64 0)
      (while (< ou n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ou) (<= ou n)))
        (invariant (== (len dist) n))
        (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
        (invariant
          (dj_witnessed
            (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
        (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
        (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
        (invariant (<= (dj_sum dist) pass_sum))
        (invariant
          (=>
            active
            (< (dj_sum dist) pass_sum)))
        (invariant
          (=>
            (not active)
            (dj_scan
              (view graph) dist
              10000000001 ou 0)))
        (decreases (- n ou))
        (let deg i64
          (len (idx (field graph adj) ou)))
        (let-mut ei i64 0)
        (while (< ei deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 ei) (<= ei deg)))
          (invariant (== (len dist) n))
          (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
          (invariant
            (dj_witnessed
              (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
          (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
          (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
          (invariant (<= (dj_sum dist) pass_sum))
          (invariant
            (=>
              active
              (< (dj_sum dist) pass_sum)))
          (invariant
            (=>

  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=>
        (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))))
        (=>
          (< (idx dist u) inf)
          (and
            (< (idx dist v) inf)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_result
  ((dist (seq int)) (res (seq (option int))) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len res) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
              (some (idx dist v))
              (none))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_row_unique ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
          (!= i j))
        (!=
          (get (idx row i) 0)
          (get (idx row j) 0))))))

(lemma dj_graph_facts
  (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures
    (dj_vertices (view wg))
    (dj_rows_unique (view wg))
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
        (dj_row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))
  (body))

(lemma dj_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (>= (idx s i) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (dj_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_nonnegative (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_upper
  (params (s (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= b 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (<= (idx s i) b)))))
  (ensures (<= (dj_sum s) (* (len s) b)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int) (w int) (at int) (i int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row at) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row at) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i at)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- at i))
  (body
    (if (< i at)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_find row v w at (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_find (idx g u) v w i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (take p k)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_initial_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
        (==
          (idx dist x)
          (if (== x start) 0 inf))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist v) inf)
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v)))))
  (body
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))))

(lemma dj_initial_witnesses
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))

    (forall ((x int))

        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
        (==
          (idx dist x)
          (if (== x start) 0 inf))))
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures (dj_witnessed g start dist inf))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_initial_one g start dist inf v))))

(lemma dj_initial_bound
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (start int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))

        (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))

(lemma dj_edge_facts
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)

    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg)))
    (and
      (<= 0 i)

    (and
      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))

    (and
      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1))
      (<= (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1) 100000))
    (has_edge
      (view wg)
      u
      (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert

        (view wg)
        u
        (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)

    (assert
      (>= (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1) 0))

(lemma dj_witness_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int) (z int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (== (len d0) (len g))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (exists ((p (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z)))
          (== (path_weight g p) (idx d1 z))))))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d0))))
    (assert (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf))
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (if (== z v)
        (block
          (obtain ((p (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
              (== (path_weight g p) (idx d0 u))))
          (call dj_append_path g p u v w)
          (assert
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
                  (==
                    (idx
                      (concat p (seq-lit v))
                      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
                    z)))
              (==
                (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (idx d1 z)))))
        (block
          (obtain ((q (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g q)
                (and
                  (== (idx q 0) start)
                  (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z)))
              (== (path_weight g q) (idx d0 z))))
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) (idx d0 z)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_witness_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (== (len d0) (len g))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures (dj_witnessed g start d1 inf))
  (body
    (forall ((z int))
      (call dj_witness_one
        g start d0 d1 inf u v w x z))))

(lemma dj_bound_step
  (params
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))

  (requires
    (dj_bounded d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d0)))
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))

  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (inf int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (dj_scan g dist inf u i)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and
      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len dist)))
    (=>
      (< (idx dist u) inf)
      (and
        (< (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) inf)
        (<=
          (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (+
            (idx dist u)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (dj_scan g dist inf u (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma dj_scan_row
  (params

  (requires

(lemma dj_scan_complete_one
  (params

    (obtain ((i int))

        (and

          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist))))

(lemma dj_scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int)) (inf int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_scan g dist inf (len g) 0))
  (ensures (dj_stable g dist inf))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (call dj_scan_complete_one g dist inf u v w))))

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound
          g start dist inf p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len dist))))
        (call dj_edge_weight
          g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_path_weight_step g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist (idx p k))
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))
            0))))))

(lemma dj_lower_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (and
        (< (idx dist v) inf)
        (<= (idx dist v) (path_weight g p)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound
          g start dist inf p (- (len p) 1))
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist v) inf)
            (<= (idx dist v) (path_weight g p)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_final_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start dist inf)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path
            g start dist inf v q))
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist
            g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path
            g start dist inf v p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))))))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (dj_witnessed (view wg) start dist inf)
    (dj_stable (view wg) dist inf)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (== (len dist) (size wg)))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path (view wg) p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
                      v)))
                false)))
          (case (some d)
            (is_shortest_dist
              (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (call dj_graph_facts wg)
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_final_at
        (view wg) start dist res inf v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (call dj_graph_facts graph)
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj_init_i) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (assert
      (forall ((dj_init_j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 dj_init_j) (< dj_init_j n))
          (==
            (idx dist dj_init_j)
            (if (== dj_init_j start)
              0
              10000000001)))))
    (call dj_initial_witnesses
      (view graph) start dist 10000000001)
    (call dj_initial_bound
      dist start 10000000001)
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative dist)
    (call dj_sum_upper dist 10000000001)
    (let-mut budget i64
      (+ (* n 10000000001) 1))
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (while active
      (invariant (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 100000)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (dj_vertices (view graph)))
      (invariant (dj_rows_unique (view graph)))
      (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
      (invariant
        (dj_witnessed
          (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
      (invariant (>= budget 0))
      (invariant
        (=>
          active
          (> budget (dj_sum dist))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (not active)
          (dj_stable
            (view graph) dist 10000000001)))
      (decreases budget)
      (ghost-let pass_sum int (dj_sum dist))
      (set budget (- budget 1))
      (set active false)

          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))

(ghost-fn dj_rows_unique ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (forall ((i int) (j int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
              (!= i j))
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_witnessed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (< (idx dist v) inf))
        (exists ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_bounded ((dist (seq int)) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx dist v)) (<= (idx dist v) inf))))))

(ghost-fn dj_scan
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int))
   (inf int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (and
            (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) (len dist)))))
        (=>
          (< (idx dist x) inf)
          (and
            (< (idx dist (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) inf)
            (<=
              (idx dist (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))
              (+ (idx dist x) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_stable
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=>
        (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))))
        (=>
          (< (idx dist u) inf)
          (and
            (< (idx dist v) inf)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_result
  ((dist (seq int)) (res (seq (option int))) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len res) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
              (some (idx dist v))
              (none))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_row_unique ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
          (!= i j))
        (!=
          (get (idx row i) 0)
          (get (idx row j) 0))))))

(lemma dj_graph_facts
  (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures
    (dj_vertices (view wg))
    (dj_rows_unique (view wg))
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))

(lemma dj_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (>= (idx s i) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (dj_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_nonnegative (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_upper
  (params (s (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= b 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (<= (idx s i) b)))))
  (ensures (<= (dj_sum s) (* (len s) b)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int) (w int) (at int) (i int))
  (requires
    (dj_row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row at) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row at) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i at)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- at i))
  (body
    (if (< i at)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_find row v w at (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))
    (call dj_weight_find (idx g u) v w i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (take p k)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_initial_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))

          (idx dist x)

  (body

(lemma dj_initial_witnesses

(lemma dj_initial_bound

(lemma dj_edge_facts

(lemma dj_witness_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int) (z int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf)
    (dj_upd d0 d1 v x)
    (== (len d0) (len g))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (< (idx d0 u) inf)
    (== x (+ (idx d0 u) w))
    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (exists ((p (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z)))
          (== (path_weight g p) (idx d1 z))))))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d0))))
    (assert (dj_witnessed g start d0 inf))
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (if (== z v)
        (block
          (obtain ((p (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
              (== (path_weight g p) (idx d0 u))))
          (call dj_append_path g p u v w)
          (assert
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
                  (==
                    (idx
                      (concat p (seq-lit v))
                      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
                    z)))
              (==
                (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
                (idx d1 z)))))
        (block
          (obtain ((q (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g q)
                (and
                  (== (idx q 0) start)
                  (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z)))
              (== (path_weight g q) (idx d0 z))))
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) (idx d0 z)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- k 1))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len dist))))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) inf)
            (and
              (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
              (<=
                (idx dist (idx p k))
                (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) w)))))
        (call dj_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_path_weight_step g p k)
        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist (idx p k))
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))
            0))))))

  (params

  (ensures

  (body
    (if
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)

      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- (len p) 1))

        (assert

(lemma dj_final_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start dist inf)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v q))
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))))))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
