                    (and (known dist v d) (not (idx used v))))
                  (<= bestd d))))
          (forall ((v int) (d int))
            (=> (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v upto))
                  (known dist v d))
                (idx used v))))))))

(spec pick_min
  (params
    (dist (ref (slice (option i64))))
    (used (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (r (option (tuple i64 i64))))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len used)))
  (ensures
    (match r
      (case (none) (all_known_used dist used))
      (case (some p)
        (minimum_known dist used (get p 0) (get p 1)))))
  (effects))

(def pick_min
  (body
    (let-mut found bool false)
    (let-mut best i64 0)
    (let-mut bestd i64 0)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len dist))))
      (invariant (scan_state dist used i found best bestd))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (match (idx dist i)
        (case (none) (block))
        (case (some cur)
          (if (not (idx used i))
            (if (or (not found) (< cur bestd))
              (block
                (set found true)
                (set best i)
                (set bestd cur))
              (block))
            (block))))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (if found
      (return (some (tuple best bestd)))
      (return (none)))))

(ghost-fn dist_nonnegative ((dist (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (d int))
      (=> (known dist v d) (>= d 0)))))

(ghost-fn dist_bounded ((dist (seq (option int))) (bound int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (d int))
      (=> (known dist v d) (<= d bound)))))

(ghost-fn witnesses
  ((wg weighted_graph) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (size wg))
      (forall ((v int) (d int))
        (=> (known dist v d)
            (exists ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (is_path (view wg) p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))))))

(ghost-fn final_vertices
  ((wg weighted_graph) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len used))
        (== (len dist) (size wg)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
              (idx used v))
            (exists ((d int))
              (and
                (known dist v d)
                (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))))

(ghost-fn closed_vertices
  ((wg weighted_graph)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len used))
        (== (len dist) (size wg)))
      (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
        (=> (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len used)))
                (and
                  (idx used u)
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used)))))
              (and
                (not (idx used v))
                (has_edge (view wg) u v w)))
            (exists ((du int) (dv int))
              (and
                (and (known dist u du) (known dist v dv))
                (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))

(ghost-fn partial_relaxed
  ((wg weighted_graph)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
   (u int) (du int) (upto int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (well_formed wg)
      (and
        (and
          (== (len dist) (len used))
          (== (len dist) (size wg)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 upto)
              (<= upto (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
            (forall ((j int))
              (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j upto))
                  (=> (not
                        (idx used
                          (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)))
                      (exists ((dv int))
                        (and
                          (known dist
                            (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
                            dv)
                          (<= dv
                            (+ du
                               (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn option_update
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (v int) (d int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len before) (len after))
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after v) (some d))
        (forall ((x int))
          (=> (and
                (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len before)))
                (!= x v))
              (== (idx after x) (idx before x))))))))

(ghost-fn better
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (v int) (d int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) true)
        (case (some old) (< d old))))))

(lemma row_weight_value
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int) (w int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len row)))
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (forall ((j int) (k int))
      (=> (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)))
          (== (get (idx row j) 1)
              (get (idx row k) 1)))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- (len row) i))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
      (assert (== (get (idx row i) 1) w))
      (call row_weight_value row v w (+ i 1)))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 1) w))))
    (call row_weight_value (idx (view wg) u) v w 0)))

(lemma split_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path (view wg) p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected
      (view wg)
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
        (+ (path_weight
             (view wg)
             (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight
             (view wg)
             (idx p (- (len p) 2))
             (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p
      (- (len p) 1)
      (- (len p) 2))))

(lemma path_endpoint_range
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (start int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (obtain ((endpoint_w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            endpoint_w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg))))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int))
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_value wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take
            (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
          u))
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight
            (view wg)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                 (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                 (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)))
          w))))

(lemma lower_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (chosen int) (chosen_d int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (dist_nonnegative dist)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (minimum_known dist used chosen chosen_d)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx used (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) chosen_d))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (assert (== (len used) (size wg)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len used))))
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix)
        (assert (and (<= 0 from) (< from (len used))))
        (obtain ((edge_w int))
          (has_edge (view wg) from dest edge_w))
        (call edge_weight_value wg from dest edge_w)
        (assert (>= edge_w 0))
        (if (idx used from)
          (block
            (obtain ((from_d int))
              (and
                (known dist from from_d)
                (is_shortest_dist
                  (view wg) start from from_d)))
            (obtain ((dest_d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from from_d)
                  (known dist dest dest_d))
                (<= dest_d (+ from_d edge_w))))
            (assert
              (>= (path_weight (view wg) prefix) from_d)))
          (call lower_path
            wg start dist used chosen chosen_d prefix))))))

(lemma selected_is_final
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (dist_nonnegative dist)
    (witnesses wg start dist)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (minimum_known dist used u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (call lower_path
        wg start dist used u du q))))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (old_bound int) (new_bound int))
  (requires (dist_bounded dist old_bound) (<= old_bound new_bound))
  (ensures (dist_bounded dist new_bound))
  (body))

(lemma update_nonnegative_at
  (params
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int) (x int) (dx int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (>= d 0)
    (known after x dx))
  (ensures (>= dx 0))
  (body))

(lemma update_nonnegative_all
  (params
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (>= d 0))
  (ensures (dist_nonnegative after))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (dx int))
      (call update_nonnegative_at before after v d x dx))))

(lemma update_bounded_at
  (params
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int) (bound int) (x int) (dx int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= d bound)
    (known after x dx))
  (ensures (<= dx bound))
  (body))

(lemma update_bounded_all
  (params
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= d bound))
  (ensures (dist_bounded after bound))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (dx int))
      (call update_bounded_at before after v d bound x dx))))

(lemma update_witness_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int) (p (seq int)) (x int) (dx int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (known after x dx)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) q)
          (and
            (== (idx q 0) start)
            (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) q) dx))))
  (body))

(lemma update_witnesses_all
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (d int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (ensures (witnesses wg start after))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))
    (forall ((x int) (dx int))
      (call update_witness_at
        wg start before after v d p x dx))))

(lemma update_final_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)) (v int) (d int) (x int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (not (idx used v))
    (final_vertices wg start before used)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len after)))
    (idx used x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((dx int))
      (and
        (known after x dx)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start x dx))))
  (body))

(lemma update_final_all
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool)) (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (not (idx used v))
    (final_vertices wg start before used))
  (ensures (final_vertices wg start after used))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len before)))
    (assert (== (len after) (len used)))
    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call update_final_at
        wg start before after used v d x))))

(lemma update_closed_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int) (d int)
    (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (better before v d)
    (not (idx used v))
    (closed_vertices wg before used)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len used)))
    (idx used a)
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len used)))
    (not (idx used b))
    (has_edge (view wg) a b w))
  (ensures
    (exists ((da int) (db int))
      (and
        (and (known after a da) (known after b db))
        (<= db (+ da w)))))
  (body))

(lemma update_closed_all
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (option_update before after v d)
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (better before v d)
    (not (idx used v))
    (closed_vertices wg before used))
  (ensures (closed_vertices wg after used))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len before)))
    (assert (== (len after) (len used)))
    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (w int))
      (call update_closed_at
        wg before after used v d a b w))))

(lemma update_partial_before_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int)
    (v int) (d int) (j int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg before used u du i)
    (option_update before after v d)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) v)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((dv int))
      (and
        (known after
          (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
          dv)
        (<= dv
          (+ du
             (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (!= (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0) v))
    (obtain ((old_d int))
      (and
        (known before
          (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
          old_d)
        (<= old_d
          (+ du
             (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1)))))
    (assert
      (known after
        (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
        old_d))))

(lemma update_partial_before
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int)
    (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg before used u du i)
    (option_update before after v d)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed wg after used u du i))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len before)))
    (assert (== (len after) (len used)))
    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (call update_partial_before_at
        wg before after used u du i v d j))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (v int) (w int) (candidate int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (== (len before) (size wg))
    (option_update before after v candidate)
    (better before v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== candidate (+ du w))
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= candidate bound)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (final_vertices wg start before used)
    (closed_vertices wg before used))
  (ensures
    (dist_nonnegative after)
    (dist_bounded after bound)
    (witnesses wg start after)
    (final_vertices wg start after used)
    (closed_vertices wg after used))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (ghost-let extended (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call update_nonnegative_all
      before after v candidate)
    (call update_bounded_all
      before after v candidate bound)
    (call update_witnesses_all
      wg start before after v candidate extended)
    (call update_final_all
      wg start before after used v candidate)
    (call update_closed_all
      wg before after used v candidate)))

(lemma partial_next
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg dist used u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (or
      (idx used (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
      (exists ((d int))
        (and
          (known dist
            (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)
            d)
          (<= d
            (+ du
               (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1)))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed wg dist used u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len row)))
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (forall ((j int) (k int))
      (=> (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)))
          (== (get (idx row j) 1)
              (get (idx row k) 1)))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- (len row) i))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (and
          (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))))
    (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
      (assert (== (get (idx row i) 1) w))
      (call row_weight_value row v w (+ i 1)))))

(lemma edge_weight_value
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 1) w))))
    (call row_weight_value (idx (view wg) u) v w 0)))

(lemma split_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path (view wg) p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected
      (view wg)
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
        (+ (path_weight
             (view wg)
             (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight
             (view wg)
             (idx p (- (len p) 2))
             (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p
      (- (len p) 1)
      (- (len p) 2))))

(lemma path_endpoint_range
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (start int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (obtain ((endpoint_w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            endpoint_w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg))))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int))
    (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_value wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (== (take
            (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
          u))
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight
            (view wg)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                 (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                 (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)))
          w))))

(lemma lower_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (chosen int) (chosen_d int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (dist_nonnegative dist)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (minimum_known dist used chosen chosen_d)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx used (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) chosen_d))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (assert (== (len used) (size wg)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len used))))
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix)
        (assert (and (<= 0 from) (< from (len used))))
        (obtain ((edge_w int))
          (has_edge (view wg) from dest edge_w))
        (call edge_weight_value wg from dest edge_w)
        (assert (>= edge_w 0))
        (if (idx used from)
          (block
            (obtain ((from_d int))
              (and
                (known dist from from_d)
                (is_shortest_dist
                  (view wg) start from from_d)))
            (obtain ((dest_d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from from_d)
                  (known dist dest dest_d))
                (<= dest_d (+ from_d edge_w))))
            (assert
              (>= (path_weight (view wg) prefix) from_d)))
          (call lower_path
            wg start dist used chosen chosen_d prefix))))))

(lemma selected_is_final
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (dist_nonnegative dist)
    (witnesses wg start dist)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (minimum_known dist used u du))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (forall ((q (seq int)))
      (call lower_path
        wg start dist used u du q))))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params

  (requires (dist_bounded dist old_bound) (<= old_bound new_bound))
  (ensures (dist_bounded dist new_bound))

    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))

(lemma update_final_at
  (params

(lemma update_final_all
  (params

(lemma update_closed_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)

    (idx used a)
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len used)))
    (not (idx used b))
    (has_edge (view wg) a b w))

    (exists ((da int) (db int))

  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)

(lemma update_partial_before_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int)
    (v int) (d int) (j int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg before used u du i)
    (option_update before after v d)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) v)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
    (not
      (idx used
        (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((dv int))
      (and
        (known after
          (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
          dv)
        (<= dv
          (+ du
             (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (!= (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0) v))
    (obtain ((old_d int))
      (and
        (known before
          (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
          old_d)
        (<= old_d
          (+ du
             (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1)))))
    (assert
      (known after
        (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 0)
        old_d))))

(lemma update_partial_before
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int)
    (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg before used u du i)
    (option_update before after v d)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed wg after used u du i))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len before)))
    (assert (== (len after) (len used)))
    (assert (== (len after) (size wg)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (call update_partial_before_at
        wg before after used u du i v d j))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (v int) (w int) (candidate int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (== (len before) (size wg))
    (option_update before after v candidate)
    (better before v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== candidate (+ du w))
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= candidate bound)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (final_vertices wg start before used)
    (closed_vertices wg before used))
  (ensures
    (dist_nonnegative after)
    (dist_bounded after bound)
    (witnesses wg start after)
    (final_vertices wg start after used)
    (closed_vertices wg after used))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (ghost-let extended (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call update_nonnegative_all
      before after v candidate)
    (call update_bounded_all
      before after v candidate bound)
    (call update_witnesses_all
      wg start before after v candidate extended)
    (call update_final_all
      wg start before after used v candidate)
    (call update_closed_all
      wg before after used v candidate)))

(lemma partial_next
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (partial_relaxed wg dist used u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
    (or
      (idx used (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0))
      (exists ((d int))
        (and
          (known dist
            (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 0)
            d)
          (<= d
            (+ du
               (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) i) 1)))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed wg dist used u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma mark_final_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after u true)
    (not (idx before u))
    (final_vertices wg start dist before)
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (known dist u du)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len after)))
    (idx after x))
  (ensures
    (exists ((dx int))
      (and
        (known dist x dx)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start x dx))))
  (body))

(lemma mark_final
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after u true)
    (not (idx before u))
    (final_vertices wg start dist before)
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (known dist u du))
  (ensures (final_vertices wg start dist after))
  (body
    (assert (== (len before) (len after)))
    (assert (== (len dist) (len after)))
    (assert (== (len dist) (size wg)))

        wg start dist before after u du x))))

(lemma mark_closed_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int)
    (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bool_update before after u true)
    (not (idx before u))
    (known dist u du)
    (closed_vertices wg dist before)
    (partial_relaxed
      wg dist before u du
      (len (idx (field wg adj) u)))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len after)))
    (idx after a)
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len after)))
    (not (idx after b))
    (has_edge (view wg) a b w))
  (ensures
    (exists ((da int) (db int))
      (and
        (and (known dist a da) (known dist b db))
        (<= db (+ da w)))))
  (body
    (if (== a u)
      (block
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 j)
                (< j (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 0) b)
              (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 1) w))))
        (assert (not (idx before b)))
        (obtain ((db2 int))
          (and
            (known dist b db2)
            (<= db2
              (+ du
                 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (idx before a))
        (assert (not (idx before b)))))))

(lemma mark_closed
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bool_update before after u true)
    (not (idx before u))
    (known dist u du)
    (closed_vertices wg dist before)
    (partial_relaxed
      wg dist before u du
      (len (idx (field wg adj) u))))
  (ensures (closed_vertices wg dist after))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (w int))
      (call mark_closed_at
        wg dist before after u du a b w))))

(lemma path_endpoint_known
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (all_known_used dist used)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (known dist (idx p (- (len p) 1)) d)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix2 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from2 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest2 int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix2)
        (call path_endpoint_known
          wg start dist used prefix2)
        (obtain ((from_d2 int))
          (known dist from2 from_d2))
        (assert (idx used from2))
        (if (idx used dest2)
          (obtain ((dest_d2 int))
            (and
              (known dist dest2 dest_d2)
              (is_shortest_dist
                (view wg) start dest2 dest_d2)))
          (block
            (obtain ((edge_w2 int))
              (has_edge (view wg) from2 dest2 edge_w2))
            (obtain ((from_d3 int) (dest_d3 int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from2 from_d3)

    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=>
        (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))))
        (=>
          (< (idx dist u) inf)
          (and
            (< (idx dist v) inf)
            (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_result
  ((dist (seq int)) (res (seq (option int))) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len res) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
              (some (idx dist v))
              (none))))))))

(ghost-fn dj_row_unique ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
          (!= i j))
        (!=
          (get (idx row i) 0)
          (get (idx row j) 0))))))

(lemma dj_graph_facts
  (params (wg weighted_graph))

(lemma dj_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq int)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (>= (idx s i) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (dj_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_nonnegative (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_upper
  (params (s (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= b 0)
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (<= (idx s i) b)))))
  (ensures (<= (dj_sum s) (* (len s) b)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int) (w int) (at int) (i int))
  (requires

    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row at) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row at) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i at)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- at i))
  (body
    (if (< i at)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call dj_weight_find row v w at (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma dj_edge_weight
  (params

          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (take p k)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)

    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma dj_initial_one

(lemma dj_witness_one
  (params

    (< (idx d0 u) inf)

    (< x (idx d0 v))
    (dj_rows_unique g))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (exists ((p (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z)))
          (== (path_weight g p) (idx d1 z))))))
  (body

    (if

        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))

          (obtain ((p (seq int)))

                (is_path g p)

                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))

                      (concat p (seq-lit v))

                (idx d1 z)))))
        (block
          (obtain ((q (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_path g q)
                (and
                  (== (idx q 0) start)
                  (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z)))
              (== (path_weight g q) (idx d0 z))))
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) (idx d0 z)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- k 1))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len dist))))
        (assert
          (and
            (< (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) inf)
            (and
              (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
              (<=
                (idx dist (idx p k))
                (+ (idx dist (idx p (- k 1))) w)))))
        (call dj_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_path_weight_step g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist (idx p k))
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))
            0))))))

(lemma dj_final_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))

  (requires

    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v q))
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_path g p)

                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (dj_witnessed (view wg) start dist inf)
    (dj_stable (view wg) dist inf)
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path (view wg) p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                false)))
          (case (some d)
            (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (call dj_graph_facts wg)
    (assert (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_final_at (view wg) start dist res inf v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (call dj_graph_facts graph)
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj_init_i) 10000000001)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut found i64 1)
    (assert
      (forall ((dj_init_j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 dj_init_j) (< dj_init_j n))
          (==
            (idx dist dj_init_j)
            (if (== dj_init_j start) 0 10000000001)))))
    (assert (dj_progress dist 10000000001 found))
    (call dj_initial_witnesses
      (view graph) start dist 10000000001)
    (call dj_initial_bound dist start 10000000001)
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative dist)
    (call dj_sum_upper dist 10000000001)

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (v int) (w int) (candidate int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (== (len before) (size wg))
    (option_update before after v candidate)
    (better before v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== candidate (+ du w))
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= candidate bound)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (final_vertices wg start before used)
    (closed_vertices wg before used))
  (ensures
    (dist_nonnegative after)
    (dist_bounded after bound)
    (witnesses wg start after)
    (final_vertices wg start after used)
    (closed_vertices wg after used))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (ghost-let extended (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call update_nonnegative_all
      before after v candidate)
    (call update_bounded_all
      before after v candidate bound)
    (call update_witnesses_all
      wg start before after v candidate extended)
    (call update_final_all
      wg start before after used v candidate)
    (call update_closed_all
      wg before after used v candidate)))

  (body))

(lemma path_endpoint_known
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (all_known_used dist used)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (known dist (idx p (- (len p) 1)) d)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix2 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from2 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest2 int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix2)
        (call path_endpoint_known
          wg start dist used prefix2)
        (obtain ((from_d2 int))
          (known dist from2 from_d2))
        (assert (idx used from2))
        (if (idx used dest2)
          (obtain ((dest_d2 int))
            (and
              (known dist dest2 dest_d2)
              (is_shortest_dist
                (view wg) start dest2 dest_d2)))
          (block
            (obtain ((edge_w2 int))
              (has_edge (view wg) from2 dest2 edge_w2))
            (obtain ((from_d3 int) (dest_d3 int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from2 from_d3)
                  (known dist dest2 dest_d3))
                (<= dest_d3 (+ from_d3 edge_w2))))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_i)
          (if (== init_i start)
            (some 0)
            (none)))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (used_i) false)))
    (call false_count_all used)
    (call false_count_nonnegative used)
    (assert (known dist start 0))
    (assert
      (forall ((initial_v int) (initial_d int))
        (=> (known dist initial_v initial_d)
            (and
              (== initial_v start)
              (== initial_d 0)))))
    (call initial_witnesses graph start dist)
    (let-mut settled i64 0)
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (while active
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 settled) (<= settled n)))
      (invariant (== (+ settled (false_count used)) n))
      (invariant (>= (false_count used) 0))
      (invariant (known dist start 0))
      (invariant (dist_nonnegative dist))
      (invariant
        (dist_bounded
          dist
          (* (+ settled 1) 100000)))
      (invariant (witnesses graph start dist))
      (invariant
        (final_vertices graph start dist used))
      (invariant (closed_vertices graph dist used))
      (invariant
        (=> (not active)
            (all_known_used dist used)))
      (decreases
        (+ (false_count used)
           (if active 1 0)))
      (let ((choice (option (tuple i64 i64))))
        (call pick_min (borrow dist) (borrow used)))
      (match choice
        (case (none)
          (set active false))
        (case (some selected)
          (block
            (let u i64 (get selected 0))
            (let du i64 (get selected 1))
            (assert (minimum_known dist used u du))
            (call selected_is_final
              graph start dist used u du)
            (let prior i64 settled)
            (set settled (+ settled 1))
            (call widen_bound
              dist
              (* (+ prior 1) 100000)
              (* (+ settled 1) 100000))
            (let degree i64
              (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
            (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
            (while (< edge_i degree)
              (invariant
                (and (<= 0 edge_i)
                     (<= edge_i degree)))
              (invariant (known dist u du))
              (invariant
                (is_shortest_dist
                  (view graph) start u du))
              (invariant (dist_nonnegative dist))
              (invariant
                (dist_bounded
                  dist
                  (* (+ settled 1) 100000)))
              (invariant
                (witnesses graph start dist))
              (invariant
                (final_vertices graph start dist used))
              (invariant
                (closed_vertices graph dist used))
              (invariant
                (partial_relaxed
                  graph dist used u du edge_i))
              (decreases (- degree edge_i))
              (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
                (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) edge_i))
              (let destination i64 (get edge 0))
              (let edge_weight i64 (get edge 1))
              (assert
                (has_edge
                  (view graph)
                  u destination edge_weight))
              (assert
                (and (>= edge_weight 0)
                     (<= edge_weight 100000)))
              (if (idx used destination)
                (call partial_next
                  graph dist used u du edge_i)
                (block
                  (let candidate i64 (+ du edge_weight))
                  (match (idx dist destination)
                    (case (none)
                      (block
                        (ghost-let before_none
                          (seq (option int)) dist)
                        (set-idx dist destination
                          (some candidate))
                        (assert
                          (option_update
                            before_none dist
                            destination candidate))
                        (call update_partial_before
                          graph before_none dist used
                          u du edge_i destination candidate)
                        (call relax_update
                          graph start
                          before_none dist used
                          u du destination edge_weight
                          candidate
                          (* (+ settled 1) 100000))
                        (assert
                          (exists ((new_d int))
                            (and
                              (known dist destination new_d)
                              (<= new_d candidate))))
                        (call partial_next
                          graph dist used u du edge_i)))
                    (case (some old_distance)
                      (if (< candidate old_distance)
                        (block
                          (ghost-let before_some
                            (seq (option int)) dist)
                          (set-idx dist destination
                            (some candidate))
                          (assert
                            (option_update
                              before_some dist
                              destination candidate))
                          (call update_partial_before
                            graph before_some dist used
                            u du edge_i destination candidate)
                          (call relax_update
                            graph start
                            before_some dist used
                            u du destination edge_weight
                            candidate
                            (* (+ settled 1) 100000))
                          (assert
                            (exists ((new_d2 int))
                              (and
                                (known dist destination new_d2)
                                (<= new_d2 candidate))))
                          (call partial_next
                            graph dist used u du edge_i))
                        (block
                          (assert
                            (exists ((kept_d int))
                              (and

  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (dist_nonnegative dist)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (minimum_known dist used chosen chosen_d)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx used (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) chosen_d))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (assert (== (len used) (size wg)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len used))))
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix)
        (assert (and (<= 0 from) (< from (len used))))
        (obtain ((edge_w int))
          (has_edge (view wg) from dest edge_w))
        (call edge_weight_value wg from dest edge_w)
        (assert (>= edge_w 0))
        (if (idx used from)
          (block
            (obtain ((from_d int))
              (and
                (known dist from from_d)
                (is_shortest_dist
                  (view wg) start from from_d)))
            (obtain ((dest_d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from from_d)
                  (known dist dest dest_d))
                (<= dest_d (+ from_d edge_w))))
            (assert
              (>= (path_weight (view wg) prefix) from_d)))
          (call lower_path
            wg start dist used chosen chosen_d prefix))))))

(lemma relax_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (v int) (w int) (candidate int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len before) (len used))
    (== (len before) (size wg))
    (option_update before after v candidate)
    (better before v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== candidate (+ du w))
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u du)
    (dist_nonnegative before)
    (dist_bounded before bound)
    (<= candidate bound)
    (witnesses wg start before)
    (final_vertices wg start before used)
    (closed_vertices wg before used))
  (ensures
    (dist_nonnegative after)
    (dist_bounded after bound)
    (witnesses wg start after)
    (final_vertices wg start after used)
    (closed_vertices wg after used))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (ghost-let extended (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (call update_nonnegative_all
      before after v candidate)
    (call update_bounded_all
      before after v candidate bound)
    (call update_witnesses_all
      wg start before after v candidate extended)
    (call update_final_all
      wg start before after used v candidate)
    (call update_closed_all
      wg before after used v candidate)))

  (body))

(lemma mark_closed_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int)
    (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (bool_update before after u true)
    (not (idx before u))
    (known dist u du)
    (closed_vertices wg dist before)
    (partial_relaxed
      wg dist before u du
      (len (idx (field wg adj) u)))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len after)))
    (idx after a)
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len after)))
    (not (idx after b))
    (has_edge (view wg) a b w))
  (ensures
    (exists ((da int) (db int))
      (and
        (and (known dist a da) (known dist b db))
        (<= db (+ da w)))))
  (body
    (if (== a u)
      (block
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 j)
                (< j (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 0) b)
              (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) j) 1) w))))
        (assert (not (idx before b)))
        (obtain ((db2 int))
          (and
            (known dist b db2)
            (<= db2
              (+ du
                 (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) u) j) 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (idx before a))
        (assert (not (idx before b)))))))

(lemma path_endpoint_known
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (all_known_used dist used)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (known dist (idx p (- (len p) 1)) d)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range wg start p)
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (call law_last p)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start)))
      (block
        (call split_path wg p)
        (ghost-let prefix2 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let from2 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let dest2 int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_endpoint_range wg start prefix2)
        (call path_endpoint_known
          wg start dist used prefix2)
        (obtain ((from_d2 int))
          (known dist from2 from_d2))
        (assert (idx used from2))
        (if (idx used dest2)
          (obtain ((dest_d2 int))
            (and
              (known dist dest2 dest_d2)
              (is_shortest_dist
                (view wg) start dest2 dest_d2)))
          (block
            (obtain ((edge_w2 int))
              (has_edge (view wg) from2 dest2 edge_w2))
            (obtain ((from_d3 int) (dest_d3 int))
              (and
                (and
                  (known dist from2 from_d3)
                  (known dist dest2 dest_d3))
                (<= dest_d3 (+ from_d3 edge_w2))))))))))

    (== (idx dist v) (none))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body

    (obtain ((d int))

(lemma vertex_result
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (known dist start 0)
    (all_known_used dist used)
    (final_vertices wg start dist used)
    (closed_vertices wg dist used))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p2 (seq int)))
          (call absent_has_no_path
            wg start dist used v p2)))
      (case (some result_d)
        (block
          (assert (known dist v result_d))
          (assert (idx used v))
          (call present_is_final
            wg start dist used v result_d))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_i)
          (if (== init_i start)
            (some 0)
            (none)))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (used_i) false)))

          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (dj_row_unique (idx g u)))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p k))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (take p k)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p k))
          (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))))))

(lemma dj_append_path
  (params

  (ensures

    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call dj_edge_weight g u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))

    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))

(lemma dj_witness_one

    (=>

            (is_path g p)

                (is_path g p)

                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))

                (is_path g q)

                  (== (idx q 0) start)
                  (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z)))

(lemma dj_progress_at
  (params
    (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int))

  (requires
    (dj_progress d0 inf f0)

  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))

  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len d1)))
        (< (idx d1 z) inf))
      (if (== z v)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) x))
          (if (== (idx d0 v) inf)
            (block
              (assert (== f1 (+ f0 1)))
              (assert
                (<= (idx d1 z) (* (- f1 1) 100000))))
            (block
              (assert (< (idx d0 v) inf))
              (assert
                (<= (idx d0 v) (* (- f0 1) 100000)))
              (assert (== f1 f0))
              (assert
                (<= (idx d1 z) (* (- f1 1) 100000))))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx d1 z) (idx d0 z)))
          (assert (< (idx d0 z) inf))
          (assert
            (<= (idx d0 z) (* (- f0 1) 100000)))
          (assert (<= f0 f1))

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (len dist)))
    (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- k 1))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len dist))))
        (call dj_stable_edge
          g dist inf
          (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w)
        (call dj_path_weight_step g p k)
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx dist (idx p k))
            (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))
            0))))))

    (if
      (and
        (is_path g p)
        (and
          (== (idx p 0) start)
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- (len p) 1))
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert
          (and

(lemma dj_final_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (dj_witnessed g start dist inf)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (< (idx dist v) inf)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v))))
        (forall ((q (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v q))
        (assert
          (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx dist v))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call dj_lower_path g start dist inf v p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))))))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (seq (option int)))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (dj_witnessed (view wg) start dist inf)
    (dj_stable (view wg) dist inf)
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (dj_result dist res inf))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path (view wg) p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                false)))
          (case (some d)
            (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (call dj_graph_facts wg)
    (assert (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dj_final_at (view wg) start dist res inf v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (call dj_graph_facts graph)
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)

    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut found i64 1)

    (call dj_initial_bound dist start 10000000001)

      (invariant (dj_rows_unique (view graph)))
      (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))

      (invariant
        (=> active (> budget (dj_sum dist))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (not active)
          (dj_stable (view graph) dist 10000000001)))
      (decreases budget)
      (ghost-let pass_sum int (dj_sum dist))
      (set budget (- budget 1))
      (set active false)
      (let-mut ou i64 0)
      (while (< ou n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ou) (<= ou n)))
        (invariant (== (len dist) n))
        (invariant (dj_vertices (view graph)))
        (invariant (dj_rows_unique (view graph)))
        (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
        (invariant (dj_progress dist 10000000001 found))
        (invariant
          (dj_witnessed (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
        (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
        (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
        (invariant (<= (dj_sum dist) pass_sum))
        (invariant
          (=> active (< (dj_sum dist) pass_sum)))
        (invariant
          (=>
            (not active)
            (dj_scan (view graph) dist 10000000001 ou 0)))
        (decreases (- n ou))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) ou)))
        (let-mut ei i64 0)
        (while (< ei deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 ei) (<= ei deg)))
          (invariant (== (len dist) n))
          (invariant (dj_vertices (view graph)))
          (invariant (dj_rows_unique (view graph)))
          (invariant (dj_bounded dist 10000000001))
          (invariant (dj_progress dist 10000000001 found))
          (invariant
            (dj_witnessed (view graph) start dist 10000000001))
          (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
          (invariant (>= (dj_sum dist) 0))
          (invariant (<= (dj_sum dist) pass_sum))
          (invariant
            (=> active (< (dj_sum dist) pass_sum)))
          (invariant
            (=>
              (not active)
              (dj_scan (view graph) dist 10000000001 ou ei)))
          (decreases (- deg ei))
          (call dj_edge_facts graph ou ei)

        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (<= (idx s i) b)))))
  (ensures (<= (dj_sum s) (* (len s) b)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find

        (call dj_weight_find row v w at (+ i 1))

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params

        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))

  (params

(lemma dj_witness_one

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int) (dist (seq int)) (inf int)
    (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (> inf 0)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)
    (dj_vertices g)
    (dj_rows_unique g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))

    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))

      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dj_path_bound g start dist inf p (- k 1))

      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p k) start))
        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (take p 1))

(lemma dj_finish
  (params
