                        (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next))))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u i)
                         (!= (idx old a) inf)))
                  (<=
                    (idx next (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                    (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
                (or
                  (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
                  (exists ((a int) (j int))
                    (and
                      (and
                        (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                             (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                        (and
                          (and
                            (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                            (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                          (and (bf_seen a j u i)
                               (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
                        (== (idx next v)
                            (+ (idx old a)
                               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_changed
  ((old (seq int)) (next (seq int)) (changed bool))
  bool
  (body (== changed (not (== old next)))))

(ghost-fn bf_update
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before))
           (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after v) x)
        (forall ((q int))
          (=> (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len before))) (!= q v))
              (== (idx after q) (idx before q))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_answer
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (inf int))
  bool
  (body
    (and (== (len d) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (if (== (idx d v) inf)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path g p)
                    (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                         (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false))
            (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_option_prefix
  ((d (seq int)) (out (seq (option int))) (k int) (inf int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len d)))
      (and (== (len out) k)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k))
            (match (idx out v)
              (case (none) (== (idx d v) inf))
              (case (some x)
                (and (!= (idx d v) inf)
                     (== x (idx d v)))))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_graph_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (<= (len g) 100000)
      (and
        (forall ((u int) (i int))
          (=> (and
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))
        (and
          (forall ((u int) (i int) (j int))
            (=> (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))))
                  (!= i j))
                (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
                    (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
          (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
            (=> (has_edge g u v w)
                (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000)))))))))

(ghost-fn bf_in_range_seq ((s (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n))))))

(ghost-fn bf_join ((a (seq int)) (b (seq int))) (seq int)
  (requires (> (len b) 0))
  (body (concat a (drop b 1))))

(lemma bf_graph_ok_view
  (params (g weighted_graph))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view g)))
  (ensures (bf_graph_ok (view g)))
  (body
    (assert (<= (len (view g)) 100000))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (i int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view g))))
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (view g) u)))))
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (view g) u) i) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx (view g) u) i) 0)
                 (len (view g)))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (i int) (j int))
        (=> (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view g))))
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (view g) u))))
                  (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx (view g) u))))))
              (!= i j))
            (!= (get (idx (idx (view g) u) i) 0)
                (get (idx (idx (view g) u) j) 0)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
        (=> (has_edge (view g) u v w)
            (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000)))))))

(lemma bf_weight_at
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (from int)
    (at int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 from) (<= from at))
    (< at (len row))
    (forall ((h int))
      (=> (and (<= from h) (< h at))
          (!= (get (idx row h) 0)
              (get (idx row at) 0)))))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row (get (idx row at) 0) from)
        (get (idx row at) 1)))
  (decreases (- at from))
  (body
    (if (< from at)
      (call bf_weight_at row (+ from 1) at)
      (block))))

(lemma bf_edge_value
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge g u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((h int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 h) (< h i))
            (!= (get (idx (idx g u) h) 0)
                (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
    (call bf_weight_at (idx g u) 0 i)))

(lemma bf_append_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (h int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) h)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ h 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_append_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (== (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_append_edge_at g p v h))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight g
               (take (concat p (seq-lit v))
                     (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g
               (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                    (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
               (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                    (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma bf_prefix_edge_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (h int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (>= (len p) 2)
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- (len p) 2))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) h)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ h 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_prefix_last
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p)
    (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i)
             (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 0)
              (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
          (and
            (== (get_edge_weight g
                  (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 1))
            (== (path_weight g p)
                (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                   (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 1))))))))
  (body
    (forall ((h int))
      (call bf_prefix_edge_at g p h))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))
        w))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (< (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i)
               (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 0)
              (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) i) 1)
              w))))
    (call bf_edge_value g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) i)))

(lemma bf_path_weight_bounds
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (is_path g p))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= (path_weight g p)
          (* -100000 (- (len p) 1)))
      (<= (path_weight g p)
          (* 100000 (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call bf_path_weight_bounds g prefix)
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 edge_index)
              (< edge_index
                 (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
            (and
              (== (get
                    (idx
                      (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                      edge_index)
                    0)
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g
                      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                        edge_index)
                      1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g prefix)
                       (get
                         (idx
                           (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                           edge_index)
                         1)))))))
        (call bf_edge_value
          g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) edge_index)
        (assert
          (and
            (>=
              (get
                (idx
                  (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                  edge_index)
                1)
              -100000)
            (<=
              (get
                (idx
                  (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                  edge_index)
                1)
              100000)))))))

(lemma bf_initial_range
  (params (d (seq int)) (n int) (start int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (> inf 0)
    (bf_source_shape d n start inf))
  (ensures (bf_range d 0 inf))
  (body))

(lemma bf_initial_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (> inf 0)
    (bf_source_shape d (len g) start inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx d v) inf))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and (is_path g p)
          (and (== (idx p 0) start)
            (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
                 (<= (len p) 1))))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))))
  (body
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (== (idx d v) 0))
    (assert
      (and (is_path g (seq-lit start))
        (and (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start)
          (and (== (idx (seq-lit start)
                       (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1))
                   v)
               (<= (len (seq-lit start)) 1)))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))))

(lemma bf_initial_lower
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (> inf 0)
    (bf_source_shape d (len g) start inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (and (is_path g p)
      (and (== (idx p 0) start)
        (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
             (<= (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== v start))
    (assert (== (idx d v) 0))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))))

(lemma bf_initial_round
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (> inf 0)
    (bf_source_shape d (len g) start inf))
  (ensures (bf_round_ok g start d 0 inf))
  (body
    (call bf_initial_range d (len g) start inf)
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_initial_witness g start d inf v))
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (call bf_initial_lower g start d inf v p))))

(lemma bf_pass_begin
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires
    (== next old)
    (== (len old) (len g)))
  (ensures

(lemma bf_pass_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (inf int)
    (was_changed bool)
    (now_changed bool))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old before u i inf)
    (bf_changed old before was_changed)
    (if (and (!= (idx old u) inf)
             (< (+ (idx old u) w) (idx before v)))
      (and
        (== x (+ (idx old u) w))
        (and
          (bf_update before after v x)
          (== now_changed true)))
      (and
        (== after before)
        (== now_changed was_changed))))
  (ensures
    (bf_pass_ok g old after u (+ i 1) inf)
    (bf_changed old after now_changed))
  (body
    (assert (== (len after) (len old)))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
            (<= (idx after q) (idx old q)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after))))
            (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                 (!= (idx old a) inf)))
          (<=
            (idx after (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
          (or
            (== (idx after q) (idx old q))
            (exists ((a int) (j int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                       (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                      (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len after)))
                    (and (bf_seen a j u (+ i 1))
                         (!= (idx old a) inf))))
                (and
                  (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) q)
                  (== (idx after q)
                      (+ (idx old a)
                         (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))))))))

(lemma bf_pass_row
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (u int)

  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (bf_pass_ok g old next u (len (idx g u)) inf))
  (ensures (bf_pass_ok g old next (+ u 1) 0 inf))
  (body))

(lemma bf_finish_range_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g 0 old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (or (== (idx next v) inf)
      (and
        (>= (idx next v) (* -100000 (+ k 1)))
        (<= (idx next v) (* 100000 (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) 100000)))))))

(lemma bf_finish_witness_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) inf))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and (is_path g p)
          (and (== (idx p 0) start)
            (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
                 (<= (len p) (+ (+ k 1) 1)))))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx next v) (idx old v))
      (block
        (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (and (is_path g old_path)
              (and (== (idx old_path 0) start)
                (and
                  (== (idx old_path (- (len old_path) 1)) v)
                  (<= (len old_path) (+ k 1)))))
            (== (path_weight g old_path) (idx old v))))
        (assert
          (and (is_path g old_path)
            (and (== (idx old_path 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx old_path (- (len old_path) 1)) v)
                (<= (len old_path) (+ (+ k 1) 1)))))))
      (block
        (obtain ((a int) (j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
                   (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
                (and
                  (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
                  (!= (idx old a) inf))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (== (idx next v)
                  (+ (idx old a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
        (obtain ((edge_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (and (is_path g edge_path)
              (and (== (idx edge_path 0) start)
                (and
                  (== (idx edge_path (- (len edge_path) 1)) a)
                  (<= (len edge_path) (+ k 1)))))
            (== (path_weight g edge_path) (idx old a))))
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (call bf_append_one
          g edge_path v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
        (assert
          (and
            (is_path g (concat edge_path (seq-lit v)))
            (and
              (== (idx (concat edge_path (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx (concat edge_path (seq-lit v))
                         (- (len (concat edge_path (seq-lit v))) 1))
                    v)
                (<= (len (concat edge_path (seq-lit v)))
                    (+ (+ k 1) 1))))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_lower_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (k int)
    (inf int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (< k (len g))
    (== inf (bf_inf))
    (bf_round_ok g start old k inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (and (is_path g p)
      (and (== (idx p 0) start)
        (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
             (<= (len p) (+ (+ k 1) 1))))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx next v)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (and (is_path g p)
            (and (== (idx p 0) start)
              (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
                   (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) (+ k 2)))
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 j)
              (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 0)
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g
                      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                    (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2))) j) 1)))))))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (and (is_path g prefix)
            (and (== (idx prefix 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx prefix (- (len prefix) 1))
                    (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                (<= (len prefix) (+ k 1))))))
        (call bf_path_weight_bounds g prefix)
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g prefix)
              (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2)))))
        (assert
          (< (path_weight g prefix) inf))
        (assert
          (!= (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2))) inf))
        (assert
          (bf_seen
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            j
            (len g)
            0))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx next
              (get
                (idx
                  (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                  j)
                0))
            (+ (idx old (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
               (get
                 (idx
                   (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
                   j)
                 1))))))))

(lemma bf_finish_round

(lemma bf_path_range_at

  (ensures

  (body
    (if (< h (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (obtain ((next_weight int))
          (has_edge g (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)) next_weight)))
      (if (== h 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert
            (connected g
              (idx p (- h 1))

          (obtain ((previous_weight int))
            (has_edge g

              (idx p h)

          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx p (- h 1)))
                     (< (idx p (- h 1)) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 j)
                     (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- h 1)))))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- h 1))) j) 0)

(lemma bf_compress_range
  (params (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (!= y x))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (if (< y x) y (- y 1)))
      (< (if (< y x) y (- y 1)) (- n 1))))
  (body))

(lemma bf_compress_range_at
  (params
    (s (seq int))
    (x int)
    (n int)
    (h int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n)
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h n))
    (not
      (exists ((q int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
          (== (idx s q) x))))
    (== x (idx s n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0
        (if (< (idx s h) x)
          (idx s h)
          (- (idx s h) 1)))
      (<
        (if (< (idx s h) x)
          (idx s h)
          (- (idx s h) 1))
        (- n 1))))
  (body
    (assert (!= (idx s h) x))
    (call bf_compress_range x (idx s h) n)))

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))
      (if (< b x) b (- b 1))))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found_index int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found_index) (< found_index n))
                (== (idx s found_index) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range_at s x n h))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((repeat_i int) (repeat_j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 repeat_i) (< repeat_i repeat_j))
                (and
                  (< repeat_j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed repeat_i)
                      (idx compressed repeat_j)))))
            (assert (< repeat_i n))
            (assert (< repeat_j n))
            (assert (!= (idx s repeat_i) x))
            (assert (!= (idx s repeat_j) x))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s repeat_i) (idx s repeat_j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (bf_join a b))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (bf_join a b) (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
        (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (len (bf_join a b))
        (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
        (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (> (len b) 1)
      (block
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (call bf_subpath g b 0 (- (len b) 2))
        (call bf_join_paths g a prefix)
        (assert
          (==
            (bf_join a b)
            (concat
              (bf_join a prefix)
              (seq-lit (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))
        (assert
          (==
            (take (bf_join a b)
                  (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
            (bf_join a prefix)))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx (bf_join a b)
                 (- (len (bf_join a b)) 2))
            (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx (bf_join a b)
                 (- (len (bf_join a b)) 1))
            (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g b)
            (+ (path_weight g prefix)
               (get_edge_weight g
                 (idx b (- (len b) 2))
                 (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
            (+ (path_weight g (bf_join a prefix))
               (get_edge_weight g
                 (idx b (- (len b) 2))
                 (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight g (bf_join a b))
            (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (bf_join a b) a))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) 0))))))

(lemma bf_cycle_remove
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
    (< j (len p))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (== (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))
             (- (len (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g
      (bf_join
        (take p (+ i 1))
        (drop p j)))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          0)
        (idx p 0))
    (== (idx
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j))
          (-
            (len
              (bf_join
                (take p (+ i 1))
                (drop p j)))
            1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (len
          (bf_join
            (take p (+ i 1))
            (drop p j)))
        (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g
            (bf_join
              (take p (+ i 1))
              (drop p j)))
          (path_weight g
            (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let prefix_i (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let prefix_j (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop p i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (ghost-let suffix_j (seq int) (drop p j))
    (call bf_subpath g p 0 i)
    (call bf_subpath g p i j)
    (call bf_subpath g p j (- (len p) 1))
    (call bf_join_paths g prefix_i cycle)
    (call bf_join_paths g prefix_j suffix_j)
    (call bf_join_paths g prefix_i suffix_j)
    (assert (== (bf_join prefix_i cycle) prefix_j))
    (assert (== (bf_join prefix_j suffix_j) p))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g prefix_j)
        (+ (path_weight g prefix_i)
           (path_weight g cycle))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g prefix_j)
           (path_weight g suffix_j))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (bf_join prefix_i suffix_j))
        (+ (path_weight g prefix_i)
           (path_weight g suffix_j))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (bf_join prefix_i suffix_j))
           (path_weight g cycle))))))

(lemma bf_negative_final_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq int))
    (next (seq int))
    (inf int))
  (requires
    (bf_graph_ok g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- (len g) 1) inf)
    (bf_pass_ok g old next (len g) 0 inf)
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (assert (< (idx next v) (idx old v)))
    (obtain ((a int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) (len next)))
            (and
              (bf_seen a j (len g) 0)
              (!= (idx old a) inf))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
          (== (idx next v)
              (+ (idx old a) (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and (is_path g p)
          (and (== (idx p 0) start)
            (and (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) a)
                 (<= (len p) (len g)))))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx old a))))
    (call bf_edge_value g a j)
    (call bf_append_one g p v (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (idx next v)))
    (assert (<= (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (if (<= (len q) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (and (is_path g q)
            (and (== (idx q 0) start)
              (and (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v)
                   (<= (len q) (len g))))))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len g) 1)))
    (call bf_path_range g start q)
    (call bf_pigeon q (len g))
    (obtain ((i int) (cycle_end int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i cycle_end))
        (and
          (< cycle_end (len q))
          (== (idx q i) (idx q cycle_end)))))
    (call bf_cycle_remove g q i cycle_end)
    (ghost-let cycle (seq int)
      (take (drop q i) (+ (- cycle_end i) 1)))
    (ghost-let shortened (seq int)
      (bf_join
        (take q (+ i 1))
        (drop q cycle_end)))
    (if (>= (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shortened) (len g)))
        (assert
          (and (is_path g shortened)
            (and (== (idx shortened 0) start)
              (and (== (idx shortened (- (len shortened) 1)) v)
                   (<= (len shortened) (len g))))))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g shortened) (idx old v)))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g q) (idx old v)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path g cycle) (> (len cycle) 1))
        (and
          (== (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))
          (< (path_weight g cycle) 0))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (d (seq int))

  (requires

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx d v) inf)
    (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (and (is_path g p)
            (and (== (idx p 0) start)
              (and
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)

        (call bf_path_weight_bounds g p)
        (assert (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))
        (assert (< (path_weight g p) inf))
        (assert (!= (idx d v) inf)))
      (block
        (call bf_prefix_last g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int)
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0) v)
              (and
                (== (get_edge_weight g a v)
                    (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
                (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g prefix)
                       (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))
        (call bf_fixed_path g start d inf a prefix)
        (call bf_edge_value g a j)
        (assert (bf_seen a j (len g) 0))
        (assert
          (<=
            (idx d v)
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))))
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) -100000)
            (<= (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1) 100000)))
        (assert
          (<= (idx d a)
              (* 100000 (- (len g) 1))))
        (assert
          (<
            (+ (idx d a)
               (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            inf))
        (assert (!= (idx d v) inf))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight g p) (idx d v)))))))

        (if (< (idx s h) x)

          (- (idx s h) 1)))
      (<
        (if (< (idx s h) x)

(lemma bf_compress_injective
  (params (x int) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (!= a x)
    (!= b x)
    (==
      (if (< a x) a (- a 1))

(lemma bf_pigeon
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len s) (+ n 1))
    (bf_in_range_seq s n))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and (< j (len s))
             (== (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx s 1) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let x int (idx s n))
        (if
          (exists ((i int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
              (== (idx s i) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found_index int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found_index) (< found_index n))
                (== (idx s found_index) x))))
          (block
            (ghost-let compressed (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (h)
                  (if (< (idx s h) x)
                    (idx s h)
                    (- (idx s h) 1)))))
            (forall ((h int))
              (call bf_compress_range_at s x n h))
            (assert (bf_in_range_seq compressed (- n 1)))
            (call bf_pigeon compressed (- n 1))
            (obtain ((repeat_i int) (repeat_j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 repeat_i) (< repeat_i repeat_j))
                (and
                  (< repeat_j (len compressed))
                  (== (idx compressed repeat_i)
                      (idx compressed repeat_j)))))
            (assert (< repeat_i n))
            (assert (< repeat_j n))
            (assert (!= (idx s repeat_i) x))
            (assert (!= (idx s repeat_j) x))
            (call bf_compress_injective
              x (idx s repeat_i) (idx s repeat_j) n)))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (if (> (len b) 1)

  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call dj_sum_upper (take s (- (len s) 1)) b)
        (call law_last s)
        (assert
          (==
            (dj_sum s)
            (+ (dj_sum (take s (- (len s) 1))) (last s)))))
      (block))))

(lemma dj_sum_decrease
  (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (dj_upd s0 s1 i x)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (idx s0 i)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0)))
        (>= (idx s0 j) 0))))
  (ensures
    (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))
    (>= (dj_sum s1) 0))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (if (< i (- (len s0) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (dj_upd
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            i x))
        (call dj_sum_decrease
          (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))
          (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
          i x)
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert (== (last s1) (last s0)))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len s0) 1)))
        (call law_last s0)
        (call law_last s1)
        (assert
          (==
            (take s1 (- (len s1) 1))
            (take s0 (- (len s0) 1))))
        (assert (< (dj_sum s1) (dj_sum s0)))))
    (call dj_sum_nonnegative s1)))

(lemma dj_weight_find

(lemma dj_path_weight_step
  (params

(lemma dj_path_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires
    (> inf 0)
    (dj_stable g dist inf)

        (assert (< (idx dist (idx p k)) inf))

(ghost-fn a_sum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
    (+ (a_sum g h d (- a 1) b) (if (ins d (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn b_sum ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (b_sum h d a (- b 1)) (col_w h d (- b 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn rt ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int
  (body (- (if (ins d u) (row_sum h u m) 0) (col_w h d u m))))
(ghost-fn g_sum ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (g_sum h d (- a 1) n) (rt h d (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn s_sum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
    (+ (s_sum g h d (- a 1) n)
       (if (ins d (- a 1)) (- (row_sum h (- a 1) n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) n)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cons_h ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (ins d u) (!= u s)) (== (row_sum h u n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u n))))))
(ghost-fn tight ((d (seq int)) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (and (=> (and (ins d u) (not (ins d v))) (<= (get_flow h0 u v) (get_flow h1 u v)))
             (=> (and (not (ins d u)) (ins d v)) (<= (get_flow h1 u v) (get_flow h0 u v))))))))
(ghost-fn flow_nn ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn flow_of ((c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))) (seq (seq int))
  (body (seq-build (len c) (fn (u) (seq-build (len c) (fn (v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))))))

(ghost-fn wf ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
          (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))
    (forall ((u int) (i int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
               (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j)))
          (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn tg ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int)) int
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) -1)))
(ghost-fn tgt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) false (or (tgt g u (- k 1) v) (== (tg g u (- k 1)) v)))))
(ghost-fn z_sum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (z_sum g h u k (- m 1)) (if (tgt g u k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn row_supp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (!= (get_flow h u v) 0))
          (tgt g u (len (idx g u)) v))))))

(ghost-fn cell_good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow c x y) 100000))
             (=> (> (get_flow c x y) 0) (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y))))))))
(ghost-fn rows_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
        (=> (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))
            (== (get_flow c x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (sq c (len g))
    (and (cell_good g c (len g))
      (forall ((u int) (v int) (x int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v x) (== (get_flow c u v) x)))))))

(ghost-fn ge_m1 ((dist (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist))) (>= (idx dist w) -1)))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((queue (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n))))))
(ghost-fn queue_dist ((dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len dist))))
    (and (<= 0 (idx dist (idx queue k))) (<= (idx dist (idx queue k)) k))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist))) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx dist w) 0))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos w)) (< (idx pos w) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn notin ((queue (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (!= (idx queue k) v)))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn closed ((r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len d))) (> (get_flow r (idx queue k) e) 0)))
        (>= (idx d e) 0)))))
(ghost-fn partial ((r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e i)) (and (< e (len d)) (> (get_flow r u e) 0)))
        (>= (idx d e) 0)))))
(ghost-fn closed_all ((r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len d))))
             (and (>= (idx d u) 0) (> (get_flow r u e) 0)))
        (>= (idx d e) 0)))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (a (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len p) (len d)) (== (len a) (len d)))
    (forall ((w int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len d))) (>= (idx d w) 0))
          (and (>= (idx a w) 1)
            (=> (!= w s)
              (and (and (<= 0 (idx p w)) (< (idx p w) (len d)))
                (and (and (>= (idx d (idx p w)) 0) (== (idx d w) (+ (idx d (idx p w)) 1)))
                  (and (<= (idx a w) (idx a (idx p w)))
                       (<= (idx a w) (get_flow r (idx p w) w))))))))))))

(lemma gf_at (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sq m n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (and (< u (len m)) (< v (len (idx m u)))) (== (get_flow m u v) (idx (idx m u) v)))
  (body))
(lemma view_len (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (ensures (== (len (view cg)) (len (field cg adj))))

(lemma view_row (params (cg capacity_graph) (u int))

           (== (len (idx (view cg) u)) (len (idx (field cg adj) u))))

(lemma view_at (params (cg capacity_graph) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (field cg adj)))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))))
  (ensures (== (len (view cg)) (len (field cg adj)))
           (== (len (idx (view cg) u)) (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
           (== (get (idx (idx (view cg) u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 0))

(lemma pair_compose (params (m (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (delta int) (w1 int) (w2 int))
  (requires (cell_upd m m1 n a b w1) (cell_upd m1 m2 n b a w2) (!= a b)
            (== w1 (- (get_flow m a b) delta)) (== w2 (+ (get_flow m b a) delta)))
  (ensures (pair_upd m m2 n a b delta))
  (body))
(lemma row_pair (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (delta int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (pair_upd m0 m1 n a b delta) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum m1 u m) (+ (row_sum m0 u m) (row_chg a b delta u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call row_pair m0 m1 n a b delta u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow m1 u (- m 1)) (+ (get_flow m0 u (- m 1)) (pt_chg a b delta u (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma row_nn (params (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (rnn r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (>= (row_sum r u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call row_nn r n u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma row_ub (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum c u m) (* m 100000)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call row_ub g c u (- m 1))
        (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow c u (- m 1)) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma cap_rnn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (sq c (len g)) (rnn c (len g)))
  (body))
(lemma bd_from (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (== n (len g)) (skew c r n))
  (ensures (pair_bd r n))
  (body))
(lemma bd_skew (params (r (seq (seq int))) (q (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (pair_bd r n) (same_skew r q n))
  (ensures (pair_bd q n))
  (body))
(lemma rnn_step (params (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (rnn c0 n) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (<= 0 delta) (<= delta (get_flow c0 u v)) (!= u v))
  (ensures (rnn c1 n))
  (body))
(lemma skew_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (same_skew r c0 n) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v))
  (ensures (same_skew r c1 n))
  (body))
(lemma untouched_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (== (len d) n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (untouched r c0 d (idx d v)) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (== (idx d v) (+ (idx d u) 1)))
  (ensures (untouched r c1 d (idx d u)))
  (body))
(lemma shift_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (t int) (v int) (u int) (delta int) (x int))
  (requires (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (row_shift r c0 n t v delta) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum c1 x n) (- (+ (row_sum r x n) (if (== x t) delta 0)) (if (== x u) delta 0))))
  (body
    (call row_pair c0 c1 n u v delta x n)
    (assert (== (row_sum c0 x n) (- (+ (row_sum r x n) (if (== x t) delta 0)) (if (== x v) delta 0))))))
(lemma shift_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (t int) (v int) (u int) (delta int))
  (requires (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (row_shift r c0 n t v delta))
  (ensures (row_shift r c1 n t u delta))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call shift_at r c0 c1 n t v u delta x))))
(lemma skew_next (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (skew c r1 n) (same_skew r1 r n))
  (ensures (skew c r n))
  (body))
(lemma bal_next (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (val int) (dl int))
  (requires (balanced c r1 n s t val) (row_shift r1 r n t s dl) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t))
  (ensures (balanced c r n s t (+ val dl))
           (== (row_sum r s n) (- (row_sum r1 s n) dl)))
  (body))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 dist0) (upd dist0 dist v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 dist))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_qdist (params (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (queue_dist dist0 queue0) (in_range queue0 (len dist0)) (notin queue0 v) (upd dist0 dist v x)
            (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (len queue0))))
  (ensures (queue_dist dist queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_pos (params (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
                        (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (positions dist0 queue0 pos0) (== (len pos0) (len dist0)) (upd dist0 dist v x) (== (idx dist0 v) -1)
            (appended queue0 queue v) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)))
  (ensures (positions dist queue pos))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree (params (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (d0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (a0 (seq int))
                         (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (a (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (tree_ok r s d0 p0 a0) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len d0))) (== (idx d0 s) 0)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d0))) (>= (idx d0 u) 0)
            (upd d0 d v x) (== (idx d0 v) -1) (upd p0 p v u) (upd a0 a v y)
            (== x (+ (idx d0 u) 1)) (>= y 1) (<= y (idx a0 u)) (<= y (get_flow r u v)))
  (ensures (tree_ok r s d p a))
  (body))
(lemma step_closed (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (closed r d0 q0 head) (<= head (len q0)) (upd d0 d v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q v))
  (ensures (closed r d q head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial r d0 u v) (upd d0 d v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial r d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_seen (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial r d u v) (ge_m1 d) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
            (=> (> (get_flow r u v) 0) (!= (idx d v) -1)))
  (ensures (partial r d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (u int))
  (requires (closed r d q head) (partial r d u (len d)) (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q))) (== (idx q head) u))
  (ensures (closed r d q (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma final_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (positions d q pos) (== (len pos) (len d)) (closed r d q (len q))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len d)))
            (>= (idx d u) 0) (> (get_flow r u e) 0))
  (ensures (>= (idx d e) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx q (idx pos u)) u))
    (assert (> (get_flow r (idx q (idx pos u)) e) 0))))
(lemma final_closed (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)))
  (requires (positions d q pos) (== (len pos) (len d)) (closed r d q (len q)))
  (ensures (closed_all r d))
  (body (forall ((u int) (e int)) (call final_at r d q pos u e))))
(lemma tree_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (a (seq int)) (w int))
  (requires (tree_ok r s d p a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len d))) (>= (idx d w) 0))
  (ensures
    (and (== (len p) (len d)) (== (len a) (len d)))
    (>= (idx a w) 1)
    (=> (!= w s)
      (and (and (<= 0 (idx p w)) (< (idx p w) (len d)))
        (and (and (>= (idx d (idx p w)) 0) (== (idx d w) (+ (idx d (idx p w)) 1)))
          (and (<= (idx a w) (idx a (idx p w)))
               (<= (idx a w) (get_flow r (idx p w) w)))))))
  (body))

(lemma tgt_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)))
  (ensures (tgt g u k (tg g u i)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> (- k 1) i) (call tgt_has g u (- k 1) i) (block))))
(lemma tgt_fresh (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k j)) (< j (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (not (tgt g u k (tg g u j))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call tgt_fresh g u (- k 1) j)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
        (assert (!= (tg g u (- k 1)) (tg g u j))))
      (block))))
(lemma z_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block (call z_zero g h u (- m 1)) (assert (not (tgt g u 0 (- m 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma z_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u k m)
               (+ (z_sum g h u (- k 1) m)
                  (if (< (tg g u (- k 1)) m) (get_flow h u (tg g u (- k 1))) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (>= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) 0))
    (assert (>= (tg g u (- k 1)) 0))
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call z_step g h u k (- m 1))
        (call tgt_fresh g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
        (assert (== (tgt g u k (- m 1)) (or (tgt g u (- k 1) (- m 1)) (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_z (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (z_sum g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_z g h u (- k 1))
        (call z_step g h u k (len g))
        (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g)))
        (assert (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))
      (call z_zero g h u (len g)))))
(lemma z_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (row_supp g h u) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u (len (idx g u)) m) (row_sum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call z_full g h u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma supp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h u v) 0) (tgt g u (len (idx g u)) v)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((y int)) (and (has_capacity g u v y) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) y)))
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                                 (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) y))))
          (call tgt_has g u (len (idx g u)) i)
          (assert (== (tg g u i) v)))
        (block))
      (block))))
(lemma out_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_z g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_at g h u v))
    (assert (row_supp g h u))
    (call z_full g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))))

(lemma bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h) (cap_ok g c)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((y int)) (and (has_capacity g u v y) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) y)))
          (assert (== (get_flow c u v) y)))
        (block))
      (block))))

(lemma a_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (> b 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a b) (+ (a_sum g h d a (- b 1)) (col_w h d (- b 1) a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call a_step g h d (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) b)
                    (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (- b 1)) (get_flow h (- b 1) (- a 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma a_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call a_zero g h d (- a 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) 0) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma ab_swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a b) (b_sum h d a b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block (call ab_swap g h d a (- b 1)) (call a_step g h d a b))
      (call a_zero g h d a))))
(lemma s_g (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (- (s_sum g h d a n) (g_sum h d a n)) (- (b_sum h d n a) (a_sum g h d a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call s_g g h d (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (rt h d (- a 1) n) (- (if (ins d (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) n) 0) (col_w h d (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma s_single (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (cons_h g h d s n) (ins d s) (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (s_sum g h d a n)
               (if (< s a) (- (row_sum h s n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call s_single g h d s n (- a 1))
        (assert (=> (and (ins d (- a 1)) (!= (- a 1) s))
                    (== (row_sum h (- a 1) n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma rt_mono (params (d (seq int)) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (tight d h0 h1 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (rt h0 d u m) (rt h1 d u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rt_mono d h0 h1 n u (- m 1))
        (assert (<= (- (if (ins d u) (get_flow h0 u (- m 1)) 0) (if (ins d (- m 1)) (get_flow h0 u (- m 1)) 0))
                    (- (if (ins d u) (get_flow h1 u (- m 1)) 0) (if (ins d (- m 1)) (get_flow h1 u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma g_mono (params (d (seq int)) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (tight d h0 h1 n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (g_sum h0 d a n) (g_sum h1 d a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block (call g_mono d h0 h1 n (- a 1)) (call rt_mono d h0 h1 n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma val_g (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int))
  (requires (ins d s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (cons_h g h d s (len g))
            (== (total_flow_out g h s) (row_sum h s (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (g_sum h d (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call s_single g h d s (len g) (len g))
    (call s_g g h d (len g) (len g))
    (call ab_swap g h d (len g) (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))))))

(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (not (ins d t)) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (ins d u) (!= u s))
  (ensures (== (row_sum h u (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (flow_nn h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
    (assert (!= u t))
    (call out_eq g h u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma cons_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (not (ins d t)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (cons_h g h d s (len g)))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g h d s t u))))

(lemma fo_sq (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))))
  (ensures (sq (flow_of c r) (len c)))
  (body (assert (== (len (flow_of c r)) (len c)))))
(lemma fo_idx (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len c))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len c))))
  (ensures (== (len (flow_of c r)) (len c))
           (== (len (idx (flow_of c r) u)) (len c))
           (== (idx (idx (flow_of c r) u) v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v))))
           (== (get_flow (flow_of c r) u v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
  (body))
(lemma fo_nn (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))))
  (ensures (flow_nn (flow_of c r)))
  (body
    (call fo_sq c r)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fo_idx c r u v))))
(lemma fo_resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (== (len c) (len g)) (sq (flow_of c r) (len g)) (rnn r (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx (flow_of c r) u) v) 0)
               (exists ((k int)) (and (has_capacity g u v k) (<= (idx (idx (flow_of c r) u) v) k)))))
  (body
    (call fo_idx c r u v)
    (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow r u v) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow c u v) 0)
      (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
      (block))))
(lemma fo_resp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g (flow_of c r)))
  (body
    (assert (sq c (len g)))
    (call fo_sq c r)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fo_resp_at g c r u v))))
(lemma f_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (== (len c) n) (skew c r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (== (- (row_sum (flow_of c r) u m) (sum_flow_in_recursive g (flow_of c r) u m))
               (- (row_sum c u m) (row_sum r u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call f_net g c r n u (- m 1))
        (call fo_idx c r u (- m 1))
        (call fo_idx c r (- m 1) u)
        (assert (== (+ (get_flow r u (- m 1)) (get_flow r (- m 1) u))
                    (+ (get_flow c u (- m 1)) (get_flow c (- m 1) u))))
        (assert (== (- (get_flow (flow_of c r) u (- m 1)) (get_flow (flow_of c r) (- m 1) u))
                    (- (get_flow c u (- m 1)) (get_flow r u (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma fo_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (balanced c r (len g) s t val)
            (respects_capacity g (flow_of c r)) (flow_nn (flow_of c r))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g (flow_of c r) u) (total_flow_out g (flow_of c r) u)))
  (body
    (assert (sq c (len g)))
    (call out_eq g (flow_of c r) u)
    (call f_net g c r (len g) u (len g))
    (assert (== (row_sum r u (len g)) (row_sum c u (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g (flow_of c r) u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g (flow_of c r) u (len g))))))
(lemma fo_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (balanced c r (len g) s t val))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g (flow_of c r) s t)
           (respects_capacity g (flow_of c r))
           (flow_nn (flow_of c r)))
  (body
    (call fo_resp g c r)
    (call fo_nn c r)
    (forall ((u int)) (call fo_cons_at g c r s t val u))
    (assert (is_conserved g (flow_of c r) s t))))
(lemma fo_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g c) (skew c r (len g)) (balanced c r (len g) s t val)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (respects_capacity g (flow_of c r)) (flow_nn (flow_of c r)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g (flow_of c r) s) val))
  (body
    (assert (sq c (len g)))
    (call out_eq g (flow_of c r) s)
    (call f_net g c r (len g) s (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g (flow_of c r) s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g (flow_of c r) s (len g))))))
(lemma tight_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (== (len d) (len g)) (closed_all r d)
            (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (and (=> (and (ins d u) (not (ins d v))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow (flow_of c r) u v)))
                (=> (and (not (ins d u)) (ins d v)) (<= (get_flow (flow_of c r) u v) (get_flow h u v)))))
  (body
    (assert (sq c (len g)))
    (assert (== (len c) (len g)))
    (call fo_idx c r u v)
    (call bound_at g h c u v)
    (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow c v u) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow r u v) 0))
    (assert (>= (get_flow r v u) 0))
    (assert (== (+ (get_flow r u v) (get_flow r v u)) (+ (get_flow c u v) (get_flow c v u))))
    (assert (=> (and (>= (idx d u) 0) (> (get_flow r u v) 0)) (>= (idx d v) 0)))
    (assert (=> (and (>= (idx d v) 0) (> (get_flow r v u) 0)) (>= (idx d u) 0)))))
(lemma tight_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (== (len d) (len g)) (closed_all r d)
            (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h))
  (ensures (tight d h (flow_of c r) (len g)))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call tight_at g c r h d u v))))
(lemma max_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (== (len d) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (== (idx d s) 0) (== (idx d t) -1) (closed_all r d)
            (is_valid_flow g (flow_of c r) s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g (flow_of c r) s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (ins d s))
    (assert (not (ins d t)))
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (flow_nn h))
    (assert (respects_capacity g (flow_of c r)))
    (assert (flow_nn (flow_of c r)))
    (call out_eq g h s)
    (call out_eq g (flow_of c r) s)
    (call cons_valid g h d s t)
    (call cons_valid g (flow_of c r) d s t)
    (call val_g g h d s)
    (call val_g g (flow_of c r) d s)
    (call tight_all g c r h d)
    (call g_mono d h (flow_of c r) (len g) (len g))))
(lemma final_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (cap_ok g c) (rnn r (len g)) (skew c r (len g)) (balanced c r (len g) s t val)
            (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (== (idx d s) 0) (== (idx d t) -1) (closed_all r d))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g (flow_of c r) s t) (== (flow_val g (flow_of c r) s) val))
  (body
    (call fo_valid g c r s t val)
    (call fo_val g c r s t val)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call max_other g c r d s t h))))

(lemma build_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
            (cell_good g c0 n) (rows_done g c0 u i) (cell_upd c0 c1 n u v w))
  (ensures (cell_good g c1 n) (rows_done g c1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body (assert (has_capacity g u v w))))
(lemma rows_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rows_done g c u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (rows_done g c (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma cap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (rows_done g c (len g) 0) (has_capacity g u v x))
  (ensures (== (get_flow c u v) x))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) x))))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma cap_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (sq c (len g)) (cell_good g c (len g)) (rows_done g c (len g) 0))
  (ensures (cap_ok g c))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int) (x int)) (call cap_at g c u v x))))

(spec set_cell
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (n i64) (a i64) (b i64) (w i64))
  (returns (q (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (sq m n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (cell_upd m q n a b w))
  (effects))
(def set_cell
  (body
    (call gf_at m n a b)
    (let-mut z (vec (vec i64)) m)
    (set-idx (idx z a) b w)
    (return z)))

(spec push_pair
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (n i64) (a i64) (b i64) (delta i64))
  (returns (q (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (sq m n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (!= a b)
            (and (<= 0 delta) (<= delta (get_flow m a b))) (pair_bd m n))
  (ensures (pair_upd m q n a b delta))
  (effects))
(def push_pair
  (body
    (call gf_at m n a b)
    (call gf_at m n b a)
    (assert (<= (+ (get_flow m a b) (get_flow m b a)) 200000))
    (let x i64 (idx (idx m a) b))
    (let y i64 (idx (idx m b) a))
    (let w1 i64 (- x delta))
    (let w2 i64 (+ y delta))
    (let ((m1 (vec (vec i64)))) (call set_cell m n a b w1))
    (let ((m2 (vec (vec i64)))) (call set_cell m1 n b a w2))
    (call pair_compose m m1 m2 n a b delta w1 w2)
    (return m2)))

(spec build_cap
  (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (returns (c (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (wf (view cg)) (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (ensures (cap_ok (view cg) c))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field cg adj)))
    (call view_len cg)
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (i0) (seq-build n (fn (j0) 0)))))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (sq m n))
      (invariant (cell_good (view cg) m n))
      (invariant (rows_done (view cg) m u 0))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (call view_row cg u)
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (sq m n))
        (invariant (cell_good (view cg) m n))
        (invariant (rows_done (view cg) m u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (call view_at cg u i)
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 0))
