(lemma pair_compose (params (m (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (delta int) (w1 int) (w2 int))
  (requires (cell_upd m m1 n a b w1) (cell_upd m1 m2 n b a w2) (!= a b)
            (== w1 (- (get_flow m a b) delta)) (== w2 (+ (get_flow m b a) delta)))
  (ensures (pair_upd m m2 n a b delta))
  (body))
(lemma row_pair (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (delta int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (pair_upd m0 m1 n a b delta) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum m1 u m) (+ (row_sum m0 u m) (row_chg a b delta u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call row_pair m0 m1 n a b delta u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow m1 u (- m 1)) (+ (get_flow m0 u (- m 1)) (pt_chg a b delta u (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma row_nn (params (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (rnn r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (>= (row_sum r u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call row_nn r n u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma row_ub (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum c u m) (* m 100000)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call row_ub g c u (- m 1))
        (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow c u (- m 1)) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma cap_rnn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g c))
  (ensures (sq c (len g)) (rnn c (len g)))
  (body))
(lemma bd_from (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_ok g c) (== n (len g)) (skew c r n))
  (ensures (pair_bd r n))
  (body))
(lemma bd_skew (params (r (seq (seq int))) (q (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (pair_bd r n) (same_skew r q n))
  (ensures (pair_bd q n))
  (body))
(lemma rnn_step (params (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (rnn c0 n) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (<= 0 delta) (<= delta (get_flow c0 u v)) (!= u v))
  (ensures (rnn c1 n))
  (body))
(lemma skew_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (same_skew r c0 n) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v))
  (ensures (same_skew r c1 n))
  (body))
(lemma untouched_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (delta int))
  (requires (== (len d) n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (untouched r c0 d (idx d v)) (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (== (idx d v) (+ (idx d u) 1)))
  (ensures (untouched r c1 d (idx d u)))
  (body))
(lemma shift_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (t int) (v int) (u int) (delta int) (x int))
  (requires (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (row_shift r c0 n t v delta) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum c1 x n) (- (+ (row_sum r x n) (if (== x t) delta 0)) (if (== x u) delta 0))))
  (body
    (call row_pair c0 c1 n u v delta x n)
    (assert (== (row_sum c0 x n) (- (+ (row_sum r x n) (if (== x t) delta 0)) (if (== x v) delta 0))))))
(lemma shift_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (t int) (v int) (u int) (delta int))
  (requires (pair_upd c0 c1 n u v delta) (!= u v) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (row_shift r c0 n t v delta))
  (ensures (row_shift r c1 n t u delta))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call shift_at r c0 c1 n t v u delta x))))
(lemma skew_next (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (skew c r1 n) (same_skew r1 r n))
  (ensures (skew c r n))
  (body))
(lemma bal_next (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (val int) (dl int))
  (requires (balanced c r1 n s t val) (row_shift r1 r n t s dl) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t))
  (ensures (balanced c r n s t (+ val dl))
           (== (row_sum r s n) (- (row_sum r1 s n) dl)))
  (body))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 dist0) (upd dist0 dist v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 dist))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_qdist (params (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (queue_dist dist0 queue0) (in_range queue0 (len dist0)) (notin queue0 v) (upd dist0 dist v x)
            (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (len queue0))))
  (ensures (queue_dist dist queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_pos (params (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
                        (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (positions dist0 queue0 pos0) (== (len pos0) (len dist0)) (upd dist0 dist v x) (== (idx dist0 v) -1)
            (appended queue0 queue v) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)))
  (ensures (positions dist queue pos))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree (params (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (d0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (a0 (seq int))
                         (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (a (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (tree_ok r s d0 p0 a0) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len d0))) (== (idx d0 s) 0)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d0))) (>= (idx d0 u) 0)
            (upd d0 d v x) (== (idx d0 v) -1) (upd p0 p v u) (upd a0 a v y)
            (== x (+ (idx d0 u) 1)) (>= y 1) (<= y (idx a0 u)) (<= y (get_flow r u v)))
  (ensures (tree_ok r s d p a))
  (body))
(lemma step_closed (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (closed r d0 q0 head) (<= head (len q0)) (upd d0 d v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q v))
  (ensures (closed r d q head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial r d0 u v) (upd d0 d v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial r d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_seen (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial r d u v) (ge_m1 d) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
            (=> (> (get_flow r u v) 0) (!= (idx d v) -1)))
  (ensures (partial r d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (u int))
  (requires (closed r d q head) (partial r d u (len d)) (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q))) (== (idx q head) u))
  (ensures (closed r d q (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma final_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (e int))
  (requires (positions d q pos) (== (len pos) (len d)) (closed r d q (len q))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len d)))
            (>= (idx d u) 0) (> (get_flow r u e) 0))
  (ensures (>= (idx d e) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx q (idx pos u)) u))
    (assert (> (get_flow r (idx q (idx pos u)) e) 0))))
(lemma final_closed (params (r (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)))
  (requires (positions d q pos) (== (len pos) (len d)) (closed r d q (len q)))
  (ensures (closed_all r d))
  (body (forall ((u int) (e int)) (call final_at r d q pos u e))))
(lemma tree_at (params (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (d (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (a (seq int)) (w int))
  (requires (tree_ok r s d p a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len d))) (>= (idx d w) 0))
  (ensures
    (and (== (len p) (len d)) (== (len a) (len d)))
    (>= (idx a w) 1)
    (=> (!= w s)
      (and (and (<= 0 (idx p w)) (< (idx p w) (len d)))
        (and (and (>= (idx d (idx p w)) 0) (== (idx d w) (+ (idx d (idx p w)) 1)))
          (and (<= (idx a w) (idx a (idx p w)))
               (<= (idx a w) (get_flow r (idx p w) w)))))))
  (body))

(lemma tgt_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)))
  (ensures (tgt g u k (tg g u i)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> (- k 1) i) (call tgt_has g u (- k 1) i) (block))))
(lemma tgt_fresh (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k j)) (< j (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (not (tgt g u k (tg g u j))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call tgt_fresh g u (- k 1) j)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
        (assert (!= (tg g u (- k 1)) (tg g u j))))
      (block))))
(lemma z_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block (call z_zero g h u (- m 1)) (assert (not (tgt g u 0 (- m 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma z_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u k m)
               (+ (z_sum g h u (- k 1) m)
                  (if (< (tg g u (- k 1)) m) (get_flow h u (tg g u (- k 1))) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (>= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) 0))
    (assert (>= (tg g u (- k 1)) 0))
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call z_step g h u k (- m 1))
        (call tgt_fresh g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
        (assert (== (tgt g u k (- m 1)) (or (tgt g u (- k 1) (- m 1)) (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_z (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (z_sum g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_z g h u (- k 1))
        (call z_step g h u k (len g))
        (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g)))
        (assert (== (tg g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))
      (call z_zero g h u (len g)))))
(lemma z_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (row_supp g h u) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (z_sum g h u (len (idx g u)) m) (row_sum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call z_full g h u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma supp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h u v) 0) (tgt g u (len (idx g u)) v)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((y int)) (and (has_capacity g u v y) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) y)))
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                                 (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) y))))
          (call tgt_has g u (len (idx g u)) i)
          (assert (== (tg g u i) v)))
        (block))
      (block))))
(lemma out_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_z g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_at g h u v))
    (assert (row_supp g h u))
    (call z_full g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))))

(lemma bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (flow_nn h) (cap_ok g c)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (assert (cell_good g c (len g)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
        (block
          (obtain ((y int)) (and (has_capacity g u v y) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) y)))
          (assert (== (get_flow c u v) y)))
        (block))
      (block))))

(lemma a_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (> b 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a b) (+ (a_sum g h d a (- b 1)) (col_w h d (- b 1) a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call a_step g h d (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) b)
                    (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (- b 1)) (get_flow h (- b 1) (- a 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma a_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call a_zero g h d (- a 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) 0) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma ab_swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (a_sum g h d a b) (b_sum h d a b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block (call ab_swap g h d a (- b 1)) (call a_step g h d a b))
      (call a_zero g h d a))))
(lemma s_g (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (- (s_sum g h d a n) (g_sum h d a n)) (- (b_sum h d n a) (a_sum g h d a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call s_g g h d (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (rt h d (- a 1) n) (- (if (ins d (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) n) 0) (col_w h d (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma s_single (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (cons_h g h d s n) (ins d s) (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (s_sum g h d a n)
               (if (< s a) (- (row_sum h s n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call s_single g h d s n (- a 1))
        (assert (=> (and (ins d (- a 1)) (!= (- a 1) s))
                    (== (row_sum h (- a 1) n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma rt_mono (params (d (seq int)) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (tight d h0 h1 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (rt h0 d u m) (rt h1 d u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rt_mono d h0 h1 n u (- m 1))
        (assert (<= (- (if (ins d u) (get_flow h0 u (- m 1)) 0) (if (ins d (- m 1)) (get_flow h0 u (- m 1)) 0))
                    (- (if (ins d u) (get_flow h1 u (- m 1)) 0) (if (ins d (- m 1)) (get_flow h1 u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma g_mono (params (d (seq int)) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (h1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (tight d h0 h1 n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (g_sum h0 d a n) (g_sum h1 d a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block (call g_mono d h0 h1 n (- a 1)) (call rt_mono d h0 h1 n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma val_g (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int))
  (requires (ins d s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (cons_h g h d s (len g))
            (== (total_flow_out g h s) (row_sum h s (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (g_sum h d (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call s_single g h d s (len g) (len g))
    (call s_g g h d (len g) (len g))
    (call ab_swap g h d (len g) (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))))))

(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (not (ins d t)) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (ins d u) (!= u s))
  (ensures (== (row_sum h u (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (flow_nn h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
    (assert (!= u t))
    (call out_eq g h u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma cons_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (not (ins d t)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (cons_h g h d s (len g)))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g h d s t u))))

(lemma fo_sq (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))))
  (ensures (sq (flow_of c r) (len c)))
  (body (assert (== (len (flow_of c r)) (len c)))))
(lemma fo_idx (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len c))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len c))))
  (ensures (== (len (flow_of c r)) (len c))
           (== (len (idx (flow_of c r) u)) (len c))
           (== (idx (idx (flow_of c r) u) v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v))))
           (== (get_flow (flow_of c r) u v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
  (body))
(lemma fo_nn (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))))
  (ensures (flow_nn (flow_of c r)))
  (body
    (call fo_sq c r)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fo_idx c r u v))))

(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (v int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g c n) (flow_ok c f n) (good_flow g f) (balanced f n s t v) (closed_set c f d n)

(spec build_cap
  (params (cg capacity_graph) (n i64))
  (returns (c (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (== n (len (field cg adj))) (well_formed cg) (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (ensures (cap_ok (view cg) c n))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (call wf_of cg)
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view cg))
    (let-mut c (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j) (seq-build n (fn (j2) 0)))))
    (assert (cap_bounded c n))
    (assert (cap_pos g c n))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (cap_bounded c n))
      (invariant (cap_pos g c n))
      (invariant (cap_upto g c u 0))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (cap_bounded c n))
        (invariant (cap_pos g c n))
        (invariant (cap_upto g c u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i))
        (assert (== (get e 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (assert (== (get e 1) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) n)))
        (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) c)
        (set-idx (idx c u) (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (assert (set_one c0 c n u (get e 0) (get e 1)))
        (call step_cap g c0 c n u i)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call cap_row_done g c u)

            (>= (get_flow f0 v u) d) (== x (- (get_flow f0 v u) d)) (set_one f0 f1 n v u x))
  (ensures (pushed c f0 f1 n u v d))
  (body
    (assert (<= (get_flow f0 v u) (get_flow c v u)))
    (call one_ok c f0 f1 n v u x)
    (call one_moved f0 f1 n v u x)
    (call one_resid c f0 f1 n v u x)))
(lemma two_push (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= u v)
            (set_one f0 f1 n v u 0) (set_one f1 f2 n u v y)
            (== x (get_flow f0 v u)) (== y (+ (get_flow f0 u v) (- d x))) (> d x) (>= d 1)
            (<= d (resid c f0 u v)))

  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f0 u v)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f0 v u)) (<= (get_flow f0 v u) (get_flow c v u))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f0 u v)) (<= (get_flow f0 u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (assert (<= y (get_flow c u v)))

    (call one_ok c f1 f2 n u v y)
    (call one_moved f0 f1 n v u 0)
    (call one_moved f1 f2 n u v y)
    (call one_resid c f0 f1 n v u 0)

(lemma other_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))

(lemma dom_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f n) (closed_set c f d n) (under_cap c h n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (<= (cr h d a b) (cr f d a b)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow c a b))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f b a)) (<= (get_flow f b a) (get_flow c b a))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow c a b))))
    (if (and (ins d a) (not (ins d b)))

    (forall ((x int) (y int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
               (and (and (>= (idx d x) 0) (< (idx pos x) head)) (> (resid c f x y) 0)))
          (>= (idx d y) 0))))))
(ghost-fn partial_row ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len d) n)
    (forall ((y int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y i)) (and (< y n) (> (resid c f u y) 0)))
          (>= (idx d y) 0))))))
(ghost-fn closed_set ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len d) n)
    (forall ((x int) (y int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
               (and (>= (idx d x) 0) (> (resid c f x y) 0)))
          (>= (idx d y) 0))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn in_list ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g))) (>= (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))))
          false
          (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v) (in_list g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn part ((f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (in_list g u k v) (get_flow f u v) 0)))
(ghost-fn part_sum ((f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (part_sum f g u k (- b 1)) (part f g u k (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn ins ((d (seq int)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (>= (idx d x) 0))))
(ghost-fn cr ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (ins d u)
          (if (ins d v) 0 (get_flow f u v))
          (if (ins d v) (- 0 (get_flow f u v)) 0))))
(ghost-fn cr_row ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (cr_row f d u (- b 1)) (cr f d u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn cr_all ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cr_all f d (- a 1) b) (cr_row f d (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn pr ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (pr f d u (- b 1)) (if (ins d (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wrow ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (wrow f d (- a 1) b) (if (ins d (- a 1)) (rowsum f (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wcol ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (wcol f d a (- b 1)) (if (ins d (- b 1)) (colsum f (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wbal ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (k int) (n int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (wbal f d (- k 1) n) (if (ins d (- k 1)) (balance f (- k 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn s_zero ((f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (ins d w)) (!= w s)) (== (balance f w n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dom ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (<= (cr f0 d a b) (cr f1 d a b))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma row_one (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (set_one f0 f1 n a b x) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (<= 0 b) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (rowsum f1 w k) (+ (rowsum f0 w k) (if (and (== w a) (< b k)) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call row_one f0 f1 n a b x w (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f1 w (- k 1)) (if (and (== w a) (== (- k 1) b)) x (get_flow f0 w (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rowsum f1 w k) (+ (rowsum f1 w (- k 1)) (get_flow f1 w (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rowsum f0 w k) (+ (rowsum f0 w (- k 1)) (get_flow f0 w (- k 1)))))
      (if (and (== w a) (== (- k 1) b))
        (assert (== (get_flow f0 w (- k 1)) (get_flow f0 a b)))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma col_one (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (set_one f0 f1 n a b x) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (<= 0 a) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (colsum f1 w k) (+ (colsum f0 w k) (if (and (== w b) (< a k)) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call col_one f0 f1 n a b x w (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow f1 (- k 1) w) (if (and (== (- k 1) a) (== w b)) x (get_flow f0 (- k 1) w))))
      (assert (== (colsum f1 w k) (+ (colsum f1 w (- k 1)) (get_flow f1 (- k 1) w))))
      (assert (== (colsum f0 w k) (+ (colsum f0 w (- k 1)) (get_flow f0 (- k 1) w))))
      (if (and (== (- k 1) a) (== w b))
        (assert (== (get_flow f0 (- k 1) w) (get_flow f0 a b)))
        (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma bal_one (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int) (w int))
  (requires (set_one f0 f1 n a b x) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (balance f1 w n)
               (+ (balance f0 w n) (- (if (== w a) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0) (if (== w b) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0)))))
  (body (call row_one f0 f1 n a b x w n) (call col_one f0 f1 n a b x w n)))
(lemma one_moved (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (set_one f0 f1 n a b x) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (moved f0 f1 n a b (- x (get_flow f0 a b))))
  (body (forall ((w int)) (call bal_one f0 f1 n a b x w))))
(lemma one_ok (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f0 n) (set_one f0 f1 n a b x) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get_flow c a b))))
  (ensures (flow_ok c f1 n))
  (body))
(lemma one_resid (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (set_one f0 f1 n a b x))
  (ensures (resid_same c f0 f1 n a b))
  (body))
(lemma one_push (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (x int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= d 1)
            (>= (get_flow f0 v u) d) (== x (- (get_flow f0 v u) d)) (set_one f0 f1 n v u x))
  (ensures (pushed c f0 f1 n u v d))
  (body
    (assert (<= (get_flow f0 v u) (get_flow c v u)))
    (call one_ok c f0 f1 n v u x)
    (call one_moved f0 f1 n v u x)
    (call one_resid c f0 f1 n v u x)))
(lemma two_push (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= u v)
            (set_one f0 f1 n v u 0) (set_one f1 f2 n u v y)
            (== x (get_flow f0 v u)) (== y (+ (get_flow f0 u v) (- d x))) (> d x) (>= d 1)
            (<= d (resid c f0 u v)))
  (ensures (pushed c f0 f2 n u v d))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f0 u v)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f0 v u)) (<= (get_flow f0 v u) (get_flow c v u))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f0 u v)) (<= (get_flow f0 u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (assert (<= y (get_flow c u v)))
    (call one_ok c f0 f1 n v u 0)
    (call one_ok c f1 f2 n u v y)
    (call one_moved f0 f1 n v u 0)
    (call one_moved f1 f2 n u v y)
    (call one_resid c f0 f1 n v u 0)
    (call one_resid c f1 f2 n u v y)))
(lemma read_facts (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_ok c f n) (cap_bounded c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (== (len (idx c u)) n) (== (len (idx f u)) n) (== (len (idx f v)) n)
           (== (idx (idx c u) v) (get_flow c u v))
           (== (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow f u v))
           (== (idx (idx f v) u) (get_flow f v u))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow c u v)) (<= (get_flow c u v) 100000))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) 100000))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow f v u)) (<= (get_flow f v u) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (<= (get_flow c u v) 100000))
    (assert (<= (get_flow c v u) 100000))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)))))

  (decreases k)

  (ensures (<= (balance f s n) 100000000))
  (body

(lemma part_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int))

(lemma cell_idx (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))

(lemma mput_madd (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (d int))
  (requires (mput m r a b e) (== e (+ (get_flow m a b) d)))
  (ensures (madd m r a b d))

(lemma row_madd (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (madd m r a b d))

(lemma net_madd (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (y int))
  (requires (madd m r a b d) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (net r n y) (- (+ (net m n y) (if (== y a) d 0)) (if (== y b) d 0))))
  (body (call row_madd m r a b d y n) (call col_madd m r a b d y n)))
(lemma walk_start (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (t int) (delta int))
  (ensures (walked f0 f0 n t t delta))
  (body))
(lemma walk_cell (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (fb (seq (seq int))) (fc (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (x int) (p int) (t int) (c int) (delta int) (y int))
  (requires (walked f0 fa n x t delta) (madd fa fb x p (neg c)) (madd fb fc p x (- delta c))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (== (net fc n y) (- (+ (net f0 n y) (if (== y p) delta 0)) (if (== y t) delta 0))))
  (body
    (call net_madd fa fb n x p (neg c) y)
    (call net_madd fb fc n p x (- delta c) y)))
(lemma walk_step (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (fb (seq (seq int))) (fc (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (x int) (p int) (t int) (c int) (delta int))
  (requires (walked f0 fa n x t delta) (madd fa fb x p (neg c)) (madd fb fc p x (- delta c))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)))
  (ensures (walked f0 fc n p t delta))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call walk_cell f0 fa fb fc n x p t c delta y))))

                          (n int) (x int) (p int) (c int) (d int))
  (requires (flow_le cp fa n) (madd fa fb x p (neg c)) (madd fb fc p x d) (!= x p)
            (and (<= 0 c) (<= c (get_flow fa x p))) (>= d 0)
            (<= (+ (get_flow fa p x) d) (get_flow cp p x)))

  (body))

                           (rk (seq int)) (n int) (x int) (p int) (c int) (d int))

            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len rk))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len rk)))

(lemma row_le (params (f (seq (seq int))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (k int))

  (requires (flow_le cp f n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (net f n s) (row_sum cp s n)))

  (ensures (<= (row_sum cp s k) (* 100000 k)))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))

  (body (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))
(lemma fc_range (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded gs))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (first_cap gs a k b)) (<= (first_cap gs a k b) 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (and (> k 0) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (<= k (len (idx gs a)))))
    (block
      (assert (has_capacity gs a (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 1)))
      (call fc_range gs a (- k 1) b))
    (block))))
(lemma fc_sound (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (k int) (b int))
  (ensures (=> (!= (first_cap gs a k b) 0) (has_capacity gs a b (first_cap gs a k b))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (and (> k 0) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (<= k (len (idx gs a)))))
    (if (== (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 0) b)
      (assert (has_capacity gs a b (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 1)))
      (call fc_sound gs a (- k 1) b))
    (block))))
(lemma fc_complete (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx gs a))))
  (ensures (== (first_cap gs a k (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 1)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1))
    (block
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0)))
      (call fc_complete gs a i (- k 1)))
    (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma fill_step (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (u int) (i int) (tg int) (cv int))
  (requires (rows_done gs c0 n u) (rows_zero c0 n (+ u 1)) (row_part gs c0 n u i) (mput c0 c1 u tg cv)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs u))))
            (== tg (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0)) (== cv (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 1)))
  (ensures (rows_done gs c1 n u) (rows_zero c1 n (+ u 1)) (row_part gs c1 n u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma done_step (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (deg int))
  (requires (rows_done gs cp n u) (row_part gs cp n u deg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (== deg (len (idx gs u))))
  (ensures (rows_done gs cp n (+ u 1)))
  (body (assert (== (deg_of gs u) deg))))
(lemma cap_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded gs) (rows_done gs cp n n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow cp a b)) (<= (get_flow cp a b) 100000))
           (=> (!= (get_flow cp a b) 0) (has_capacity gs a b (get_flow cp a b))))
  (body
    (call fc_range gs a (deg_of gs a) b)
    (call fc_sound gs a (deg_of gs a) b)
    (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) (cap_of gs a b)))))
(lemma cap_comp (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (rows_done gs cp n n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (has_capacity gs a b c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cp a b) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 1) c))))
    (call fc_complete gs a i (len (idx gs a)))
    (assert (== (deg_of gs a) (len (idx gs a))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) (cap_of gs a b)))))
(lemma cap_final (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (capacities_bounded gs) (rows_done gs cp n n))
  (ensures (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call cap_cell gs cp n a b))
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int)) (call cap_comp gs cp n a b c))))

(lemma cond_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (assert (not (in_first gs u 0 (- b 1)))) (call cond_zero f gs u (- b 1)))

  (ensures (not (in_first gs u k (get (idx (idx gs u) j) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx gs u) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx gs u) j) 0)))
      (call first_fresh gs u j (- k 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma cond_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx gs u)))))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u (+ k 1) b)
               (+ (cond_row f gs u k b)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0) b))
                    (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0))
                    0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call cond_step f gs u k (- b 1))
      (call first_fresh gs u k k)
      (assert (== (in_first gs u (+ k 1) (- b 1))
                  (or (== (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0) (- b 1)) (in_first gs u k (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma out_cond (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx gs u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive gs f u k) (cond_row f gs u k (len gs))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call out_cond f gs u (- k 1))
      (call cond_step f gs u (- k 1) (len gs)))
    (call cond_zero f gs u (len gs)))))
(lemma first_member (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx gs u))))
  (ensures (in_first gs u k (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1))
    (call first_member gs u i (- k 1))
    (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma edge_first (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity gs u v c))
  (ensures (in_first gs u (deg_of gs u) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 1) c))))
    (call first_member gs u i (len (idx gs u)))
    (assert (== (deg_of gs u) (len (idx gs u))))))
(lemma cond_full (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (in_first gs u k v)))))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u k b) (row_sum f u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cond_full f gs u k (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma row_edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_only gs f (len gs)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len gs))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (in_first gs u (deg_of gs u) v)))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (obtain ((c int)) (has_capacity gs u v c))
      (call edge_first gs u v c))
    (block))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs f (len gs)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out gs f u) (row_sum f u (len gs))))
  (body
    (assert (== (deg_of gs u) (len (idx gs u))))
    (call out_cond f gs u (deg_of gs u))
    (forall ((v int)) (call row_edge_cell gs f u v))
    (call cond_full f gs u (deg_of gs u) (len gs))))
(lemma col_eq (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive gs f u k) (col_sum f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call col_eq gs f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma in_is_col (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in gs f u) (col_sum f u (len gs))))
  (body (call col_eq gs f u (len gs))))
(lemma val_eq (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len gs))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val gs h s) (net h (len gs) s)))
  (body (call out_is_row gs h s) (call in_is_col gs h s)))
(lemma cons_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (is_conserved gs h s t)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len gs))) (and (!= y s) (!= y t)))
  (ensures (== (net h (len gs) y) 0))
  (body
    (call out_is_row gs h y)
    (call in_is_col gs h y)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in gs h y) (total_flow_out gs h y)))))
(lemma cons_to_bal (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (is_conserved gs h s t))
  (ensures (balanced h (len gs) s t))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call cons_cell gs h s t y))))
(lemma bal_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (balanced h (len gs) s t)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len gs))) (and (!= y s) (!= y t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in gs h y) (total_flow_out gs h y)))
  (body
    (call out_is_row gs h y)
    (call in_is_col gs h y)
    (assert (== (net h (len gs) y) 0))))
(lemma bal_to_cons (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (balanced h (len gs) s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved gs h s t))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call bal_cell gs h s t y))))

(lemma cross_split (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cross f rk u b) (- (if (in_s rk u) (row_sum f u b) 0) (wrow f rk u b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cross_split f rk u (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma wcol_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (wcol f rk 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (assert (== (col_sum f (- b 1) 0) 0)) (call wcol_zero f rk (- b 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma wcol_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (wcol f rk (+ a 1) b) (+ (wcol f rk a b) (wrow f rk a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (col_sum f (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col_sum f (- b 1) a) (get_flow f a (- b 1)))))
      (call wcol_step f rk a (- b 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma tsum_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (tsum f rk a b) (- (wr f rk a b) (wcol f rk a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call tsum_eq f rk (- a 1) b)
      (call cross_split f rk (- a 1) b)
      (call wcol_step f rk (- a 1) b))
    (call wcol_zero f rk b))))
(lemma netsum_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (- (wr f rk k n) (wcol f rk n k)) (netsum f rk n k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call netsum_eq f rk n (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma netsum_val (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (balanced f n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (netsum f rk n k) (if (< s k) (net f n s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call netsum_val f rk n s t (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma value_cut (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (balanced f n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (tsum f rk n n) (net f n s)))
  (body
    (call tsum_eq f rk n n)
    (call netsum_eq f rk n n)
    (call netsum_val f rk n s t n)))
(lemma cross_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (cdom f1 f2 rk n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (cross f1 rk u b) (cross f2 rk u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call cross_mono f1 f2 rk n u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (cterm f1 rk u (- b 1)) (cterm f2 rk u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tsum_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cdom f1 f2 rk n) (<= a n) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (tsum f1 rk a b) (tsum f2 rk a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call tsum_mono f1 f2 rk n (- a 1) b)
      (call cross_mono f1 f2 rk n (- a 1) b))
    (block))))
(lemma duality (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (balanced f1 n s t) (balanced f2 n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (cdom f1 f2 rk n))
  (ensures (<= (net f1 n s) (net f2 n s)))
  (body
    (call value_cut f1 rk n s t)
    (call value_cut f2 rk n s t)
    (call tsum_mono f1 f2 rk n n n)))
(lemma dom_cell (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_le cp other n) (flow_le cp fl n) (cut_ok cp fl rk n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (cterm other rk u v) (cterm fl rk u v)))
  (body
    (assert (=> (and (in_s rk u) (not (in_s rk v))) (<= (rsd cp fl u v) 0)))
    (assert (=> (and (in_s rk v) (not (in_s rk u))) (<= (rsd cp fl v u) 0)))))
(lemma dominate (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (flow_le cp other n) (flow_le cp fl n) (cut_ok cp fl rk n))
  (ensures (cdom other fl rk n))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call dom_cell cp other fl rk n u v))))

(lemma edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow other a b) 0) (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity gs a b c))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow other a b) 0)
    (block
      (assert (> (idx (idx other a) b) 0))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs a b c) (<= (idx (idx other a) b) c))))
    (block))))
(lemma valid_edges (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (edges_only gs other (len gs)))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_cell gs other s t a b))))
(lemma other_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (is_valid_flow gs other s t)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow other a b)) (<= (get_flow other a b) (get_flow cp a b))))
  (body (if (> (get_flow other a b) 0)
    (block
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs a b c) (<= (get_flow other a b) c)))
      (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) c)))
    (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (flow_le cp other n))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call other_cell gs cp n other s t a b))))
(lemma fl_edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow fl a b) 0) (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity gs a b c))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow fl a b) 0)
    (assert (has_capacity gs a b (get_flow cp a b)))
    (block))))
(lemma fl_edges (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n))
  (ensures (edges_only gs fl n))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call fl_edge_cell gs cp fl n a b))))
(lemma resp_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (mat fl n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fl))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx fl u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx fl u) v) 0)
           (=> (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs u v c) (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (call cell_idx fl n u v)
    (if (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0)
      (assert (has_capacity gs u v (get_flow cp u v)))
      (block))))
(lemma fl_valid (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (cap_ok gs cp n) (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow gs fl s t))
  (body
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)
    (call bal_to_cons gs fl s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_cell gs cp fl n u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity gs fl))))
(lemma optimal (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int))
                       (n int) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t)
            (cut_ok cp fl rk n) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val gs fl s) (flow_val gs other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_edges gs other s t)
    (call valid_le gs cp n other s t)
    (call cons_to_bal gs other s t)
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)
    (call val_eq gs other s)
    (call val_eq gs fl s)
    (call dominate cp other fl rk n)
    (call duality other fl rk n s t)))
(lemma flow_done (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int))
                         (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t)
            (cut_ok cp fl rk n) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow gs fl s t) (== (flow_val gs fl s) (net fl n s)))
  (body
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)
    (call fl_valid gs cp fl n s t)
    (call val_eq gs fl s)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call optimal gs cp fl rk n s t other))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 dist0) (upd dist0 dist v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 dist))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_qrank (params (rk0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (q_rank rk0 queue0) (in_range queue0 (len rk0)) (upd rk0 rk v (len queue0))
            (== (idx rk0 v) -1) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (q_rank rk queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_rkpos (params (rk0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (rk_pos rk0 queue0) (upd rk0 rk v (len queue0)) (== (idx rk0 v) -1) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (rk_pos rk queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (rk0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (bn0 (seq int))
                         (rk (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int) (mv int))
  (requires (bfs_tree cp f s rk0 par0 bn0)
            (and (== (len par0) (len rk0)) (== (len bn0) (len rk0)))
            (upd rk0 rk v x) (upd par0 par v u) (upd bn0 bn v mv)
            (== (idx rk0 v) -1) (!= v s)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len rk0))) (>= (idx rk0 u) 0) (< (idx rk0 u) x)
            (>= mv 1) (<= mv (idx bn0 u)) (<= mv (rsd cp f u v)))
  (ensures (bfs_tree cp f s rk par bn))
  (body))
(lemma step_scanned (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
                            (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (scanned cp f rk0 queue0 head) (<= head (len queue0)) (upd rk0 rk v x) (>= x 0) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (scanned cp f rk queue head))
  (body))
(lemma step_part (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk0 (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (scan_part cp f rk0 u v) (upd rk0 rk v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (scan_part cp f rk u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma keep_part (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scan_part cp f rk u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len rk)))
            (=> (> (rsd cp f u v) 0) (>= (idx rk v) 0)))
  (ensures (scan_part cp f rk u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma head_step (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (scanned cp f rk queue head) (scan_part cp f rk u n) (<= (len rk) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (scanned cp f rk queue (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cut_cell (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (scanned cp f rk queue head) (== head (len queue)) (rk_pos rk queue) (== (len rk) n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (in_s rk a) (not (in_s rk b)))
  (ensures (<= (rsd cp f a b) 0))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx rk a)) (< (idx rk a) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx rk a)) a)))
    (assert (=> (> (rsd cp f (idx queue (idx rk a)) b) 0) (>= (idx rk b) 0)))))
(lemma cut_final (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (n int))
  (requires (scanned cp f rk queue head) (== head (len queue)) (rk_pos rk queue) (== (len rk) n))
  (ensures (cut_ok cp f rk n))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call cut_cell cp f rk queue head n a b))))

(spec zero_mat
  (params (n i64))
  (returns (m (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (mat m n) (all_zero m))
  (effects alloc))
(def zero_mat
  (body (return (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b) 0)))))))

(spec put_cell
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (a i64) (b i64) (e i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (mat m (len m)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len m))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len m))))
  (ensures (mat r (len m)) (mput m r a b e))
  (effects))
(def put_cell
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) m)
    (set-idx (idx w a) b e)
    (return w)))

(spec build_cap
  (params (g capacity_graph))
  (returns (cp (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (gwf (view g)) (capacities_bounded (view g)))
  (ensures (mat cp (len (view g))) (cap_range cp (len (view g))) (cap_ok (view g) cp (len (view g))))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (ghost-let gs (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view g))
    (let n i64 (len (field g adj)))
    (assert (== n (len gs)))
    (let ((m0 (vec (vec i64)))) (call zero_mat n))
    (let-mut cp (vec (vec i64)) m0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (mat cp n))
      (invariant (rows_done gs cp n u))
      (invariant (rows_zero cp n u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field g adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (mat cp n))
        (invariant (rows_done gs cp n u))
        (invariant (rows_zero cp n (+ u 1)))
        (invariant (row_part gs cp n u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let tg i64 (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 0))
        (let cv i64 (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))
        (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) cp)
        (let ((c1 (vec (vec i64)))) (call put_cell cp u tg cv))
        (set cp c1)
        (call fill_step gs c0 cp n u i tg cv)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call done_step gs cp n u deg)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call cap_final gs cp n)
    (return cp)))

(spec bfs_search
  (params (cp (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (rk (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (bn (vec i64)))
  (requires (mat cp (len cp)) (mat f (len cp)) (cap_range cp (len cp)) (flow_le cp f (len cp))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len cp))))
  (ensures (== (len rk) (len cp)) (== (len par) (len cp)) (== (len bn) (len cp))
           (>= (idx rk s) 0)
           (bfs_tree cp f s rk par bn)
           (cut_ok cp f rk (len cp)))
  (effects alloc))
(def bfs_search
  (body
    (let n i64 (len cp))
    (let-mut rk (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j) -1)))
    (set-idx rk s 0)
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) 0)))
    (let-mut bn (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j2) 0)))
    (set-idx bn s 1000000000)
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue s)
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (and (== (len rk) n) (and (== (len par) n) (== (len bn) n))))
      (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences rk -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences rk -1) 0))
      (invariant (ge_m1 rk))
      (invariant (in_range queue n))
      (invariant (q_rank rk queue))
      (invariant (rk_pos rk queue))
      (invariant (>= (idx rk s) 0))
