  (body (if (and (> k 0) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (<= k (len (idx gs a)))))
    (if (== (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 0) b)
      (assert (has_capacity gs a b (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 1)))
      (call fc_sound gs a (- k 1) b))
    (block))))
(lemma fc_complete (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx gs a))))
  (ensures (== (first_cap gs a k (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 1)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1))
    (block
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx gs a) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0)))
      (call fc_complete gs a i (- k 1)))
    (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma fill_step (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (u int) (i int) (tg int) (cv int))
  (requires (rows_done gs c0 n u) (rows_zero c0 n (+ u 1)) (row_part gs c0 n u i) (mput c0 c1 u tg cv)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs u))))
            (== tg (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0)) (== cv (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 1)))
  (ensures (rows_done gs c1 n u) (rows_zero c1 n (+ u 1)) (row_part gs c1 n u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma done_step (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (deg int))
  (requires (rows_done gs cp n u) (row_part gs cp n u deg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (== deg (len (idx gs u))))
  (ensures (rows_done gs cp n (+ u 1)))
  (body (assert (== (deg_of gs u) deg))))
(lemma cap_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded gs) (rows_done gs cp n n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow cp a b)) (<= (get_flow cp a b) 100000))
           (=> (!= (get_flow cp a b) 0) (has_capacity gs a b (get_flow cp a b))))
  (body
    (call fc_range gs a (deg_of gs a) b)
    (call fc_sound gs a (deg_of gs a) b)
    (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) (cap_of gs a b)))))
(lemma cap_comp (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (rows_done gs cp n n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (has_capacity gs a b c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cp a b) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx gs a) i) 1) c))))
    (call fc_complete gs a i (len (idx gs a)))
    (assert (== (deg_of gs a) (len (idx gs a))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) (cap_of gs a b)))))
(lemma cap_final (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (capacities_bounded gs) (rows_done gs cp n n))
  (ensures (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call cap_cell gs cp n a b))
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int)) (call cap_comp gs cp n a b c))))

(lemma cond_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (assert (not (in_first gs u 0 (- b 1)))) (call cond_zero f gs u (- b 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma first_fresh (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx gs u)))) (<= k j))
  (ensures (not (in_first gs u k (get (idx (idx gs u) j) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx gs u) (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx gs u) j) 0)))
      (call first_fresh gs u j (- k 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma cond_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx gs u)))))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u (+ k 1) b)
               (+ (cond_row f gs u k b)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0) b))
                    (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0))
                    0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call cond_step f gs u k (- b 1))
      (call first_fresh gs u k k)
      (assert (== (in_first gs u (+ k 1) (- b 1))
                  (or (== (get (idx (idx gs u) k) 0) (- b 1)) (in_first gs u k (- b 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma out_cond (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx gs u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive gs f u k) (cond_row f gs u k (len gs))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call out_cond f gs u (- k 1))
      (call cond_step f gs u (- k 1) (len gs)))
    (call cond_zero f gs u (len gs)))))
(lemma first_member (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx gs u))))
  (ensures (in_first gs u k (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1))
    (call first_member gs u i (- k 1))
    (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma edge_first (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity gs u v c))
  (ensures (in_first gs u (deg_of gs u) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx gs u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx gs u) i) 1) c))))
    (call first_member gs u i (len (idx gs u)))
    (assert (== (deg_of gs u) (len (idx gs u))))))
(lemma cond_full (params (f (seq (seq int))) (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v b)) (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (in_first gs u k v)))))
  (ensures (== (cond_row f gs u k b) (row_sum f u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cond_full f gs u k (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma row_edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_only gs f (len gs)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len gs))))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (in_first gs u (deg_of gs u) v)))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow f u v) 0)
    (block
      (obtain ((c int)) (has_capacity gs u v c))
      (call edge_first gs u v c))
    (block))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs f (len gs)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len gs))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out gs f u) (row_sum f u (len gs))))
  (body
    (assert (== (deg_of gs u) (len (idx gs u))))
    (call out_cond f gs u (deg_of gs u))
    (forall ((v int)) (call row_edge_cell gs f u v))
    (call cond_full f gs u (deg_of gs u) (len gs))))
(lemma col_eq (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive gs f u k) (col_sum f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call col_eq gs f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma in_is_col (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in gs f u) (col_sum f u (len gs))))
  (body (call col_eq gs f u (len gs))))
(lemma val_eq (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len gs))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val gs h s) (net h (len gs) s)))
  (body (call out_is_row gs h s) (call in_is_col gs h s)))
(lemma cons_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (is_conserved gs h s t)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len gs))) (and (!= y s) (!= y t)))
  (ensures (== (net h (len gs) y) 0))
  (body
    (call out_is_row gs h y)
    (call in_is_col gs h y)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in gs h y) (total_flow_out gs h y)))))
(lemma cons_to_bal (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (is_conserved gs h s t))
  (ensures (balanced h (len gs) s t))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call cons_cell gs h s t y))))
(lemma bal_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (balanced h (len gs) s t)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len gs))) (and (!= y s) (!= y t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in gs h y) (total_flow_out gs h y)))
  (body
    (call out_is_row gs h y)
    (call in_is_col gs h y)
    (assert (== (net h (len gs) y) 0))))
(lemma bal_to_cons (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (edges_only gs h (len gs)) (balanced h (len gs) s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved gs h s t))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call bal_cell gs h s t y))))

(lemma cross_split (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cross f rk u b) (- (if (in_s rk u) (row_sum f u b) 0) (wrow f rk u b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cross_split f rk u (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma wcol_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (wcol f rk 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block (assert (== (col_sum f (- b 1) 0) 0)) (call wcol_zero f rk (- b 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma wcol_step (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (wcol f rk (+ a 1) b) (+ (wcol f rk a b) (wrow f rk a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (col_sum f (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col_sum f (- b 1) a) (get_flow f a (- b 1)))))
      (call wcol_step f rk a (- b 1)))
    (block))))
(lemma tsum_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (tsum f rk a b) (- (wr f rk a b) (wcol f rk a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call tsum_eq f rk (- a 1) b)
      (call cross_split f rk (- a 1) b)
      (call wcol_step f rk (- a 1) b))
    (call wcol_zero f rk b))))
(lemma netsum_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (- (wr f rk k n) (wcol f rk n k)) (netsum f rk n k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call netsum_eq f rk n (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma netsum_val (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (balanced f n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (netsum f rk n k) (if (< s k) (net f n s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call netsum_val f rk n s t (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma value_cut (params (f (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (balanced f n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (tsum f rk n n) (net f n s)))
  (body
    (call tsum_eq f rk n n)
    (call netsum_eq f rk n n)
    (call netsum_val f rk n s t n)))
(lemma cross_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (cdom f1 f2 rk n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (cross f1 rk u b) (cross f2 rk u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call cross_mono f1 f2 rk n u (- b 1))
      (assert (<= (cterm f1 rk u (- b 1)) (cterm f2 rk u (- b 1)))))
    (block))))
(lemma tsum_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cdom f1 f2 rk n) (<= a n) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (tsum f1 rk a b) (tsum f2 rk a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call tsum_mono f1 f2 rk n (- a 1) b)
      (call cross_mono f1 f2 rk n (- a 1) b))
    (block))))
(lemma duality (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (balanced f1 n s t) (balanced f2 n s t) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (cdom f1 f2 rk n))
  (ensures (<= (net f1 n s) (net f2 n s)))
  (body
    (call value_cut f1 rk n s t)
    (call value_cut f2 rk n s t)
    (call tsum_mono f1 f2 rk n n n)))
(lemma dom_cell (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_le cp other n) (flow_le cp fl n) (cut_ok cp fl rk n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (cterm other rk u v) (cterm fl rk u v)))
  (body
    (assert (=> (and (in_s rk u) (not (in_s rk v))) (<= (rsd cp fl u v) 0)))
    (assert (=> (and (in_s rk v) (not (in_s rk u))) (<= (rsd cp fl v u) 0)))))
(lemma dominate (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (flow_le cp other n) (flow_le cp fl n) (cut_ok cp fl rk n))
  (ensures (cdom other fl rk n))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call dom_cell cp other fl rk n u v))))

(lemma edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow other a b) 0) (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity gs a b c))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow other a b) 0)
    (block
      (assert (> (idx (idx other a) b) 0))
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs a b c) (<= (idx (idx other a) b) c))))
    (block))))
(lemma valid_edges (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (edges_only gs other (len gs)))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_cell gs other s t a b))))
(lemma other_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (is_valid_flow gs other s t)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow other a b)) (<= (get_flow other a b) (get_flow cp a b))))
  (body (if (> (get_flow other a b) 0)
    (block
      (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs a b c) (<= (get_flow other a b) c)))
      (assert (== (get_flow cp a b) c)))
    (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (flow_le cp other n))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call other_cell gs cp n other s t a b))))
(lemma fl_edge_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow fl a b) 0) (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity gs a b c))))
  (body (if (!= (get_flow fl a b) 0)
    (assert (has_capacity gs a b (get_flow cp a b)))
    (block))))
(lemma fl_edges (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n))
  (ensures (edges_only gs fl n))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call fl_edge_cell gs cp fl n a b))))
(lemma resp_cell (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (mat fl n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fl))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx fl u)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity gs u v c) (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (call cell_idx fl n u v)
    (if (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0)
      (assert (has_capacity gs u v (get_flow cp u v)))
      (block))))
(lemma fl_resp (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (mat fl n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity gs fl))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_cell gs cp fl n u v))))
(lemma nn_cell (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fl))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx fl u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx fl u) v) 0))
  (body (call cell_idx fl n u v)))
(lemma fl_nonneg (params (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n))
  (ensures (nonneg_f fl))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_cell cp fl n u v))))
(lemma valid_of (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (respects_capacity gs fl) (is_conserved gs fl s t) (nonneg_f fl))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow gs fl s t))
  (body))
(lemma fl_valid (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (cap_ok gs cp n) (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow gs fl s t))
  (body
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)
    (call bal_to_cons gs fl s t)
    (call fl_resp gs cp fl n)
    (call fl_nonneg cp fl n)
    (call valid_of gs fl s t)))
(lemma optimal (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int))
                       (n int) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t)
            (cut_ok cp fl rk n) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)) (is_valid_flow gs other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val gs fl s) (flow_val gs other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_edges gs other s t)
    (call valid_le gs cp n other s t)
    (call cons_to_bal gs other s t)
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)
    (call val_eq gs other s)
    (call val_eq gs fl s)
    (call dominate cp other fl rk n)
    (call duality other fl rk n s t)))
(lemma flow_done (params (gs (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cp (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (rk (seq int))
                         (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf gs) (== n (len gs)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (cap_range cp n) (cap_ok gs cp n) (mat fl n) (flow_le cp fl n) (balanced fl n s t)
            (cut_ok cp fl rk n) (in_s rk s) (not (in_s rk t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow gs fl s t) (== (flow_val gs fl s) (net fl n s)))
  (body
    (call fl_edges gs cp fl n)

  (params

              (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)

(lemma canonical_flow
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires (> n 0))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
  )
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n)))))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures
    (flat_bounded (canonical_flat f n))
    (is_valid_flow
      g (flat_matrix (canonical_flat f n) n) s t)
    (==
      (flow_val g (flat_matrix (canonical_flat f n) n) s)
      (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))

    (forall ((u int) (v int))

(lemma support_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))

    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))
  (requires
    (==
      old_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u v)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
  (requires
    (==
      good
      (=>
        (> (idx a (+ (* u n) v)) 0)
        (edge_allowed g u v (idx a (+ (* u n) v))))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (and old_ok good)
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u (+ v 1))
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
  (body))

(lemma balance_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (n int) (s int) (t int)
    (u int) (incoming int) (outgoing int)
    (old_ok bool) (new_ok bool))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (requires
    (==
      old_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u n)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
  (requires
    (==
      incoming
      (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) u)))
  (requires
    (==
      outgoing
      (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) u)))
  (requires
    (==
      new_ok
      (and
        old_ok
        (or
          (or (== u s) (== u t))
          (== incoming outgoing)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      new_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n (+ u 1) 0)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t (+ u 1)))))
  (body
    (call row_advance g a n u)))

(spec inspect_flat
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (a (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires (== (len g) n))
  (requires (and (> n 0) (<= n 1000)))
  (requires (== (len a) (* n n)))
  (requires (flat_bounded a))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n)))))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t))
    (=> ok
      (== value (flow_val g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
  (effects))

(def inspect_flat
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_out
            (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_in
            (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (==
          ok
          (and
            (support_prefix g a n u 0)
            (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            ok
            (and
              (support_prefix g a n u v)
              (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) v)))
        (let-mut good bool true)
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i (len (idx g u)))
              (invariant
                (and
                  (<= 0 i)
                  (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (exists ((j int))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                        (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
              (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
              (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx g u) i))
              (if
                (and
                  (== (get e 0) v)
                  (<= x (get e 1)))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (set good found))
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            good
            (=>
              (> x 0)
              (edge_allowed g u v x))))
        (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
        (set ok (and ok good))
        (call support_advance
          g a n s t u v old_ok good)
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut oi i64 0)
      (while (< oi (len (idx g u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 oi)
            (<= oi (len (idx g u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u oi)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing 100000000)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) oi))
        (let dest i64 (get (idx (idx g u) oi) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 dest) (< dest n)))
        (call matrix_get a n u dest)
        (set outgoing
          (+ outgoing (idx a (+ (* u n) dest))))
        (set oi (+ oi 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut ii i64 0)
      (while (< ii n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ii) (<= ii n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u ii)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming 100000000)))
        (decreases (- n ii))
        (call matrix_get a n ii u)
        (set incoming
          (+ incoming (idx a (+ (* ii n) u))))
        (set ii (+ ii 1)))
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (set source_out outgoing)
          (set source_in incoming))
        (block))
      (ghost-let before_balance bool ok)
      (if
        (and
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t))
          (!= incoming outgoing))
        (set ok false)
        (block))
      (assert
        (==
          ok
          (and
            before_balance
            (or
              (or (== u s) (== u t))
              (== incoming outgoing)))))
      (call balance_advance
        g a n s t u incoming outgoing before_balance ok)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (if ok
      (call flat_characterization g a n s t)
      (block))
    (return ok (- source_out source_in))))

(lemma prefix_after_update
  (params
    (a (seq int)) (child (seq int))
    (n int) (p int) (x int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (requires (== (len child) (len a)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len a))))
  (requires (== (idx child p) x))
  (requires
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k)))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (same_prefix child other (+ p 1))
        (and
          (same_prefix a other p)
          (== (flat_item other p) x)))))
  (body))

(lemma dominance_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (child (seq int))
    (candidate (seq int))
    (n int) (s int) (t int)
    (p int) (x int)
    (old_best int) (new_best int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len a))))
  (requires (flat_bounded a))
  (requires (== (len child) (len a)))
  (requires (== (idx child p) x))
  (requires
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k)))))
  (requires
    (dominates_prefix g a p x n s t old_best))
  (requires
    (and
      (== (len candidate) (* n n))
      (flat_bounded candidate)))
  (requires
    (is_valid_flow
      g (flat_matrix candidate n) s t))
  (requires
    (==
      new_best
      (if
        (>
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
          old_best)
        (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
        old_best)))
  (requires
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix child other (+ p 1)))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))
        (>=
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))
  (ensures
    (dominates_prefix
      g a p (+ x 1) n s t new_best))
  (body
    (call prefix_after_update a child n p x)))

(spec enumerate_flows
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (a (vec i64))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64) (p i64))
  (returns (best (vec i64)) (best_value i64))
  (requires (== (len g) n))
  (requires (and (> n 0) (<= n 1000)))
  (requires (== (len a) (* n n)))
  (requires (flat_bounded a))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n)))))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== (len best) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded best)
    (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix best n) s t)
    (== best_value (flow_val g (flat_matrix best n) s))
    (>= best_value 0)
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix a other p))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))
        (>=
          best_value
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))
  (effects alloc))

(def enumerate_flows
  (decreases (- (* n n) p))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (let ((ok bool) (candidate_value i64))
          (call inspect_flat g (borrow a) n s t))
        (forall ((other (seq int)))
          (call same_prefix_all a other p))
        (if (and ok (> candidate_value 0))
          (return
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k) (idx a k)))
            candidate_value)
          (block
            (let zero (vec i64)
              (seq-build (* n n)
                (fn (k2) 0)))
            (call zero_is_valid g zero n s t)
            (return zero 0))))
      (block
        (let-mut best (vec i64)
          (seq-build (* n n)
            (fn (k3) 0)))
        (let-mut best_value i64 0)
        (call zero_is_valid g best n s t)
        (let-mut x i64 0)
        (while (<= x 100000)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
          (invariant
            (== (len best) (* n n)))
          (invariant (flat_bounded best))
          (invariant
            (is_valid_flow
              g (flat_matrix best n) s t))
          (invariant
            (==
              best_value
              (flow_val g (flat_matrix best n) s)))
          (invariant (>= best_value 0))
          (invariant
            (dominates_prefix
              g a p x n s t best_value))
          (decreases (- 100001 x))
          (let-mut child (vec i64)
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k4) (idx a k4))))
          (set-idx child p x)
          (ghost-let child_view (seq int) child)
          (let ((candidate (vec i64)) (child_value i64))
            (call enumerate_flows
              g child n s t (+ p 1)))
          (ghost-let old_best_value int best_value)
          (if (> child_value best_value)
            (block
              (set best candidate)
              (set best_value child_value))
            (block))
          (assert
            (==
              best_value
              (if
                (> child_value old_best_value)
                child_value
                old_best_value)))
          (call dominance_advance
            g a child_view candidate
            n s t p x old_best_value best_value)

(spec inspect_flat
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (a (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires (== (len g) n))
  (requires (and (> n 0) (<= n 1000)))
  (requires (== (len a) (* n n)))
  (requires (flat_bounded a))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n)))))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t))
    (=> ok
      (== value (flow_val g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
  (effects))

(def inspect_flat
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_out
            (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_in
            (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (==
          ok
          (and
            (support_prefix g a n u 0)
            (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            ok
            (and
              (support_prefix g a n u v)
              (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) v)))
        (let-mut good bool true)
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i (len (idx g u)))
              (invariant
                (and
                  (<= 0 i)
                  (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (exists ((j int))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                        (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
              (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
              (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx g u) i))
              (if
                (and
                  (== (get e 0) v)
                  (<= x (get e 1)))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (set good found))
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            good
            (=>
              (> x 0)
              (edge_allowed g u v x))))
        (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
        (set ok (and ok good))
        (call support_advance
          g a n s t u v old_ok good)
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut oi i64 0)
      (while (< oi (len (idx g u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 oi)
            (<= oi (len (idx g u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u oi)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing 100000000)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) oi))
        (let dest i64 (get (idx (idx g u) oi) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 dest) (< dest n)))
        (call matrix_get a n u dest)
        (set outgoing
          (+ outgoing (idx a (+ (* u n) dest))))
        (set oi (+ oi 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut ii i64 0)
      (while (< ii n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ii) (<= ii n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u ii)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming 100000000)))
        (decreases (- n ii))
        (call matrix_get a n ii u)
        (set incoming
          (+ incoming (idx a (+ (* ii n) u))))
        (set ii (+ ii 1)))
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (set source_out outgoing)
          (set source_in incoming))
        (block))
      (ghost-let before_balance bool ok)
      (if
        (and
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t))
          (!= incoming outgoing))
        (set ok false)
        (block))
      (assert
        (==
          ok
          (and
            before_balance
            (or
              (or (== u s) (== u t))
              (== incoming outgoing)))))
      (call balance_advance
        g a n s t u incoming outgoing before_balance ok)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (if ok
      (call flat_characterization g a n s t)
      (block))
    (return ok (- source_out source_in))))

(lemma prefix_after_update
  (params

  (requires

    (forall ((k int))

          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k)))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (same_prefix child other (+ p 1))
        (and

(lemma dominance_advance
  (params

  (requires

  (requires (== (len child) (len a)))

  (requires

      (=>

  (requires

  (requires
    (==
      new_best
      (if
        (>

        (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)

  (requires
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix child other (+ p 1)))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))
        (>=
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))
  (ensures
    (dominates_prefix
      g a p (+ x 1) n s t new_best))
  (body
    (call prefix_after_update a child n p x)))

(spec enumerate_flows
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))

  (returns (best (vec i64)) (best_value i64))
  (requires (== (len g) n))

  (requires (== (len a) (* n n)))
  (requires (flat_bounded a))
  (requires
    (forall ((u int) (i int))

    (== (len best) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded best)

    (>= best_value 0)
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))

            (same_prefix a other p))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))

(def enumerate_flows
  (decreases (- (* n n) p))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (let ((ok bool) (candidate_value i64))
          (call inspect_flat g (borrow a) n s t))
        (forall ((other (seq int)))
          (call same_prefix_all a other p))
        (if (and ok (> candidate_value 0))
          (return
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k) (idx a k)))
            candidate_value)
          (block
            (let zero (vec i64)
              (seq-build (* n n)
                (fn (k2) 0)))
            (call zero_is_valid g zero n s t)
            (return zero 0))))
      (block
        (let-mut best (vec i64)
          (seq-build (* n n)
            (fn (k3) 0)))
        (let-mut best_value i64 0)
        (call zero_is_valid g best n s t)
        (let-mut x i64 0)
        (while (<= x 100000)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
          (invariant
            (== (len best) (* n n)))
          (invariant (flat_bounded best))
          (invariant
            (is_valid_flow
              g (flat_matrix best n) s t))
          (invariant
            (==
              best_value
              (flow_val g (flat_matrix best n) s)))
          (invariant (>= best_value 0))
          (invariant
            (dominates_prefix
              g a p x n s t best_value))
          (decreases (- 100001 x))
          (let-mut child (vec i64)
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k4) (idx a k4))))
          (set-idx child p x)
          (ghost-let child_view (seq int) child)
          (let ((candidate (vec i64)) (child_value i64))
            (call enumerate_flows
              g child n s t (+ p 1)))
          (ghost-let old_best_value int best_value)
          (if (> child_value best_value)
            (block
              (set best candidate)
              (set best_value child_value))
            (block))
          (assert
            (==
              best_value
              (if
                (> child_value old_best_value)
                child_value
                old_best_value)))
          (call dominance_advance
            g a child_view candidate
            n s t p x old_best_value best_value)
          (set x (+ x 1)))
        (return best best_value)))))

  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))

  (requires

            (or (< u ru) (and (== u ru) (< v rv)))))
        (=>
          (> (flat_item a (+ (* u n) v)) 0)
          (edge_allowed
            g u v (flat_item a (+ (* u n) v))))))))

(ghost-fn balance_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int))
   (n int) (s int) (t int) (p int)) bool
  (requires (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u p))
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (==
          (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) u)
          (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) u))))))

(ghost-fn dominates_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (p int)
   (x int) (n int) (s int) (t int) (best int)) bool
  (requires (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len a))))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix a other p))
          (and
            (< (flat_item other p) x)
            (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t)))
        (>= best (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s))))))

(ghost-fn canonical_flat ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq int)
  (requires (> n 0))
  (body
    (seq-build (* n n)
      (fn (k)
        (get_flow f (/ k n) (% k n))))))

(lemma matrix_get

(lemma same_prefix_all

(lemma zero_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (z (seq int))
    (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (and (> n 0) (== (len z) (* n n)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len z)))
          (== (idx z j) 0)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (forall ((q int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (idx g u))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) q) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) q) 0) n))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g (flat_matrix z n) u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call zero_out g z n u (- k 1))
        (call matrix_get
          z n u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma zero_total_out

  (ensures

  (params

  (params

(lemma flat_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (support_prefix g a n n 0)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))
  (ensures
    (>= (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v) 0)
    (=>
      (> (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v) 0)
      (exists ((c int))
        (and
          (has_capacity g u v c)
          (<= (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v) c)))))
  (body
    (call matrix_get a n u v)
    (if (> (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (edge_allowed
            g u v (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v)))
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
              (<=
                (get_flow (flat_matrix a n) u v)
                (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
        (assert
          (has_capacity
            g u v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block))))

(lemma flat_characterization
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

    (balance_prefix g a n s t n))
  (ensures
    (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call flat_cell g a n u v))))

(lemma canonical_get
  (params

(lemma canonical_out
  (params

        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and

    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_out_recursive

  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)

(lemma canonical_total_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

  (ensures
    (==
      (total_flow_out
        g (flat_matrix (canonical_flat f n) n) u)
      (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (body
    (call canonical_out g f n u (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma canonical_in
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))

  (ensures

      (sum_flow_in_recursive

  (decreases k)
  (body

(lemma canonical_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (forall ((x int) (y int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g x y c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000))))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (>= (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (<= (get_flow f u v) 100000)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow f u v) c))))
      (block))))

(lemma canonical_flow
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (> n 0)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000))))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures
    (flat_bounded (canonical_flat f n))
    (is_valid_flow
      g (flat_matrix (canonical_flat f n) n) s t)
    (==
      (flow_val g (flat_matrix (canonical_flat f n) n) s)
      (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call canonical_get f n u v))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call canonical_cell g f n s t u v))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call canonical_in g f n u n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call canonical_total_out g f n u))))

(lemma support_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (n int) (s int) (t int)
    (u int) (v int)
    (old_ok bool) (good bool))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
    (==
      old_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u v)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u)))
    (==
      good
      (=>
        (> (idx a (+ (* u n) v)) 0)
        (edge_allowed g u v (idx a (+ (* u n) v))))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (and old_ok good)
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u (+ v 1))
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
  (body))

(lemma row_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (n int) (u int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (support_prefix g a n u n)
      (support_prefix g a n (+ u 1) 0)))
  (body))

(lemma balance_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (n int) (s int) (t int)
    (u int) (incoming int) (outgoing int)
    (old_ok bool) (new_ok bool))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (==
      old_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n u n)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t u)))
    (==
      incoming
      (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) u))
    (==
      outgoing
      (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) u))
    (==
      new_ok
      (and
        old_ok
        (or
          (or (== u s) (== u t))
          (== incoming outgoing)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      new_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n (+ u 1) 0)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t (+ u 1)))))
  (body
    (call row_advance g a n u)))

(spec inspect_flat
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (a (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (and (> n 0) (<= n 1000))
    (== (len a) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000))))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t))
    (=> ok
      (== value (flow_val g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
  (effects))

(def inspect_flat
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_out
            (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_in
            (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (==
          ok
          (and
            (support_prefix g a n u 0)
            (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            ok
            (and
              (support_prefix g a n u v)
              (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) v)))
        (let-mut good bool true)
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i (len (idx g u)))
              (invariant
                (and
                  (<= 0 i)
                  (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (exists ((j int))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                        (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
              (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
              (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx g u) i))
              (if
                (and
                  (== (get e 0) v)
                  (<= x (get e 1)))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (set good found))
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            good
            (=>
              (> x 0)
              (edge_allowed g u v x))))
        (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
        (set ok (and ok good))
        (call support_advance
          g a n s t u v old_ok good)
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut oi i64 0)
      (while (< oi (len (idx g u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 oi)
            (<= oi (len (idx g u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u oi)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing 100000000)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) oi))
        (let dest i64 (get (idx (idx g u) oi) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 dest) (< dest n)))
        (call matrix_get a n u dest)
        (set outgoing
          (+ outgoing (idx a (+ (* u n) dest))))
        (set oi (+ oi 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut ii i64 0)
      (while (< ii n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ii) (<= ii n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u ii)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming 100000000)))
        (decreases (- n ii))
        (call matrix_get a n ii u)
        (set incoming
          (+ incoming (idx a (+ (* ii n) u))))
        (set ii (+ ii 1)))
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (set source_out outgoing)
          (set source_in incoming))
        (block))
      (ghost-let before_balance bool ok)
      (if
        (and
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t))
          (!= incoming outgoing))
        (set ok false)
        (block))
      (assert
        (==
          ok
          (and
            before_balance
            (or
              (or (== u s) (== u t))
              (== incoming outgoing)))))
      (call balance_advance
        g a n s t u incoming outgoing before_balance ok)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (if ok
      (call flat_characterization g a n s t)
      (block))
    (return ok (- source_out source_in))))

(lemma prefix_after_update
  (params
    (a (seq int)) (child (seq int))
    (n int) (p int) (x int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (== (len child) (len a))
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len a)))
    (== (idx child p) x)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k)))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (same_prefix child other (+ p 1))
        (and
          (same_prefix a other p)
          (== (flat_item other p) x)))))
  (body))

(lemma dominance_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (child (seq int))
    (candidate (seq int))
    (n int) (s int) (t int)
    (p int) (x int)
    (old_best int) (new_best int))
  (requires
    (and (> n 0) (== (len a) (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len a)))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (== (len child) (len a))
    (== (idx child p) x)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k))))
    (dominates_prefix g a p x n s t old_best)
    (and
      (== (len candidate) (* n n))
      (flat_bounded candidate))
    (is_valid_flow
      g (flat_matrix candidate n) s t)
    (==
      new_best
      (if
        (>
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
          old_best)
        (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
        old_best))
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix child other (+ p 1)))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))
        (>=
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix candidate n) s)
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))
  (ensures
    (dominates_prefix
      g a p (+ x 1) n s t new_best))
  (body
    (call prefix_after_update a child n p x)))

(spec enumerate_flows
  (params
    (g (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (a (vec i64))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64) (p i64))
  (returns (best (vec i64)) (best_value i64))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (and (> n 0) (<= n 1000))
    (== (len a) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))
      (=>
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000))))
    (and (<= 0 p) (<= p (* n n)))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== (len best) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded best)
    (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix best n) s t)
    (== best_value (flow_val g (flat_matrix best n) s))
    (>= best_value 0)
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and
              (== (len other) (* n n))
              (flat_bounded other))
            (same_prefix a other p))
          (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix other n) s t))
        (>=
          best_value
          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))

  (params

  (requires

(lemma balance_advance
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (old_ok bool) (new_ok bool))
  (requires

    (==

        (support_prefix g a n u n)

    (==

      (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) u))
    (==

      (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) u))
    (==

  (ensures
    (==
      new_ok
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n (+ u 1) 0)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t (+ u 1)))))
  (body
    (call row_advance g a n u)
    (if new_ok
      (call balance_forward g a n s t u)
      (block))
    (if
      (and
        (support_prefix g a n (+ u 1) 0)
        (balance_prefix g a n s t (+ u 1)))

      (block))))

(spec inspect_flat

    (== (len a) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and

        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))

(def inspect_flat
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 source_out) (<= source_out 100000000)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 source_in) (<= source_in 100000000)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_out
            (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_in
            (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (==
          ok
          (and
            (support_prefix g a n u 0)
            (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            ok
            (and
              (support_prefix g a n u v)
              (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) v)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100000)))
        (let-mut good bool true)
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i (len (idx g u)))
              (invariant
                (and
                  (<= 0 i)
                  (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (exists ((j int))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                        (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
              (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
              (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx g u) i))
              (if
                (and
                  (== (get e 0) v)
                  (<= x (get e 1)))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (set good found))
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            good
            (=>
              (> x 0)
              (edge_allowed g u v x))))
        (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
        (set ok (and ok good))
        (call support_advance
          g a n s t u v old_ok good)
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call degree_bound g n u)
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut oi i64 0)
      (while (< oi (len (idx g u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 oi)
            (<= oi (len (idx g u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u oi)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing (* oi 100000))))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) oi))
        (let dest i64 (get (idx (idx g u) oi) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 dest) (< dest n)))
        (call matrix_get a n u dest)
        (let amount i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) dest)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 amount) (<= amount 100000)))
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing amount))
        (set oi (+ oi 1)))
      (assert (and (<= 0 outgoing) (<= outgoing 100000000)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut ii i64 0)
      (while (< ii n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ii) (<= ii n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u ii)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming (* ii 100000))))
        (decreases (- n ii))
        (call matrix_get a n ii u)
        (let amount2 i64 (idx a (+ (* ii n) u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 amount2) (<= amount2 100000)))
        (set incoming (+ incoming amount2))
        (set ii (+ ii 1)))
      (assert (and (<= 0 incoming) (<= incoming 100000000)))
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (set source_out outgoing)
          (set source_in incoming))
        (block))
      (ghost-let before_balance bool ok)
      (if
        (and
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t))
          (!= incoming outgoing))
        (set ok false)
        (block))
      (assert
        (==
          ok
          (and
            before_balance
            (or
              (or (== u s) (== u t))
              (== incoming outgoing)))))
      (call balance_advance
        g a n s t u incoming outgoing before_balance ok)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (if ok
      (call flat_characterization g a n s t)
      (block))
    (if (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t)
      (block
        (call valid_flat_support g a n s t)
        (call valid_flat_balance g a n s t))
      (block))
    (assert
      (==
        ok
        (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= -100000000 (- source_out source_in))
        (<= (- source_out source_in) 100000000)))
    (return ok (- source_out source_in))))

  (params

  (ensures

    (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int))

    (forall ((u int))

    (forall ((u int))

    (== (len a) (* n n))
    (flat_bounded a)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))

(def inspect_flat
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 source_out) (<= source_out 100000000)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 source_in) (<= source_in 100000000)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_out
            (total_flow_out g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> u s)
          (==
            source_in
            (total_flow_in g (flat_matrix a n) s))))
      (invariant
        (==
          ok
          (and
            (support_prefix g a n u 0)
            (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            ok
            (and
              (support_prefix g a n u v)
              (balance_prefix g a n s t u))))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) v)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100000)))
        (let-mut good bool true)
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut i i64 0)
            (while (< i (len (idx g u)))
              (invariant
                (and
                  (<= 0 i)
                  (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (exists ((j int))
                    (and
                      (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
                      (and
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                        (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
              (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) i))
              (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx g u) i))
              (if
                (and
                  (== (get e 0) v)
                  (<= x (get e 1)))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set i (+ i 1)))
            (set good found))
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            good
            (=>
              (> x 0)
              (edge_allowed g u v x))))
        (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
        (set ok (and ok good))
        (call support_advance
          g a n s t u v old_ok good)
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call degree_bound g n u)
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut oi i64 0)
      (while (< oi (len (idx g u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 oi)
            (<= oi (len (idx g u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u oi)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing (* oi 100000))))
        (decreases (- (len (idx g u)) oi))
        (let dest i64 (get (idx (idx g u) oi) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 dest) (< dest n)))
        (call matrix_get a n u dest)
        (let amount i64 (idx a (+ (* u n) dest)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 amount) (<= amount 100000)))
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing amount))
        (set oi (+ oi 1)))
      (assert (and (<= 0 outgoing) (<= outgoing 100000000)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut ii i64 0)
      (while (< ii n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ii) (<= ii n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive
              g (flat_matrix a n) u ii)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming (* ii 100000))))
        (decreases (- n ii))
        (call matrix_get a n ii u)
        (let amount2 i64 (idx a (+ (* ii n) u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 amount2) (<= amount2 100000)))
        (set incoming (+ incoming amount2))
        (set ii (+ ii 1)))
      (assert (and (<= 0 incoming) (<= incoming 100000000)))
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (set source_out outgoing)
          (set source_in incoming))
        (block))
      (ghost-let before_balance bool ok)
      (if
        (and
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t))
          (!= incoming outgoing))
        (set ok false)
        (block))
      (assert
        (==
          ok
          (and
            before_balance
            (or
              (or (== u s) (== u t))
              (== incoming outgoing)))))
      (call balance_advance
        g a n s t u incoming outgoing before_balance ok)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (if ok
      (call flat_characterization g a n s t)
      (block))
    (if (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t)
      (block
        (call valid_flat_support g a n s t)
        (call valid_flat_balance g a n s t))
      (block))
    (assert
      (==
        ok
        (is_valid_flow g (flat_matrix a n) s t)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= -100000000 (- source_out source_in))
        (<= (- source_out source_in) 100000000)))
    (return ok (- source_out source_in))))

(lemma prefix_after_update

    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k)))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (same_prefix child other (+ p 1))

  (params

        (and
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (!= k p))
        (== (idx child k) (idx a k))))
    (dominates_prefix g a p x n s t old_best)
    (and

    (==

        (>

        old_best))
    (forall ((other (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (and

              (== (len other) (* n n))

          (flow_val g (flat_matrix other n) s)))))
  (ensures

  (body

(def enumerate_flows
  (decreases (- (* n n) p))
  (body
    (if (== p (* n n))
      (block
        (let ((ok bool) (candidate_value i64))
          (call inspect_flat g (borrow a) n s t))
        (forall ((other (seq int)))
          (call same_prefix_all a other p))
        (if (and ok (> candidate_value 0))
          (return
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k) (idx a k)))
            candidate_value)
          (block
            (let zero (vec i64)
              (seq-build (* n n)
                (fn (k2) 0)))
            (call zero_is_valid g zero n s t)
            (return zero 0))))
      (block
        (let-mut best (vec i64)
          (seq-build (* n n)
            (fn (k3) 0)))
        (let-mut best_value i64 0)
        (call zero_is_valid g best n s t)
        (let-mut x i64 0)
        (while (<= x 100000)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 x) (<= x 100001)))
          (invariant
            (== (len best) (* n n)))
          (invariant (flat_bounded best))
          (invariant
            (is_valid_flow
              g (flat_matrix best n) s t))
          (invariant
            (==
              best_value
              (flow_val g (flat_matrix best n) s)))
          (invariant (>= best_value 0))
          (invariant
            (dominates_prefix
              g a p x n s t best_value))
          (decreases (- 100001 x))
          (let-mut child (vec i64)
            (seq-build (* n n)
              (fn (k4) (idx a k4))))
          (set-idx child p x)
          (ghost-let child_view (seq int) child)
          (let ((candidate (vec i64)) (child_value i64))
            (call enumerate_flows
              g child n s t (+ p 1)))
          (ghost-let old_best_value int best_value)
          (if (> child_value best_value)
            (block
              (set best candidate)
              (set best_value child_value))
            (block))
          (assert
            (==
              best_value
              (if
                (> child_value old_best_value)
                child_value
                old_best_value)))
          (call dominance_advance
            g a child_view candidate
            n s t p x old_best_value best_value)
          (set x (+ x 1)))
        (return best best_value)))))
