  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
    (ghost-let b int (idx p (- m 1)))
    (ghost-let c int (idx p m))
    (call edge_get o b c)
    (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at o i b c))
    (if (ins pos k b)
      (block
        (assert (cut_edge o pos k i b c))
        (call conn_refl (remove o i) c)
        (assert (picked o pos k c i b c)))
      (block
        (call pick_at o pos k p (- m 1))
        (obtain ((e0 int) (a0 int) (x0 int)) (picked o pos k b e0 a0 x0))
        (assert (cut_edge o pos k e0 a0 x0))
        (assert (edges_connected (remove o e0) x0 b))
        (assert (!= i e0))
        (call edge_keep o e0 i b c)
        (call conn_append (remove o e0) x0 b c)
        (assert (picked o pos k c e0 a0 x0))))))
(lemma kept_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (e int) (a int) (x int) (v int) (r (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (cut_edge o pos k e a x) (edges_connected (remove o e) x v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))) (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)) (>= k 0)
            (path_follows_edges o r) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len r))) (ins pos k (idx r 0)))
  (ensures (reached (remove o e) pos (+ k 1) (idx r m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (ghost-let o2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (call conn_refl o2 (idx r 0))
        (assert (ins pos (+ k 1) (idx r 0))))
      (block
        (call kept_at o pos k e a x v r (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx r (- m 1)) (idx r m)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx r (- m 1)))
        (ghost-let c int (idx r m))
        (call edge_get o b c)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at o i b c))
        (if (== i e)
          (if (== c a)
            (block
              (call conn_refl o2 a)
              (assert (ins pos (+ k 1) a)))
            (block
              (assert (== c x))
              (call conn_sym o2 x v)
              (assert (ins pos (+ k 1) v))))
          (block
            (call edge_keep o e i b c)
            (assert (reached o2 pos (+ k 1) b))
            (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos (+ k 1) s) (edges_connected o2 s b)))
            (call conn_append o2 s b c)
            (assert (ins pos (+ k 1) s))))))))
(lemma kept (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (e int) (a int) (x int) (v int) (y int))
  (requires (all_reached o pos k) (cut_edge o pos k e a x) (edges_connected (remove o e) x v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))) (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)) (>= k 0)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len pos))))
  (ensures (reached (remove o e) pos (+ k 1) y))
  (body
    (assert (reached o pos k y))
    (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos k s) (edges_connected o s y)))
    (assert (edges_connected o s y))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) s) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges o r)))
    (call kept_at o pos k e a x v r (- (len r) 1))))
(lemma tw_remove (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o e) 2) (total_weight (remove o e)))))
  (decreases e)
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o 0) 2) (total_weight (drop o 1)))))
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (== e 0)
      (assert (== r (drop o 1)))
      (block
        (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o 1))
        (call tw_remove o1 (- e 1))
        (assert (== (idx o1 (- e 1)) (idx o e)))
        (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx o 0)))
        (assert (== (drop r 1) (remove o1 (- e 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1)))))))))
(lemma valid_remove_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))) (== r (remove o e)) (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k e)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx o (+ k 1))))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 0) (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 1) (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_remove (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (remove o e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_remove_at g o e r k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len t))) (== (len o) (- (len t) k))
            (are_valid_edges g o) (all_reached o pos k))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (drop t k)) (total_weight o)))
  (decreases (- (len t) k))
  (body
    (if (== k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight o) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let v int (idx order (+ k 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))))
        (assert (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)))
        (assert (not (ins pos k v)))
        (assert (reached o pos k v))
        (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos k s) (edges_connected o s v)))
        (assert (edges_connected o s v))
        (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
        (call pick_at o pos k p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((e int) (a int) (x int)) (picked o pos k v e a x))
        (assert (cut_edge o pos k e a x))
        (assert (edges_connected (remove o e) x v))
        (ghost-let o2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
        (assert (== (len o2) (- (len o) 1)))
        (forall ((y int)) (call kept o pos k e a x v y))
        (assert (all_reached o2 pos (+ k 1)))
        (call valid_remove g o e)
        (call exchange g pos order t (+ k 1) o2)
        (call tw_remove o e)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o e) 0) (get (idx o e) 1) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (assert (min_cut g pos k (get (idx t k) 2)))
        (assert (!= (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 0)) (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 1))))
        (assert (<= (get (idx t k) 2) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (assert (== (drop (drop t k) 1) (drop t (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) (+ (get (idx (drop t k) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (drop t k) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx (drop t k) 0) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma base_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning g other) (== (len pos) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len pos))))
  (ensures (reached other pos 0 y))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected other 0 y))
    (assert (ins pos 0 0))))
(lemma mst_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((y int)) (call base_at g pos other y))
    (assert (all_reached other pos 0))
    (call exchange g pos order t 0 other)
    (assert (== (drop t 0) t))))
(lemma span_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len pos))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t a b))
  (body
    (assert (>= (idx pos a) 0))
    (assert (>= (idx pos b) 0))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 a))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 b))
    (call conn_sym t 0 a)
    (call conn_trans t a 0 b)))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order)
            (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g)) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0))
  (ensures (is_mst g t))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call span_at t pos a b))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call mst_at g pos order t other))
    (assert (is_mst g t))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma find_at (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 1))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (== (idx s i) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call law_occurrences_none s x)
    (assert (> k 0))
    (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
    (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
    (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
    (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
      (assert (== (idx s (- k 1)) x))
      (call find_at s x (- k 1)))))
(lemma all_in_at (params (pos (seq int)) (c int) (x int))
  (requires (== (occurrences pos -1) 0) (ranks_ok pos c) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))))
  (ensures (>= (idx pos x) 0))
  (body
    (assert (>= (idx pos x) -1))
    (if (== (idx pos x) -1)
      (block
        (call count_member pos x (len pos))
        (call law_take_all pos))
      (block))))
(lemma find_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_graph g p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (in_t pos (idx p 0)) (not (in_t pos (idx p m))))
  (ensures (exists ((a int) (i int)) (out_edge g pos a i)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
    (if (in_t pos (idx p (- m 1)))
      (block
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) j) 0) (idx p m))))
        (assert (out_edge g pos (idx p (- m 1)) j)))
      (call find_cross g pos p (- m 1)))))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (vo int) (found bool) (w int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (> (len g) 0) (in_t pos 0) (and (<= 0 vo) (< vo (len g))) (not (in_t pos vo))
            (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 vo))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) vo))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call find_cross g pos p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((a int) (i int)) (out_edge g pos a i))
    (assert (out_edge g pos a i))
    (assert (!= (in_t pos a) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))))
    (assert (and found (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_range (params (wg weighted_graph) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) a b c))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len (field wg adj)))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (field wg adj)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view wg))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) a) i) 0) b))))
(lemma has_edge_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (f0 bool) (w0 int) (f1 bool) (w1 int))
  (requires (scanned g pos u i f0 w0)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> (!= (in_t pos u) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (and f1 (<= w1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
            (=> f0 (and f1 (<= w1 w0))))
  (ensures (scanned g pos u (+ i 1) f1 w1))
  (body))
(lemma scan_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (f bool) (w int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (scanned g pos u (len (idx g u)) f w))
  (ensures (scanned g pos (+ u 1) 0 f w))
  (body))
(lemma in_t_ins (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (x int))
  (requires (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (== (ins pos k x) (in_t pos x)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos)))
      (assert (< (idx pos x) (+ k 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma scan_min_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (found bool) (w int) (k int) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w) (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)) (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins pos k a) (ins pos k b)))
  (ensures (<= w c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
    (call in_t_ins pos k a)
    (call in_t_ins pos k b)
    (assert (!= (in_t pos a) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))))
    (assert (and found (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))))
(lemma scan_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (found bool) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w) (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (min_cut g pos k w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int)) (call scan_min_at g pos found w k a b c))
    (assert (min_cut g pos k w))))
(lemma step_ranks (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (ranks_ok pos0 c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0))
  (ensures (ranks_ok pos (+ c 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_order_at (params (pos0 (seq int)) (order0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (i int))
  (requires (order_ok pos0 order0) (== (len order0) c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended order0 order v)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len order))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx order i)) (< (idx order i) (len pos))) (== (idx pos (idx order i)) i)))
  (body
    (if (< i c)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx order i) (idx order0 i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx order0 i)) (< (idx order0 i) (len pos0))))
        (assert (== (idx pos0 (idx order0 i)) i))
        (assert (!= (idx order0 i) v))
        (assert (== (idx pos (idx order0 i)) (idx pos0 (idx order0 i)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i c))
        (assert (== (idx order i) v))))))
(lemma step_order (params (pos0 (seq int)) (order0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (order_ok pos0 order0) (== (len order0) c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended order0 order v))
  (ensures (order_ok pos order))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call step_order_at pos0 order0 pos order v c i))
    (assert (order_ok pos order))))
(lemma step_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g e0) (pushed e0 e1 t) (has_edge g (get t 0) (get t 1) (get t 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len e1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx e1 k) 0) (get (idx e1 k) 1) (get (idx e1 k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len e0))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx e1 k) (idx e0 k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx e0 k) 0) (get (idx e0 k) 1) (get (idx e0 k) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len e0)))
        (assert (== (idx e1 k) t))))))
(lemma step_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g e0) (pushed e0 e1 t) (has_edge g (get t 0) (get t 1) (get t 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g e1))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call step_valid_at g e0 e1 t k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g e1))))
(lemma edge_mono (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (edge_in_set e0 a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set e1 a b))
  (body
    (call edge_get e0 a b)
    (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at e0 i a b))
    (assert (== (idx e1 i) (idx e0 i)))
    (call edge_wit e1 i a b)))
(lemma mono_at (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (path_follows_edges e0 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set e1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set e0 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono e0 e1 t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (edges_connected e0 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e0 p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_at e0 e1 t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges e1 p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e1 p)))))
(lemma step_conn_at (params (o0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (a int) (x int))
  (requires (tree_conn o0 pos0) (pushed o0 o1 t) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 a) 0)
            (or (and (== (get t 0) a) (== (get t 1) v)) (and (== (get t 0) v) (== (get t 1) a)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (>= (idx pos x) 0))
  (ensures (edges_connected o1 0 x))
  (body
    (if (== x v)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected o0 0 a))
        (call conn_mono o0 o1 t 0 a)
        (assert (edge_at o1 (len o0) a v))
        (call edge_wit o1 (len o0) a v)
        (call conn_append o1 0 a v))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx pos x) (idx pos0 x)))
        (assert (edges_connected o0 0 x))
        (call conn_mono o0 o1 t 0 x)))))
(lemma step_conn (params (o0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (a int))
  (requires (tree_conn o0 pos0) (pushed o0 o1 t) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)

            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))) (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)) (>= k 0)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len pos))))
  (ensures (reached (remove o e) pos (+ k 1) y))
  (body
    (assert (reached o pos k y))
    (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos k s) (edges_connected o s y)))
    (assert (edges_connected o s y))
    (obtain ((r (seq int))) (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) s) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges o r)))
    (call kept_at o pos k e a x v r (- (len r) 1))))
(lemma tw_remove (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o e) 2) (total_weight (remove o e)))))
  (decreases e)
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o 0) 2) (total_weight (drop o 1)))))
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (== e 0)
      (assert (== r (drop o 1)))
      (block
        (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o 1))
        (call tw_remove o1 (- e 1))
        (assert (== (idx o1 (- e 1)) (idx o e)))
        (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx o 0)))
        (assert (== (drop r 1) (remove o1 (- e 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1)))))))))
(lemma valid_remove_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))) (== r (remove o e)) (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k e)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx o (+ k 1))))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 0) (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 1) (get (idx o (+ k 1)) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_remove (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (remove o e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_remove_at g o e r k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len t))) (== (len o) (- (len t) k))
            (are_valid_edges g o) (all_reached o pos k))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (drop t k)) (total_weight o)))
  (decreases (- (len t) k))
  (body
    (if (== k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight o) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let v int (idx order (+ k 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))))
        (assert (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)))
        (assert (not (ins pos k v)))
        (assert (reached o pos k v))
        (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos k s) (edges_connected o s v)))
        (assert (edges_connected o s v))
        (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
        (call pick_at o pos k p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((e int) (a int) (x int)) (picked o pos k v e a x))
        (assert (cut_edge o pos k e a x))
        (assert (edges_connected (remove o e) x v))
        (ghost-let o2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
        (assert (== (len o2) (- (len o) 1)))
        (forall ((y int)) (call kept o pos k e a x v y))
        (assert (all_reached o2 pos (+ k 1)))
        (call valid_remove g o e)
        (call exchange g pos order t (+ k 1) o2)
        (call tw_remove o e)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o e) 0) (get (idx o e) 1) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (assert (min_cut g pos k (get (idx t k) 2)))
        (assert (!= (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 0)) (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 1))))
        (assert (<= (get (idx t k) 2) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (assert (== (drop (drop t k) 1) (drop t (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) (+ (get (idx (drop t k) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (drop t k) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx (drop t k) 0) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma base_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning g other) (== (len pos) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len pos))))
  (ensures (reached other pos 0 y))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected other 0 y))
    (assert (ins pos 0 0))))
(lemma mst_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((y int)) (call base_at g pos other y))
    (assert (all_reached other pos 0))
    (call exchange g pos order t 0 other)
    (assert (== (drop t 0) t))))
(lemma span_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len pos))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t a b))
  (body
    (assert (>= (idx pos a) 0))
    (assert (>= (idx pos b) 0))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 a))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 b))
    (call conn_sym t 0 a)
    (call conn_trans t a 0 b)))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order)
            (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g)) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0))
  (ensures (is_mst g t))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call span_at t pos a b))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call mst_at g pos order t other))
    (assert (is_mst g t))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma find_at (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 1))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (== (idx s i) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call law_occurrences_none s x)
    (assert (> k 0))
    (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
    (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
    (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
    (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
      (assert (== (idx s (- k 1)) x))
      (call find_at s x (- k 1)))))
(lemma all_in_at (params (pos (seq int)) (c int) (x int))
  (requires (== (occurrences pos -1) 0) (ranks_ok pos c) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))))
  (ensures (>= (idx pos x) 0))
  (body
    (assert (>= (idx pos x) -1))
    (if (== (idx pos x) -1)
      (block
        (call count_member pos x (len pos))
        (call law_take_all pos))
      (block))))
(lemma find_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_graph g p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (in_t pos (idx p 0)) (not (in_t pos (idx p m))))
  (ensures (exists ((a int) (i int)) (out_edge g pos a i)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
    (if (in_t pos (idx p (- m 1)))
      (block
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) j) 0) (idx p m))))
        (assert (out_edge g pos (idx p (- m 1)) j)))
      (call find_cross g pos p (- m 1)))))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (vo int) (found bool) (w int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (> (len g) 0) (in_t pos 0) (and (<= 0 vo) (< vo (len g))) (not (in_t pos vo))
            (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 vo))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) vo))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call find_cross g pos p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((a int) (i int)) (out_edge g pos a i))
    (assert (out_edge g pos a i))
    (assert (!= (in_t pos a) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))))
    (assert (and found (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_range (params (wg weighted_graph) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) a b c))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len (field wg adj)))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (field wg adj)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view wg))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx (field wg adj) a) i) 0) b))))
(lemma has_edge_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (f0 bool) (w0 int) (f1 bool) (w1 int))
  (requires (scanned g pos u i f0 w0)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> (!= (in_t pos u) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (and f1 (<= w1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
            (=> f0 (and f1 (<= w1 w0))))
  (ensures (scanned g pos u (+ i 1) f1 w1))
  (body))
(lemma scan_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (f bool) (w int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (scanned g pos u (len (idx g u)) f w))
  (ensures (scanned g pos (+ u 1) 0 f w))
  (body))
(lemma in_t_ins (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (x int))
  (requires (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (== (ins pos k x) (in_t pos x)))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos)))
      (assert (< (idx pos x) (+ k 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma scan_min_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (found bool) (w int) (k int) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w) (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)) (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins pos k a) (ins pos k b)))
  (ensures (<= w c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
    (call in_t_ins pos k a)
    (call in_t_ins pos k b)
    (assert (!= (in_t pos a) (in_t pos (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))))
    (assert (and found (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))))
(lemma scan_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (found bool) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (scanned g pos (len g) 0 found w) (ranks_ok pos (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (min_cut g pos k w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int)) (call scan_min_at g pos found w k a b c))
    (assert (min_cut g pos k w))))
(lemma step_ranks (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (ranks_ok pos0 c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0))
  (ensures (ranks_ok pos (+ c 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_order_at (params (pos0 (seq int)) (order0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (i int))
  (requires (order_ok pos0 order0) (== (len order0) c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended order0 order v)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len order))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx order i)) (< (idx order i) (len pos))) (== (idx pos (idx order i)) i)))
  (body
    (if (< i c)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx order i) (idx order0 i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx order0 i)) (< (idx order0 i) (len pos0))))
        (assert (== (idx pos0 (idx order0 i)) i))
        (assert (!= (idx order0 i) v))
        (assert (== (idx pos (idx order0 i)) (idx pos0 (idx order0 i)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i c))
        (assert (== (idx order i) v))))))
(lemma step_order (params (pos0 (seq int)) (order0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (order_ok pos0 order0) (== (len order0) c) (upd pos0 pos v c) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended order0 order v))
  (ensures (order_ok pos order))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call step_order_at pos0 order0 pos order v c i))
    (assert (order_ok pos order))))
(lemma step_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g e0) (pushed e0 e1 t) (has_edge g (get t 0) (get t 1) (get t 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len e1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx e1 k) 0) (get (idx e1 k) 1) (get (idx e1 k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len e0))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx e1 k) (idx e0 k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx e0 k) 0) (get (idx e0 k) 1) (get (idx e0 k) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len e0)))
        (assert (== (idx e1 k) t))))))
(lemma step_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g e0) (pushed e0 e1 t) (has_edge g (get t 0) (get t 1) (get t 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g e1))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call step_valid_at g e0 e1 t k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g e1))))
(lemma edge_mono (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (edge_in_set e0 a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set e1 a b))
  (body
    (call edge_get e0 a b)
    (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at e0 i a b))
    (assert (== (idx e1 i) (idx e0 i)))
    (call edge_wit e1 i a b)))
(lemma mono_at (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (path_follows_edges e0 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set e1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set e0 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono e0 e1 t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (e0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (pushed e0 e1 t) (edges_connected e0 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e0 p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_at e0 e1 t p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges e1 p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e1 p)))))
(lemma step_conn_at (params (o0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (a int) (x int))
  (requires (tree_conn o0 pos0) (pushed o0 o1 t) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 a) 0)
            (or (and (== (get t 0) a) (== (get t 1) v)) (and (== (get t 0) v) (== (get t 1) a)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (>= (idx pos x) 0))
  (ensures (edges_connected o1 0 x))
  (body
    (if (== x v)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected o0 0 a))
        (call conn_mono o0 o1 t 0 a)
        (assert (edge_at o1 (len o0) a v))
        (call edge_wit o1 (len o0) a v)
        (call conn_append o1 0 a v))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx pos x) (idx pos0 x)))
        (assert (edges_connected o0 0 x))
        (call conn_mono o0 o1 t 0 x)))))
(lemma step_conn (params (o0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (a int))
  (requires (tree_conn o0 pos0) (pushed o0 o1 t) (upd pos0 pos v c) (>= c 0) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 a) 0)
            (or (and (== (get t 0) a) (== (get t 1) v)) (and (== (get t 0) v) (== (get t 1) a))))
  (ensures (tree_conn o1 pos))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call step_conn_at o0 o1 t pos0 pos v c a x))
    (assert (tree_conn o1 pos))))
(lemma ins_same (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (k int) (x int))
  (requires (upd pos0 pos v c) (> c k) (== (idx pos0 v) -1))
  (ensures (== (ins pos k x) (ins pos0 k x)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos0))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx pos x) (idx pos0 x)))
      (block))))
(lemma min_cut_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (k int) (w int) (a int) (b int) (e int))
  (requires (min_cut g pos0 k w) (upd pos0 pos v c) (> c k) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (has_edge g a b e) (!= (ins pos k a) (ins pos k b)))
  (ensures (<= w e))
  (body
    (call ins_same pos0 pos v c k a)
    (call ins_same pos0 pos v c k b)
    (assert (!= (ins pos0 k a) (ins pos0 k b)))
    (assert (has_edge g a b e))))
(lemma min_cut_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (k int) (w int))
  (requires (min_cut g pos0 k w) (upd pos0 pos v c) (> c k) (== (idx pos0 v) -1))
  (ensures (min_cut g pos k w))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (e int)) (call min_cut_at g pos0 pos v c k w a b e))
    (assert (min_cut g pos k w))))
(lemma step_steps_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (tuple int int int)) (v int) (c int) (k int))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos0 t0) (min_cut g pos0 (len t0) (get t 2)) (pushed t0 t1 t) (upd pos0 pos v c)
            (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (== c (+ (len t0) 1)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (min_cut g pos k (get (idx t1 k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len t0))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t0 k)))
        (assert (min_cut g pos0 k (get (idx t0 k) 2)))
        (call min_cut_same g pos0 pos v c k (get (idx t0 k) 2)))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len t0)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) t))

(lemma drop_step_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len t) (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (drop t k) 1) i) (idx (drop t (+ k 1)) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (drop (drop t k) 1) i) (idx (drop t k) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop t k) (+ i 1)) (idx t (+ i (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop t (+ k 1)) i) (idx t (+ i (+ k 1)))))))

  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))))
  (ensures (== (drop (drop t k) 1) (drop t (+ k 1))))

(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len t))) (== (len o) (- (len t) k))
            (are_valid_edges g o) (all_reached o pos k))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (drop t k)) (total_weight o)))
  (decreases (- (len t) k))
  (body
    (if (== k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight o) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let v int (idx order (+ k 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos))))
        (assert (== (idx pos v) (+ k 1)))
        (assert (not (ins pos k v)))
        (assert (reached o pos k v))
        (obtain ((s int)) (and (ins pos k s) (edges_connected o s v)))
        (assert (edges_connected o s v))
        (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
        (call pick_at o pos k p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((e int) (a int) (x int)) (picked o pos k v e a x))
        (assert (cut_edge o pos k e a x))
        (assert (edges_connected (remove o e) x v))
        (ghost-let o2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove o e))
        (assert (== (len o2) (- (len o) 1)))
        (forall ((y int)) (call kept o pos k e a x v y))
        (assert (all_reached o2 pos (+ k 1)))
        (call valid_remove g o e)
        (call exchange g pos order t (+ k 1) o2)
        (call tw_remove o e)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o e) 0) (get (idx o e) 1) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (assert (min_cut g pos k (get (idx t k) 2)))
        (assert (!= (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 0)) (ins pos k (get (idx o e) 1))))
        (assert (<= (get (idx t k) 2) (get (idx o e) 2)))
        (call drop_step t k)
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop t k)) (+ (get (idx (drop t k) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (drop t k) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx (drop t k) 0) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma base_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning g other) (== (len pos) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len pos))))

(lemma mst_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (order (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order) (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))

    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((y int)) (call base_at g pos other y))
    (assert (all_reached other pos 0))

  (requires (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len pos))))

  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (tree_conn t pos) (all_in pos) (steps_ok g pos t) (order_ok pos order)
            (== (len order) (+ (len t) 1)) (== (len pos) (len g)) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (> (len g) 0) (== (idx pos 0) 0))
  (ensures (is_mst g t))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let gv (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len gv) n))
    (assert (> n 0))
    (let-mut pos (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j) -1)))
    (set-idx pos 0 0)
    (ghost-let-mut order (seq int) (seq-lit 0))
    (let-mut es (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call conn_refl es 0)
    (let-mut cnt i64 1)
    (while (< cnt n)
      (invariant (and (<= 1 cnt) (<= cnt n)))
      (invariant (== (len pos) n))
      (invariant (== (len es) (- cnt 1)))
      (invariant (== (len order) cnt))
      (invariant (== (+ cnt (occurrences pos -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences pos -1) 0))
      (invariant (ranks_ok pos cnt))
      (invariant (order_ok pos order))
      (invariant (== (idx pos 0) 0))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges gv es))
      (invariant (tree_conn es pos))
      (invariant (steps_ok gv pos es))
      (decreases (- n cnt))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut bu i64 0)
      (let-mut bv i64 0)
      (let-mut bw i64 0)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (scanned gv pos u 0 found bw))
        (invariant (cand_ok gv pos found bu bv bw))
        (decreases (- n u))

      (call conn_refl o (idx q lo))
      (block
        (call segment_conn o q lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi)))
        (call conn_edge o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))
        (call conn_trans o (idx q lo) (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (upd3 o m e)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (upd3 o m e) j) (if (== j m) e (idx o j))))))
  (body))
(lemma keep_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o q) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
    (!= k j)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (!= k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j))
    (assert (!= x m))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx o x)))
    (assert (ends (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
(lemma cover_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) x y)
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) y x)
    (ends (idx o m) x y)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (if (== k m)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
        (call conn_edge (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1))))))
(lemma exch_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o) (walk o q a b) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o m e))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (forall ((k int)) (call keep_step o q m e j k))
    (call segment_conn o1 q 0 j)
    (call segment_conn o1 q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx o1 m) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set o1 a b))
    (call conn_edge o1 a b)
    (call conn_sym o1 a (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q (+ j 1)) b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) a b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) b (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cover_step o m e (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)) k))
    (assert (covers o1 o))
    (call span_lift g o o1)))
(lemma exch_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (exists ((m int))
    (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
         (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
              (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e))))))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (walk o p a b))
    (call to_simple o p a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q)))
    (assert (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (call first_cross s q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
      (and (mem s (idx q j)) (not (mem s (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((mm int)) (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (ends (idx o mm) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (call exch_at g o q e a b mm j)
    (assert (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
                 (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1)))
                      (is_spanning g (upd3 o mm e)))))))

(lemma tw_diff (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len x) (len y))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len x)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len x))) (!= k i)) (== (idx x k) (idx y k)))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_weight x) (get (idx x i) 2)) (- (total_weight y) (get (idx y i) 2))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight y) (+ (get (idx y 0) 2) (total_weight (drop y 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop x 1) (drop y 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx x 0) (idx y 0)))
        (call tw_diff (drop x 1) (drop y 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) (- i 1)) (idx x i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop y 1) (- i 1)) (idx y i)))))))
(lemma rb_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (rebuilt o m e t)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) j) (if (== j t) e (if (== j m) (idx o t) (idx o j)))))))
  (body))
(lemma rb_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (rebuilt o m e t)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o m) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (call upd3_facts o t e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) t) e))
    (call tw_diff o (upd3 o t e) t)
    (if (== m t)
      (assert (== (rebuilt o m e t) (upd3 o t e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) m) (idx o t)))
        (call tw_diff (upd3 o t e) (rebuilt o m e t) m)))))
(lemma rb_cover_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (rebuilt o m e t) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e t))
    (ghost-let pos int (if (== k m) t (if (== k t) m k)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 pos) (< pos (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx r pos) (idx (upd3 o m e) k)))
    (assert (ends (idx r pos) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (call conn_edge r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1))))
(lemma rb_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g o)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 0) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 1) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o t) 0) (get (idx o t) 1) (get (idx o t) 2)))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
    (if (== k t)
      (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) e))
      (if (== k m)
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o t)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o k)))))))
(lemma rb_pref_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (pref t o)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (and (<= (len t) m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (rebuilt o m e (len t)) k) (idx t1 k)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (if (== k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma light_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (b int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (lightest g s b) (has_edge g x y w) (!= (mem s x) (mem s y)))
  (ensures (<= b w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (!= (mem s x) (mem s (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
    (assert (<= b (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma rebuild (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g o)
    (pref t o)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
    (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (ensures
    (<= (len t) m)
    (is_spanning_tree g (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (pref t1 (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (<= (total_weight (rebuilt o m e (len t))) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (if (< m (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o m) (idx t m)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 0)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (<= (len t) m))
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (call rb_weight o m e (len t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_valid_at g o m e (len t) k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_cover_at o m e (len t) k))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (covers r (upd3 o m e)))
    (call span_lift g (upd3 o m e) r)
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_pref_at t t1 o m e k))
    (assert (pref t1 r))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2)))
    (call light_edge g s (get e 2) (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2))))
(lemma ext_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t1 o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g other))
    (obtain ((o0 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o0) (and (pref t o0) (<= (total_weight o0) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (is_spanning g o0))
    (call exch_find g s o0 e a b)
    (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o0)))
      (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 1)))
           (is_spanning g (upd3 o0 m e)))))
    (call rebuild g s t t1 o0 e m)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o0 m e (len t)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g r) (and (pref t1 r) (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (extendable g t1))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_at g s t t1 e a b other))))
(lemma ext_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (pref t other))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g other) (and (pref t other) (<= (total_weight other) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g t))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_at g t other))))
(lemma final_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (== o t))))
(lemma conclude (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (conn_inside s t)
    (== (len t) (- (len g) 1))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (mem s v))))
  (ensures (is_mst g t))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call final_min g t other))))

(lemma valid_step_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx t1 k) 0) (get (idx t1 k) 1) (get (idx t1 k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2))))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (appended3 t t1 e) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g t1))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_step_at g t t1 e k))))
(lemma mem_mono (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (upd1 s0 s v 1) (mem s0 x))
  (ensures (mem s x))
  (body
    (if (== x v)
      (assert (== (idx s x) 1))
      (assert (== (idx s x) (idx s0 x))))))
(lemma binary_step (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (binary s0) (upd1 s0 s v 1))
  (ensures (binary s))
  (body))
(lemma internal_at (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires
    (internal s0 t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (mem s0 a)
    (ends e a b)
    (upd1 s0 s b 1)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (and (mem s (get (idx t1 k) 0)) (mem s (get (idx t1 k) 1))))
  (body
    (call mem_mono s0 s b a)
    (assert (mem s b))
    (if (< k (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (mem s0 (get (idx t k) 0)))
        (assert (mem s0 (get (idx t k) 1)))
        (call mem_mono s0 s b (get (idx t k) 0))
        (call mem_mono s0 s b (get (idx t k) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e)))))
(lemma internal_step (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (internal s0 t) (appended3 t t1 e) (mem s0 a) (ends e a b) (upd1 s0 s b 1))
  (ensures (internal s t1))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call internal_at s0 s t t1 e a b k))))
(lemma covers_app_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (appended3 t t1 e) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t1 (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))
    (assert (ends (idx t1 k) (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t1 (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1)))
    (call conn_edge t1 (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1))))
(lemma conn_step_at (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (conn_inside s0 t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (mem s0 a)
    (ends e a b)
    (upd1 s0 s b 1)
    (mem s u)
    (mem s v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t1 u v))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call covers_app_at t t1 e k))
    (assert (covers t1 t))
    (assert (== (idx t1 (len t)) e))
    (assert (ends (idx t1 (len t)) a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set t1 a b))
    (call conn_edge t1 a b)
    (call conn_sym t1 a b)
    (if (and (mem s0 u) (mem s0 v))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected t u v))
        (call conn_lift t t1 u v))
      (if (mem s0 u)
        (block
          (assert (== v b))
          (assert (edges_connected t u a))
          (call conn_lift t t1 u a)
          (call conn_trans t1 u a b))
        (if (mem s0 v)
          (block
            (assert (== u b))
            (assert (edges_connected t a v))
            (call conn_lift t t1 a v)
            (call conn_trans t1 b a v))
          (block
            (assert (== u b))
            (assert (== v b))
