    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges a p)))
    (call lift_prefix a b p (len p))))
(lemma span_lift_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected a u v))
    (call conn_lift a b u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a))
  (ensures (is_spanning g b))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_lift_at g a b u v))))

(lemma splice_idx (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))) (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))
    (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
        (if (<= k i) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k (- j i))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_drop p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))
    (call law_idx_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)) k)
    (if (<= k i)
      (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) k)
      (call law_idx_drop p (+ j 1) (- k (+ i 1))))))
(lemma splice_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
                          (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call splice_idx p i j k)
    (call splice_idx p i j (+ k 1))
    (if (< k i)
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (+ k (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ k (- j i)) 1)))))))
(lemma splice_walk (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (walk o p a b) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (walk o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))))
    (call splice_idx p i j 0)
    (call splice_idx p i j (- (len r) 1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o p))
    (forall ((k int)) (call splice_step o p i j k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) b))))
(lemma to_simple (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (walk o p a b))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (assert (and (walk o p a b) (simple p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (call splice_walk o p a b i j)
        (call splice_idx p i j 0)
        (call to_simple o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (simple q) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len q))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len q))) (!= x y))
  (ensures (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (body
    (if (< x y)
      (assert (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
      (assert (!= (idx q y) (idx q x))))))
(lemma first_cross (params (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (mem s (idx p 0)) (not (mem s (idx p k))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (and (mem s (idx p j)) (not (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0) (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p 0))) (block))
    (assert (> k 0))
    (if (mem s (idx p (- k 1)))
      (assert (and (mem s (idx p (- k 1))) (not (mem s (idx p (+ (- k 1) 1))))))
      (call first_cross s p (- k 1)))))
(lemma segment_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires
    (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k hi)) (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o (idx q lo) (idx q hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl o (idx q lo))
      (block
        (call segment_conn o q lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi)))
        (call conn_edge o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))
        (call conn_trans o (idx q lo) (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (upd3 o m e)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (upd3 o m e) j) (if (== j m) e (idx o j))))))
  (body))
(lemma keep_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o q) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
    (!= k j)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (!= k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j))
    (assert (!= x m))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx o x)))
    (assert (ends (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
(lemma cover_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) x y)
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) y x)
    (ends (idx o m) x y)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (if (== k m)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
        (call conn_edge (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1))))))
(lemma exch_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o) (walk o q a b) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o m e))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (forall ((k int)) (call keep_step o q m e j k))
    (call segment_conn o1 q 0 j)
    (call segment_conn o1 q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx o1 m) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set o1 a b))
    (call conn_edge o1 a b)
    (call conn_sym o1 a (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q (+ j 1)) b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) a b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) b (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cover_step o m e (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)) k))
    (assert (covers o1 o))
    (call span_lift g o o1)))
(lemma exch_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (exists ((m int))
    (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
         (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
              (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e))))))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (walk o p a b))
    (call to_simple o p a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q)))
    (assert (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (call first_cross s q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
      (and (mem s (idx q j)) (not (mem s (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((mm int)) (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (ends (idx o mm) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (call exch_at g o q e a b mm j)
    (assert (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
                 (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1)))
                      (is_spanning g (upd3 o mm e)))))))

(lemma tw_diff (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len x) (len y))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len x)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len x))) (!= k i)) (== (idx x k) (idx y k)))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_weight x) (get (idx x i) 2)) (- (total_weight y) (get (idx y i) 2))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight y) (+ (get (idx y 0) 2) (total_weight (drop y 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop x 1) (drop y 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx x 0) (idx y 0)))
        (call tw_diff (drop x 1) (drop y 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) (- i 1)) (idx x i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop y 1) (- i 1)) (idx y i)))))))
(lemma rb_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (rebuilt o m e t)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) j) (if (== j t) e (if (== j m) (idx o t) (idx o j)))))))
  (body))
(lemma rb_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (rebuilt o m e t)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o m) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (call upd3_facts o t e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) t) e))
    (call tw_diff o (upd3 o t e) t)
    (if (== m t)
      (assert (== (rebuilt o m e t) (upd3 o t e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) m) (idx o t)))
        (call tw_diff (upd3 o t e) (rebuilt o m e t) m)))))
(lemma rb_cover_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (rebuilt o m e t) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e t))
    (ghost-let pos int (if (== k m) t (if (== k t) m k)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 pos) (< pos (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx r pos) (idx (upd3 o m e) k)))
    (assert (ends (idx r pos) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (call conn_edge r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1))))
(lemma rb_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g o)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 0) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 1) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o t) 0) (get (idx o t) 1) (get (idx o t) 2)))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
    (if (== k t)
      (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) e))
      (if (== k m)
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o t)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o k)))))))
(lemma rb_pref_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (pref t o)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (and (<= (len t) m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (rebuilt o m e (len t)) k) (idx t1 k)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (if (== k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma light_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (b int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (lightest g s b) (has_edge g x y w) (!= (mem s x) (mem s y)))
  (ensures (<= b w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (!= (mem s x) (mem s (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
    (assert (<= b (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma rebuild (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g o)
    (pref t o)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
    (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (ensures
    (<= (len t) m)
    (is_spanning_tree g (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (pref t1 (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (<= (total_weight (rebuilt o m e (len t))) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (if (< m (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o m) (idx t m)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 0)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (<= (len t) m))
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (call rb_weight o m e (len t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_valid_at g o m e (len t) k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_cover_at o m e (len t) k))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (covers r (upd3 o m e)))
    (call span_lift g (upd3 o m e) r)
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_pref_at t t1 o m e k))
    (assert (pref t1 r))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2)))
    (call light_edge g s (get e 2) (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2))))
(lemma ext_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t1 o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g other))
    (obtain ((o0 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o0) (and (pref t o0) (<= (total_weight o0) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (is_spanning g o0))
    (call exch_find g s o0 e a b)
    (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o0)))
      (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 1)))
           (is_spanning g (upd3 o0 m e)))))
    (call rebuild g s t t1 o0 e m)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o0 m e (len t)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g r) (and (pref t1 r) (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (extendable g t1))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_at g s t t1 e a b other))))
(lemma ext_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (pref t other))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g other) (and (pref t other) (<= (total_weight other) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g t))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_at g t other))))
(lemma final_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (== o t))))
(lemma conclude (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (are_valid_edges g t)

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma some_out (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (> (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((y int)) (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y k)) (== (idx s y) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call law_occurrences_none s x)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (assert (== (take s k) (concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))))))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
        (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k)) (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)))
          (block
            (assert (> (occurrences (take s (- k 1)) x) 0))
            (call some_out s x (- k 1))
            (obtain ((n0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 n0) (< n0 (- k 1))) (== (idx s n0) x)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 n0) (< n0 k)) (== (idx s n0) x)))))))))
(lemma full_at (params (it (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (== (occurrences it -1) 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len it))))
  (ensures (ins it y))
  (body
    (if (== (idx it y) -1)
      (block
        (call law_take_all it)
        (call count_member it y (len it))
        (assert (== (take it (len it)) it))
        (assert (>= (occurrences it (idx it y)) 1)))
      (block))
    (assert (!= (idx it y) -1))))

(lemma edge_intro (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (h int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s))) (joins (idx s h) u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s u v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) u) (== (get (idx s h) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) v) (== (get (idx s h) 1) u)))))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set s u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) u) (== (get (idx s f) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) v) (== (get (idx s f) 1) u)))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) v) (== (get (idx s f) 1) u))
          (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) u) (== (get (idx s f) 1) v)))))))
(lemma conn_intro (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (walks s p u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s p))
    (assert (walks s p u u))
    (call conn_intro s p u u)))
(lemma conn_step (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat (seq-lit u) (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) v))
    (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s p))
    (assert (walks s p u v))
    (call conn_intro s p u v)))
(lemma rev_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges s p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (rev p) k) (idx (rev p) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let h int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
    (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
    (call edge_sym s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) k) (idx p (+ h 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)) (idx p h)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_at s p k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (rev p))
    (assert (== (len r) (len p)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) u))
    (assert (walks s r v u))
    (call conn_intro s r v u)))
(lemma trans_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges s p) (path_follows_edges s q)
    (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0))
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (glue p q)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (glue p q) k) (idx (glue p q) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (glue p q))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let h int (- (+ k 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q h)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ h 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx q h) (idx q (+ h 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected s u v) (edges_connected s v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges s q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_at s p q k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (glue p q))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (assert (walks s r u w))
    (call conn_intro s r u w)))
(lemma mono_walk (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (lifts s t) (path_follows_edges s p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p 0) (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl t (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call mono_walk s t p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (assert (edges_connected t (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_trans t (idx p 0) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (lifts s t) (edges_connected s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call mono_walk s t p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len p))) (seg_ok s p lo hi))
  (ensures (edges_connected s (idx p lo) (idx p hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl s (idx p lo))
      (block
        (assert (seg_ok s p lo (- hi 1)))
        (call seg_conn s p lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi)))
        (call conn_step s (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi))
        (call conn_trans s (idx p lo) (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi))))))

(lemma cut_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges s p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (cut p i j) k) (idx (cut p i j) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< k i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx c k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx c (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let h int (+ k (- j i)))
        (assert (== (idx c k) (idx p h)))
        (assert (== (idx c (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))))))
(lemma make_simple (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (walks s p u v))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (walks s q u v) (simple q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (assert (and (walks s p u v) (simple p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int)) (exists ((j0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j0)) (< j0 (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j0)))))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut p i j))
        (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_at s p i j k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges s c))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) u))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) v))
        (assert (walks s c u v))
        (call make_simple s c u v)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (m int) (o int))
  (requires (simple q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))) (and (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len q))) (!= m o))))
  (ensures (!= (idx q m) (idx q o)))
  (body (if (< m o) (assert (!= (idx q m) (idx q o))) (assert (!= (idx q o) (idx q m))))))
(lemma find_flip (params (it (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))) (!= (ins it (idx q 0)) (ins it (idx q m))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (< j m) (flips it q j))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (if (!= (ins it (idx q 0)) (ins it (idx q (- m 1))))
      (block
        (call find_flip it q (- m 1))
        (obtain ((f int)) (and (< f (- m 1)) (flips it q f)))
        (assert (and (< f m) (flips it q f))))
      (assert (and (< (- m 1) m) (flips it q (- m 1)))))))

(lemma weight_unit (params (y (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit y)) (get y 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit y))
    (assert (== (len s) 1))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) y))
    (assert (== (len (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))
(lemma weight_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body
    (if (== (len a) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a b) b))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a b))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx a 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
        (call weight_concat (drop a 1) b)
        (assert (== (total_weight c) (+ (get (idx c 0) 2) (total_weight (drop c 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))))))
(lemma swapped_len (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped es rest rp x)) (+ (len es) (len rest))))
  (body))
(lemma swapped_weight (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (+ (total_weight (swapped es rest rp x)) (get (idx rest rp) 2))
               (+ (total_weight (concat es rest)) (get x 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest rp))
    (ghost-let b (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ rp 1)))
    (ghost-let m (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit (idx rest rp)))
    (ghost-let y (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (concat m b) (drop rest rp)))
    (assert (== rest (concat a (drop rest rp))))
    (assert (== rest (concat a (concat m b))))
    (assert (== (swapped es rest rp x) (concat (concat es y) (concat a b))))
    (call weight_concat es rest)
    (call weight_concat a (concat m b))
    (call weight_concat m b)
    (call weight_concat (concat es y) (concat a b))
    (call weight_concat es y)
    (call weight_concat a b)
    (call weight_unit (idx rest rp))
    (call weight_unit x)))
(lemma swapped_keeps (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (f int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (and (<= 0 f) (< f (+ (len es) (len rest))))
    (!= f (+ (len es) rp)))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f)) (< (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f) (+ (len es) (len rest))))
    (== (idx (swapped es rest rp x) (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f)) (idx (concat es rest) f)))
  (body
    (ghost-let ne int (len es))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (ghost-let a (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest rp))
    (ghost-let b (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ rp 1)))
    (assert (== tp (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) (concat a b))))
    (assert (== (len tp) (+ ne (len rest))))
    (if (< f ne)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t f) (idx es f)))
        (assert (== (idx tp f) (idx es f)))
        (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) f)))
      (if (< f (+ ne rp))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t f) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx a (- f ne)) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx tp (+ f 1)) (idx a (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) (+ f 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t f) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx b (- f (+ ne (+ rp 1)))) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx tp f) (idx b (- f (+ ne (+ rp 1))))))
          (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) f)))))))
(lemma valid_swap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (h int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat es rest))
    (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (+ (len es) (len rest)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 0)
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 1)
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let ne int (len es))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (if (== h ne)
      (assert (== (idx tp h) x))
      (block
        (ghost-let f int (if (and (< ne h) (<= h (+ ne rp))) (- h 1) h))
        (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
        (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) h))
        (assert (== (idx tp h) (idx t f)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t f) 0) (get (idx t f) 1) (get (idx t f) 2)))))))

(lemma q_keep (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat es rest) q)
    (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
    (joins (idx (concat es rest) (+ (len es) rp)) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q))) (!= k j)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped es rest rp x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let r int (+ (len es) rp))
    (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx t f) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx t f) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (== k (+ j 1)) (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j) (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1)))
    (assert (!= f r))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
    (ghost-let h int (shifted (len es) r f))
    (assert (== (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) (idx t f)))
    (assert (joins (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_intro (swapped es rest rp x) h (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))
(lemma pair_conn (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat es rest) q)
    (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
    (== (idx q 0) (get x 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get x 1))
    (joins (idx (concat es rest) (+ (len es) rp)) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (forall ((k int)) (call q_keep es rest rp x q j k))
    (assert (seg_ok tp q 0 j))
    (assert (seg_ok tp q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1)))
    (call seg_conn tp q 0 j)
    (call seg_conn tp q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx tp (len es)) x))
    (assert (joins (idx tp (len es)) (get x 0) (get x 1)))
    (call edge_intro tp (len es) (get x 0) (get x 1))
    (call conn_step tp (get x 0) (get x 1))
    (assert (edges_connected tp (idx q 0) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
    (call conn_sym tp (idx q 0) (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym tp (idx q (+ j 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans tp (idx q j) (idx q 0) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans tp (idx q j) (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx q (+ j 1)))))
(lemma lift_swap (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (m int) (o int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) (get (idx rest rp) 0) (get (idx rest rp) 1))
    (edge_in_set (concat es rest) m o))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) m o))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (ghost-let r int (+ (len es) rp))
    (assert (== (idx t r) (idx rest rp)))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) m) (== (get (idx t f) 1) o))
          (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) o) (== (get (idx t f) 1) m)))))
    (if (== f r)
      (if (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) m) (== (get (idx t f) 1) o))
        (assert (edges_connected tp m o))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected tp o m))
          (call conn_sym tp o m)))
      (block
        (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
        (ghost-let h int (shifted (len es) r f))
        (assert (== (idx tp h) (idx t f)))
        (assert (joins (idx tp h) m o))

  (body (or (and (== (get y 0) u) (== (get y 1) v)) (and (== (get y 0) v) (== (get y 1) u)))))
(ghost-fn walks ((s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p))))
(ghost-fn lifts ((s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (edge_in_set s x y) (edges_connected t x y)))))
(ghost-fn seg_ok ((s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k hi))
        (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p))) (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))))
(ghost-fn rev ((p (seq int))) (seq int)
  (body (seq-build (len p) (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i))))))
(ghost-fn glue ((p (seq int)) (q (seq int))) (seq int)
  (requires (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0)))
  (body (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)
    (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx q (- (+ i 1) (len p))))))))
(ghost-fn cut ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i))
    (fn (t) (if (<= t i) (idx p t) (idx p (+ t (- j i))))))))
(ghost-fn simple ((q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len q))) (!= (idx q a) (idx q b))))))
(ghost-fn flips ((it (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
             (!= (ins it (idx q j)) (ins it (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
(ghost-fn inside ((it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
        (and (ins it (get (idx es k) 0)) (ins it (get (idx es k) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn mincut ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int) (c int))
    (=> (and (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins it a) (ins it b))) (<= w c)))))
(ghost-fn good_edge ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (x (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 (get x 0)) (< (get x 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get x 1)) (< (get x 1) (len g))))
             (and (and (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (!= (ins it (get x 0)) (ins it (get x 1))))
                  (mincut g it (get x 2))))))
(ghost-fn swapped ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
  (body (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) (concat (take rest rp) (drop rest (+ rp 1))))))
(ghost-fn shifted ((ne int) (r int) (f int)) int
  (body (if (and (<= ne f) (< f r)) (+ f 1) f)))
(ghost-fn extends_opt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (exists ((rest (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat es rest))
         (<= (total_weight (concat es rest)) (total_weight other))))))
(ghost-fn promising ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g other) (extends_opt g es other)))))
(ghost-fn edge_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (u int) (e int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
            (=> (!= (ins it u) (ins it (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)))
                (and f (<= b (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn seen ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int))
    (=> (or (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (and (== x u) (< e i))) (edge_ok g it f b x e)))))
(ghost-fn cand ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (a int) (b int) (c int)) bool
  (body (=> f (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
                   (and (has_edge g a b c) (!= (ins it a) (ins it b)))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn added ((i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (z int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (== (ins i1 y) (or (ins i0 y) (== y z))))))
(ghost-fn links ((i0 (seq int)) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int)) bool
  (body (or (and (== z (get x 0)) (ins i0 (get x 1)))
            (and (== z (get x 1)) (ins i0 (get x 0))))))
(ghost-fn span_in ((it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (ins it x) (edges_connected es 0 x)))))
(ghost-fn only_zero ((it (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (ins it y) (== y 0)))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma some_out (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (> (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((y int)) (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y k)) (== (idx s y) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call law_occurrences_none s x)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (assert (== (take s k) (concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))))))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
        (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k)) (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)))
          (block
            (assert (> (occurrences (take s (- k 1)) x) 0))
            (call some_out s x (- k 1))
            (obtain ((n0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 n0) (< n0 (- k 1))) (== (idx s n0) x)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 n0) (< n0 k)) (== (idx s n0) x)))))))))
(lemma full_at (params (it (seq int)) (y int))
  (requires (== (occurrences it -1) 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len it))))
  (ensures (ins it y))
  (body
    (if (== (idx it y) -1)
      (block
        (call law_take_all it)
        (call count_member it y (len it))
        (assert (== (take it (len it)) it))
        (assert (>= (occurrences it (idx it y)) 1)))
      (block))
    (assert (!= (idx it y) -1))))

(lemma edge_intro (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (h int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s))) (joins (idx s h) u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s u v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) u) (== (get (idx s h) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) v) (== (get (idx s h) 1) u)))))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set s u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) u) (== (get (idx s f) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) v) (== (get (idx s f) 1) u)))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) v) (== (get (idx s f) 1) u))
          (and (== (get (idx s f) 0) u) (== (get (idx s f) 1) v)))))))
(lemma conn_intro (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (walks s p u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))))
(lemma conn_refl (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s p))
    (assert (walks s p u u))
    (call conn_intro s p u u)))
(lemma conn_step (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat (seq-lit u) (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) v))
    (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s p))
    (assert (walks s p u v))
    (call conn_intro s p u v)))
(lemma rev_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges s p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (rev p) k) (idx (rev p) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let h int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
    (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
    (call edge_sym s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) k) (idx p (+ h 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)) (idx p h)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_at s p k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (rev p))
    (assert (== (len r) (len p)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) u))
    (assert (walks s r v u))
    (call conn_intro s r v u)))
(lemma trans_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges s p) (path_follows_edges s q)
    (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0))
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (glue p q)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (glue p q) k) (idx (glue p q) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (glue p q))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let h int (- (+ k 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx q h)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ h 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx q h) (idx q (+ h 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected s u v) (edges_connected s v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges s q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_at s p q k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (glue p q))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (assert (walks s r u w))
    (call conn_intro s r u w)))
(lemma mono_walk (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (lifts s t) (path_follows_edges s p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p 0) (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl t (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call mono_walk s t p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (assert (edges_connected t (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_trans t (idx p 0) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (lifts s t) (edges_connected s u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call mono_walk s t p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len p))) (seg_ok s p lo hi))
  (ensures (edges_connected s (idx p lo) (idx p hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl s (idx p lo))
      (block
        (assert (seg_ok s p lo (- hi 1)))
        (call seg_conn s p lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi)))
        (call conn_step s (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi))
        (call conn_trans s (idx p lo) (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi))))))

(lemma cut_at (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges s p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (cut p i j) k) (idx (cut p i j) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< k i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx c k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx c (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let h int (+ k (- j i)))
        (assert (== (idx c k) (idx p h)))
        (assert (== (idx c (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ h 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))))))
(lemma make_simple (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (walks s p u v))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (walks s q u v) (simple q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (assert (and (walks s p u v) (simple p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int)) (exists ((j0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j0)) (< j0 (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j0)))))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut p i j))
        (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_at s p i j k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges s c))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) u))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) v))
        (assert (walks s c u v))
        (call make_simple s c u v)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (m int) (o int))
  (requires (simple q) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))) (and (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len q))) (!= m o))))
  (ensures (!= (idx q m) (idx q o)))
  (body (if (< m o) (assert (!= (idx q m) (idx q o))) (assert (!= (idx q o) (idx q m))))))
(lemma find_flip (params (it (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))) (!= (ins it (idx q 0)) (ins it (idx q m))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (< j m) (flips it q j))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (if (!= (ins it (idx q 0)) (ins it (idx q (- m 1))))
      (block
        (call find_flip it q (- m 1))
        (obtain ((f int)) (and (< f (- m 1)) (flips it q f)))
        (assert (and (< f m) (flips it q f))))
      (assert (and (< (- m 1) m) (flips it q (- m 1)))))))

(lemma weight_unit (params (y (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit y)) (get y 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit y))
    (assert (== (len s) 1))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) y))
    (assert (== (len (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))
(lemma weight_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body
    (if (== (len a) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a b) b))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a b))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx a 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
        (call weight_concat (drop a 1) b)
        (assert (== (total_weight c) (+ (get (idx c 0) 2) (total_weight (drop c 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))))))
(lemma swapped_len (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped es rest rp x)) (+ (len es) (len rest))))
  (body))
(lemma swapped_weight (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
  (ensures (== (+ (total_weight (swapped es rest rp x)) (get (idx rest rp) 2))
               (+ (total_weight (concat es rest)) (get x 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest rp))
    (ghost-let b (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ rp 1)))
    (ghost-let m (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit (idx rest rp)))
    (ghost-let y (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (concat m b) (drop rest rp)))
    (assert (== rest (concat a (drop rest rp))))
    (assert (== rest (concat a (concat m b))))
    (assert (== (swapped es rest rp x) (concat (concat es y) (concat a b))))
    (call weight_concat es rest)
    (call weight_concat a (concat m b))
    (call weight_concat m b)
    (call weight_concat (concat es y) (concat a b))
    (call weight_concat es y)
    (call weight_concat a b)
    (call weight_unit (idx rest rp))
    (call weight_unit x)))
(lemma swapped_keeps (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (f int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (and (<= 0 f) (< f (+ (len es) (len rest))))
    (!= f (+ (len es) rp)))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f)) (< (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f) (+ (len es) (len rest))))
    (== (idx (swapped es rest rp x) (shifted (len es) (+ (len es) rp) f)) (idx (concat es rest) f)))
  (body
    (ghost-let ne int (len es))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (ghost-let a (seq (tuple int int int)) (take rest rp))
    (ghost-let b (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop rest (+ rp 1)))
    (assert (== tp (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) (concat a b))))
    (assert (== (len tp) (+ ne (len rest))))
    (if (< f ne)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t f) (idx es f)))
        (assert (== (idx tp f) (idx es f)))
        (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) f)))
      (if (< f (+ ne rp))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t f) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx a (- f ne)) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx tp (+ f 1)) (idx a (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) (+ f 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t f) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx b (- f (+ ne (+ rp 1)))) (idx rest (- f ne))))
          (assert (== (idx tp f) (idx b (- f (+ ne (+ rp 1))))))
          (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) f)))))))
(lemma valid_swap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (h int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (are_valid_edges g (concat es rest))
    (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (+ (len es) (len rest)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 0)
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 1)
    (get (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let ne int (len es))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (if (== h ne)
      (assert (== (idx tp h) x))
      (block
        (ghost-let f int (if (and (< ne h) (<= h (+ ne rp))) (- h 1) h))
        (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
        (assert (== (shifted ne (+ ne rp) f) h))
        (assert (== (idx tp h) (idx t f)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t f) 0) (get (idx t f) 1) (get (idx t f) 2)))))))

(lemma q_keep (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat es rest) q)
    (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
    (joins (idx (concat es rest) (+ (len es) rp)) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q))) (!= k j)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped es rest rp x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let r int (+ (len es) rp))
    (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx t f) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx t f) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (== k (+ j 1)) (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j) (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1)))
    (assert (!= f r))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
    (ghost-let h int (shifted (len es) r f))
    (assert (== (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) (idx t f)))
    (assert (joins (idx (swapped es rest rp x) h) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_intro (swapped es rest rp x) h (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))
(lemma pair_conn (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat es rest) q)
    (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
    (== (idx q 0) (get x 0))
    (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (get x 1))
    (joins (idx (concat es rest) (+ (len es) rp)) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (forall ((k int)) (call q_keep es rest rp x q j k))
    (assert (seg_ok tp q 0 j))
    (assert (seg_ok tp q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1)))
    (call seg_conn tp q 0 j)
    (call seg_conn tp q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx tp (len es)) x))
    (assert (joins (idx tp (len es)) (get x 0) (get x 1)))
    (call edge_intro tp (len es) (get x 0) (get x 1))
    (call conn_step tp (get x 0) (get x 1))
    (assert (edges_connected tp (idx q 0) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
    (call conn_sym tp (idx q 0) (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym tp (idx q (+ j 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans tp (idx q j) (idx q 0) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans tp (idx q j) (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx q (+ j 1)))))
(lemma lift_swap (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (rp int) (x (tuple int int int)) (m int) (o int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest)))
    (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) (get (idx rest rp) 0) (get (idx rest rp) 1))
    (edge_in_set (concat es rest) m o))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es rest rp x) m o))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (ghost-let r int (+ (len es) rp))
    (assert (== (idx t r) (idx rest rp)))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) m) (== (get (idx t f) 1) o))
          (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) o) (== (get (idx t f) 1) m)))))
    (if (== f r)
      (if (and (== (get (idx t f) 0) m) (== (get (idx t f) 1) o))
        (assert (edges_connected tp m o))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected tp o m))
          (call conn_sym tp o m)))
      (block
        (call swapped_keeps es rest rp x f)
        (ghost-let h int (shifted (len es) r f))
        (assert (== (idx tp h) (idx t f)))
        (assert (joins (idx tp h) m o))
        (call edge_intro tp h m o)
        (call conn_step tp m o)))))
(lemma span_via (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (tp (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (o int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (lifts t tp) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len g))) (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len g)))))
  (ensures (edges_connected tp m o))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t m o))
    (call conn_mono t tp m o)))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g (concat es rest)) (inside it es) (good_edge g it x))
  (ensures (exists ((nr0 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr0))
         (<= (total_weight (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr0)) (total_weight (concat es rest))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es rest))
    (ghost-let a int (get x 0))
    (ghost-let b int (get x 1))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected t a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (assert (walks t p a b))
    (call make_simple t p a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walks t q a b) (simple q)))
    (assert (!= (ins it (idx q 0)) (ins it (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (call find_flip it q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (< j (- (len q) 1)) (flips it q j)))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t q))
    (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((r int)) (and (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t r) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx t r) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx t r) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx t r) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (joins (idx t r) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (assert (!= (ins it (idx q j)) (ins it (idx q (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (!= (ins it (get (idx t r) 0)) (ins it (get (idx t r) 1))))
    (if (< r (len es))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t r) (idx es r)))
        (assert (and (ins it (get (idx es r) 0)) (ins it (get (idx es r) 1)))))
      (block))
    (assert (>= r (len es)))
    (ghost-let rp int (- r (len es)))
    (assert (== (+ (len es) rp) r))
    (assert (and (<= 0 rp) (< rp (len rest))))
    (assert (== (idx t r) (idx rest rp)))
    (ghost-let tp (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es rest rp x))
    (call swapped_len es rest rp x)
    (call pair_conn es rest rp x q j)
    (if (and (== (get (idx rest rp) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx rest rp) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
      (assert (edges_connected tp (get (idx rest rp) 0) (get (idx rest rp) 1)))
      (block
        (call conn_sym tp (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
        (assert (edges_connected tp (get (idx rest rp) 0) (get (idx rest rp) 1)))))
    (forall ((m int) (o int)) (call lift_swap es rest rp x m o))
    (assert (lifts t tp))
    (forall ((m int) (o int)) (call span_via g t tp m o))
    (assert (is_spanning g tp))
    (forall ((h int)) (call valid_swap_at g es rest rp x h))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g tp))
    (assert (== (len tp) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g tp))
    (call swapped_weight es rest rp x)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t r) 0) (get (idx t r) 1) (get (idx t r) 2)))
    (assert (<= (get x 2) (get (idx t r) 2)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight tp) (total_weight t)))
    (ghost-let nr (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (take rest rp) (drop rest (+ rp 1))))
    (assert (== tp (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr))
                 (<= (total_weight (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr)) (total_weight (concat es rest)))))))
(lemma step_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (promising g es) (inside it es) (good_edge g it x) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (extends_opt g (concat es (seq-lit x)) other))
  (body
    (assert (extends_opt g es other))
    (obtain ((rs (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat es rs)) (<= (total_weight (concat es rs)) (total_weight other))))
    (call exchange g it es rs x)
    (obtain ((nr (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr))
           (<= (total_weight (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr)) (total_weight (concat es rs)))))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr))
                 (<= (total_weight (concat (concat es (seq-lit x)) nr)) (total_weight other))))))
(lemma promising_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (promising g es) (inside it es) (good_edge g it x))
  (ensures (promising g (concat es (seq-lit x))))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call step_other g it es x o))))
(lemma init_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (extends_opt g es other))
  (body
    (assert (== (concat es other) other))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat es other))
                 (<= (total_weight (concat es other)) (total_weight other))))))
(lemma promising_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (promising g es))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call init_other g es o))))

(lemma seen_up_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f0 bool) (b0 int) (f1 bool) (b1 int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (e int))
  (requires (seen g it f0 b0 u i) (and f1 (=> f0 (<= b1 b0)))
            (or (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (and (== x u) (< e i))))
  (ensures (edge_ok g it f1 b1 x e))
  (body (assert (edge_ok g it f0 b0 x e))))
(lemma seen_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f0 bool) (b0 int) (f1 bool) (b1 int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (seen g it f0 b0 u i) (and f1 (=> f0 (<= b1 b0))))
  (ensures (seen g it f1 b1 u i))
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int)) (call seen_up_at g it f0 b0 f1 b1 u i x e))))
(lemma seen_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (seen g it f b u i) (edge_ok g it f b u i))
  (ensures (seen g it f b u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma seen_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (u int) (x int) (e int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (seen g it f b u (len (idx g u)))
            (or (and (<= 0 x) (< x (+ u 1))) (and (== x (+ u 1)) (< e 0))))
  (ensures (edge_ok g it f b x e))
  (body
    (if (< x u)
      (assert (edge_ok g it f b x e))
      (if (and (== x u) (< e (len (idx g u))))
        (assert (edge_ok g it f b x e))
        (block)))))
(lemma seen_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (seen g it f b u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (seen g it f b (+ u 1) 0))
  (body (forall ((x int) (e int)) (call seen_done_at g it f b u x e))))
(lemma seen_min_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int) (a1 int) (b1 int) (c1 int))
  (requires (seen g it f b (len g) 0) (has_edge g a1 b1 c1) (!= (ins it a1) (ins it b1)))
  (ensures (and f (<= b c1)))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a1) (< a1 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a1)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g a1) i) 0) b1) (== (get (idx (idx g a1) i) 1) c1))))
    (assert (edge_ok g it f b a1 i))))
(lemma seen_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int))
  (requires (seen g it f b (len g) 0))
  (ensures (mincut g it b))
  (body (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int) (c1 int)) (call seen_min_at g it f b a1 b1 c1))))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (it (seq int)) (f bool) (b int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (== (len it) (len g)) (ins it 0) (> (occurrences it -1) 0) (seen g it f b (len g) 0))
  (ensures f)
  (body
    (call law_take_all it)
    (assert (== (take it (len it)) it))
    (call some_out it -1 (len it))
    (obtain ((z int)) (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len it))) (== (idx it z) -1)))
    (assert (not (ins it z)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 z))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (!= (ins it (idx p 0)) (ins it (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call find_flip it p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (< j (- (len p) 1)) (flips it p j)))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p j))))))
      (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) i) 0) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (edge_ok g it f b (idx p j) i))))

(lemma added_intro (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (z int))
  (requires (upd i0 i1 z 0))
  (ensures (added i0 i1 z))
  (body))
(lemma both_after (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int))
  (requires (added i0 i1 z) (links i0 x z))
  (ensures (and (ins i1 (get x 0)) (ins i1 (get x 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (ins i1 (get x 0)) (or (ins i0 (get x 0)) (== (get x 0) z))))
    (assert (== (ins i1 (get x 1)) (or (ins i0 (get x 1)) (== (get x 1) z))))))
(lemma inside_at (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int) (k int))
  (requires (inside i0 es) (added i0 i1 z) (links i0 x z) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len es) 1))))
  (ensures (and (ins i1 (get (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) 0)) (ins i1 (get (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k (len es))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) (idx es k)))
        (assert (and (ins i0 (get (idx es k) 0)) (ins i0 (get (idx es k) 1))))
        (assert (== (ins i1 (get (idx es k) 0)) (or (ins i0 (get (idx es k) 0)) (== (get (idx es k) 0) z))))
        (assert (== (ins i1 (get (idx es k) 1)) (or (ins i0 (get (idx es k) 1)) (== (get (idx es k) 1) z)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) x))
        (call both_after i0 i1 x z)))))
(lemma inside_step (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int))
  (requires (inside i0 es) (added i0 i1 z) (links i0 x z))
  (ensures (inside i1 (concat es (seq-lit x))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call inside_at i0 i1 es x z k))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len es) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g
    (get (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) 0)
    (get (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) 1)
    (get (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len es))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) (idx es k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1) (get (idx es k) 2))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) k) x)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat es (seq-lit x))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_at g es x k))))
(lemma extend_lift_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit x)) a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((f int)) (and (and (<= 0 f) (< f (len es)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx es f) 0) a) (== (get (idx es f) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx es f) 0) b) (== (get (idx es f) 1) a)))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) f) (idx es f)))
    (assert (joins (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) f) a b))
    (call edge_intro (concat es (seq-lit x)) f a b)
    (call conn_step (concat es (seq-lit x)) a b)))
(lemma extend_lifts (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (lifts es (concat es (seq-lit x))))
  (body (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call extend_lift_at es x a1 b1))))
(lemma new_conn (params (i0 (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int))
  (requires (span_in i0 es) (links i0 x z))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit x)) 0 z))
  (body
    (ghost-let s1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit x)))
    (ghost-let a int (get x 0))
    (ghost-let b int (get x 1))
    (call extend_lifts es x)
    (assert (== (len s1) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx s1 (len es)) x))
    (assert (joins (idx s1 (len es)) a b))
    (call edge_intro s1 (len es) a b)
    (call conn_step s1 a b)
    (if (and (== z a) (ins i0 b))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected es 0 b))
        (call conn_mono es s1 0 b)
        (call conn_sym s1 a b)
        (call conn_trans s1 0 b a))
      (block
        (assert (ins i0 a))
        (assert (== z b))
        (assert (edges_connected es 0 a))
        (call conn_mono es s1 0 a)
        (call conn_trans s1 0 a b)))))
(lemma span_at (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int) (y int))
  (requires (span_in i0 es) (added i0 i1 z) (links i0 x z) (ins i1 y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit x)) 0 y))
  (body
    (call new_conn i0 es x z)
    (call extend_lifts es x)
    (assert (== (ins i1 y) (or (ins i0 y) (== y z))))
    (if (ins i0 y)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected es 0 y))
        (call conn_mono es (concat es (seq-lit x)) 0 y))
      (assert (== y z)))))
(lemma span_step (params (i0 (seq int)) (i1 (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (z int))
  (requires (span_in i0 es) (added i0 i1 z) (links i0 x z))
  (ensures (span_in i1 (concat es (seq-lit x))))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call span_at i0 i1 es x z y))))
(lemma span_zero (params (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (y int))
  (requires (only_zero it) (ins it y))

(lemma span_init (params (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma span_pair (params (it (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (o int))
  (requires (span_in it es) (== (occurrences it -1) 0) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len it))) (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len it))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es m o))
  (body
    (call full_at it m)
    (call full_at it o)
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 m))
