(lemma conn_lift (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (covers b a) (edges_connected a u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges a p)))
    (call lift_prefix a b p (len p))))
(lemma span_lift_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected a u v))
    (call conn_lift a b u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a))
  (ensures (is_spanning g b))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_lift_at g a b u v))))

(lemma splice_idx (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))) (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))
    (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
        (if (<= k i) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k (- j i))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_drop p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))
    (call law_idx_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)) k)
    (if (<= k i)
      (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) k)
      (call law_idx_drop p (+ j 1) (- k (+ i 1))))))
(lemma splice_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
                          (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call splice_idx p i j k)
    (call splice_idx p i j (+ k 1))
    (if (< k i)
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (+ k (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ k (- j i)) 1)))))))
(lemma splice_walk (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (walk o p a b) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (walk o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))))
    (call splice_idx p i j 0)
    (call splice_idx p i j (- (len r) 1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o p))
    (forall ((k int)) (call splice_step o p i j k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) b))))
(lemma to_simple (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (walk o p a b))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (assert (and (walk o p a b) (simple p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (call splice_walk o p a b i j)
        (call splice_idx p i j 0)
        (call to_simple o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (simple q) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len q))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len q))) (!= x y))
  (ensures (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (body
    (if (< x y)
      (assert (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
      (assert (!= (idx q y) (idx q x))))))
(lemma first_cross (params (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (mem s (idx p 0)) (not (mem s (idx p k))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (and (mem s (idx p j)) (not (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0) (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p 0))) (block))
    (assert (> k 0))
    (if (mem s (idx p (- k 1)))
      (assert (and (mem s (idx p (- k 1))) (not (mem s (idx p (+ (- k 1) 1))))))
      (call first_cross s p (- k 1)))))
(lemma segment_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires
    (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k hi)) (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o (idx q lo) (idx q hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl o (idx q lo))
      (block
        (call segment_conn o q lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi)))
        (call conn_edge o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))
        (call conn_trans o (idx q lo) (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (upd3 o m e)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (upd3 o m e) j) (if (== j m) e (idx o j))))))
  (body))
(lemma keep_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o q) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
    (!= k j)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (!= k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j))
    (assert (!= x m))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx o x)))
    (assert (ends (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
(lemma cover_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) x y)
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) y x)
    (ends (idx o m) x y)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (if (== k m)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
        (call conn_edge (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1))))))
(lemma exch_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o) (walk o q a b) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o m e))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (forall ((k int)) (call keep_step o q m e j k))
    (call segment_conn o1 q 0 j)
    (call segment_conn o1 q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx o1 m) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set o1 a b))
    (call conn_edge o1 a b)
    (call conn_sym o1 a (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q (+ j 1)) b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) a b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) b (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cover_step o m e (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)) k))
    (assert (covers o1 o))
    (call span_lift g o o1)))
(lemma exch_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (exists ((m int))
    (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
         (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
              (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e))))))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (walk o p a b))
    (call to_simple o p a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q)))
    (assert (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (call first_cross s q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
      (and (mem s (idx q j)) (not (mem s (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((mm int)) (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (ends (idx o mm) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (call exch_at g o q e a b mm j)
    (assert (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
                 (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1)))
                      (is_spanning g (upd3 o mm e)))))))

(lemma tw_diff (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len x) (len y))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len x)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len x))) (!= k i)) (== (idx x k) (idx y k)))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_weight x) (get (idx x i) 2)) (- (total_weight y) (get (idx y i) 2))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight y) (+ (get (idx y 0) 2) (total_weight (drop y 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop x 1) (drop y 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx x 0) (idx y 0)))
        (call tw_diff (drop x 1) (drop y 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) (- i 1)) (idx x i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop y 1) (- i 1)) (idx y i)))))))
(lemma rb_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (rebuilt o m e t)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) j) (if (== j t) e (if (== j m) (idx o t) (idx o j)))))))
  (body))
(lemma rb_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (rebuilt o m e t)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o m) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (call upd3_facts o t e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) t) e))
    (call tw_diff o (upd3 o t e) t)
    (if (== m t)
      (assert (== (rebuilt o m e t) (upd3 o t e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) m) (idx o t)))
        (call tw_diff (upd3 o t e) (rebuilt o m e t) m)))))
(lemma rb_cover_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (rebuilt o m e t) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e t))
    (ghost-let pos int (if (== k m) t (if (== k t) m k)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 pos) (< pos (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx r pos) (idx (upd3 o m e) k)))
    (assert (ends (idx r pos) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (call conn_edge r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1))))
(lemma rb_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g o)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 0) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 1) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o t) 0) (get (idx o t) 1) (get (idx o t) 2)))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
    (if (== k t)
      (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) e))
      (if (== k m)
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o t)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o k)))))))
(lemma rb_pref_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (pref t o)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (and (<= (len t) m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (rebuilt o m e (len t)) k) (idx t1 k)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (if (== k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma light_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (b int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (lightest g s b) (has_edge g x y w) (!= (mem s x) (mem s y)))
  (ensures (<= b w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (!= (mem s x) (mem s (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
    (assert (<= b (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma rebuild (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g o)
    (pref t o)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
    (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (ensures
    (<= (len t) m)
    (is_spanning_tree g (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (pref t1 (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (<= (total_weight (rebuilt o m e (len t))) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (if (< m (len t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o m) (idx t m)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 0)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx t m) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (<= (len t) m))
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (call rb_weight o m e (len t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_valid_at g o m e (len t) k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_cover_at o m e (len t) k))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (covers r (upd3 o m e)))
    (call span_lift g (upd3 o m e) r)
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g r))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rb_pref_at t t1 o m e k))
    (assert (pref t1 r))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2)))
    (call light_edge g s (get e 2) (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2))))
(lemma ext_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t1 o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g other))
    (obtain ((o0 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o0) (and (pref t o0) (<= (total_weight o0) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (is_spanning g o0))
    (call exch_find g s o0 e a b)
    (obtain ((m int)) (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o0)))
      (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o0 m) 1)))
           (is_spanning g (upd3 o0 m e)))))
    (call rebuild g s t t1 o0 e m)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o0 m e (len t)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g r) (and (pref t1 r) (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (extendable g t)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (extendable g t1))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_at g s t t1 e a b other))))
(lemma ext_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (pref t other))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g other) (and (pref t other) (<= (total_weight other) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g t))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_at g t other))))
(lemma final_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (pref t o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight other)))))

          (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q 0) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (call law_idx_drop q 1 (- k (len p)))
          (call law_idx_drop q 1 (- (+ k 1) (len p)))
          (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- k (len p)) 1) 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected o a b) (edges_connected o b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected o a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges o q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (call law_len_drop q 1)
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step o p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o r))
    (call law_idx_concat p (drop q 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (drop q 1) (- (len r) 1))
    (if (> (len q) 1)
      (call law_idx_drop q 1 (- (len q) 2))
      (block))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) c))
    (assert (walk o r a c))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set o a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) a) (== (get (idx o x) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) b) (== (get (idx o x) 1) a)))))
    (assert (ends (idx o x) b a))))
(lemma rev_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges o p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx (rev p) k) (idx (rev p) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (- (- (- (len p) 1) k) 1))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p a) (idx p (+ a 1))))
    (call edge_sym o (idx p a) (idx p (+ a 1)))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) k) (idx p (+ a 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)) (idx p a)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected o a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected o b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (rev p))
    (assert (== (len r) (len p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step o p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) b))
    (assert (== (- (len r) 1) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))
    (assert (walk o r b a))))
(lemma lift_edge (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (covers b a) (edge_in_set a u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx a x) 0) u) (== (get (idx a x) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx a x) 0) v) (== (get (idx a x) 1) u)))))
    (assert (edges_connected b (get (idx a x) 0) (get (idx a x) 1)))
    (if (and (== (get (idx a x) 0) u) (== (get (idx a x) 1) v))
      (block)
      (call conn_sym b v u))))
(lemma lift_prefix (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (covers b a) (path_follows_edges a p) (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b (idx p 0) (idx p (- k 1))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 1)
      (call conn_refl b (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call lift_prefix a b p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set a (idx p (- k 2)) (idx p (- k 1))))
        (call lift_edge a b (idx p (- k 2)) (idx p (- k 1)))
        (call conn_trans b (idx p 0) (idx p (- k 2)) (idx p (- k 1)))))))
(lemma conn_lift (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (covers b a) (edges_connected a u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges a p)))
    (call lift_prefix a b p (len p))))
(lemma span_lift_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected b u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected a u v))
    (call conn_lift a b u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g a) (covers b a))
  (ensures (is_spanning g b))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_lift_at g a b u v))))

(lemma splice_idx (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))) (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))
    (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
        (if (<= k i) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k (- j i))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_drop p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)))
    (call law_idx_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1)) k)
    (if (<= k i)
      (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) k)
      (call law_idx_drop p (+ j 1) (- k (+ i 1))))))
(lemma splice_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (+ i 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) k)
                          (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call splice_idx p i j k)
    (call splice_idx p i j (+ k 1))
    (if (< k i)
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (+ k (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ k (- j i)) 1)))))))
(lemma splice_walk (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (walk o p a b) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (walk o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))))
    (call splice_idx p i j 0)
    (call splice_idx p i j (- (len r) 1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o p))
    (forall ((k int)) (call splice_step o p i j k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) b))))
(lemma to_simple (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (walk o p a b))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (assert (and (walk o p a b) (simple p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (call splice_walk o p a b i j)
        (call splice_idx p i j 0)
        (call to_simple o (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop p (+ j 1))) a b)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (simple q) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len q))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len q))) (!= x y))
  (ensures (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (body
    (if (< x y)
      (assert (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
      (assert (!= (idx q y) (idx q x))))))
(lemma first_cross (params (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (mem s (idx p 0)) (not (mem s (idx p k))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (and (mem s (idx p j)) (not (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0) (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p 0))) (block))
    (assert (> k 0))
    (if (mem s (idx p (- k 1)))
      (assert (and (mem s (idx p (- k 1))) (not (mem s (idx p (+ (- k 1) 1))))))
      (call first_cross s p (- k 1)))))
(lemma segment_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires
    (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k hi)) (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o (idx q lo) (idx q hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (== lo hi)
      (call conn_refl o (idx q lo))
      (block
        (call segment_conn o q lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi)))
        (call conn_edge o (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))
        (call conn_trans o (idx q lo) (idx q (- hi 1)) (idx q hi))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (upd3 o m e)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (upd3 o m e) j) (if (== j m) e (idx o j))))))
  (body))
(lemma keep_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges o q) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
    (!= k j)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o x) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx o x) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (!= k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j))
    (assert (!= x m))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx o x)))
    (assert (ends (idx (upd3 o m e) x) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
(lemma cover_step (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) x y)
    (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) y x)
    (ends (idx o m) x y)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (if (== k m)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o m e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (edge_in_set (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1)))
        (call conn_edge (upd3 o m e) (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1))))))
(lemma exch_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o) (walk o q a b) (simple q)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (ends (idx o m) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (body
    (ghost-let o1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o m e))
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (forall ((k int)) (call keep_step o q m e j k))
    (call segment_conn o1 q 0 j)
    (call segment_conn o1 q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (assert (== (idx o1 m) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set o1 a b))
    (call conn_edge o1 a b)
    (call conn_sym o1 a (idx q j))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q (+ j 1)) b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) a b)
    (call conn_trans o1 (idx q j) b (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_sym o1 (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cover_step o m e (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)) k))
    (assert (covers o1 o))
    (call span_lift g o o1)))
(lemma exch_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning g o)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
    (mem s a)
    (not (mem s b))
    (ends e a b))
  (ensures (exists ((m int))
    (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
         (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
              (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e))))))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o a b))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (assert (walk o p a b))
    (call to_simple o p a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk o q a b) (simple q)))
    (assert (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (call first_cross s q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
      (and (mem s (idx q j)) (not (mem s (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((mm int)) (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o mm) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o mm) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (ends (idx o mm) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (call exch_at g o q e a b mm j)
    (assert (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 mm) (< mm (len o)))
                 (and (!= (mem s (get (idx o mm) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o mm) 1)))
                      (is_spanning g (upd3 o mm e)))))))

(lemma tw_diff (params (x (seq (tuple int int int))) (y (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (== (len x) (len y))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len x)))
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len x))) (!= k i)) (== (idx x k) (idx y k)))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_weight x) (get (idx x i) 2)) (- (total_weight y) (get (idx y i) 2))))
  (decreases (len x))
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight y) (+ (get (idx y 0) 2) (total_weight (drop y 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop x 1) (drop y 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx x 0) (idx y 0)))
        (call tw_diff (drop x 1) (drop y 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop x 1) (- i 1)) (idx x i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop y 1) (- i 1)) (idx y i)))))))
(lemma rb_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (rebuilt o m e t)) (len o))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
      (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) j) (if (== j t) e (if (== j m) (idx o t) (idx o j)))))))
  (body))
(lemma rb_weight (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (rebuilt o m e t)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o m) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (call upd3_facts o t e)
    (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) t) e))
    (call tw_diff o (upd3 o t e) t)
    (if (== m t)
      (assert (== (rebuilt o m e t) (upd3 o t e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd3 o t e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) m) (idx o t)))
        (call tw_diff (upd3 o t e) (rebuilt o m e t) m)))))
(lemma rb_cover_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (rebuilt o m e t) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts o m e)
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rebuilt o m e t))
    (ghost-let pos int (if (== k m) t (if (== k t) m k)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 pos) (< pos (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx r pos) (idx (upd3 o m e) k)))
    (assert (ends (idx r pos) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (assert (edge_in_set r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1)))
    (call conn_edge r (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd3 o m e) k) 1))))
(lemma rb_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g o)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 0) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 1) (get (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e t)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o t) 0) (get (idx o t) 1) (get (idx o t) 2)))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
    (if (== k t)
      (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) e))
      (if (== k m)
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o t)))
        (assert (== (idx (rebuilt o m e t) k) (idx o k)))))))
(lemma rb_pref_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (pref t o)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (and (<= (len t) m) (< m (len o)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (rebuilt o m e (len t)) k) (idx t1 k)))
  (body
    (call rb_facts o m e (len t))
    (if (== k (len t))
      (assert (== (idx t1 k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (== (idx t1 k) (idx t k)))))))
(lemma light_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (b int) (x int) (y int) (w int))
  (requires (lightest g s b) (has_edge g x y w) (!= (mem s x) (mem s y)))
  (ensures (<= b w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (!= (mem s x) (mem s (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))))
    (assert (<= b (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma rebuild (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g o)
    (pref t o)
    (internal s t)
    (appended3 t t1 e)
    (lightest g s (get e 2))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len o)))
    (!= (mem s (get (idx o m) 0)) (mem s (get (idx o m) 1)))
    (is_spanning g (upd3 o m e)))
  (ensures
    (<= (len t) m)
    (is_spanning_tree g (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (pref t1 (rebuilt o m e (len t)))
    (<= (total_weight (rebuilt o m e (len t))) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (if (< m (len t))

      0
      (+ (true_count (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
         (if (last seen) 1 0)))))

(ghost-fn included_edges
  ((small (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (large (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((edge (tuple int int int)))
        (<= (occurrences small edge) (occurrences large edge)))
      (=>
        (== (len small) (len large))
        (and
          (== (multiset small) (multiset large))
          (== (total_weight small) (total_weight large)))))))

(ghost-fn partial_tree
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len seen) (len g))
        (and (> (len seen) 0) (idx seen 0)))
      (and
        (are_valid_edges g chosen)
        (and
          (== (len chosen) (- (true_count seen) 1))
          (forall ((vertex int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g)))
                (idx seen vertex))
              (edges_connected chosen 0 vertex))))))))

(ghost-fn optimal_extension
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (exists ((tree (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (is_mst g tree)
        (included_edges chosen tree)))))

(ghost-fn prim_state
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (partial_tree g seen chosen)
      (optimal_extension g chosen))))

(ghost-fn crossing_edge
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (from int)
   (to int)
   (weight int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len seen) (len g))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 from) (< from (len g)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 to) (< to (len g)))
          (and
            (!= (idx seen from) (idx seen to))
            (has_edge g from to weight)))))))

(ghost-fn scan_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (seen (seq bool))
   (scan_vertex int)
   (scan_edge int)
   (found bool)
   (best_from int)
   (best_to int)
   (best_weight int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len seen) (len g))
      (and
        (=>
          found
          (crossing_edge g seen best_from best_to best_weight))
        (forall ((vertex int) (edge_index int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g)))
                (and
                  (<= 0 edge_index)
                  (< edge_index (len (idx g vertex)))))
              (or
                (< vertex scan_vertex)
                (and
                  (== vertex scan_vertex)
                  (< edge_index scan_edge))))
            (=>
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_index) 0))
                (<
                  (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_index) 0)
                  (len seen)))
              (and
                (=>
                  (!=
                    (idx seen vertex)
                    (idx seen
                      (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_index) 0)))
                  found)
                (=>
                  (!=
                    (idx seen vertex)
                    (idx seen
                      (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_index) 0)))
                  (<=
                    best_weight
                    (get (idx (idx g vertex) edge_index) 1)))))))))))

(lemma true_count_bounds
  (params (seen (seq bool)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (true_count seen))
      (<= (true_count seen) (len seen))))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 0)
      (call true_count_bounds (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma true_count_full
  (params (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (true_count seen) (len seen)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((vertex int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len seen)))
        (idx seen vertex))))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 0)
      (block
        (call true_count_bounds
          (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
        (assert (last seen))
        (assert
          (==
            (true_count (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
            (len (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))))
        (call true_count_full
          (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
        (assert
          (forall ((vertex int))
            (=>
              (and
                (<= 0 vertex)
                (< vertex (len (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))))
              (idx seen vertex)))))
      (block))))

(lemma true_count_has_false
  (params (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires (< (true_count seen) (len seen)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((vertex int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen vertex)))))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (assert (> (len seen) 0))
    (if (not (last seen))
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (- (len seen) 1))
              (< (- (len seen) 1) (len seen)))
            (not (idx seen (- (len seen) 1))))))
      (block
        (assert
          (<
            (true_count (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
            (len (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))))
        (call true_count_has_false
          (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
        (obtain ((vertex int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 vertex)
              (< vertex (len (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))))
            (not
              (idx
                (take seen (- (len seen) 1))
                vertex))))
        (assert
          (and
            (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len seen)))
            (not (idx seen vertex))))))))

(lemma single_true_count
  (params (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (> (len seen) 0)
    (forall ((vertex int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len seen)))
        (== (idx seen vertex) (== vertex 0)))))
  (ensures (== (true_count seen) 1))
  (decreases (len seen))
  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (forall ((vertex int))
            (=>
              (and
                (<= 0 vertex)
                (< vertex (len (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))))
              (==
                (idx (take seen (- (len seen) 1)) vertex)
                (== vertex 0)))))
        (call single_true_count
          (take seen (- (len seen) 1)))
        (assert (not (last seen))))
      (assert (last seen)))))

(lemma occurrence_nonnegative
  (params
    (s (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edge (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences s edge) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)

      (block))))

(lemma empty_included
  (params (large (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (included_edges (seq-lit) large))
  (body
    (forall ((edge (tuple int int int)))

(lemma count_added
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (vertex int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len before)))
    (not (idx before vertex))
    (== after (bool_update before vertex true)))
  (ensures
    (== (true_count after) (+ (true_count before) 1)))
  (decreases (len before))
  (body
    (if (< vertex (- (len before) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (take after (- (len after) 1))
            (bool_update
              (take before (- (len before) 1))
              vertex
              true)))
        (call count_added
          (take before (- (len before) 1))
          (take after (- (len after) 1))
          vertex)
        (assert (== (last after) (last before))))
      (block
        (assert (== vertex (- (len before) 1)))
        (assert (not (last before)))
        (assert (last after))
        (assert
          (==
            (take after (- (len after) 1))
            (take before (- (len before) 1))))))))

(lemma empty_tree_connections
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (vertex int))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (== vertex 0)
      (edges_connected (seq-lit) 0 vertex)))
  (body
    (if (== vertex 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (> (len (seq-lit 0)) 0)
            (and
              (== (idx (seq-lit 0) 0) 0)
              (==
                (idx
                  (seq-lit 0)
                  (- (len (seq-lit 0)) 1))
                0))))
        (assert

            (seq-lit)

      (block))))

(lemma empty_partial_tree
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (forall ((vertex int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len seen)))
        (== (idx seen vertex) (== vertex 0)))))
  (ensures
    (partial_tree g seen (seq-lit)))
  (body
    (call single_true_count seen)
    (forall ((vertex int))

    (assert (are_valid_edges g (seq-lit)))

(lemma path_has_cut
  (params
    (seen (seq bool))
    (path (seq int)))
  (requires
    (> (len path) 0)
    (forall ((index int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 index) (< index (len path)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx path index))
          (< (idx path index) (len seen)))))
    (idx seen (idx path 0))
    (not
      (idx seen
        (idx path (- (len path) 1))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((index int))
      (and
        (and
          (<= 0 index)
          (< index (- (len path) 1)))
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx path index))
          (idx seen (idx path (+ index 1)))))))
  (decreases (len path))
  (body
    (assert (> (len path) 1))
    (if
      (!=
        (idx seen
          (idx path (- (len path) 2)))
        (idx seen
          (idx path (- (len path) 1))))
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (- (len path) 2))
              (< (- (len path) 2) (- (len path) 1)))
            (!=
              (idx seen
                (idx path (- (len path) 2)))
              (idx seen
                (idx path (+ (- (len path) 2) 1)))))))
      (block
        (assert
          (forall ((index int))
            (=>
              (and
                (<= 0 index)
                (< index
                  (len (take path (- (len path) 1)))))
              (and
                (<= 0
                  (idx
                    (take path (- (len path) 1))
                    index))
                (<
                  (idx
                    (take path (- (len path) 1))
                    index)
                  (len seen))))))
        (assert
          (idx seen
            (idx
              (take path (- (len path) 1))
              0)))
        (assert
          (not
            (idx seen
              (idx
                (take path (- (len path) 1))
                (-
                  (len (take path (- (len path) 1)))
                  1)))))
        (call path_has_cut
          seen
          (take path (- (len path) 1)))))))

(lemma graph_path_vertices
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (path (seq int)))
  (requires
    (> (len path) 0)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx path 0))
      (< (idx path 0) (len g)))
    (path_follows_graph g path)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((index int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 index) (< index (len path)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx path index))
          (< (idx path index) (len g))))))
  (decreases (len path))
  (body
    (if (> (len path) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (graph_has_any_edge
            g
            (idx path 0)
            (idx path 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx path 0))
                (< (idx path 0) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                  (len (idx g (idx path 0))))))
            (==
              (get
                (idx
                  (idx g (idx path 0))
                  edge_index)
                0)
              (idx path 1))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx path 1))
            (< (idx path 1) (len g)))))
      (block))))

(lemma connected_cut_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (idx seen 0)
    (< (true_count seen) (len seen))
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((from int) (to int) (weight int))
      (crossing_edge g seen from to weight)))
  (body
    (call true_count_has_false seen)
    (obtain ((unseen int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 unseen) (< unseen (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen unseen))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 unseen))
    (obtain ((path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len path) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx path 0) 0)
            (==
              (idx path (- (len path) 1))
              unseen)))
        (path_follows_graph g path)))
    (call graph_path_vertices g path)
    (call path_has_cut seen path)
    (obtain ((cut_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (<= 0 cut_index)
          (< cut_index (- (len path) 1)))
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx path cut_index))
          (idx seen (idx path (+ cut_index 1))))))
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge
        g
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))))
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx path cut_index))
            (< (idx path cut_index) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index
              (len (idx g (idx path cut_index))))))
        (==
          (get
            (idx
              (idx g (idx path cut_index))
              edge_index)
            0)
          (idx path (+ cut_index 1)))))
    (let edge_value (tuple int int)
      (idx
        (idx g (idx path cut_index))
        edge_index))
    (assert
      (has_edge
        g
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))
        (get edge_value 1)))
    (assert
      (crossing_edge
        g
        seen
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))
        (get edge_value 1)))))

(lemma connected_preserved_by_append
  (params
    (chosen (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (from int)
    (to int)
    (weight int)
    (vertex int))
  (requires
    (edges_connected chosen 0 vertex))
  (ensures
    (edges_connected
      (concat chosen (seq-lit (tuple from to weight)))
      0
      vertex))
  (body
    (obtain ((path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len path) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx path 0) 0)
            (== (idx path (- (len path) 1)) vertex)))
        (path_follows_edges chosen path)))
    (assert
      (path_follows_edges
        (concat chosen (seq-lit (tuple from to weight)))
        path))))

(lemma connected_new_vertex
  (params
    (chosen (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (old_vertex int)
    (new_vertex int)
    (from int)
    (to int)
    (weight int))
  (requires
    (edges_connected chosen 0 old_vertex)
    (or
      (and (== from old_vertex) (== to new_vertex))
      (and (== from new_vertex) (== to old_vertex))))
  (ensures
    (edges_connected
      (concat chosen (seq-lit (tuple from to weight)))
      0
      new_vertex))
  (body
    (obtain ((path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len path) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx path 0) 0)
            (== (idx path (- (len path) 1)) old_vertex)))
        (path_follows_edges chosen path)))
    (ghost-let extended (seq int)
      (concat path (seq-lit new_vertex)))
    (assert (> (len extended) 0))
    (assert (== (idx extended 0) 0))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx extended (- (len extended) 1))
        new_vertex))
    (assert
      (path_follows_edges
        (concat chosen (seq-lit (tuple from to weight)))
        extended))))

(lemma partial_tree_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (seen_after (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (best_from int)
    (best_to int)
    (best_weight int)
    (next_vertex int))
  (requires
    (partial_tree g seen_before chosen_before)
    (crossing_edge
      g seen_before best_from best_to best_weight)
    (==
      next_vertex
      (if (idx seen_before best_from)
        best_to
        best_from))
    (not (idx seen_before next_vertex))
    (==
      seen_after
      (bool_update seen_before next_vertex true))
    (==
      chosen_after
      (concat
        chosen_before
        (seq-lit
          (tuple best_from best_to best_weight)))))
  (ensures
    (partial_tree g seen_after chosen_after))
  (body
    (call count_added seen_before seen_after next_vertex)
    (assert (are_valid_edges g chosen_after))
    (assert
      (if (idx seen_before best_from)
        (and
          (== next_vertex best_to)
          (idx seen_before best_from))
        (and
          (== next_vertex best_from)
          (idx seen_before best_to))))
    (forall ((vertex int))
      (if
        (and
          (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g)))
          (idx seen_before vertex))
        (call connected_preserved_by_append
          chosen_before
          best_from
          best_to
          best_weight
          vertex)
        (block)))
    (if (idx seen_before best_from)
      (call connected_new_vertex
        chosen_before
        best_from
        best_to
        best_from
        best_to
        best_weight)
      (call connected_new_vertex
        chosen_before
        best_to
        best_from
        best_from
        best_to
        best_weight))
    (assert
      (forall ((vertex int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g)))
            (idx seen_after vertex))
          (edges_connected chosen_after 0 vertex))))))

(lemma completed_partial_is_tree
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (partial_tree g seen chosen)
    (== (true_count seen) (len seen)))
  (ensures
    (is_spanning_tree g chosen))
  (body
    (call true_count_full seen)
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
          (edges_connected chosen u v))))
    (assert (is_spanning g chosen))
    (assert (== (len chosen) (- (len g) 1)))))

(lemma spanning_tree_exists_from_partial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (partial_tree g seen chosen)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((tree (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (is_spanning_tree g tree)))
  (decreases (- (len seen) (true_count seen)))
  (body
    (call true_count_bounds seen)
    (if (< (true_count seen) (len seen))
      (block
        (call connected_cut_edge g seen)
        (obtain ((from int) (to int) (weight int))
          (crossing_edge g seen from to weight))
        (ghost-let next_vertex int
          (if (idx seen from) to from))
        (assert (not (idx seen next_vertex)))
        (ghost-let next_seen (seq bool)
          (bool_update seen next_vertex true))
        (ghost-let next_chosen (seq (tuple int int int))
          (concat chosen (seq-lit (tuple from to weight))))
        (call partial_tree_step
          g
          seen
          chosen
          next_seen
          next_chosen
          from
          to
          weight
          next_vertex)
        (call count_added seen next_seen next_vertex)
        (call spanning_tree_exists_from_partial
          g next_seen next_chosen))
      (block
        (call completed_partial_is_tree g seen chosen)
        (assert
          (exists ((tree (seq (tuple int int int))))
            (is_spanning_tree g tree)))))))

(lemma valid_edge_weight_lower
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edge (tuple int int int)))
  (requires
    (weights_bounded g)
    (has_edge
      g
      (get edge 0)
      (get edge 1)
      (get edge 2)))
  (ensures (>= (get edge 2) -100000))
  (body))

(lemma valid_tail
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (> (len edges) 0)
    (are_valid_edges g edges))
  (ensures
    (are_valid_edges g (drop edges 1)))
  (body))

(lemma total_weight_lower
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (weights_bounded g)
    (are_valid_edges g edges))
  (ensures
    (>=
      (total_weight edges)
      (* -100000 (len edges))))
  (decreases (len edges))
  (body
    (if (> (len edges) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (has_edge
            g
            (get (idx edges 0) 0)
            (get (idx edges 0) 1)
            (get (idx edges 0) 2)))
        (call valid_edge_weight_lower g (idx edges 0))
        (call valid_tail g edges)
        (call total_weight_lower g (drop edges 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma minimum_tree_from
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (tree (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (weights_bounded g)
    (is_spanning_tree g tree))
  (ensures
    (exists ((minimum (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (is_mst g minimum)))
  (decreases
    (-
      (total_weight tree)
      (* -100000 (- (len g) 1))))
  (body
    (call total_weight_lower g tree)
    (if
      (exists ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g other)
          (< (total_weight other) (total_weight tree))))
      (block
        (obtain ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
          (and
            (is_spanning_tree g other)
            (< (total_weight other) (total_weight tree))))
        (call total_weight_lower g other)
        (call minimum_tree_from g other))
      (block
        (assert
          (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
            (=>
              (is_spanning_tree g other)
              (<=
                (total_weight tree)
                (total_weight other)))))
        (assert (is_mst g tree))
        (assert
          (exists ((minimum (seq (tuple int int int))))
            (is_mst g minimum)))))))

(lemma mst_exists
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires

(lemma graph_path_vertices
  (params

    (forall ((u int) (i int))

  (ensures
    (forall ((index int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 index) (< index (len path)))
        (and

          (< (idx path index) (len g))))))
  (decreases (len path))
  (body
    (if (> (len path) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (graph_has_any_edge
            g
            (idx path 0)
            (idx path 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx path 0))
                (< (idx path 0) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)

                  (len (idx g (idx path 0))))))

                  (idx g (idx path 0))

(lemma connected_cut_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)

    (idx seen 0)

      (=>

          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))

          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((from int) (to int) (weight int))
      (crossing_edge g seen from to weight)))
  (body
    (call true_count_has_false seen)
    (obtain ((unseen int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 unseen) (< unseen (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen unseen))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 unseen))
    (obtain ((path (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len path) 0)

            (== (idx path 0) 0)
            (==
              (idx path (- (len path) 1))
              unseen)))
        (path_follows_graph g path)))
    (call graph_path_vertices g path)
    (call path_has_cut seen path)
    (obtain ((cut_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (<= 0 cut_index)
          (< cut_index (- (len path) 1)))
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx path cut_index))
          (idx seen (idx path (+ cut_index 1))))))
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge
        g
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))))
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx path cut_index))
            (< (idx path cut_index) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index
              (len (idx g (idx path cut_index))))))
        (==
          (get
            (idx
              (idx g (idx path cut_index))
              edge_index)
            0)
          (idx path (+ cut_index 1)))))
    (let edge_value (tuple int int)
      (idx
        (idx g (idx path cut_index))
        edge_index))
    (assert
      (has_edge
        g
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))
        (get edge_value 1)))
    (assert
      (crossing_edge
        g
        seen
        (idx path cut_index)
        (idx path (+ cut_index 1))

(lemma partial_tree_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

        (seq-lit

          (== next_vertex best_to)
          (idx seen_before best_from))

          (== next_vertex best_from)
          (idx seen_before best_to))))

      (if
        (and
          (and (<= 0 vertex) (< vertex (len g)))
          (idx seen_before vertex))
        (call connected_preserved_by_append
          chosen_before
          best_from
          best_to
          best_weight
          vertex)

    (if (idx seen_before best_from)
      (call connected_new_vertex
        chosen_before
        best_from
        best_to
        best_from
        best_to
        best_weight)
      (call connected_new_vertex
        chosen_before
        best_to
        best_from
        best_from
        best_to
        best_weight))
    (assert
      (forall ((vertex int))
        (=>

  (params
