  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_mono h f p n u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (cut h p a n) (cut f p a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_mono h f p n (- a 1))
        (call cutrow_mono h f p n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_range cap))
    (assert (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (< a (len h)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h a))))))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (cap_exact g cap))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_le (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len p) n) (closed_cut cap f p) (bounded cap f) (flow_le cap h n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (if (ins p u)
      (if (ins p v) (block) (assert (not (resid cap f u v))))
      (if (ins p v) (assert (not (resid cap f v u))) (block)))))

(lemma valid_parts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (body))
(lemma net_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))))
  (ensures (== (net h u n) 0))
  (body (call flow_net_eq g h u)))
(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (bounded cap f) (conserved_net f s t n)
    (== (len p) n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (closed_cut cap f p)
    (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_parts g other s t)
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_other g other s t n u))
    (assert (conserved_net other s t n))
    (call flow_net_eq g other s)
    (call value_is_cut other p s t n)
    (call value_is_cut f p s t n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call valid_le g cap other n a b))
    (assert (flow_le cap other n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_le cap f other p n a b))
    (assert (term_le other f p n))
    (call cut_mono other f p n n)
    (assert (== (flow_val g other s) (net other s n)))))

(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (square f n) (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow cap u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)))
    (assert (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v))))))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_flow f) (conserved_net f s t n)
            (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w s) (!= w t))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f w) (total_flow_out g f w)))
  (body
    (call flow_net_eq g f w)
    (assert (== (net f w n) 0))))
(lemma our_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (cap_sound g cap))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g cap f n u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nonneg_at cap f u v))
    (assert (nonneg_flow f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call cons_at g f s t n w))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call flow_net_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (== (len pos) n) (== (idx pos s) 0) (< (idx pos t) 0) (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) val))))
  (body
    (call our_valid g cap f s t n val)
    (assert (ins pos s))
    (assert (not (ins pos t)))
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g cap f pos s t n other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val)))))

(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn ge_m1 ((pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) -1)))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((queue (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) 0))
    (and (< (idx pos w) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn queue_pos ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len pos))))
    (== (idx pos (idx queue k)) k)))))
(ghost-fn parents ((pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len pos)))
             (and (>= (idx pos (idx par w)) 0) (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn path_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
             (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) lim))))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0)))
        (not (resid cap f (idx queue k) w))))))
(ghost-fn partial ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w i)) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (== (net f u n) (- (+ (net f0 u n) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (if (== u t) 1 0))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 pos0) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 pos))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_positions (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (positions pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (positions pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_qpos (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (queue_pos pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (queue_pos pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_parents (params (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (parents pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 u) 0) (< (idx pos0 u) x))
  (ensures (parents pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree_res (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int))
                             (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (resid cap f u v))
  (ensures (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_scanned (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
                            (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos0 queue0 head) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0) (appended queue0 queue v) (<= head (len queue0)))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_mark (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos0 u v) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos)))
            (or (>= (idx pos v) 0) (not (resid cap f u v))))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos queue head) (partial cap f pos u n) (== (len pos) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (a int) (w int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue))
            (ins pos a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (not (ins pos w)))
  (ensures (not (resid cap f a w)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (>= (idx pos a) 0)))
    (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))
    (assert (< (idx pos w) 0))
    (assert (not (resid cap f (idx queue (idx pos a)) w)))))
(lemma final_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (body (forall ((a int) (w int)) (call closed_at cap f pos queue head a w))))
(lemma tree_path (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (ensures (path_res cap f pos par s lim))
  (body))

(lemma path_keep (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                         (s int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires
    (parents pos par s)
    (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (< x (len par))) (!= x s) (>= (idx pos x) 0) (== (idx par x) p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len pos)))
    (path_res cap f0 pos par s (idx pos x))
    (same_except f0 f1 a b)
    (or (and (== a p) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b p)))
    (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
    (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) (idx pos p)))))
  (ensures (resid cap f1 (idx par w) w))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx pos p) (idx pos x)))
    (assert (!= w x))
    (assert (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w)))
    (assert (!= (idx par w) x))
    (assert (resid cap f0 (idx par w) w))
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 (idx par w) w) (get_flow f0 (idx par w) w)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 w (idx par w)) (get_flow f0 w (idx par w))))))
(lemma walk_all (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int)))
                        (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires
    (bounded cap f0) (walk_net fl f0 x t n)
    (== (len pos) n) (== (len par) n) (parents pos par s)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x s) (>= (idx pos x) 0) (== (idx par x) p) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n))
    (path_res cap f0 pos par s (idx pos x))
    (same_except f0 f1 a b) (== (get_flow f1 a b) (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d))
    (or (and (and (== a p) (== b x)) (== d 1)) (and (and (== a x) (== b p)) (== d -1)))
    (and (<= 0 (get_flow f1 a b)) (<= (get_flow f1 a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
  (ensures (bounded cap f1) (walk_net fl f1 p t n) (path_res cap f1 pos par s (idx pos p)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_delta f0 f1 a b d u n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call path_keep cap f0 f1 pos par s x p a b w))))
(lemma after_aug (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap f0 s t n val) (walk_net f0 r s t n) (bounded cap r) (!= s t))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap r s t n (+ val 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (net f0 s n) val))
    (assert (conserved_net f0 s t n))
    (assert (conserved_net r s t n))
    (assert (== (net r s n) (+ val 1)))))

(lemma zero_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (all_zero cap))
  (ensures (cap_range cap) (cap_sound g cap))
  (body))
(lemma cap_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square c0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
    (has_capacity g u v w) (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (cap_range c0) (cap_sound g c0) (cap_upto g c0 u i)
    (upd2 c0 c1 n u v w))
  (ensures (cap_range c1) (cap_sound g c1) (cap_upto g c1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
    (call upd2_same c0 c1 n u v w)))
(lemma cap_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (cap_upto g cap u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (cap_upto g cap (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma cap_fin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_upto g cap n 0))
  (ensures (cap_exact g cap))
  (body))

(spec build_cap
  (params (graph capacity_graph))
  (returns (cap (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (well_formed graph) (capacities_bounded (view graph)))
  (ensures (square cap (size graph)) (cap_good (view graph) cap))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_view graph)
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (let-mut cap (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b) 0)))))
    (assert (square cap n))
    (assert (all_zero cap))
    (call zero_cap g cap)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (square cap n))
      (invariant (cap_range cap))
      (invariant (cap_sound g cap))
      (invariant (cap_upto g cap u 0))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (square cap n))
        (invariant (cap_range cap))
        (invariant (cap_sound g cap))
        (invariant (cap_upto g cap u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (let v i64 (get e 0))
        (let c i64 (get e 1))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c))
        (assert (and (<= 0 c) (<= c 100000)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) cap)
        (set-idx (idx cap u) v c)
        (assert (upd2 c0 cap n u v c))
        (call cap_step g c0 cap n u i v c)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call cap_next g cap u)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call cap_fin g cap n)
    (assert (== (size graph) n))
    (assert (cap_good g cap))
    (return cap)))

(spec find_path
  (params (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (fl (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (n i64) (s i64))
  (returns (pos (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)))

  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cut h p (- a 1) b) (cutrow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn prow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (prow h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (row h (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dsum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dsum h p (- a 1) b) (srow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn esum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (esum h p a (- b 1)) (if (ins p (- b 1)) (col h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn anet ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (anet h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (net h (- a 1) n) 0)))))

(lemma cutrow_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (cutrow h p u k) (- (if (ins p u) (row h u k) 0) (srow h p u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_split h p u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cut h p a b) (- (prow h p b a) (dsum h p a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_split h p (- a 1) b)
        (call cutrow_split h p (- a 1) b))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (esum h p (+ a 1) b) (+ (esum h p a b) (srow h p a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call esum_step h p a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (esum h p 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) 0) 0))
        (call esum_zero h p (- b 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma swap_sums (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (dsum h p a b) (esum h p a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call swap_sums h p (- a 1) b)
        (call esum_step h p (- a 1) b))
      (call esum_zero h p b))))
(lemma anet_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (- (prow h p n a) (esum h p n a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_split h p n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma anet_value (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s a)) (net h s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_value h p s t n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma value_is_cut (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (== (cut h p n n) (net h s n)))
  (body
    (call cut_split h p n n)
    (call swap_sums h p n n)
    (call anet_split h p n n)
    (call anet_value h p s t n n)))

(ghost-fn term_le ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v))))))
(ghost-fn flow_le ((cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b)))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (w int))
    (=> (and (ins p u) (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (not (ins p w))))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(lemma cutrow_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (cutrow h p u k) (cutrow f p u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_mono h f p n u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (cut h p a n) (cut f p a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_mono h f p n (- a 1))
        (call cutrow_mono h f p n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_range cap))
    (assert (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (< a (len h)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h a))))))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (cap_exact g cap))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_le (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len p) n) (closed_cut cap f p) (bounded cap f) (flow_le cap h n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (if (ins p u)
      (if (ins p v) (block) (assert (not (resid cap f u v))))
      (if (ins p v) (assert (not (resid cap f v u))) (block)))))

(lemma valid_parts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (body))
(lemma net_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))))
  (ensures (== (net h u n) 0))
  (body (call flow_net_eq g h u)))
(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (bounded cap f) (conserved_net f s t n)
    (== (len p) n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (closed_cut cap f p)
    (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_parts g other s t)
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_other g other s t n u))
    (assert (conserved_net other s t n))
    (call flow_net_eq g other s)
    (call value_is_cut other p s t n)
    (call value_is_cut f p s t n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call valid_le g cap other n a b))
    (assert (flow_le cap other n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_le cap f other p n a b))
    (assert (term_le other f p n))
    (call cut_mono other f p n n)
    (assert (== (flow_val g other s) (net other s n)))))

(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (square f n) (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow cap u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)))
    (assert (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v))))))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_flow f) (conserved_net f s t n)
            (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w s) (!= w t))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f w) (total_flow_out g f w)))
  (body
    (call flow_net_eq g f w)
    (assert (== (net f w n) 0))))
(lemma our_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (cap_sound g cap))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g cap f n u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nonneg_at cap f u v))
    (assert (nonneg_flow f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call cons_at g f s t n w))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call flow_net_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (== (len pos) n) (== (idx pos s) 0) (< (idx pos t) 0) (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) val))))
  (body
    (call our_valid g cap f s t n val)
    (assert (ins pos s))
    (assert (not (ins pos t)))
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g cap f pos s t n other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val)))))

(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn ge_m1 ((pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) -1)))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((queue (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) 0))
    (and (< (idx pos w) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn queue_pos ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len pos))))
    (== (idx pos (idx queue k)) k)))))
(ghost-fn parents ((pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len pos)))
             (and (>= (idx pos (idx par w)) 0) (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn path_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
             (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) lim))))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0)))
        (not (resid cap f (idx queue k) w))))))
(ghost-fn partial ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w i)) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (== (net f u n) (- (+ (net f0 u n) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (if (== u t) 1 0))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 pos0) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 pos))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_positions (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (positions pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (positions pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_qpos (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (queue_pos pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (queue_pos pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_parents (params (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (parents pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 u) 0) (< (idx pos0 u) x))
  (ensures (parents pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree_res (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int))
                             (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (resid cap f u v))
  (ensures (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_scanned (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
                            (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos0 queue0 head) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0) (appended queue0 queue v) (<= head (len queue0)))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_mark (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos0 u v) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos)))
            (or (>= (idx pos v) 0) (not (resid cap f u v))))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos queue head) (partial cap f pos u n) (== (len pos) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (a int) (w int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue))
            (ins pos a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (not (ins pos w)))
  (ensures (not (resid cap f a w)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (>= (idx pos a) 0)))
    (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))
    (assert (< (idx pos w) 0))
    (assert (not (resid cap f (idx queue (idx pos a)) w)))))
(lemma final_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (body (forall ((a int) (w int)) (call closed_at cap f pos queue head a w))))
(lemma tree_path (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (ensures (path_res cap f pos par s lim))
  (body))

(lemma path_keep (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                         (s int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires
    (parents pos par s)
    (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (< x (len par))) (!= x s) (>= (idx pos x) 0) (== (idx par x) p)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len pos)))
    (path_res cap f0 pos par s (idx pos x))
    (same_except f0 f1 a b)
    (or (and (== a p) (== b x)) (and (== a x) (== b p)))
    (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
    (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) (idx pos p)))))
  (ensures (resid cap f1 (idx par w) w))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx pos p) (idx pos x)))
    (assert (!= w x))
    (assert (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w)))
    (assert (!= (idx par w) x))
    (assert (resid cap f0 (idx par w) w))
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 (idx par w) w) (get_flow f0 (idx par w) w)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 w (idx par w)) (get_flow f0 w (idx par w))))))
(lemma walk_all (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int)))
                        (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires
    (bounded cap f0) (walk_net fl f0 x t n)

(ghost-fn cutrow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cutrow h p u (- k 1)) (term h p u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn cut ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cut h p (- a 1) b) (cutrow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn prow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (prow h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (row h (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dsum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dsum h p (- a 1) b) (srow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn esum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (esum h p a (- b 1)) (if (ins p (- b 1)) (col h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn anet ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (anet h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (net h (- a 1) n) 0)))))

(lemma cutrow_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (cutrow h p u k) (- (if (ins p u) (row h u k) 0) (srow h p u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_split h p u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cut h p a b) (- (prow h p b a) (dsum h p a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_split h p (- a 1) b)
        (call cutrow_split h p (- a 1) b))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (esum h p (+ a 1) b) (+ (esum h p a b) (srow h p a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call esum_step h p a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (esum h p 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) 0) 0))
        (call esum_zero h p (- b 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma swap_sums (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (dsum h p a b) (esum h p a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call swap_sums h p (- a 1) b)
        (call esum_step h p (- a 1) b))
      (call esum_zero h p b))))
(lemma anet_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (- (prow h p n a) (esum h p n a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_split h p n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma anet_value (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s a)) (net h s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_value h p s t n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma value_is_cut (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (== (cut h p n n) (net h s n)))
  (body
    (call cut_split h p n n)
    (call swap_sums h p n n)
    (call anet_split h p n n)
    (call anet_value h p s t n n)))

(ghost-fn term_le ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v))))))
(ghost-fn flow_le ((cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b)))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (w int))
    (=> (and (ins p u) (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (not (ins p w))))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(lemma cutrow_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (cutrow h p u k) (cutrow f p u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_mono h f p n u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (cut h p a n) (cut f p a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_mono h f p n (- a 1))
        (call cutrow_mono h f p n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_range cap))
    (assert (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (< a (len h)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h a))))))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (cap_exact g cap))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_le (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len p) n) (closed_cut cap f p) (bounded cap f) (flow_le cap h n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (if (ins p u)
      (if (ins p v) (block) (assert (not (resid cap f u v))))
      (if (ins p v) (assert (not (resid cap f v u))) (block)))))

(lemma valid_parts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (body))
(lemma net_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))))
  (ensures (== (net h u n) 0))
  (body (call flow_net_eq g h u)))
(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (bounded cap f) (conserved_net f s t n)
    (== (len p) n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (closed_cut cap f p)
    (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_parts g other s t)
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_other g other s t n u))
    (assert (conserved_net other s t n))
    (call flow_net_eq g other s)
    (call value_is_cut other p s t n)
    (call value_is_cut f p s t n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call valid_le g cap other n a b))
    (assert (flow_le cap other n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_le cap f other p n a b))
    (assert (term_le other f p n))
    (call cut_mono other f p n n)
    (assert (== (flow_val g other s) (net other s n)))))

(ghost-fn resp_wit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v))))))))
(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v)))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow cap u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)))))
(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap))
  (ensures (resp_wit g cap f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g cap f u v))))
(lemma resp_from_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (resp_wit g cap f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body))
(lemma resp_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (call resp_all g cap f)
    (call resp_from_wit g cap f)))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_flow f) (conserved_net f s t n)
            (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w s) (!= w t))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f w) (total_flow_out g f w)))
  (body
    (call flow_net_eq g f w)
    (assert (== (net f w n) 0))))
(lemma our_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (cap_sound g cap))
    (call resp_ok g cap f)
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nonneg_at cap f u v))
    (assert (nonneg_flow f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call cons_at g f s t n w))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call flow_net_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (== (len pos) n) (== (idx pos s) 0) (< (idx pos t) 0) (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) val))))
  (body
    (call our_valid g cap f s t n val)
    (assert (ins pos s))
    (assert (not (ins pos t)))
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g cap f pos s t n other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val)))))

(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn ge_m1 ((pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) -1)))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((queue (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) 0))
    (and (< (idx pos w) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn queue_pos ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len pos))))
    (== (idx pos (idx queue k)) k)))))
(ghost-fn parents ((pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len pos)))
             (and (>= (idx pos (idx par w)) 0) (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn path_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
             (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) lim))))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0)))
        (not (resid cap f (idx queue k) w))))))
(ghost-fn partial ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w i)) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (== (net f u n) (- (+ (net f0 u n) (if (== u x) 1 0)) (if (== u t) 1 0))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 pos0) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 pos))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_positions (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (positions pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (positions pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_qpos (params (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (queue_pos pos0 queue0) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)) (== (idx pos0 v) -1) (appended queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (queue_pos pos queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_parents (params (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (parents pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (== (idx pos0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len pos0))) (>= (idx pos0 u) 0) (< (idx pos0 u) x))
  (ensures (parents pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree_res (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int))
                             (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (v int) (x int) (u int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos0 par0 s) (upd pos0 pos v x) (upd par0 par v u) (resid cap f u v))
  (ensures (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (body))
(lemma step_scanned (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
                            (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos0 queue0 head) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0) (appended queue0 queue v) (<= head (len queue0)))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_mark (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos0 (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos0 u v) (upd pos0 pos v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial cap f pos u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len pos)))
            (or (>= (idx pos v) 0) (not (resid cap f u v))))
  (ensures (partial cap f pos u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (scanned cap f pos queue head) (partial cap f pos u n) (== (len pos) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (scanned cap f pos queue (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (a int) (w int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue))
            (ins pos a) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (not (ins pos w)))
  (ensures (not (resid cap f a w)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len pos))) (>= (idx pos a) 0)))
    (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a))
    (assert (< (idx pos w) 0))
    (assert (not (resid cap f (idx queue (idx pos a)) w)))))
(lemma final_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int))
  (requires (positions pos queue) (scanned cap f pos queue head) (== head (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (body (forall ((a int) (w int)) (call closed_at cap f pos queue head a w))))
(lemma tree_path (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int))
  (requires (tree_res cap f pos par s))
  (ensures (path_res cap f pos par s lim))
  (body))

(lemma path_keep (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                         (s int) (x int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires

            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (!= (get (idx r i) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (in_prefix r v k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call prefix_absent r v (- k 1)) (block))))
(ghost-fn mrow ((r (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0
          (+ (mrow r h u k (- j 1)) (if (in_prefix r (- j 1) k) (get_flow h u (- j 1)) 0)))))
(lemma mrow_none (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int))
  (ensures (== (mrow r h u 0 j) 0))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (assert (not (in_prefix r (- j 1) 0)))
        (call mrow_none r h u (- j 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma mrow_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))) (not (in_prefix r (get (idx r k) 0) k)))
  (ensures (== (mrow r h u (+ k 1) j)
               (+ (mrow r h u k j)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) j)) (get_flow h u (get (idx r k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call mrow_step r h u k (- j 1))
        (assert (== (in_prefix r (- j 1) (+ k 1)) (or (== (get (idx r k) 0) (- j 1)) (in_prefix r (- j 1) k)))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_mrow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (mrow (idx g u) h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_mrow g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (call prefix_absent (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (- k 1))
        (call mrow_step (idx g u) h u (- k 1) (len g)))
      (call mrow_none (idx g u) h u (len g)))))
(lemma mrow_full (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v j)) (or (in_prefix r v k) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (mrow r h u k j) (row h u j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call mrow_full r h u k (- j 1)) (block))))
(lemma supp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (in_prefix (idx g u) v (len (idx g u))) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (call prefix_intro (idx g u) v i (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma in_col (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (col h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call in_col g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma flow_net_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row h u (len g)))
           (== (total_flow_in g h u) (col h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_mrow g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_at g h u v))
    (call mrow_full (idx g u) h u (len (idx g u)) (len g))
    (call in_col g h u (len g))))

(ghost-fn ins ((p (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p))) (>= (idx p v) 0))))
(ghost-fn srow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (srow h p u (- k 1)) (if (ins p (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn term ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (ins p u)
          (if (ins p v) 0 (get_flow h u v))
          (if (ins p v) (- 0 (get_flow h u v)) 0))))
(ghost-fn cutrow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cutrow h p u (- k 1)) (term h p u (- k 1))))))
(ghost-fn cut ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (cut h p (- a 1) b) (cutrow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn prow ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (prow h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (row h (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dsum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dsum h p (- a 1) b) (srow h p (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn esum ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (esum h p a (- b 1)) (if (ins p (- b 1)) (col h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn anet ((h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (anet h p n (- a 1)) (if (ins p (- a 1)) (net h (- a 1) n) 0)))))

(lemma cutrow_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (cutrow h p u k) (- (if (ins p u) (row h u k) 0) (srow h p u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_split h p u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (cut h p a b) (- (prow h p b a) (dsum h p a b))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_split h p (- a 1) b)
        (call cutrow_split h p (- a 1) b))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (esum h p (+ a 1) b) (+ (esum h p a b) (srow h p a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call esum_step h p a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma esum_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (b int))
  (ensures (== (esum h p 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (col h (- b 1) 0) 0))
        (call esum_zero h p (- b 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma swap_sums (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (dsum h p a b) (esum h p a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call swap_sums h p (- a 1) b)
        (call esum_step h p (- a 1) b))
      (call esum_zero h p b))))
(lemma anet_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (- (prow h p n a) (esum h p n a))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_split h p n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma anet_value (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (anet h p n a) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s a)) (net h s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call anet_value h p s t n (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma value_is_cut (params (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (conserved_net h s t n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (== (cut h p n n) (net h s n)))
  (body
    (call cut_split h p n n)
    (call swap_sums h p n n)
    (call anet_split h p n n)
    (call anet_value h p s t n n)))

(ghost-fn term_le ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v))))))
(ghost-fn flow_le ((cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b)))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (w int))
    (=> (and (ins p u) (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (not (ins p w))))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(lemma cutrow_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= k n))
  (ensures (<= (cutrow h p u k) (cutrow f p u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cutrow_mono h f p n u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cut_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (term_le h f p n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (cut h p a n) (cut f p a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call cut_mono h f p n (- a 1))
        (call cutrow_mono h f p n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h a b)) (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_range cap))
    (assert (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (< a (len h)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx h a))))))
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (cap_exact g cap))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_le (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len p) n) (closed_cut cap f p) (bounded cap f) (flow_le cap h n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (term h p u v) (term f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (if (ins p u)
      (if (ins p v) (block) (assert (not (resid cap f u v))))
      (if (ins p v) (assert (not (resid cap f v u))) (block)))))

(lemma valid_parts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (body))
(lemma net_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_flow h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))))
  (ensures (== (net h u n) 0))
  (body (call flow_net_eq g h u)))
(lemma beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g cap) (bounded cap f) (conserved_net f s t n)
    (== (len p) n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (ins p s) (not (ins p t)) (closed_cut cap f p)
    (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n))
    (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (call valid_parts g other s t)
    (forall ((u int)) (call net_other g other s t n u))
    (assert (conserved_net other s t n))
    (call flow_net_eq g other s)
    (call value_is_cut other p s t n)
    (call value_is_cut f p s t n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call valid_le g cap other n a b))
    (assert (flow_le cap other n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call edge_le cap f other p n a b))
    (assert (term_le other f p n))
    (call cut_mono other f p n n)
    (assert (== (flow_val g other s) (net other s n)))))

(ghost-fn resp_wit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v))))))))
(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))
            (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cap u v)))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow cap u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v)))))
(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap))
  (ensures (resp_wit g cap f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g cap f u v))))
(lemma resp_from_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (resp_wit g cap f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body))
(lemma resp_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (cap_sound g cap))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (call resp_all g cap f)
    (call resp_from_wit g cap f)))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (bounded cap f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_flow f) (conserved_net f s t n)
            (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w s) (!= w t))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f w) (total_flow_out g f w)))
  (body
    (call flow_net_eq g f w)
    (assert (== (net f w n) 0))))
(lemma our_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (cap_sound g cap))
    (call resp_ok g cap f)
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nonneg_at cap f u v))
    (assert (nonneg_flow f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call cons_at g f s t n w))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call flow_net_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int))
                      (s int) (t int) (n int) (val int))
  (requires
    (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (square f n) (cap_good g cap) (flow_inv cap f s t n val)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
    (== (len pos) n) (== (idx pos s) 0) (< (idx pos t) 0) (closed_cut cap f pos))
  (ensures (exists ((w (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g w s t) (== (flow_val g w s) val))))
  (body
    (call our_valid g cap f s t n val)
    (assert (ins pos s))
    (assert (not (ins pos t)))
    (assert (bounded cap f))
    (assert (conserved_net f s t n))
    (assert (== (net f s n) val))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call beats g cap f pos s t n other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val)))))

(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn ge_m1 ((pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) -1)))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((queue (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx pos w) 0))
    (and (< (idx pos w) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn queue_pos ((pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len pos))))
    (== (idx pos (idx queue k)) k)))))
(ghost-fn parents ((pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len pos)))
             (and (>= (idx pos (idx par w)) 0) (< (idx pos (idx par w)) (idx pos w))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par))) (and (!= w s) (>= (idx pos w) 0)))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn path_res ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< w (len par)))
             (and (!= w s) (and (>= (idx pos w) 0) (<= (idx pos w) lim))))
        (resid cap f (idx par w) w)))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0)))
        (not (resid cap f (idx queue k) w))))))
(ghost-fn partial ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w i)) (< w (len pos))) (< (idx pos w) 0))
        (not (resid cap f u w))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
