  (body (forall ((b int)) (=> (and (<= 0 b) (< b j))
    (=> (has_res cap flow u b) (<= m (vat h b)))))))
(ghost-fn cellv ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n)))
        (== (get_flow f1 p q) (if (and (== p a) (== q b)) x (get_flow f0 p q)))))))
(ghost-fn ediff ((e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (dl int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len e0) n) (== (len e1) n))
    (and (and (== (vat e1 a) (- (vat e0 a) dl)) (== (vat e1 b) (+ (vat e0 b) dl)))
      (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w a) (!= w b)))
        (== (vat e1 w) (vat e0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn updv ((h0 (seq int)) (h1 (seq int)) (u int) (x int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len h1) n) (and (== (vat h1 u) x)
    (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w u)) (== (vat h1 w) (vat h0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn pot ((e (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (s int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0
    (+ (pot e h s (- j 1)) (if (== (- j 1) s) 0 (* (vat e (- j 1)) (vat h (- j 1))))))))
(ghost-fn hsum ((h (seq int)) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0 (+ (hsum h (- j 1)) (vat h (- j 1))))))
(ghost-fn zero_m ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))) (== (get_flow f p q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn zero_v ((e (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len e) n) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (== (vat e w) 0))))))
(ghost-fn h_init ((h (seq int)) (n int) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x s)) (== (vat h x) 0)))))
(ghost-fn init_part ((cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n)))
        (== (get_flow f p q) (if (and (== p s) (and (< q i) (!= q s))) (get_flow cap p q) 0))))))
(ghost-fn tgt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int)) int
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
    (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) -1)))
(ghost-fn wt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int)) int
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
    (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1) -1)))
(ghost-fn wf_g ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (k int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
          (and (<= 0 (tgt g u k)) (< (tgt g u k) (len g)))))
    (forall ((u int) (k int) (o int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
               (and (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len (idx g u)))) (!= k o)))
          (!= (tgt g u k) (tgt g u o)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_src ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (=> (!= (get_flow c a b) 0) (has_capacity g a b (get_flow c a b)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u0 int) (i0 int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (k int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g a)))))
             (or (< a u0) (and (== a u0) (< k i0))))
        (== (get_flow c a (tgt g a k)) (wt g a k))))))
(ghost-fn cap_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (v int)) (=> (has_capacity g a b v) (== (get_flow c a b) v)))
    (cap_src g c n))))
(ghost-fn in_adj ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) false (or (== (tgt g u (- k 1)) v) (in_adj g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn adj_sum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0
    (+ (adj_sum g f u k (- j 1)) (if (in_adj g u k (- j 1)) (get_flow f u (- j 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn covered ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (or (in_adj g u d v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0))))))
(ghost-fn gf_nn ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (>= (get_flow f x y) 0))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((h (seq int)) (lv int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cnt h lv (- k 1)) (if (<= (vat h (- k 1)) lv) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn empty_lvl ((h (seq int)) (n int) (lv int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= (vat h x) lv)))))
(ghost-fn above ((h (seq int)) (l int) (x int)) bool
  (body (> (vat h x) l)))
(ghost-fn cross ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (p int) (q int)) int
  (body (if (and (above h l p) (not (above h l q))) (get_flow f p q)
    (if (and (not (above h l p)) (above h l q)) (neg (get_flow f p q)) 0))))
(ghost-fn cross_row ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (p int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0 (+ (cross_row f h l p (- j 1)) (cross f h l p (- j 1))))))
(ghost-fn cross_all ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (i int) (j int)) int (decreases i)
  (body (if (<= i 0) 0 (+ (cross_all f h l (- i 1) j) (cross_row f h l (- i 1) j)))))
(ghost-fn into_sum ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (p int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0
    (+ (into_sum f h l p (- j 1)) (if (above h l (- j 1)) (get_flow f p (- j 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn out_part ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (i int) (j int)) int (decreases i)
  (body (if (<= i 0) 0
    (+ (out_part f h l (- i 1) j) (if (above h l (- i 1)) (row_sum f (- i 1) j) 0)))))
(ghost-fn in_part ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (ci int) (j int)) int (decreases j)
  (body (if (<= j 0) 0
    (+ (in_part f h l ci (- j 1)) (if (above h l (- j 1)) (col_sum f (- j 1) ci) 0)))))
(ghost-fn net_part ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (i int) (ci int)) int (decreases i)
  (body (if (<= i 0) 0
    (+ (net_part f h l (- i 1) ci)
       (if (above h l (- i 1)) (- (row_sum f (- i 1) ci) (col_sum f (- i 1) ci)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cross_nn_all ((f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))) (>= (cross f h l p q) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cross_le_all ((f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n)))
        (<= (cross f1 h l p q) (cross f2 h l p q))))))
(ghost-fn bal ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (!= x s) (!= x t)))
        (== (row_sum f x n) (col_sum f x n))))))

(lemma mul_nn (params (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (>= (* a b) 0))
  (body))
(lemma mul_diff (params (p int) (q int) (r int))
  (ensures (== (- (* (- p q) r) (* p r)) (neg (* q r))))
  (body))
(lemma mul_sum (params (p int) (q int) (r int))
  (ensures (== (- (* (+ p q) r) (* p r)) (* q r)))
  (body))
(lemma mul_succ (params (d int) (r int))
  (ensures (== (* d (+ r 1)) (+ (* d r) d)))
  (body))
(lemma pot_arith (params (a0 int) (a1 int) (b0 int) (b1 int) (d int) (hu int) (hv int))
  (requires (== a1 (- a0 d)) (== b1 (+ b0 d)) (== hu (+ hv 1)) (>= d 1) (>= hv 0))
  (ensures
    (== (- (* a1 hu) (* a0 hu)) (neg (* d hu)))
    (== (- (* b1 hv) (* b0 hv)) (* d hv))
    (== (* d hu) (+ (* d hv) d))
    (>= (* d hv) 0))
  (body
    (call mul_diff a0 d hu)
    (call mul_sum b0 d hv)
    (call mul_succ d hv)
    (call mul_nn d hv)
    (assert (== (* a1 hu) (* (- a0 d) hu)))
    (assert (== (* b1 hv) (* (+ b0 d) hv)))
    (assert (== (* d hu) (* d (+ hv 1))))))

(lemma row_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (cellv f0 f1 a b x n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum f1 u j)
    (+ (row_sum f0 u j) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b j))) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call row_upd f0 f1 a b x n u (- j 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 u (- j 1))
          (if (and (== u a) (== (- j 1) b)) x (get_flow f0 u (- j 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma col_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (cellv f0 f1 a b x n) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i n)))
  (ensures (== (col_sum f1 v i)
    (+ (col_sum f0 v i) (if (and (== v b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a i))) (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) 0))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (> i 0)
      (block
        (call col_upd f0 f1 a b x n v (- i 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 (- i 1) v)
          (if (and (== (- i 1) a) (== v b)) x (get_flow f0 (- i 1) v)))))
      (block))))
(lemma excess_at (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (cellv f0 f1 a b x n) (excess_ok f0 e0 n) (ediff e0 e1 a b (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (vat e1 w) (- (col_sum f1 w n) (row_sum f1 w n))))
  (body
    (call row_upd f0 f1 a b x n w n)
    (call col_upd f0 f1 a b x n w n)
    (assert (== (vat e0 w) (- (col_sum f0 w n) (row_sum f0 w n))))
    (if (and (!= w a) (!= w b)) (assert (== (vat e1 w) (vat e0 w))) (block))))
(lemma excess_step (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (cellv f0 f1 a b x n) (excess_ok f0 e0 n) (ediff e0 e1 a b (- x (get_flow f0 a b)) n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (!= a b))
  (ensures (excess_ok f1 e1 n))
  (body (forall ((w int)) (call excess_at f0 f1 e0 e1 a b x n w))))
(lemma col_bound (params (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (entries f n) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (col_sum f v i)) (<= (col_sum f v i) (* 100000 i))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (> i 0)
      (block
        (call col_bound f n v (- i 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f (- i 1) v)) (<= (get_flow f (- i 1) v) 100000))))
      (block))))
(lemma row_bound (params (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (j int))
  (requires (entries f n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (row_sum f u j)) (<= (row_sum f u j) (* 100000 j))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call row_bound f n u (- j 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u (- j 1))) (<= (get_flow f u (- j 1)) 100000))))
      (block))))
(lemma excess_range (params (flow (seq (seq int))) (e (seq int)) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (entries flow n) (excess_ok flow e n) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (<= n 1000))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000000 (vat e w)) (<= (vat e w) 100000000)))
  (body
    (call col_bound flow n w n)
    (call row_bound flow n w n)
    (assert (== (vat e w) (- (col_sum flow w n) (row_sum flow w n))))))
(lemma fb_entries (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (entries cap n) (fbound cap flow n))
  (ensures (entries flow n))
  (body))
(lemma fbound_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (fbound cap f0 n) (cellv f0 f1 a b x n) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get_flow cap a b))))
  (ensures (fbound cap f1 n))
  (body))
(lemma ediff_nn (params (e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (u int) (v int) (d int))
  (requires (e_nn e0 s n) (ediff e0 e1 u v d n) (!= u s) (!= u v) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (vat e0 u))))
  (ensures (e_nn e1 s n))
  (body))
(lemma ediff_nn_init (params (e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (i int) (dl int))
  (requires (e_nn e0 s n) (ediff e0 e1 s i dl n) (!= i s) (>= dl 0))
  (ensures (e_nn e1 s n))
  (body))
(lemma label_pt (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (label cap f0 h n) (cellv f0 f1 a b x n)
            (or (and (== a u) (== b v)) (and (== a v) (== b u)))
            (== (vat h u) (+ (vat h v) 1))
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n)))
  (ensures (=> (has_res cap f1 p q) (<= (vat h p) (+ (vat h q) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 p q) (if (and (== p a) (== q b)) x (get_flow f0 p q))))
    (assert (== (get_flow f1 q p) (if (and (== q a) (== p b)) x (get_flow f0 q p))))
    (assert (=> (and (not (and (== p u) (== q v))) (not (and (== p v) (== q u))))
                (== (has_res cap f1 p q) (has_res cap f0 p q))))
    (assert (=> (has_res cap f0 p q) (<= (vat h p) (+ (vat h q) 1))))))
(lemma label_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (label cap f0 h n) (cellv f0 f1 a b x n)
            (or (and (== a u) (== b v)) (and (== a v) (== b u)))
            (== (vat h u) (+ (vat h v) 1)))
  (ensures (label cap f1 h n))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call label_pt cap f0 f1 h a b x n u v p q))))
(lemma pot_upd (params (e0 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (j int))
  (requires (ediff e0 e1 u v d n) (!= u v) (<= 0 u) (<= 0 v) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (== (pot e1 h s j)
    (+ (pot e0 h s j)
       (+ (if (and (< u j) (!= u s)) (- (* (vat e1 u) (vat h u)) (* (vat e0 u) (vat h u))) 0)
          (if (and (< v j) (!= v s)) (- (* (vat e1 v) (vat h v)) (* (vat e0 v) (vat h v))) 0)))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call pot_upd e0 e1 h n s u v d (- j 1))
        (if (and (!= (- j 1) u) (!= (- j 1) v))
          (assert (== (vat e1 (- j 1)) (vat e0 (- j 1))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma pot_nonneg (params (e (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (j int))
  (requires (e_nn e s n) (hbnd h n) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (>= (pot e h s j) 0))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call pot_nonneg e h n s (- j 1))
        (if (!= (- j 1) s)
          (block
            (assert (>= (vat e (- j 1)) 0))
            (assert (>= (vat h (- j 1)) 0))
            (call mul_nn (vat e (- j 1)) (vat h (- j 1))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma hsum_bound (params (h (seq int)) (n int) (j int))
  (requires (hbnd h n) (<= n 1000) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (<= (hsum h j) (* 2000 j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call hsum_bound h n (- j 1))
        (assert (<= (vat h (- j 1)) (- (* 2 n) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma hsum_upd (params (h0 (seq int)) (h1 (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (updv h0 h1 u x n) (<= 0 u) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
  (ensures (== (hsum h1 j) (+ (hsum h0 j) (if (< u j) (- x (vat h0 u)) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call hsum_upd h0 h1 n u x (- j 1))
        (if (!= (- j 1) u)
          (assert (== (vat h1 (- j 1)) (vat h0 (- j 1))))
          (assert (== (vat h1 (- j 1)) x))))
      (block))))
(lemma push_fin (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (e (seq int)) (e2 (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (pr_inv cap flow e h n s t) (is_active e n s t u) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (vat h u) (+ (vat h v) 1))
            (or (and (== a u) (== b v)) (and (== a v) (== b u)))
            (rect f2 n) (cellv flow f2 a b x n) (excess_ok f2 e2 n) (ediff e e2 u v d n)
            (and (<= 1 d) (<= d (vat e u))) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get_flow cap a b))))
  (ensures (pr_inv cap f2 e2 h n s t) (< (pot e2 h s n) (pot e h s n)) (>= (pot e2 h s n) 0))
  (body
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (>= (vat h v) 0))
    (call fbound_step cap flow f2 a b x n)
    (call ediff_nn e e2 n s u v d)
    (call label_step cap flow f2 h a b x n u v)
    (call pot_upd e e2 h n s u v d n)
    (call pot_arith (vat e u) (vat e2 u) (vat e v) (vat e2 v) d (vat h u) (vat h v))
    (call pot_nonneg e2 h n s n)))
(lemma res_read (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (rect cap n) (rect flow n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (has_res cap flow u b)
    (or (< (idx (idx flow u) b) (idx (idx cap u) b)) (> (idx (idx flow b) u) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx flow u)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx cap u)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx flow b)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow flow u b) (idx (idx flow u) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap u b) (idx (idx cap u) b)))
    (assert (== (get_flow flow b u) (idx (idx flow b) u)))))
(lemma low_from_label (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (label cap flow h n) (no_adm cap flow h u n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (low_m cap flow h u n (vat h u)))
  (body))
(lemma relabel_pt (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (h1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (label cap flow h n) (updv h h1 u (+ m 1) n) (low_m cap flow h u n m) (>= m (vat h u))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (=> (has_res cap flow a b) (<= (vat h1 a) (+ (vat h1 b) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (=> (has_res cap flow a b) (<= (vat h a) (+ (vat h b) 1))))
    (if (!= a u) (assert (== (vat h1 a) (vat h a))) (block))
    (if (!= b u) (assert (== (vat h1 b) (vat h b))) (block))

(lemma relabel_lbl (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (h1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (n int))

(lemma cnt_bound (params (h (seq int)) (lv int) (k int))

(lemma cnt_strict (params (h (seq int)) (lv int) (k int) (x int))

  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (<= (vat h x) lv))

  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (> (vat h x) lv))

  (decreases k)

(lemma gap_scan (params (h (seq int)) (n int) (lo int) (m int))
  (requires (>= (cnt h lo n) 1) (>= m 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (or (exists ((z int)) (and (and (< lo z) (<= z (+ lo m))) (empty_lvl h n z)))
               (>= (cnt h (+ lo m) n) (+ 1 m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call gap_scan h n lo (- m 1))
        (if (exists ((y int)) (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (== (vat h y) (+ lo m))))
          (block
            (obtain ((y2 int)) (and (and (<= 0 y2) (< y2 n)) (== (vat h y2) (+ lo m))))
            (call cnt_strict h (+ lo m) n y2))

      (block))))
(lemma gap (params (h (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (q int) (lo int))
  (requires (== (len h) n) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
            (<= (vat h p) lo) (>= (vat h q) (+ lo n)))
  (ensures (exists ((z int)) (and (and (< lo z) (< z (+ lo n))) (empty_lvl h n z))))
  (body
    (call cnt_has h lo n p)
    (call gap_scan h n lo (- n 1))
    (call cnt_miss h (+ lo (- n 1)) n q)))

(lemma no_cross (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (n int) (a int) (b int))

  (requires (excess_ok flow e n) (e_nn e s n) (not (above h l s)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))

(lemma no_tall (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (e (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (u int))
  (requires (label cap flow h n) (fbound cap flow n) (excess_ok flow e n) (e_nn e s n) (== (len h) n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u s) (> (vat e u) 0) (== (vat h s) n))
  (ensures (< (vat h u) (* 2 n)))

        (assert (cross_nn_all flow h l n))

        (assert false))

(lemma push_fin (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (e (seq int)) (e2 (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int) (d int) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (pr_inv cap flow e h n s t) (is_active e n s t u) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))

            (and (<= 1 d) (<= d (vat e u))) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get_flow cap a b))))
  (ensures (pr_inv cap f2 e2 h n s t) (< (pot e2 h s n) (pot e h s n)) (>= (pot e2 h s n) 0))
  (body
    (assert (!= u v))

    (call fbound_step cap flow f2 a b x n)
    (call ediff_nn e e2 n s u v d)

    (call pot_upd e e2 h n s u v d n)

(lemma res_read (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))

(lemma cnt_bound (params (h (seq int)) (lv int) (k int))

(lemma gap_scan (params (h (seq int)) (n int) (lo int) (m int))
  (requires (>= (cnt h lo n) 1) (>= m 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (or (exists ((z int)) (and (and (< lo z) (<= z (+ lo m))) (empty_lvl h n z)))
               (>= (cnt h (+ lo m) n) (+ 1 m))))
  (decreases m)

        (if (exists ((y int)) (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (== (vat h y) (+ lo m))))
          (block
            (obtain ((y2 int)) (and (and (<= 0 y2) (< y2 n)) (== (vat h y2) (+ lo m))))

(lemma gap (params (h (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (q int) (lo int))
  (requires (== (len h) n) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
            (<= (vat h p) lo) (>= (vat h q) (+ lo n)))
  (ensures (exists ((z int)) (and (and (< lo z) (< z (+ lo n))) (empty_lvl h n z))))
  (body
    (call cnt_has h lo n p)
    (call gap_scan h n lo (- n 1))
    (call cnt_miss h (+ lo (- n 1)) n q)))

(lemma cross_row_split (params (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (p int) (j int))

(lemma no_cross (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (h (seq int)) (l int) (n int) (a int) (b int))

  (requires (excess_ok flow e n) (e_nn e s n) (not (above h l s)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (above h l u) (> (vat e u) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i n)))

(lemma no_tall (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (flow (seq (seq int))) (e (seq int)) (h (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (u int))
  (requires (label cap flow h n) (fbound cap flow n) (excess_ok flow e n) (e_nn e s n) (== (len h) n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (!= u s) (> (vat e u) 0) (== (vat h s) n))
  (ensures (< (vat h u) (* 2 n)))

      (block

(ghost-fn cons_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (!= a s) (!= a t))) (== (rsum r a n) (rsum c a n))))))
(ghost-fn cell_set ((m0 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (mat_ok m n) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))
    (and (== (get_flow m u v) x)
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
            (=> (or (!= a u) (!= b v)) (== (get_flow m a b) (get_flow m0 a b)))))))))
(ghost-fn push_cell ((m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (w int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (mat_ok m n) (and (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n))))
    (and (!= p w)
      (and (== (get_flow m p w) (- (get_flow m1 p w) 1))
        (and (== (get_flow m w p) (+ (get_flow m1 w p) 1))
          (forall ((a int) (b int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
                (=> (and (or (!= a p) (!= b w)) (or (!= a w) (!= b p)))
                    (== (get_flow m a b) (get_flow m1 a b)))))))))))
(ghost-fn reach_par ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len ord) n) (== (len par) n))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x s)) (>= (idx ord x) 0))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx par x)) (< (idx par x) n))
               (and (and (>= (idx ord (idx par x)) 0) (< (idx ord (idx par x)) (idx ord x)))
                    (>= (get_flow r (idx par x) x) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ord) n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=> (and (>= (idx ord a) 0) (>= (get_flow r a b) 1)) (>= (idx ord b) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn queue_ok ((queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ord) n)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue)))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) n)) (== (idx ord (idx queue k)) k)))))))
(ghost-fn pos_ok ((queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ord) n)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
          (and (>= (idx ord x) -1)
               (=> (>= (idx ord x) 0)
                   (and (< (idx ord x) (len queue)) (== (idx queue (idx ord x)) x)))))))))
(ghost-fn closed_upto ((r (seq (seq int))) (queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (head int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ord) n)
    (forall ((k int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=> (>= (get_flow r (idx queue k) b) 1) (>= (idx ord b) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn partial_row ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len ord) n)
    (forall ((b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b v)) (< b n))
          (=> (>= (get_flow r u b) 1) (>= (idx ord b) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn walk_ok ((m (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (w int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len ord) n) (== (len par) n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
    (forall ((x int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x s))
               (and (>= (idx ord x) 0) (<= (idx ord x) (idx ord w))))
          (>= (get_flow m (idx par x) x) 1))))))
(ghost-fn walk_delta ((r0 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (w int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
        (== (rsum m a n) (- (+ (rsum r0 a n) (if (== a t) 1 0)) (if (== a w) 1 0)))))))

(ghost-fn bld_cells ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow m a b)) (<= (get_flow m a b) 100000))
             (=> (> (get_flow m a b) 0) (has_capacity g a b (get_flow m a b))))))))
(ghost-fn bld_rows ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len g) n)
    (forall ((a int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a u)) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
          (== (get_flow m a (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn bld_part ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len g) n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
    (forall ((e int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e i)) (< e (len (idx g u))))
          (== (get_flow m u (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))))))

(ghost-fn tmask ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (or (< u 0) (>= u (len g)))) false
          (or (and (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
              (tmask g u (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn msum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
          (+ (msum g f u k (- b 1)) (if (tmask g u k (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn flow_nonneg ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn flow_base ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (and (respects_capacity g f) (flow_nonneg f))))

(ghost-fn inn ((ss (seq int)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len ss))) (>= (idx ss u) 0))))
(ghost-fn ri ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (ri f ss u (- k 1)) (if (inn ss (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn ro ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (ro f ss u (- k 1)) (if (inn ss (- k 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))))
(ghost-fn ci ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (ci f ss u (- k 1)) (if (inn ss (- k 1)) (get_flow f (- k 1) u) 0)))))
(ghost-fn co ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (co f ss u (- k 1)) (if (inn ss (- k 1)) 0 (get_flow f (- k 1) u))))))
(ghost-fn dr ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dr f ss (- a 1) b) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (ri f ss (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dro ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dro f ss (- a 1) b) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (ro f ss (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dc ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dc f ss (- a 1) b) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (ci f ss (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dco ((f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (dco f ss (- a 1) b) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (co f ss (- a 1) b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn netsum ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
          (+ (netsum g f ss (- a 1) n)
             (if (inn ss (- a 1))
                 (- (rsum f (- a 1) n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f (- a 1) n))
                 0)))))

(ghost-fn mk_flow ((c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq (seq int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (body (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b) (pos_part (- (get_flow c a b) (get_flow r a b)))))))))
(ghost-fn fl_is ((fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (mat_ok fl n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (== (idx (idx fl a) b) (pos_part (- (get_flow c a b) (get_flow r a b)))))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma view_wf (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wf_view (view cg)))
  (body))

(lemma rsum_same (params (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (== (get_flow m2 u v) (get_flow m1 u v)))))
  (ensures (== (rsum m2 u k) (rsum m1 u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call rsum_same m1 m2 u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rsum_point (params (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (>= j 0)
            (== (get_flow m2 u j) (+ (get_flow m1 u j) d))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (!= v j)) (== (get_flow m2 u v) (get_flow m1 u v)))))
  (ensures (== (rsum m2 u k) (+ (rsum m1 u k) (if (< j k) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call rsum_point m1 m2 u j d (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rsum_nonneg (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (>= (get_flow m u v) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (rsum m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call rsum_nonneg m u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rsum_ub (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0)
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (<= (get_flow m u v) 100000))))
  (ensures (<= (rsum m u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call rsum_ub m u (- k 1)) (block))))

(lemma rsum_frame (params (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (w int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (push_cell m1 m p w n) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x p) (!= x w))
  (ensures (== (rsum m x n) (rsum m1 x n)))
  (body (call rsum_same m1 m x n)))
(lemma push_rows (params (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (w int) (n int))
  (requires (push_cell m1 m p w n))
  (ensures (== (rsum m p n) (- (rsum m1 p n) 1))
           (== (rsum m w n) (+ (rsum m1 w n) 1))
           (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (!= x p) (!= x w))) (== (rsum m x n) (rsum m1 x n)))))
  (body
    (call rsum_point m1 m p w -1 n)
    (call rsum_point m1 m w p 1 n)
    (forall ((x int)) (call rsum_frame m1 m p w x n))))
(lemma step_push (params (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (w int) (ca int) (cb int) (n int))
  (requires (mat_ok m1 n)
            (cell_set m1 m2 n p w (- ca 1))
            (cell_set m2 m n w p (+ cb 1))
            (!= p w)
            (== (get_flow m1 p w) ca)
            (== (get_flow m1 w p) cb))
  (ensures (push_cell m1 m p w n))
  (body))
(lemma step_same (params (r0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (p int) (w int) (n int))
  (requires (same_sums r0 m1 n) (push_cell m1 m p w n) (>= (get_flow m1 p w) 1))
  (ensures (same_sums r0 m n))
  (body))
(lemma step_delta (params (r0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (t int) (w int) (p int) (n int))
  (requires (walk_delta r0 m1 t w n) (push_cell m1 m p w n))
  (ensures (walk_delta r0 m t p n))
  (body (call push_rows m1 m p w n)))
(lemma step_walk (params (r0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int))
                         (s int) (w int) (p int) (n int))
  (requires (reach_par r0 ord par s n)
            (walk_ok m1 ord par s w n)
            (push_cell m1 m p w n)
            (and (>= (idx ord p) 0) (< (idx ord p) (idx ord w))))
  (ensures (walk_ok m ord par s p n))
  (body))
(lemma main_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (res_ok c r1 n) (cons_ok c r1 n s t) (same_sums r1 r2 n) (walk_delta r1 r2 t s n))
  (ensures (res_ok c r2 n) (cons_ok c r2 n s t))
  (body))
(lemma pair_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (res_ok c r n))
  (ensures (pair_bd r n))
  (body))

(lemma s_qok (params (q0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (queue_ok q0 o0 n) (upd o0 o1 v (len q0)) (appended q0 q1 v) (== (idx o0 v) -1))
  (ensures (queue_ok q1 o1 n))
  (body))
(lemma s_pos (params (q0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (pos_ok q0 o0 n) (upd o0 o1 v (len q0)) (appended q0 q1 v))
  (ensures (pos_ok q1 o1 n))
  (body))
(lemma s_par (params (r (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int))
                     (s int) (v int) (u int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (reach_par r o0 p0 s n)
            (upd o0 o1 v x)
            (upd p0 p1 v u)
            (== (idx o0 v) -1)
            (!= v s)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (>= (idx o0 u) 0) (< (idx o0 u) x))
            (>= (get_flow r u v) 1))
  (ensures (reach_par r o1 p1 s n))
  (body))
(lemma s_closed (params (r (seq (seq int))) (q0 (seq int)) (o0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))
                        (head int) (v int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (closed_upto r q0 o0 head n) (upd o0 o1 v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q1 v) (<= head (len q0)))
  (ensures (closed_upto r q1 o1 head n))
  (body))
(lemma s_part (params (r (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (partial_row r o0 u v n) (upd o0 o1 v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial_row r o1 u (+ v 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma s_skip (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (partial_row r ord u v n)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (=> (>= (get_flow r u v) 1) (>= (idx ord v) 0)))
  (ensures (partial_row r ord u (+ v 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma s_head (params (r (seq (seq int))) (queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (closed_upto r queue ord head n)
            (partial_row r ord u n n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue)))
            (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (closed_upto r queue ord (+ head 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma s_final (params (r (seq (seq int))) (queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (head int) (n int))
  (requires (pos_ok queue ord n) (closed_upto r queue ord head n) (== head (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut r ord n))
  (body))

(lemma bld_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (cp int))
  (requires (wf_view g)
            (== (len g) n)
            (bld_cells g m0 n)
            (bld_rows g m0 u n)
            (bld_part g m0 u i n)
            (cell_set m0 m n u v cp)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) cp)
            (and (<= 0 cp) (<= cp 100000)))
  (ensures (bld_cells g m n) (bld_rows g m u n) (bld_part g m u (+ i 1) n))
  (body (assert (has_capacity g u v cp))))
(lemma bld_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (== (len g) n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (bld_rows g m u n)
            (bld_part g m u (len (idx g u)) n))
  (ensures (bld_rows g m (+ u 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma bld_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (mat_ok m n) (== (len g) n) (bld_cells g m n) (bld_rows g m n n))
  (ensures (cap_mat g m n))
  (body))

(lemma mask_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (and (< i k) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (tmask g u k v))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1)) (call mask_intro g u i (- k 1) v) (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma mask_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                                  (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (tmask g u k v)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call mask_none g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma msum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (msum g f u 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block (call msum_zero g f u (- b 1)) (assert (not (tmask g u 0 (- b 1)))))
          (block))))
(lemma msum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
            (not (tmask g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (msum g f u (+ k 1) b)
               (+ (msum g f u k b)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) b))
                      (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
                      0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block
            (call msum_step g f u k (- b 1))
            (assert (== (tmask g u (+ k 1) (- b 1))
                        (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- b 1)) (tmask g u k (- b 1))))))
          (block))))
(lemma out_msum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_view g)
            (== (len g) n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (msum g f u k n)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call out_msum g f n u (- k 1))
            (call mask_none g u (- k 1) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
            (call msum_step g f u (- k 1) n))
          (call msum_zero g f u n))))
(lemma rsum_is_msum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                                  (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (tmask g u (len (idx g u)) v))))
            (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (== (msum g f u (len (idx g u)) b) (rsum f u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call rsum_is_msum g f n u (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma edge_of_flow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_base g f)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (!= (get_flow f u v) 0))
  (ensures (tmask g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
    (assert (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (has_capacity g u v e) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) e)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
    (call mask_intro g u i (len (idx g u)) v)))
(lemma flow_out_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u n)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_of_flow g f u v))
    (call out_msum g f n u (len (idx g u)))
    (call rsum_is_msum g f n u n)))

(lemma row_split (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (rsum f u k) (+ (ri f ss u k) (ro f ss u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call row_split f ss u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma col_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (+ (ci f ss u k) (co f ss u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call col_split g f ss u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (netsum g f ss a n)
               (- (+ (dro f ss a n) (dr f ss a n)) (+ (dco f ss a n) (dc f ss a n)))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call net_split g f ss (- a 1) n)
            (call row_split f ss (- a 1) n)
            (call col_split g f ss (- a 1) n))
          (block))))
(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (<= a 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f ss b a) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call dc_zero f ss (- b 1) a) (block))))
(lemma dc_peel (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 1))
  (ensures (== (dc f ss b a)
               (+ (dc f ss b (- a 1)) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (ri f ss (- a 1) b) 0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block
            (call dc_peel f ss (- b 1) a)
            (assert (== (ci f ss (- b 1) a)
                        (+ (ci f ss (- b 1) (- a 1))
                           (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (get_flow f (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0))))
            (assert (== (ri f ss (- a 1) b)
                        (+ (ri f ss (- a 1) (- b 1))
                           (if (inn ss (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0)))))
          (block))))
(lemma swap_dr (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (dr f ss a b) (dc f ss b a)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block (call swap_dr f ss (- a 1) b) (call dc_peel f ss b a))
          (call dc_zero f ss b a))))
(lemma conserved_sum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int))
                             (n int) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
                                  (== (rsum f u n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n))))
            (>= s 0)
            (inn ss s)
            (not (inn ss t))
            (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (netsum g f ss a n)
               (if (< s a) (- (rsum f s n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call conserved_sum g f ss n s t (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (is_conserved g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (rsum f u n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n)))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g f n u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n)))))
(lemma val_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (is_conserved g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (inn ss s) (not (inn ss t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (- (dro f ss n n) (dco f ss n n))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g f n s t u))
    (call conserved_sum g f ss n s t n)
    (call net_split g f ss n n)
    (call swap_dr f ss n n)
    (call flow_out_rsum g f n s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s n)))))

(lemma ro_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (inn ss u) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (inn ss x) (not (inn ss y))))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (ro f1 ss u k) (ro f2 ss u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ro_mono f1 f2 ss u (- k 1) n) (block))))
(lemma dro_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (inn ss x) (not (inn ss y))))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (dro f1 ss a n) (dro f2 ss a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call dro_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n)
            (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (call ro_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n n) (block)))
          (block))))
(lemma co_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (inn ss u) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (not (inn ss x)) (inn ss y)))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (co f1 ss u k) (co f2 ss u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call co_mono f1 f2 ss u (- k 1) n) (block))))
(lemma dco_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (not (inn ss x)) (inn ss y)))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (dco f1 ss a n) (dco f2 ss a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call dco_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n)
            (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (call co_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n n) (block)))
          (block))))

(lemma gf_nonneg (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_nonneg f))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
  (body))
(lemma other_le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (flow_base g other) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow other u v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow other u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len other))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx other u))))))
            (assert (> (idx (idx other u) v) 0))
            (obtain ((e int)) (and (has_capacity g u v e) (<= (idx (idx other u) v) e)))
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
                                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) e)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) e))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) e)))
          (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)))))
(lemma cross_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n) (flow_base g other)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
            (and (inn ord x) (not (inn ord y))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow other x y) (get_flow fl x y)))
  (body
    (call other_le_cap g c other n x y)
    (assert (== (get_flow r x y) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl x y) (pos_part (- (get_flow c x y) (get_flow r x y)))))))
(lemma cross_ge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n) (flow_base g other)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
            (and (not (inn ord x)) (inn ord y)))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow fl x y) (get_flow other x y)))
  (body
    (call gf_nonneg other x y)
    (assert (== (get_flow r y x) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl x y) (pos_part (- (get_flow c x y) (get_flow r x y)))))))
(lemma opt_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                       (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n)
            (flow_base g fl) (is_conserved g fl s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (inn ord s) (not (inn ord t))
            (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g fl s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (assert (flow_base g other))
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call val_cut g other ord s t n)
    (call val_cut g fl ord s t n)
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call cross_le g fl c r ord other n x y))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call cross_ge g fl c r ord other n x y))
    (call dro_mono other fl ord n n)
    (call dco_mono fl other ord n n)))

(lemma mk_flow_ok (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (fl_is (mk_flow c r n) c r n))
  (body))
(lemma fl_cap1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fl)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx fl u))))
            (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((e int)) (and (has_capacity g u v e) (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) e))))
  (body
    (assert (and (< u n) (< v n)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx fl u) v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
    (assert (>= (get_flow r u v) 0))
    (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
    (assert (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) (get_flow c u v)))))
(lemma fl_base_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n))
  (ensures (flow_base g fl))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fl_cap1 g fl c r n u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity g fl))
    (assert (flow_nonneg fl))))
(lemma fl_anti (params (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (== (- (get_flow fl u v) (get_flow fl v u)) (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow fl u v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl v u) (pos_part (- (get_flow c v u) (get_flow r v u)))))))
(lemma fl_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (- (rsum fl u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl u k)) (- (rsum c u k) (rsum r u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call fl_net g fl c r n u (- k 1))
            (call fl_anti fl c r n u (- k 1)))
          (block))))
(lemma fl_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                          (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g fl) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (cons_ok c r n s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g fl u) (total_flow_out g fl u)))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g fl n u)
    (call fl_net g fl c r n u n)
    (assert (== (rsum r u n) (rsum c u n)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g fl u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl u n)))))
(lemma fl_value (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (s int) (fv int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g fl) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
            (== (+ fv (rsum r s n)) (rsum c s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g fl s) fv))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g fl n s)
    (call fl_net g fl c r n s n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g fl s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl s n)))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))
                      (n int) (s int) (t int) (fv int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_mat g c n) (== (len g) n) (res_ok c r n) (cons_ok c r n s t)
            (== (+ fv (rsum r s n)) (rsum c s n))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (== (len ord) n)
            (>= (idx ord s) 0) (< (idx ord t) 0)
            (closed_cut r ord n))
  (ensures (exists ((f (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) fv))))
  (body
    (ghost-let fl (seq (seq int)) (mk_flow c r n))
    (call mk_flow_ok c r n)
    (call fl_base_ok g fl c r n)
    (forall ((u int)) (call fl_cons_at g fl c r n s t u))
    (assert (is_conserved g fl s t))
    (call fl_value g fl c r n s fv)
    (assert (inn ord s))
    (assert (not (inn ord t)))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g fl s t))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call opt_one g fl c r ord other n s t))
    (assert (is_max_flow g fl s t))
    (assert (== (flow_val g fl s) fv))))

(spec build_caps
  (params (graph capacity_graph))
  (returns (c (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (well_formed graph) (capacities_bounded (view graph)))
  (ensures (cap_mat (view graph) c (len (view graph))))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_caps
  (body
    (call view_wf graph)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len (view graph))))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b) 0)))))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (mat_ok m n))
      (invariant (bld_cells (view graph) m n))
      (invariant (bld_rows (view graph) m u n))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx (view graph) u))))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (mat_ok m n))
        (invariant (bld_cells (view graph) m n))
        (invariant (bld_rows (view graph) m u n))
        (invariant (bld_part (view graph) m u i n))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
        (let cp i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (== v (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) i) 0)))
        (assert (== cp (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) i) 1)))
        (assert (has_capacity (view graph) u v cp))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 cp) (<= cp 100000)))
        (ghost-let m0 (seq (seq int)) m)
        (set-idx (idx m u) v cp)
        (assert (cell_set m0 m n u v cp))
        (call bld_step (view graph) m0 m n u i v cp)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call bld_next (view graph) m u n)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call bld_done (view graph) m n)
    (return m)))

(spec search
  (params (r (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (ord (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)))
  (requires (mat_ok r (len r)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len r))) (<= (len r) 1000))
  (ensures (== (len ord) (len r))
           (== (len par) (len r))
           (>= (idx ord s) 0)
           (reach_par r ord par s (len r))
           (closed_cut r ord (len r)))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let n i64 (len r))
    (let-mut ord (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j) -1)))
    (set-idx ord s 0)
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j2) 0)))
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue s)
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (and (== (len ord) n) (== (len par) n)))
      (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences ord -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences ord -1) 0))
      (invariant (== (idx ord s) 0))
      (invariant (queue_ok queue ord n))
      (invariant (pos_ok queue ord n))
      (invariant (reach_par r ord par s n))
      (invariant (closed_upto r queue ord head n))
      (decreases (+ (* 2 (occurrences ord -1)) (- (len queue) head)))
      (let u i64 (idx queue head))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
      (assert (== (idx ord u) head))
      (let q0 i64 (len queue))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))))
        (invariant (>= (len queue) q0))
        (invariant (== (idx queue head) u))
        (invariant (and (== (len ord) n) (== (len par) n)))
        (invariant (== (idx ord u) head))
        (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences ord -1)) n))
        (invariant (>= (occurrences ord -1) 0))
        (invariant (== (idx ord s) 0))
        (invariant (queue_ok queue ord n))
        (invariant (pos_ok queue ord n))
        (invariant (reach_par r ord par s n))
        (invariant (closed_upto r queue ord head n))
        (invariant (partial_row r ord u v n))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (if (and (>= (idx (idx r u) v) 1) (== (idx ord v) -1))
          (block
            (assert (>= (get_flow r u v) 1))
            (assert (!= v s))
            (call count_member ord v (len ord))
            (ghost-let ord0 (seq int) ord)
            (ghost-let par0 (seq int) par)
            (ghost-let queue0 (seq int) queue)
            (let l i64 (len queue))
            (set-idx ord v l)
            (set-idx par v u)
            (push queue v)
            (assert (upd ord0 ord v l))
            (assert (upd par0 par v u))
            (assert (appended queue0 queue v))
            (call s_qok queue0 ord0 queue ord v n)
            (call s_pos queue0 ord0 queue ord v n)
            (call s_par r ord0 par0 ord par s v u l n)
            (call s_closed r queue0 ord0 queue ord head v l n)
            (call s_part r ord0 ord u v l n))
          (block
            (assert (=> (>= (get_flow r u v) 1) (>= (idx ord v) 0)))
            (call s_skip r ord u v n)))
