            (=> (>= (get_flow r u v) 1) (>= (idx ord v) 0)))
  (ensures (partial_row r ord u (+ v 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma s_head (params (r (seq (seq int))) (queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (closed_upto r queue ord head n)
            (partial_row r ord u n n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue)))
            (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (closed_upto r queue ord (+ head 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma s_final (params (r (seq (seq int))) (queue (seq int)) (ord (seq int)) (head int) (n int))
  (requires (pos_ok queue ord n) (closed_upto r queue ord head n) (== head (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut r ord n))
  (body))

(lemma bld_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (cp int))
  (requires (wf_view g)
            (== (len g) n)
            (bld_cells g m0 n)
            (bld_rows g m0 u n)
            (bld_part g m0 u i n)
            (cell_set m0 m n u v cp)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) cp)
            (and (<= 0 cp) (<= cp 100000)))
  (ensures (bld_cells g m n) (bld_rows g m u n) (bld_part g m u (+ i 1) n))
  (body (assert (has_capacity g u v cp))))
(lemma bld_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (== (len g) n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (bld_rows g m u n)
            (bld_part g m u (len (idx g u)) n))
  (ensures (bld_rows g m (+ u 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma bld_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (mat_ok m n) (== (len g) n) (bld_cells g m n) (bld_rows g m n n))
  (ensures (cap_mat g m n))
  (body))

(lemma mask_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (and (< i k) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (tmask g u k v))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ i 1)) (call mask_intro g u i (- k 1) v) (assert (== (- k 1) i)))))
(lemma mask_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                                  (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))
  (ensures (not (tmask g u k v)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call mask_none g u (- k 1) v) (block))))
(lemma msum_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (mask_sum g f u 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block (call msum_zero g f u (- b 1)) (assert (not (tmask g u 0 (- b 1)))))
          (block))))
(lemma msum_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u))))
            (not (tmask g u k (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))
  (ensures (== (mask_sum g f u (+ k 1) b)
               (+ (mask_sum g f u k b)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) b))
                      (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))
                      0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block
            (call msum_step g f u k (- b 1))
            (assert (== (tmask g u (+ k 1) (- b 1))
                        (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- b 1)) (tmask g u k (- b 1))))))
          (block))))
(lemma out_msum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_view g)
            (== (len g) n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (mask_sum g f u k n)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call out_msum g f n u (- k 1))
            (call mask_none g u (- k 1) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
            (call msum_step g f u (- k 1) n))
          (call msum_zero g f u n))))
(lemma rsum_is_msum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                                  (=> (!= (get_flow f u v) 0) (tmask g u (len (idx g u)) v))))
            (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (== (mask_sum g f u (len (idx g u)) b) (rsum f u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call rsum_is_msum g f n u (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma edge_of_flow (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_base g f)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (!= (get_flow f u v) 0))
  (ensures (tmask g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))))
    (assert (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (has_capacity g u v e) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) e)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
    (call mask_intro g u i (len (idx g u)) v)))
(lemma flow_out_rsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u n)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call edge_of_flow g f u v))
    (call out_msum g f n u (len (idx g u)))
    (call rsum_is_msum g f n u n)))

(lemma row_split (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (rsum f u k) (+ (ri f ss u k) (ro f ss u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call row_split f ss u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma col_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) (+ (ci f ss u k) (co f ss u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call col_split g f ss u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma net_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (ensures (== (netsum g f ss a n)
               (- (+ (dro f ss a n) (dr f ss a n)) (+ (dco f ss a n) (dc f ss a n)))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call net_split g f ss (- a 1) n)
            (call row_split f ss (- a 1) n)
            (call col_split g f ss (- a 1) n))
          (block))))
(lemma dc_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (<= a 0))
  (ensures (== (dc f ss b a) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call dc_zero f ss (- b 1) a) (block))))
(lemma dc_peel (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 1))
  (ensures (== (dc f ss b a)
               (+ (dc f ss b (- a 1)) (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (ri f ss (- a 1) b) 0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
          (block
            (call dc_peel f ss (- b 1) a)
            (assert (== (ci f ss (- b 1) a)
                        (+ (ci f ss (- b 1) (- a 1))
                           (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (get_flow f (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0))))
            (assert (== (ri f ss (- a 1) b)
                        (+ (ri f ss (- a 1) (- b 1))
                           (if (inn ss (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0)))))
          (block))))
(lemma swap_dr (params (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (dr f ss a b) (dc f ss b a)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block (call swap_dr f ss (- a 1) b) (call dc_peel f ss b a))
          (call dc_zero f ss b a))))
(lemma conserved_sum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int))
                             (n int) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (forall ((u int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
                                  (== (rsum f u n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n))))
            (>= s 0)
            (inn ss s)
            (not (inn ss t))
            (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (netsum g f ss a n)
               (if (< s a) (- (rsum f s n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s n)) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (call conserved_sum g f ss n s t (- a 1)) (block))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (is_conserved g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (rsum f u n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n)))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g f n u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n)))))
(lemma val_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g f) (is_conserved g f s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (inn ss s) (not (inn ss t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (- (dro f ss n n) (dco f ss n n))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g f n s t u))
    (call conserved_sum g f ss n s t n)
    (call net_split g f ss n n)
    (call swap_dr f ss n n)
    (call flow_out_rsum g f n s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s n)))))

(lemma ro_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (inn ss u) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (inn ss x) (not (inn ss y))))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (ro f1 ss u k) (ro f2 ss u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ro_mono f1 f2 ss u (- k 1) n) (block))))
(lemma dro_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (inn ss x) (not (inn ss y))))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (dro f1 ss a n) (dro f2 ss a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call dro_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n)
            (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (call ro_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n n) (block)))
          (block))))
(lemma co_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (inn ss u) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (not (inn ss x)) (inn ss y)))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (co f1 ss u k) (co f2 ss u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call co_mono f1 f2 ss u (- k 1) n) (block))))
(lemma dco_mono (params (f1 (seq (seq int))) (f2 (seq (seq int))) (ss (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n))
            (forall ((x int) (y int))
              (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (and (not (inn ss x)) (inn ss y)))
                  (<= (get_flow f1 x y) (get_flow f2 x y)))))
  (ensures (<= (dco f1 ss a n) (dco f2 ss a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
          (block
            (call dco_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n)
            (if (inn ss (- a 1)) (call co_mono f1 f2 ss (- a 1) n n) (block)))
          (block))))

(lemma gf_nonneg (params (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_nonneg f))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))
  (body))
(lemma other_le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (flow_base g other) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow other u v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body (if (> (get_flow other u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len other))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx other u))))))
            (assert (> (idx (idx other u) v) 0))
            (obtain ((e int)) (and (has_capacity g u v e) (<= (idx (idx other u) v) e)))
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
                                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) e)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) e))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) e)))
          (assert (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)))))
(lemma cross_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n) (flow_base g other)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
            (and (inn ord x) (not (inn ord y))))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow other x y) (get_flow fl x y)))
  (body
    (call other_le_cap g c other n x y)
    (assert (== (get_flow r x y) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl x y) (pos_part (- (get_flow c x y) (get_flow r x y)))))))
(lemma cross_ge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n) (flow_base g other)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
            (and (not (inn ord x)) (inn ord y)))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow fl x y) (get_flow other x y)))
  (body
    (call gf_nonneg other x y)
    (assert (== (get_flow r y x) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl x y) (pos_part (- (get_flow c x y) (get_flow r x y)))))))
(lemma opt_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                       (ord (seq int)) (other (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (closed_cut r ord n)
            (flow_base g fl) (is_conserved g fl s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (inn ord s) (not (inn ord t))
            (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g fl s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (assert (flow_base g other))
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call val_cut g other ord s t n)
    (call val_cut g fl ord s t n)
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call cross_le g fl c r ord other n x y))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call cross_ge g fl c r ord other n x y))
    (call dro_mono other fl ord n n)
    (call dco_mono fl other ord n n)))

(lemma mk_flow_ok (params (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (fl_is (mk_flow c r n) c r n))
  (body))
(lemma fl_cap1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len fl)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx fl u))))
            (> (idx (idx fl u) v) 0))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v))
           (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) (get_flow c u v)))
  (body
    (assert (and (< u n) (< v n)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx fl u) v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
    (assert (>= (get_flow r u v) 0))
    (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
    (assert (<= (idx (idx fl u) v) (get_flow c u v)))))
(lemma fl_wit_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n))
  (ensures (wit_all g fl c))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call fl_cap1 g fl c r n u v))))
(lemma resp_by (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wit_all g f c))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body))
(lemma fl_base_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_mat g c n) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n))
  (ensures (flow_base g fl))
  (body
    (call fl_wit_all g fl c r n)
    (call resp_by g fl c)
    (assert (flow_nonneg fl))))
(lemma fl_anti (params (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (== (- (get_flow fl u v) (get_flow fl v u)) (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow fl u v) (pos_part (- (get_flow c u v) (get_flow r u v)))))
    (assert (== (get_flow fl v u) (pos_part (- (get_flow c v u) (get_flow r v u)))))))
(lemma fl_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (- (rsum fl u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl u k)) (- (rsum c u k) (rsum r u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call fl_net g fl c r n u (- k 1))
            (call fl_anti fl c r n u (- k 1)))
          (block))))
(lemma fl_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                          (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g fl) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n) (cons_ok c r n s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g fl u) (total_flow_out g fl u)))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g fl n u)
    (call fl_net g fl c r n u n)
    (assert (== (rsum r u n) (rsum c u n)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g fl u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl u n)))))
(lemma fl_value (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (s int) (fv int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (== (len g) n) (flow_base g fl) (fl_is fl c r n) (res_ok c r n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
            (== (+ fv (rsum r s n)) (rsum c s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g fl s) fv))
  (body
    (call flow_out_rsum g fl n s)
    (call fl_net g fl c r n s n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g fl s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g fl s n)))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))
                      (n int) (s int) (t int) (fv int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_mat g c n) (== (len g) n) (res_ok c r n) (cons_ok c r n s t)
            (== (+ fv (rsum r s n)) (rsum c s n))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (== (len ord) n)
            (>= (idx ord s) 0) (< (idx ord t) 0)
            (closed_cut r ord n))
  (ensures (exists ((f (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) fv))))
  (body
    (ghost-let fl (seq (seq int)) (mk_flow c r n))
    (call mk_flow_ok c r n)
    (call fl_base_ok g fl c r n)
    (forall ((u int)) (call fl_cons_at g fl c r n s t u))

(spec advance_prefix
  (params (d (vec i64)) (k i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len d)))
    (digit_ok d)
    (not (all_top d k)))
  (ensures
    (== (len r) (len d))
    (digit_ok r)
    (==
      (radix_code r k)
      (+ (radix_code d k) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= k i) (< i (len d)))
        (== (idx r i) (idx d i)))))
  (effects))

(def advance_prefix
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec i64) d)
    (let last_index i64 (- k 1))
    (let last_digit i64 (idx work last_index))
    (if (< last_digit 100000)
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index (+ last_digit 1))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code work k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return work))
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index 0)
        (assert (> k 1))
        (assert (not (all_top work (- k 1))))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (let ((advanced (vec i64)))
          (call advance_prefix work (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (idx advanced last_index) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code advanced k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return advanced)))))

(spec sum_edges
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n)))
        (and
          (rows_well_formed rows)
          (and
            (digit_ok d)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))))
  (ensures
    (==
      total
      (edge_total rows d n u (len (idx rows u))))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_edges
  (body
    (call degree_bound rows u)
    (let-mut edge_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
    (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 edge_index)
          (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
      (invariant
        (==
          edge_acc
          (edge_total rows d n u edge_index)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 edge_acc)
          (<= edge_acc (* edge_index 100000))))
      (decreases
        (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
      (let endpoint i64
        (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
      (set edge_acc
        (+ edge_acc
           (idx d (+ (* u n) endpoint))))
      (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
    (return edge_acc)))

(spec sum_col
  (params
    (d (ref (slice i64))) (n i64) (u i64))

  (requires

      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))

        (and
          (digit_ok d)
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))))))

  (effects))

(def sum_col
  (body
    (let-mut col_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut col_index i64 0)
    (while (< col_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 col_index) (<= col_index n)))
      (invariant
        (== col_acc (col_total d n u col_index)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 col_acc)
          (<= col_acc (* col_index 100000))))
      (decreases (- n col_index))
      (set col_acc
        (+ col_acc
           (idx d (+ (* col_index n) u))))
      (set col_index (+ col_index 1)))
    (return col_acc)))

(spec check_cell
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64) (v i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (cell_allowed rows d n u v)))
  (effects))

(def check_cell
  (body
    (let flat_index i64 (+ (* u n) v))
    (let amount i64 (idx d flat_index))
    (if (== amount 0)
      (return true)
      (block
        (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
        (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 edge_index)
              (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
          (invariant
            (not
              (cell_prefix
                rows d n u v edge_index)))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
          (let endpoint i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 1))
          (if
            (and
              (== endpoint v)
              (<= amount capacity))
            (return true)
            (block))
          (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
        (return false)))))

(spec check_row
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))

      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (row_allowed rows d n u)))
  (effects))

(def check_row
  (body
    (let-mut vertex_index i64 0)
    (while (< vertex_index n)
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 vertex_index)
          (<= vertex_index n)))
      (invariant
        (forall ((j int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j vertex_index))
            (cell_allowed rows d n u j))))
      (decreases (- n vertex_index))
      (let ((cell_ok bool))
        (call check_cell
          rows d n u vertex_index))
      (if cell_ok
        (block)
        (return false))
      (set vertex_index (+ vertex_index 1)))
    (return true)))

(spec assess_matrix
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s0 i64) (t0 i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (rows_well_formed rows)
        (and
          (digit_ok d)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
              (!= s0 t0)))))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (matrix_ok rows d n s0 t0))
    (== value (matrix_value rows d n s0)))
  (effects))

(def assess_matrix
  (body
    (let-mut matrix_valid bool true)
    (let-mut source_value i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_index i64 0)
    (while (< outer_index n)
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 outer_index)
          (<= outer_index n)))
      (invariant
        (==
          matrix_valid
          (rows_prefix_ok
            rows d n s0 t0 outer_index)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> outer_index s0)
          (==
            source_value
            (matrix_value rows d n s0))))
      (decreases (- n outer_index))
      (let ((allowed bool))
        (call check_row rows d n outer_index))
      (if allowed
        (block)
        (set matrix_valid false))
      (let ((outgoing i64))
        (call sum_edges
          rows d n outer_index))
      (let ((incoming i64))
        (call sum_col d n outer_index))
      (if
        (and
          (!= outer_index s0)
          (!= outer_index t0))
        (if (== incoming outgoing)
          (block)
          (set matrix_valid false))
        (block))
      (if (== outer_index s0)
        (set source_value (- outgoing incoming))
        (block))
      (set outer_index (+ outer_index 1)))
    (return matrix_valid source_value)))

          (<= scan_index k)))
      (invariant (all_top d scan_index))
      (decreases (- k scan_index))
      (if (!= (idx d scan_index) 100000)
        (return false)
        (block))
      (set scan_index (+ scan_index 1)))
    (return true)))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (let-mut graph_holder capacity_graph graph)
    (let-mut rows (vec (vec (tuple i64 i64)))
      (replace
        (field graph_holder adj)
        (vec-new)))
    (let vertex_count i64 (len rows))
    (call graph_view_facts graph s)
    (assert (== rows (view graph)))
    (assert (rows_well_formed rows))
    (let cell_count i64
      (* vertex_count vertex_count))
    (let-mut digits (vec i64)
      (seq-build cell_count
        (fn (zero_index) 0)))
    (let-mut best_value i64 0)
    (ghost-let-mut best_flow (seq (seq int))
      (dense_matrix digits vertex_count))
    (call initial_champion
      graph digits vertex_count s t)
    (call code_bounds digits cell_count)
    (while true
      (invariant
        (== vertex_count (size graph)))
      (invariant
        (== rows (view graph)))
      (invariant
        (rows_well_formed rows))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 1 vertex_count)
          (<= vertex_count 1000)))
      (invariant
        (== cell_count
            (* vertex_count vertex_count)))
      (invariant
        (== (len digits) cell_count))
      (invariant (digit_ok digits))

(spec advance_prefix
  (params (d (vec i64)) (k i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len d)))
    (digit_ok d)
    (not (all_top d k)))
  (ensures
    (== (len r) (len d))
    (digit_ok r)
    (==
      (radix_code r k)
      (+ (radix_code d k) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= k i) (< i (len d)))
        (== (idx r i) (idx d i)))))
  (effects))

(def advance_prefix
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec i64) d)
    (let last_index i64 (- k 1))
    (let last_digit i64 (idx work last_index))
    (if (< last_digit 100000)
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index (+ last_digit 1))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code work k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return work))
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index 0)
        (assert (> k 1))
        (assert (not (all_top work (- k 1))))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (let ((advanced (vec i64)))
          (call advance_prefix work (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (idx advanced last_index) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code advanced k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return advanced)))))

(spec sum_edges
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n)))
        (and
          (rows_well_formed rows)
          (and
            (digit_ok d)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))))
  (ensures
    (==
      total
      (edge_total rows d n u (len (idx rows u))))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_edges
  (body
    (call degree_bound rows u)
    (let-mut edge_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
    (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 edge_index)
          (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
      (invariant
        (==
          edge_acc
          (edge_total rows d n u edge_index)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 edge_acc)
          (<= edge_acc (* edge_index 100000))))
      (decreases
        (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
      (let endpoint i64
        (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
      (set edge_acc
        (+ edge_acc
           (idx d (+ (* u n) endpoint))))
      (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
    (return edge_acc)))

(spec sum_col
  (params
    (d (ref (slice i64))) (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (== (len d) (* n n))
        (and
          (digit_ok d)
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))))))
  (ensures
    (== total (col_total d n u n))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_col
  (body
    (let-mut col_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut col_index i64 0)
    (while (< col_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 col_index) (<= col_index n)))
      (invariant
        (== col_acc (col_total d n u col_index)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 col_acc)
          (<= col_acc (* col_index 100000))))
      (decreases (- n col_index))
      (set col_acc
        (+ col_acc
           (idx d (+ (* col_index n) u))))
      (set col_index (+ col_index 1)))
    (return col_acc)))

(spec check_cell
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64) (v i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (cell_allowed rows d n u v)))
  (effects))

(def check_cell
  (body
    (let flat_index i64 (+ (* u n) v))
    (let amount i64 (idx d flat_index))
    (if (== amount 0)
      (return true)
      (block
        (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
        (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 edge_index)
              (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
          (invariant
            (not
              (cell_prefix
                rows d n u v edge_index)))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
          (let endpoint i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 1))
          (if
            (and
              (== endpoint v)
              (<= amount capacity))
            (return true)
            (block))
          (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
        (return false)))))

(spec check_row
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (row_allowed rows d n u)))
  (effects))

(def check_row
  (body
    (let-mut vertex_index i64 0)
    (while (< vertex_index n)
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 vertex_index)
          (<= vertex_index n)))
      (invariant
        (forall ((j int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j vertex_index))
            (cell_allowed rows d n u j))))
      (decreases (- n vertex_index))
      (let ((cell_ok bool))
        (call check_cell
          rows d n u vertex_index))
      (if cell_ok
        (block)
        (return false))
      (set vertex_index (+ vertex_index 1)))
    (return true)))

(spec assess_matrix
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s0 i64) (t0 i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (rows_well_formed rows)
        (and
          (digit_ok d)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
              (!= s0 t0)))))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (matrix_ok rows d n s0 t0))
    (== value (matrix_value rows d n s0)))
  (effects))

(def assess_matrix
  (body
    (let-mut matrix_valid bool true)
    (let-mut source_value i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_index i64 0)
    (while (< outer_index n)
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 outer_index)
          (<= outer_index n)))
      (invariant
        (==
          matrix_valid
          (rows_prefix_ok
            rows d n s0 t0 outer_index)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> outer_index s0)
          (==
            source_value
            (matrix_value rows d n s0))))
      (decreases (- n outer_index))
      (let ((allowed bool))
        (call check_row rows d n outer_index))
      (if allowed
        (block)
        (set matrix_valid false))
      (let ((outgoing i64))
        (call sum_edges
          rows d n outer_index))
      (let ((incoming i64))
        (call sum_col d n outer_index))
      (if
        (and
          (!= outer_index s0)
          (!= outer_index t0))
        (if (== incoming outgoing)
          (block)
          (set matrix_valid false))
        (block))
      (if (== outer_index s0)

(spec advance_prefix
  (params (d (vec i64)) (k i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len d)))
    (digit_ok d)
    (not (all_top d k)))
  (ensures
    (== (len r) (len d))
    (digit_ok r)
    (==
      (radix_code r k)
      (+ (radix_code d k) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= k i) (< i (len d)))
        (== (idx r i) (idx d i)))))
  (effects))

(def advance_prefix
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec i64) d)
    (let last_index i64 (- k 1))
    (let last_digit i64 (idx work last_index))
    (if (< last_digit 100000)
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index (+ last_digit 1))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code work k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return work))
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index 0)
        (assert (> k 1))
        (assert (not (all_top work (- k 1))))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (let ((advanced (vec i64)))
          (call advance_prefix work (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (idx advanced last_index) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (radix_code advanced k)
            (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return advanced)))))

(spec sum_edges
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n)))
        (and
          (rows_well_formed rows)
          (and
            (digit_ok d)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))))
  (ensures
    (==
      total
      (edge_total rows d n u (len (idx rows u))))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_edges
  (body
    (call degree_bound rows u)
    (let-mut edge_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
    (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 edge_index)
          (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
      (invariant
        (==
          edge_acc
          (edge_total rows d n u edge_index)))
      (invariant

(spec advance_prefix
  (params (d (vec i64)) (k i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len d)))
      (and (digit_ok d) (not (all_top d k)))))
  (ensures
    (== (len r) (len d))
    (digit_ok r)
    (== (radix_code r k) (+ (radix_code d k) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= k i) (< i (len d)))
        (== (idx r i) (idx d i)))))
  (effects))

(def advance_prefix
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec i64) d)
    (let last_index i64 (- k 1))
    (let last_digit i64 (idx work last_index))
    (if (< last_digit 100000)
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index (+ last_digit 1))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (assert
          (== (radix_code work k)
              (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return work))
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index 0)
        (assert (> k 1))
        (assert (not (all_top work (- k 1))))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (let ((advanced (vec i64)))
          (call advance_prefix work (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (idx advanced last_index) 0))
        (assert
          (== (radix_code advanced k)
              (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return advanced)))))

(spec sum_edges
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))

  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n)))
        (and
          (rows_well_formed rows)
          (and (digit_ok d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))))
  (ensures
    (== total (edge_total rows d n u (len (idx rows u))))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_edges
  (body
    (call degree_bound rows u)
    (let-mut edge_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
    (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 edge_index)
             (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
      (invariant
        (== edge_acc (edge_total rows d n u edge_index)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 edge_acc)
             (<= edge_acc (* edge_index 100000))))
      (decreases (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
      (let endpoint i64
        (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
      (set edge_acc
        (+ edge_acc (idx d (+ (* u n) endpoint))))
      (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
    (return edge_acc)))

(def sum_col
  (body

      (invariant (== col_acc (col_total d n u col_index)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 col_acc)

      (decreases (- n col_index))

  (params

(def check_cell
  (body
    (let flat_index i64 (+ (* u n) v))
    (let amount i64 (idx d flat_index))
    (if (== amount 0)
      (return true)
      (block
        (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
        (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 edge_index)
              (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
          (invariant
            (not (cell_prefix rows d n u v edge_index)))
          (decreases (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
          (let endpoint i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 1))
          (if
            (and (== endpoint v) (<= amount capacity))
            (return true)
            (block))
          (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
        (return false)))))

        (if (> (endpoint_occ r v (- k 1)) 0)
          (block
            (call endpoint_occ_witness r v (- k 1))
            (obtain ((j int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- k 1)))
                (== (get (idx r j) 0) v)))
            (if (== (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0) v)
              (block
                (assert (!= j (- k 1)))
                (assert
                  (!= (get (idx r j) 0)
                      (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0)))
                (assert false))
              (block)))
          (block)))
      (block))))

(lemma endpoint_sum_step
  (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (n int) (k int) (x int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r)))
    (== x (get (idx r k) 0)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (endpoint_sum r n (+ k 1))
      (+ (endpoint_sum r n k)
         (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) 1 0))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (> n 0)
      (block
        (call endpoint_sum_step r (- n 1) k x)
        (assert
          (==
            (endpoint_occ r (- n 1) (+ k 1))
            (+ (endpoint_occ r (- n 1) k)
               (if (== x (- n 1)) 1 0)))))
      (block))))

(lemma endpoint_sum_equals_length
  (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (n int) (k int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len r)))
    (row_range r n))
  (ensures (== (endpoint_sum r n k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call endpoint_sum_equals_length r n (- k 1))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0))
            (< (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0) n)))
        (call endpoint_sum_step
          r n (- k 1) (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (endpoint_sum r n k)
            (+ (endpoint_sum r n (- k 1)) 1)))
        (assert (== (endpoint_sum r n k) k)))
      (block))))

(lemma endpoint_sum_le_range
  (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (n int) (k int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len r)))

  (ensures (<= (endpoint_sum r n k) n))
  (decreases n)

  (ensures

(lemma bridge_dense_flow
  (params
    (cg0 capacity_graph) (d (seq int))
    (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int))
  (requires
    (well_formed cg0)
    (capacities_bounded (view cg0))
    (== n (size cg0))
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (digit_ok d)
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
    (!= s0 t0))
  (ensures
    (==
      (matrix_ok (view cg0) d n s0 t0)
      (is_valid_flow (view cg0) (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0))
    (==
      (matrix_value (view cg0) d n s0)
      (flow_val (view cg0) (dense_matrix d n) s0)))
  (body
    (call graph_view_facts cg0 s0)
    (call dense_shape d n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (call dense_out_point (view cg0) d n u))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call dense_in_point (view cg0) d n u))
    (call dense_nonnegative d n)
    (if (matrix_ok (view cg0) d n s0 t0)
      (block
        (call dense_respects (view cg0) d n)
        (call dense_conserved (view cg0) d n s0 t0))
      (block))
    (if (is_valid_flow
          (view cg0) (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0)
      (call dense_valid_implies_matrix_ok
        (view cg0) d n s0 t0)
      (block))
    (assert
      (==
        (matrix_ok (view cg0) d n s0 t0)
        (is_valid_flow
          (view cg0) (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0)))
    (call dense_out
      (view cg0) d n s0 (len (idx (view cg0) s0)))
    (call dense_in (view cg0) d n s0 n)
    (assert
      (==
        (matrix_value (view cg0) d n s0)
        (flow_val
          (view cg0) (dense_matrix d n) s0)))))

    (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int) (v0 int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (== (len before) (* n n))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (== (len q) (* n n))
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
    (!= s0 t0)
    (digit_ok q)
    (covered_through g before n s0 t0 v0)
    (==
      (radix_code after (len after))
      (+ (radix_code before (len before)) 1))
    (< (radix_code q (len q)) (radix_code after (len after)))
    (is_valid_flow g (dense_matrix q n) s0 t0))
  (ensures
    (<= (flow_val g (dense_matrix q n) s0) v0))
  (body
    (if
      (<= (radix_code q (len q))
          (radix_code before (len before)))
      (block)
      (assert false))))

(lemma canonical_out
  (params

      g (dense_matrix (canonical_digits f n) n) s0 t0))

    (forall ((u int))

(lemma canonical_flow
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len g) n)
    (rows_well_formed g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (is_valid_flow g f s0 t0)
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
    (!= s0 t0))
  (ensures
    (== (len (canonical_digits f n)) (* n n))
    (digit_ok (canonical_digits f n))
    (is_valid_flow
      g
      (dense_matrix (canonical_digits f n) n)
      s0 t0)
    (==
      (flow_val
        g
        (dense_matrix (canonical_digits f n) n)
        s0)
      (flow_val g f s0)))
  (body
    (call canonical_respects g f n s0 t0)
    (call canonical_nonnegative g f n s0 t0)
    (call canonical_conserved g f n s0 t0)
    (assert
      (is_valid_flow
        g
        (dense_matrix (canonical_digits f n) n)
        s0 t0))
    (call canonical_out
      g f n s0 (len (idx g s0)))
    (call canonical_in g f n s0 n)
    (assert
      (==
        (flow_val
          g
          (dense_matrix (canonical_digits f n) n)
          s0)
        (flow_val g f s0)))))

(spec advance_prefix
  (params (d (vec i64)) (k i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len d)))
      (and (digit_ok d) (not (all_top d k)))))
  (ensures
    (== (len r) (len d))
    (digit_ok r)
    (== (radix_code r k) (+ (radix_code d k) 1))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=>
        (and (<= k i) (< i (len d)))
        (== (idx r i) (idx d i)))))
  (effects))

(def advance_prefix
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec i64) d)
    (let last_index i64 (- k 1))
    (let last_digit i64 (idx work last_index))
    (if (< last_digit 100000)
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index (+ last_digit 1))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (assert
          (== (radix_code work k)
              (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return work))
      (block
        (set-idx work last_index 0)
        (assert (> k 1))
        (assert (not (all_top work (- k 1))))
        (call same_prefix_code d work (- k 1))
        (let ((advanced (vec i64)))
          (call advance_prefix work (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (idx advanced last_index) 0))
        (assert
          (== (radix_code advanced k)
              (+ (radix_code d k) 1)))
        (return advanced)))))

(spec sum_edges
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n)))
        (and
          (rows_well_formed rows)
          (and (digit_ok d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))))
  (ensures
    (== total (edge_total rows d n u (len (idx rows u))))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_edges
  (body
    (call degree_bound rows u)
    (let-mut edge_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
    (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 edge_index)
             (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
      (invariant
        (== edge_acc (edge_total rows d n u edge_index)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 edge_acc)
             (<= edge_acc (* edge_index 100000))))
      (decreases (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
      (let endpoint i64
        (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
      (set edge_acc
        (+ edge_acc (idx d (+ (* u n) endpoint))))
      (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
    (return edge_acc)))

(spec sum_col
  (params
    (d (ref (slice i64))) (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (total i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
      (and
        (== (len d) (* n n))
        (and (digit_ok d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))))))
  (ensures
    (== total (col_total d n u n))
    (and (<= 0 total) (<= total 100000000)))
  (effects))

(def sum_col
  (body
    (let-mut col_acc i64 0)
    (let-mut col_index i64 0)
    (while (< col_index n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 col_index) (<= col_index n)))
      (invariant (== col_acc (col_total d n u col_index)))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 col_acc)
             (<= col_acc (* col_index 100000))))
      (decreases (- n col_index))
      (set col_acc
        (+ col_acc (idx d (+ (* col_index n) u))))
      (set col_index (+ col_index 1)))
    (return col_acc)))

(spec check_cell
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64) (v i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))))))
  (ensures (== ok (cell_allowed rows d n u v)))
  (effects))

(def check_cell
  (body
    (let flat_index i64 (+ (* u n) v))
    (let amount i64 (idx d flat_index))
    (if (== amount 0)
      (return true)
      (block
        (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
        (while (< edge_index (len (idx rows u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 edge_index)
              (<= edge_index (len (idx rows u)))))
          (invariant
            (not (cell_prefix rows d n u v edge_index)))
          (decreases (- (len (idx rows u)) edge_index))
          (let endpoint i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx rows u) edge_index) 1))
          (if
            (and (== endpoint v) (<= amount capacity))
            (return true)
            (block))
          (set edge_index (+ edge_index 1)))
        (return false)))))

(spec check_row
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (u i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (digit_ok d)
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))))
  (ensures (== ok (row_allowed rows d n u)))
  (effects))

(def check_row
  (body
    (let-mut vertex_index i64 0)
    (while (< vertex_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 vertex_index) (<= vertex_index n)))
      (invariant
        (forall ((j int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j vertex_index))
            (cell_allowed rows d n u j))))
      (decreases (- n vertex_index))
      (let ((cell_ok bool))
        (call check_cell rows d n u vertex_index))
      (if cell_ok (block) (return false))
      (set vertex_index (+ vertex_index 1)))
    (return true)))

(spec assess_matrix
  (params
    (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (n i64) (s0 i64) (t0 i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (value i64))
  (requires
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 1 n) (<= n 1000))
        (and (== (len rows) n) (== (len d) (* n n))))
      (and
        (rows_well_formed rows)
        (and
          (digit_ok d)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
              (!= s0 t0)))))))
  (ensures
    (== ok (matrix_ok rows d n s0 t0))
    (== value (matrix_value rows d n s0)))
  (effects))

(def assess_matrix
  (body
    (let-mut matrix_valid bool true)
    (let-mut source_value i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_index i64 0)
    (while (< outer_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 outer_index) (<= outer_index n)))
      (invariant
        (== matrix_valid
            (rows_prefix_ok rows d n s0 t0 outer_index)))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (> outer_index s0)
          (== source_value (matrix_value rows d n s0))))
      (decreases (- n outer_index))
      (let ((allowed bool))
        (call check_row rows d n outer_index))
      (if allowed (block) (set matrix_valid false))
      (let ((outgoing i64))
        (call sum_edges rows d n outer_index))
      (let ((incoming i64))
        (call sum_col d n outer_index))
      (if
        (and (!= outer_index s0) (!= outer_index t0))
        (if (== incoming outgoing)
          (block)
          (set matrix_valid false))
        (block))
      (if (== outer_index s0)
        (set source_value (- outgoing incoming))
        (block))
      (set outer_index (+ outer_index 1)))
    (return matrix_valid source_value)))

(spec check_all_top
  (params (d (ref (slice i64))) (k i64))
  (returns (ok bool))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len d))))
  (ensures (== ok (all_top d k)))
  (effects))

(def check_all_top
  (body
    (let-mut scan_index i64 0)
    (while (< scan_index k)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 scan_index) (<= scan_index k)))
      (invariant (all_top d scan_index))
      (decreases (- k scan_index))
      (if (!= (idx d scan_index) 100000)
        (return false)
        (block))
      (set scan_index (+ scan_index 1)))
    (return true)))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (let-mut graph_holder capacity_graph graph)
    (let-mut rows (vec (vec (tuple i64 i64)))
      (replace (field graph_holder adj) (vec-new)))
    (let vertex_count i64 (len rows))
    (call graph_view_facts graph s)
    (assert (== rows (view graph)))
    (assert (rows_well_formed rows))
    (let cell_count i64 (* vertex_count vertex_count))
    (let-mut digits (vec i64)
      (seq-build cell_count (fn (zero_index) 0)))
    (let-mut best_value i64 0)
    (ghost-let-mut best_flow (seq (seq int))
      (dense_matrix digits vertex_count))
    (call initial_champion graph digits vertex_count s t)
    (call code_bounds digits cell_count)
    (while true
      (invariant (== vertex_count (size graph)))
      (invariant (== rows (view graph)))
      (invariant (rows_well_formed rows))
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 vertex_count) (<= vertex_count 1000)))
      (invariant
        (== cell_count (* vertex_count vertex_count)))
      (invariant (== (len digits) cell_count))
      (invariant (digit_ok digits))
      (invariant
        (champion
          (view graph) best_flow s t best_value))
      (invariant
        (covered_before
          (view graph) digits vertex_count s t best_value))
      (invariant
        (<= (radix_code digits cell_count)
            (maximum_code cell_count)))
      (decreases
        (- (maximum_code cell_count)
           (radix_code digits cell_count)))
      (let ((candidate_ok bool) (candidate_value i64))
        (call assess_matrix
          (borrow rows) (borrow digits)
          vertex_count s t))
      (call bridge_dense_flow
        graph digits vertex_count s t)
      (ghost-let old_value int best_value)
      (ghost-let old_flow (seq (seq int)) best_flow)
      (if
        (and candidate_ok (> candidate_value best_value))
        (block
          (set best_value candidate_value)
          (ghost-set best_flow
            (dense_matrix digits vertex_count)))
        (block))
      (call select_candidate
        (view graph) digits vertex_count s t
        old_value old_flow
        best_value best_flow
        candidate_ok candidate_value)
      (let ((digits_top bool))
        (call check_all_top (borrow digits) cell_count))
      (if digits_top
        (block
          (call finish_enumeration
            graph digits vertex_count s t
            best_value best_flow)
          (assert
            (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (is_max_flow (view graph) f s t)
                (== (flow_val (view graph) f s)
                    best_value))))
          (return best_value))

  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq int)) (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int)
   (pos int) (next int) (bound int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((cand (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (matrix_ok g cand n s0 t0)
          (and
            (prefix_equal cand base pos)
            (< (idx cand pos) next)))
        (<= (matrix_value g cand n s0) bound)))))

(ghost-fn canonical_digits
  ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq int)
  (body
    (if (> n 0)
      (seq-build (* n n)
        (fn (i)
          (get_flow f (/ i n) (% i n))))
      (seq-lit))))

(lemma well_formed_rows
  (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (rows_well_formed (view cg)))
  (body
    (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))

(lemma dense_shape
  (params (d (seq int)) (n int))

    (>= n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (dense_matrix d n)) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
        (== (len (idx (dense_matrix d n) u)) n))))
  (body))

(lemma dense_get
  (params (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))

      (idx (idx (dense_matrix d n) u) v)

(lemma edge_accept_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int) (v int) (x int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (edge_accept_prefix g u v x (+ k 1))
      (or
        (edge_accept_prefix g u v x k)
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) v)
          (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) k) 1))))))
  (body))

(lemma edge_accept_capacity
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (edge_accept_prefix g u v x (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((c int))
      (and
        (has_capacity g u v c)
        (<= x c))))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
    (assert
      (has_capacity
        g u v
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma row_prefix_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
    (row_prefix_allowed g d n u k)
    (cell_allowed g d n u k))
  (ensures (row_prefix_allowed g d n u (+ k 1)))
  (body))

(lemma col_total_step
  (params (d (seq int)) (n int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (> k 0))
  (ensures
    (==
      (col_total d n v k)
      (+
        (col_total d n v (- k 1))
        (dense_cell d n (- k 1) v))))
  (body))

(lemma edge_total_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (> k 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (<= k (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (edge_total g d n u k)
      (+
        (edge_total g d n u (- k 1))
        (dense_cell
          d n u
          (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))))

(lemma checked_prefix_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int) (u int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (checked_prefix g d n s0 t0 u)
    (row_allowed g d n u)
    (=>
      (and (!= u s0) (!= u t0))
      (==
        (col_total d n u n)
        (edge_total g d n u (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures
    (checked_prefix g d n s0 t0 (+ u 1)))
  (body))

(lemma row_length_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (n int) (u int))
  (requires
    (rows_well_formed g)
    (== (len g) n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
          (!= i j))
        (!=
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))

(lemma dense_respects_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (> n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (digit_ok d)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (row_allowed g d n u))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (> (idx (idx (dense_matrix d n) u) v) 0)
      (exists ((c int))
        (and
          (has_capacity g u v c)
          (<= (idx (idx (dense_matrix d n) u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (call dense_get d n u v)
    (assert (cell_allowed g d n u v))))

(lemma dense_respects
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (> n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (digit_ok d)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
        (row_allowed g d n u))))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g (dense_matrix d n)))
  (body
    (call dense_shape d n)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call dense_respects_point g d n u v))))

(lemma dense_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (> n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_out_recursive
        g (dense_matrix d n) u k)
      (edge_total g d n u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dense_out g d n u (- k 1))
        (call dense_get
          d n u
          (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma dense_in
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (== (len g) n)
    (> n 0)
    (== (len d) (* n n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_in_recursive
        g (dense_matrix d n) u k)
      (col_total d n u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call dense_in g d n u (- k 1))
        (call dense_get d n (- k 1) u))
      (block))))

(lemma matrix_ok_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (d (seq int)) (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int))
  (requires
    (matrix_ok g d n s0 t0)
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n)))
  (ensures
    (is_valid_flow
      g (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0))
  (body
    (call dense_respects g d n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (call dense_in g d n u n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call dense_out g d n u (len (idx g u))))
    (call dense_shape d n)
    (assert
      (is_valid_flow
        g (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0))))

(lemma matrix_value_dense
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

      (flow_val g (dense_matrix d n) s0)
      (matrix_value g d n s0)))
  (body
    (call dense_out g d n s0 (len (idx g s0)))
    (call dense_in g d n s0 n)))

(lemma canonical_totals
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

(lemma canonical_matrix_ok
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))

    (> n 0)

    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))

(lemma covered_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq int)) (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int)
    (pos int) (next int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 pos) (< pos (len base)))
    (covered g base n s0 t0 pos next bound)
    (forall ((cand (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (matrix_ok g cand n s0 t0)
          (prefix_equal cand base (+ pos 1)))
        (<= (matrix_value g cand n s0) bound))))
  (ensures
    (covered
      g base n s0 t0 pos (+ next 1) bound))
  (body))

(lemma covered_all
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq int)) (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int)
    (pos int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (covered g base n s0 t0 pos 100001 bound)
    (digit_ok base))
  (ensures
    (forall ((cand (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (matrix_ok g cand n s0 t0)
          (prefix_equal cand base pos))

(lemma maximum_certificate
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (n int) (s0 int) (t0 int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== (len g) n)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 n))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 n))
    (exists ((d (seq int)))
      (and
        (matrix_ok g d n s0 t0)
        (== (matrix_value g d n s0) bound)))
    (forall ((d (seq int)))
      (=>
        (matrix_ok g d n s0 t0)
        (<= (matrix_value g d n s0) bound))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (is_max_flow g f s0 t0)
        (== (flow_val g f s0) bound))))
  (body
    (obtain ((d (seq int)))
      (and
        (matrix_ok g d n s0 t0)
        (== (matrix_value g d n s0) bound)))
    (call matrix_ok_valid g d n s0 t0)
    (call dense_out g d n s0 (len (idx g s0)))
    (call dense_in g d n s0 n)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int))))
      (call canonical_matrix_ok
        g other n s0 t0))
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int))))
      (call canonical_value g other n s0))
    (assert
      (is_max_flow
        g (dense_matrix d n) s0 t0))
    (assert
      (==
        (flow_val g (dense_matrix d n) s0)
        bound))))

(spec inspect_matrix
  (params
    (cg capacity_graph)
    (d (ref (slice i64)))
    (s0 i64) (t0 i64))
  (returns
    (same_graph capacity_graph)
    (ok bool)
    (val i64))
  (requires
    (well_formed cg)
    (capacities_bounded (view cg))
    (> (size cg) 0)
    (<= (size cg) 1000)
    (== (len d) (* (size cg) (size cg)))
    (digit_ok d)
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 (size cg)))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 (size cg))))
  (ensures
    (== same_graph cg)
    (==
      ok
      (matrix_ok
        (view cg) d (size cg) s0 t0))
    (=>
      ok
      (==
        val
        (matrix_value
          (view cg) d (size cg) s0))))
  (effects))

(def inspect_matrix
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field cg adj)))
    (let-mut all_ok bool true)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant
        (==
          all_ok
          (checked_prefix
            (view cg) d n s0 t0 u)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut row_ok bool true)
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            row_ok
            (row_prefix_allowed
              (view cg) d n u v)))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (let x i64 (idx d (+ (* u n) v)))
        (if (> x 0)
          (block
            (let-mut found bool false)
            (let-mut j i64 0)
            (let degree i64
              (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
            (while (< j degree)
              (invariant
                (and (<= 0 j) (<= j degree)))
              (invariant
                (==
                  found
                  (edge_accept_prefix
                    (view cg) u v x j)))
              (decreases (- degree j))
              (let endpoint i64
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx (field cg adj) u)
                    j)
                  0))
              (let capacity i64
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx (field cg adj) u)
                    j)
                  1))
              (if
                (and
                  (== endpoint v)
                  (<= x capacity))
                (set found true)
                (block))
              (set j (+ j 1)))
            (if found
              (block)
              (set row_ok false)))
          (block))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (col_total d n u k)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 incoming)
            (<= incoming (* 100000 k))))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (set incoming
          (+ incoming
             (idx d (+ (* k n) u))))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut e i64 0)
      (let edge_count i64
        (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (while (< e edge_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 e) (<= e edge_count)))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (edge_total
              (view cg) d n u e)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 outgoing)
            (<= outgoing (* 100000 e))))
        (decreases (- edge_count e))
        (let destination i64
          (get
            (idx
              (idx (field cg adj) u)
              e)
            0))
        (set outgoing
          (+ outgoing
             (idx d (+ (* u n) destination))))
        (set e (+ e 1)))
      (if row_ok
        (block)
        (set all_ok false))
      (if
        (and (!= u s0) (!= u t0))
        (if (== incoming outgoing)
          (block)
          (set all_ok false))
        (block))
      (call checked_prefix_step
        (view cg) d n s0 t0 u)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (let-mut source_in i64 0)
    (let-mut source_k i64 0)
    (while (< source_k n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 source_k) (<= source_k n)))
      (invariant
        (==
          source_in
          (col_total d n s0 source_k)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 source_in)
          (<= source_in (* 100000 source_k))))
      (decreases (- n source_k))
      (set source_in
        (+ source_in
           (idx d (+ (* source_k n) s0))))
      (set source_k (+ source_k 1)))
    (let-mut source_out i64 0)
    (let-mut source_e i64 0)
    (let source_degree i64
      (len (idx (field cg adj) s0)))
    (while (< source_e source_degree)
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 source_e)
          (<= source_e source_degree)))
      (invariant
        (==
          source_out
          (edge_total
            (view cg) d n s0 source_e)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 source_out)
          (<= source_out (* 100000 source_e))))
      (decreases (- source_degree source_e))
      (let source_destination i64
        (get
          (idx
            (idx (field cg adj) s0)
            source_e)
          0))
      (set source_out
        (+ source_out
           (idx d
             (+ (* s0 n) source_destination))))
      (set source_e (+ source_e 1)))
    (return cg all_ok (- source_out source_in))))

(spec enumerate_matrices
  (params
    (cg capacity_graph)
    (digits (vec i64))
    (pos i64)
    (s0 i64) (t0 i64)
    (best i64))
  (returns
    (same_graph capacity_graph)
    (same_digits (vec i64))
    (result i64))
  (requires
    (well_formed cg)
    (capacities_bounded (view cg))
    (> (size cg) 0)
    (<= (size cg) 1000)
    (== (len digits) (* (size cg) (size cg)))
    (digit_ok digits)
    (and (<= 0 pos) (<= pos (len digits)))
    (and (<= 0 s0) (< s0 (size cg)))
    (and (<= 0 t0) (< t0 (size cg)))
    (!= s0 t0)
    (exists ((d (seq int)))
      (and
        (matrix_ok
          (view cg) d (size cg) s0 t0)
        (== (matrix_value
          (view cg) d (size cg) s0) best))))
  (ensures
    (== same_graph cg)
    (== (len same_digits) (len digits))
    (digit_ok same_digits)
    (prefix_equal same_digits digits pos)
    (>= result best)
    (exists ((d (seq int)))
      (and
        (matrix_ok
          (view cg) d (size cg) s0 t0)
        (== (matrix_value
          (view cg) d (size cg) s0) result)))
    (forall ((cand (seq int)))
      (=>
        (and
          (matrix_ok
            (view cg) cand (size cg) s0 t0)
          (prefix_equal cand digits pos))
        (<=
          (matrix_value
            (view cg) cand (size cg) s0)
          result))))
  (effects))

(def enumerate_matrices
  (decreases (- (len digits) pos))
  (body
    (let-mut work_graph capacity_graph cg)
    (let-mut work_digits (vec i64) digits)
    (let-mut work_best i64 best)
    (if (== pos (len work_digits))
      (block
        (let
          ((evaluated_graph capacity_graph)
           (candidate_ok bool)
           (candidate_value i64))
          (call inspect_matrix
            work_graph
            (borrow work_digits)
            s0 t0))
        (set work_graph evaluated_graph)
        (if
          (and
            candidate_ok
            (> candidate_value work_best))
          (set work_best candidate_value)
          (block))
        (call prefix_full_equal
          work_digits work_digits)
        (return work_graph work_digits work_best))
      (block
        (let-mut next_digit i64 0)
        (while (< next_digit 100001)
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 next_digit)
              (<= next_digit 100001)))
          (invariant
            (== work_graph cg))
          (invariant
            (== (len work_digits) (len digits)))
